// ⭐ BOOT TIMELINE LOGGER — persist ke sessionStorage (survive F5)
(function caBootTimeline() {
    var KEY = '__caBootTimeline';
    try { sessionStorage.removeItem(KEY); } catch(e) {}
    var log = [];
    var start = performance.now();
    var lastHas = null;
    var frames = 0;

    function snap() {
        frames++;
        var b = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        if (b) {
            var has = b.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-active');
            var booting = document.documentElement.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-booting');
            // Log setiap perubahan ATAU setiap 100ms (buat timeline)
            var changed = (lastHas !== null && has !== lastHas);
            var tick = (frames % 6 === 0); // ~10x/detik
            if (changed || tick) {
                log.push({
                    t: Math.round(performance.now() - start) + 'ms',
                    has: has,
                    boot: booting,
                    cols: getComputedStyle(b).gridTemplateColumns.slice(0, 40),
                    pref: localStorage.getItem('ca_cinema3_v9_enabled'),
                    chg: changed ? '★' : ''
                });
                // Cap biar tidak penuh
                if (log.length > 500) log.splice(0, log.length - 500);
                try { sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(log)); } catch(e) {}
            }
            lastHas = has;
        }
        if (frames < 600) requestAnimationFrame(snap); // ~10 detik cap
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(snap);
})();

// ⭐ NORMAL MODE BOOT GATE — mask F5 flash seperti cinema3
//    Hanya aktif kalau cinema3 DISABLED
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
(function caNormalBootGate() {
    'use strict';
    if (localStorage.getItem('ca_cinema3_v9_enabled') === '1') return;

    var attempts = 0;

    function inject() {
        attempts++;
        if (!document.documentElement) {
            if (attempts < 200) return setTimeout(inject, 5);
            return;
        }

        document.documentElement.classList.add('ca-normal-booting');

        if (document.getElementById('ca-normal-boot-style')) return;

        var parent = document.head || document.documentElement;
        if (!parent) {
            if (attempts < 200) return setTimeout(inject, 5);
            return;
        }

        try {
            var style = document.createElement('style');
            style.id = 'ca-normal-boot-style';
            style.textContent = `
                html.ca-normal-booting body > * {
                    visibility: hidden !important;
                    opacity: 0 !important;
                }
                html.ca-normal-booting #ca-normal-boot-overlay,
                html.ca-normal-booting #ca-indicator {
                    visibility: visible !important;
                    opacity: 1 !important;
                }
                html.ca-normal-booting #local-video-wrapper,
                html.ca-normal-booting #remote-video-wrapper,
                html.ca-normal-booting .chat,
                html.ca-normal-booting .buttons,
                html.ca-normal-booting .roulette-box,
                html.ca-normal-booting .app,
                html.ca-normal-booting #ca-floating-box,
                html.ca-normal-booting #ca-global-status,
                html.ca-normal-booting .media-devices__wrapper {
                    transition: none !important;
                    animation: none !important;
                }
            `;
            parent.appendChild(style);

            // Overlay appended ke documentElement (bukan body) → tidak kena hide rule
            var overlay = document.createElement('div');
            overlay.id = 'ca-normal-boot-overlay';
            overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;z-index:2147483646!important;background:#0b0f19!important;pointer-events:none!important;transition:opacity 0.25s ease!important;';
            document.documentElement.appendChild(overlay);

            releaseLoop();
        } catch (e) {
            if (attempts < 200) return setTimeout(inject, 5);
        }
    }

    var released = false;
    function release(reason) {
        if (released) return;
        released = true;
        var overlay = document.getElementById('ca-normal-boot-overlay');
        if (overlay) {
            overlay.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(function() {
                if (overlay.parentNode) overlay.parentNode.removeChild(overlay);
            }, 300);
        }
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('ca-normal-booting');
        try { console.log('[CA-NORMAL-BOOT] released (' + reason + ')'); } catch(e) {}
    }

    function releaseLoop() {
        var start = Date.now();
        var MIN = 300;
        var MAX = 1800;
        var stableHits = 0;
        var STABLE_REQUIRED = 8;

        function isLayoutStable() {
            // 1) Grid sudah ter-render (panel content siap)
            var panel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
            if (panel) {
                var grid = panel.querySelector('.ca-country-grid');
                if (!grid || grid.childElementCount === 0) return false;
            }

            // 2) Video wrappers sudah punya ukuran stabil
            var rv = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
            var lv = document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper');
            if (!rv || !lv) return false;
            var rvr = rv.getBoundingClientRect();
            var lvr = lv.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (rvr.width < 100 || rvr.height < 100) return false;
            if (lvr.width < 50  || lvr.height < 50)  return false;

            // 3) Native buttons + chat sudah settle (sumber utama glitch)
            //    ⭐ FIX MOBILE: threshold width harus scale-aware — di mobile
            //    viewport < 420px, `.buttons` cuma 50% viewport (~175-200px)
            //    sehingga threshold hardcoded 200px = false positive → hang
            //    sampai timeout-1800. Pakai min(200, 40% viewport).
            var btn = document.querySelector('.buttons');
            if (btn) {
                var br = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
                var minBtnW = Math.min(200, Math.floor(window.innerWidth * 0.4));
                if (br.width < minBtnW || br.height < 40) return false;
            }
            var chat = document.querySelector('.chat');
            if (chat) {
                var cr = chat.getBoundingClientRect();
                // ⭐ Chat: threshold sudah aman (chat butuh text space, selalu > 100px
                //    di viewport wajar) — tapi tambah scale guard untuk konsistensi
                var minChatW = Math.min(100, Math.floor(window.innerWidth * 0.25));
                if (cr.width < minChatW || cr.height < 100) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        function check() {
            var elapsed = Date.now() - start;
            if (elapsed > MAX) { release('timeout-' + elapsed); return; }
            if (elapsed < MIN) { setTimeout(check, 30); return; }
            if (document.readyState === 'loading') { setTimeout(check, 30); return; }

            if (isLayoutStable()) {
                stableHits++;
                if (stableHits >= STABLE_REQUIRED) {
                    release('stable-' + elapsed + 'ms');
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                stableHits = 0;
            }
            setTimeout(check, 30);
        }
        setTimeout(check, 30);
    }

    inject();
    setTimeout(function() { release('safety-2s'); }, 2000);
})();
// ⭐ FIX #5: Post-boot init barrier (DUAL-PATH)
//   - Cinema3 user → tunggu event 'ca-cinema-boot-done' (dari release())
//   - Non-cinema3 user → flush setelah DOMContentLoaded + 50ms
// Tanpa dual-path, non-cinema3 akan tergantung 5s safety timeout = regresi.
(function caBootBarrier() {
    'use strict';
    if (window.__caBootBarrierInstalled) return;
    window.__caBootBarrierInstalled = true;

    var queue = [];
    var released = false;

    window.__caAfterBoot = function(fn) {
        if (typeof fn !== 'function') return;
        if (released) {
            // Sudah lewat — jalankan segera (async untuk safety)
            setTimeout(function() { try { fn(); } catch(e) {} }, 0);
            return;
        }
        queue.push(fn);
    };

    function flush(reason) {
        if (released) return;
        released = true;
        var q = queue;
        queue = [];
        if (q.length > 0) {
            try { console.log('[CA-BOOT-BARRIER] flushing ' + q.length + ' initializer (reason: ' + reason + ')'); } catch(_) {}
        }
        // Serialize execution — 1 per frame untuk cegah frame spike
        var i = 0;
        function next() {
            if (i >= q.length) return;
            try { q[i](); } catch(e) {}
            i++;
            requestAnimationFrame(next);
        }
        next();
    }

    var W = typeof unsafeWindow !== 'undefined' ? unsafeWindow : window;
    var isCinema3 = false;
    try { isCinema3 = localStorage.getItem('ca_cinema3_v9_enabled') === '1'; } catch(e) {}

    if (isCinema3) {
        // Path A — cinema3: tunggu event boot-done
               W.addEventListener('ca-cinema-boot-done', function() { flush('event'); }, { once: true });
        // ⭐ FIX F5: 2000ms (was 5000) — verify emergency release at 2s
        setTimeout(function() { flush('timeout-2s'); }, 2000);
    } else {
        // Path B — normal mode: flush setelah DOM ready
        var fire = function() {
            setTimeout(function() { flush('dom-ready'); }, 50);
        };
        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fire, { once: true });
        } else {
            fire();
        }
        // Safety: kalau DOMContentLoaded tidak fire (jarang)
        setTimeout(function() { flush('timeout-1s'); }, 1000);
    }
})();

(function() {

    var W = typeof unsafeWindow !== 'undefined' ? unsafeWindow : window;
        // ===== SCHEDULER =====
    // Semua periodic task masuk salah satu dari 4 bucket.
    // Menggantikan ~37 setInterval → 4 setInterval.
        var __caTimers = { t250: [], t500: [], t1000: [], t2000: [], t5000: [] };
window.__caTimers = __caTimers;   // ⭐ FIX #1
    var __caTimersPaused = false;
    window.__caOn250  = function(fn) { __caTimers.t250.push(fn); };
    window.__caOn500  = function(fn) { __caTimers.t500.push(fn); };
    window.__caOn1000 = function(fn) { __caTimers.t1000.push(fn); };
    window.__caOn2000 = function(fn) { __caTimers.t2000.push(fn); };
    window.__caOn5000 = function(fn) { __caTimers.t5000.push(fn); };
    window.__caTimerPause  = function(v) { __caTimersPaused = !!v; };
    window.__caTimerDebug  = function() {
        return {
            t250:  __caTimers.t250.length,
            t500:  __caTimers.t500.length,
            t1000: __caTimers.t1000.length,
            t2000: __caTimers.t2000.length,
            t5000: __caTimers.t5000.length,
            paused: __caTimersPaused
        };
    };
    function __caRunBucket(arr) {
        if (__caTimersPaused) return;
        for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
            try { arr[i](); } catch(e) {
                var fn = arr[i];
                fn.__caErrCount = (fn.__caErrCount || 0) + 1;
                if (fn.__caErrCount <= 3) console.warn('[CA-TIMER]', fn.name || 'anon', e);
            }
        }
    }
    setInterval(function() { __caRunBucket(__caTimers.t250);  }, 250);
    setInterval(function() { __caRunBucket(__caTimers.t500);  }, 500);
    setInterval(function() { __caRunBucket(__caTimers.t1000); }, 1000);
    setInterval(function() { __caRunBucket(__caTimers.t2000); }, 2000);
    setInterval(function() { __caRunBucket(__caTimers.t5000); }, 5000);

       W.__mscUserSwitching = false;

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ⭐ CA BODY BUS — single MutationObserver for document.body (v1)
    //    Pengganti 5 observer subtree:true yang terpisah.
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    (function caBodyBusInit() {
        if (window.__caBodyBus) return;
        var subs = [];
        var __caBusPending = [];
var __caBusSched = false;
var bus = new MutationObserver(function(muts) {
    if (subs.length === 0) return;
    for (var i = 0; i < muts.length; i++) {
        var m = muts[i];
        // ⭐ FIX F5: tangkap textContent in-place update (Searching → Connection)
        if (m.type === 'characterData') {
            var pt = m.target.parentElement;
            if (pt && pt.nodeType === 1 && pt.closest &&
                pt.closest('.message, .message__system')) {
                __caBusPending.push(pt);
            }
            continue;
        }
        var nodes = m.addedNodes;
        if (!nodes || nodes.length === 0) continue;
        for (var j = 0; j < nodes.length; j++) {
            var n = nodes[j];
            if (n.nodeType === 1) __caBusPending.push(n);
        }
    }
    if (__caBusSched) return;
    __caBusSched = true;
        requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        __caBusSched = false;
        var batch = __caBusPending;
        __caBusPending = [];

        // ⭐ FIX: raise cap 200→500, overflow PROCESSED (not dropped)
        var CAP = 500;
        if (batch.length > CAP) {
            var overflow = batch.splice(0, batch.length - CAP);
            for (var oi = 0; oi < subs.length; oi++) {
                for (var om = 0; om < overflow.length; om++) {
                    try { subs[oi](overflow[om]); } catch(e) {}
                }
            }
        }
        for (var k = 0; k < subs.length; k++) {
            for (var m = 0; m < batch.length; m++) {
                try { subs[k](batch[m]); } catch(e) {}
            }
        }
    });
});
        window.__caBodyBus = {
            subscribe: function(fn) {
                if (typeof fn === 'function') { subs.push(fn); return fn; }
            },
            unsubscribe: function(fn) {
                var i = subs.indexOf(fn);
                if (i !== -1) subs.splice(i, 1);
            }
        };
                               if (document.body) {
            bus.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
        } else {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                bus.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
            }, { once: true });
        }
    })();

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ⭐ CA MOUSE BUS — single mousemove for all subscribers
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        (function caMouseBus() {
        if (window.__caMouseBus) return;
        var subs = [];
        var x = -1, y = -1, raf = 0;
        window.__caMouseBus = {
            subscribe: function (fn) {
                if (typeof fn === 'function') { subs.push(fn); return fn; }
            }
        };
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
            x = e.clientX; y = e.clientY;
            if (raf) return;
            raf = requestAnimationFrame(function () {
                raf = 0;
                for (var i = 0; i < subs.length; i++) {
                    try { subs[i](x, y); } catch (err) {}
                }
            });
        }, { passive: true, capture: true });
    })();

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ⭐ CA RESIZE BUS — single ResizeObserver per element
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    (function caResizeBus() {
        if (window.__caResizeBus) return;
        var map = new WeakMap();
        window.__caResizeBus = {
            subscribe: function (el, fn) {
                if (!el || typeof fn !== 'function') return;
                var arr = map.get(el);
                if (!arr) {
                    arr = [];
                    map.set(el, arr);
                    try {
                        new ResizeObserver(function () {
                            for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                                try { arr[i](); } catch (e) {}
                            }
                        }).observe(el);
                    } catch (e) {}
                }
                arr.push(fn);
            }
        };
    })();

    function caIsChatElement(el) {
        if (!el) return false;
        try {
            if (el.isContentEditable) return true;
            if (el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute('contenteditable') === 'true') return true;
            if (el.closest && el.closest(
                '.chat, .chat-container, ' +
                '[class*="chat__"], [class*="chat-"], ' +
                '[class*="message-input"], [class*="chat-input"], ' +
                '.chat__body, .chat__messages, ' +
                '.message, .message-bubble, ' +
                '[data-ca-allow-keyboard]'
            )) return true;
        } catch(e) {}
        return false;
    }

    // ===== MODULE C: NETWORK HIJACK =====
    var origFetch = W.fetch.bind(W);
    var BLOB_HOST = 'blob:' + location.origin + '/';
    W.fetch = function() {
        var url = arguments[0];
        var urlStr = typeof url === 'string' ? url : (url && url.url) || '';
        if (urlStr.indexOf(BLOB_HOST) === 0) {
            var path = urlStr.substring(BLOB_HOST.length);
            var realUrl = 'https://roulette.apps-host.com/' + path;
            if (typeof url === 'string') arguments[0] = realUrl;
            else if (url && url.url) arguments[0] = new Request(realUrl, url);
        }
        return origFetch.apply(this, arguments);
    };

    var hijackDone = false;
    var ALL_237 = ['AD','AE','AF','AG','AI','AL','AM','AO','AR','AS','AT','AU','AW','AX','AZ','BA','BB','BD','BE','BF','BG','BH','BI','BJ','BL','BM','BN','BO','BQ','BR','BS','BT','BW','BY','BZ','CA','CC','CD','CF','CG','CH','CI','CK','CL','CM','CN','CO','CR','CU','CV','CW','CX','CY','CZ','DE','DJ','DK','DM','DO','DZ','EC','EE','EG','ER','ES','ET','FI','FJ','FK','FM','FO','FR','GA','GB','GD','GE','GF','GG','GH','GI','GL','GM','GN','GP','GQ','GR','GT','GU','GW','GY','HK','HN','HR','HT','HU','ID','IE','IL','IM','IN','IQ','IR','IS','IT','JE','JM','JO','JP','KE','KG','KH','KI','KM','KN','KP','KR','KW','KY','KZ','LA','LB','LC','LI','LK','LR','LS','LT','LU','LV','LY','MA','MC','MD','ME','MF','MG','MH','MK','ML','MM','MN','MO','MP','MQ','MR','MS','MT','MU','MV','MW','MX','MY','MZ','NA','NC','NE','NG','NI','NL','NO','NP','NR','NU','NZ','OM','PA','PE','PF','PG','PH','PK','PL','PM','PR','PS','PT','PW','PY','QA','RE','RO','RS','RU','RW','SA','SB','SC','SD','SE','SG','SH','SI','SK','SL','SM','SN','SO','SR','SS','ST','SV','SX','SY','SZ','TC','TD','TG','TH','TJ','TK','TL','TM','TN','TO','TR','TT','TV','TW','TZ','UA','UG','US','UY','UZ','VC','VE','VG','VI','VN','VU','WF','WS','YE','YT','ZA','ZM','ZW'];

    var HIJACK_DOMAINS_RE = /roulette\.apps-host\.com|ome\.tv|chatalternative\.com|chatruletka\.com|chatruletka\.co|minichat\.com/;

    function hijackMainScript(scriptNode) {
    if (hijackDone) return;
    hijackDone = true;
    var parent = scriptNode.parentNode;
    var origSrc = scriptNode.src;
    scriptNode.remove();

    origFetch(origSrc).then(function(r) { return r.text(); }).then(function(text) {
        var pattern = /\["SG","AR","BE","BG","BR","GB","HU","VE","GR","DK","IL","IN","ID","IE","ES","IT","CA","CN","CO","LV","LT","MK","MY","MX","NL","NZ","NO","PE","PL","PT","RO","RS","SK","SI","US","TW","TH","TR","PH","FI"[^\]]*\]/;
        var match = text.match(pattern);
                                if (!match) {
            hijackDone = false;
            if (parent) parent.appendChild(scriptNode);
            return;
        }
        var newArray = '[' + ALL_237.map(function(c) { return '"' + c + '"'; }).join(',') + ']';
        var modified = text.replace(pattern, newArray);
        var blob = new Blob([modified], { type: 'application/javascript' });
        var blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        var newScript = document.createElement('script');
        newScript.src = blobUrl;
        newScript.async = false;
        if (parent) parent.appendChild(newScript);
        else document.head.appendChild(newScript);
    }).catch(function() {
        hijackDone = false;
        if (parent) parent.appendChild(scriptNode);
    });
}

// ⭐ FUNGSI INI SEMPAT HILANG — WAJIB ADA ⭐
function fallbackScanMainJs() {
    if (hijackDone) return;
    try {
        var scripts = document.querySelectorAll('script[src*="main.js"]');
        for (var i = 0; i < scripts.length; i++) {
            if (hijackDone) return;
            var src = scripts[i].src || '';
            if (HIJACK_DOMAINS_RE.test(src)) {
                hijackMainScript(scripts[i]);
                return;
            }
        }
    } catch(e) {}
}

// ═══ FIX #1: Scope observer ke <head> + polling rapat ═══
var __hijackObs = null;
    function startHijackObserver() {
        if (hijackDone) return;
        if (__hijackObs) return;
        if (!document.head) return;

        __hijackObs = new MutationObserver(function(muts) {
            if (hijackDone) { try { __hijackObs.disconnect(); } catch(e) {} return; }
            for (var i = 0; i < muts.length; i++) {
                var nodes = muts[i].addedNodes;
                for (var j = 0; j < nodes.length; j++) {
                    var n = nodes[j];
                    if (n.nodeType !== 1 || n.tagName !== 'SCRIPT' || !n.src) continue;
                    if (!n.src.includes('main.js')) continue;
                    if (HIJACK_DOMAINS_RE.test(n.src)) {
                        if (!hijackDone) hijackMainScript(n);
                        return;  // skip sisa muts
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        __hijackObs.observe(document.head, { childList: true, subtree: true });

        // Auto-disconnect: 3s setelah hijackDone, ATAU 15s hard cap
        setTimeout(function() { try { __hijackObs && __hijackObs.disconnect(); } catch(e) {} }, 15000);
    }

    if (document.head) startHijackObserver();
    else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', startHijackObserver, { once: true });

    // Body-added script fallback (jarang, tapi bisa)
    var __bodyHijackPoll = setInterval(function() {
        if (hijackDone) { clearInterval(__bodyHijackPoll); return; }
        fallbackScanMainJs();
    }, 500);
    setTimeout(function() { clearInterval(__bodyHijackPoll); }, 10000);

    // Extra early scans (bukan replacing — komplementer)
    setTimeout(fallbackScanMainJs, 0);
    setTimeout(fallbackScanMainJs, 100);

    function makeFlagImg(code, className) {
        var cc = String(code).toLowerCase();
        var img = document.createElement('img');
        img.src = 'https://flagcdn.com/w80/' + cc + '.png';
        img.srcset = 'https://flagcdn.com/w160/' + cc + '.png 2x, https://flagcdn.com/w320/' + cc + '.png 3x';
        img.className = className || 'ca-flag';
        img.onerror = function() { this.style.display = 'none'; };
        return img;
    }

    function flagImgHtml(code, w, h, extraStyle) {

       function escAttrCA(s) {
        return String(s)
            .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
            .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
            .replace(/'/g, '&#39;')
            .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
            .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
    }

    // ⭐ SECURITY: escape HTML text content (innerHTML sink)
    function escHtmlCA(s) {
        return String(s)
            .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
            .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
            .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
            .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
            .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }
    W.escHtmlCA = escHtmlCA;
        // ⭐ SECURITY v2: whitelist-based HTML sanitizer (DOM-based, XSS-proof)
    //    Allowed tags: b/i/u/em/strong/small/br/span/div/img(flagcdn-only)
    //    Strips: ALL on* handlers, javascript:/data: URIs, dangerous CSS
    //    Fallback to '' on any parse error (fail-safe)
    function caSanitizeHtml(html) {
        if (html == null) return '';
        var str = String(html);
        if (str.indexOf('<') === -1 || str.indexOf('>') === -1) return str;

        try {
            var tpl = document.createElement('template');
            tpl.innerHTML = str;

            var ALLOWED_TAGS = {
                'B': 1, 'I': 1, 'U': 1, 'EM': 1, 'STRONG': 1, 'SMALL': 1,
                'BR': 1, 'SPAN': 1, 'DIV': 1, 'IMG': 1
            };
            var ALLOWED_ATTRS = {
                'SPAN': ['style'],
                'DIV':  ['style'],
                'IMG':  ['src', 'srcset', 'style', 'class']
            };
            var FLAGCDN_RE = /^https:\/\/flagcdn\.com\//;
                        // ⭐ FIX #7: tambah `data:` URI + `@supports` bypass
                       // ⭐ FIX F6: block CSS backslash hex/unicode escapes
            //    Bypass: url(\64 ata:...) → browser parse \64='d' → 'data:'
            //    Bypass: url(\u0064ata:...) → decode ke 'data:'
            //    Legit CSS user tidak butuh escape — safe untuk block total
            var DANGEROUS_STYLE = /expression\s*\(|javascript\s*:|behavior\s*:|@import|url\s*\(\s*['"]?\s*javascript|url\s*\(\s*['"]?\s*data:|@supports|-moz-binding|\\[0-9a-fA-F]{1,6}|\\u[0-9a-fA-F]{4}/i;

            var toRemove = [];
            var walker = document.createTreeWalker(tpl.content, NodeFilter.SHOW_ELEMENT, null, false);
            var n;
            while ((n = walker.nextNode())) {
                var tag = n.tagName;
                if (!ALLOWED_TAGS[tag]) {
                    toRemove.push(n);
                    continue;
                }
                var allowedAttrs = ALLOWED_ATTRS[tag] || [];
                for (var i = n.attributes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    var attr = n.attributes[i];
                    var aname = attr.name.toLowerCase();
                    var aval = attr.value;
                    if (aname.indexOf('on') === 0) {
                        n.removeAttribute(attr.name);
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (allowedAttrs.indexOf(aname) === -1) {
                        n.removeAttribute(attr.name);
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (tag === 'IMG' && aname === 'src') {
                        if (!FLAGCDN_RE.test(aval)) {
                            toRemove.push(n);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                                        if (tag === 'IMG' && aname === 'srcset') {
                        // ⭐ FIX #6: validate setiap entry, bukan substring match
                        var entries = aval.split(',').map(function(s) {
                            return s.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];
                        });
                        var allSafe = entries.length > 0 && entries.every(function(u) {
                            return FLAGCDN_RE.test(u);
                        });
                        if (!allSafe) {
                            n.removeAttribute(attr.name);
                        }
                    }
                    if (aname === 'style' && DANGEROUS_STYLE.test(aval)) {
                        n.removeAttribute('style');
                    }
                }
            }
            for (var j = 0; j < toRemove.length; j++) {
                var el = toRemove[j];
                if (el.parentNode) el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
            }
            return tpl.innerHTML;
        } catch (e) {
            return '';
        }
    }

    // ===== MODULE G: CHAT HELPERS =====
    var CA_CHAT_SELECTORS = ['.chat__textarea', '.chat__textfield', '#chat-text', 'textarea[placeholder*="message" i]', 'textarea[placeholder*="Write" i]', 'textarea[placeholder*="pesan" i]', 'textarea[placeholder*="Type" i]', 'input[placeholder*="message" i]', 'input[placeholder*="Type" i]', '.chat-input textarea', '.chat-input input', '.message-input textarea', '.message-input input', 'form textarea', 'textarea:not([readonly]):not([disabled])'];

       function findChatInput() {
        for (var i = 0; i < CA_CHAT_SELECTORS.length; i++) {
            try {
                var el = document.querySelector(CA_CHAT_SELECTORS[i]);
                // ⭐ FIX: Ganti offsetParent !== null dengan offsetWidth > 0
                if (el && el.offsetWidth > 0 && !el.disabled && !el.readOnly) return { el: el, selector: CA_CHAT_SELECTORS[i] };
            } catch(e) {}
        }
        return null;
    }

    function insertTextToChat(text) {
        if (!text) { showIndicator('❌ Empty text', '#ef4444'); return false; }
        var found = findChatInput();
        if (!found) { showIndicator('❌ Chat box not found', '#991b1b'); return false; }
        var box = found.el;
        var oldValue = box.value || '';
        var newValue = oldValue ? (oldValue + ' ' + text) : text;
        box.value = newValue;
        try { box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } catch(e) {}
        try { box.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } catch(e) {}
        try { box.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { bubbles: true, key: 'a' })); } catch(e) {}
        try { box.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input', { bubbles: true, inputType: 'insertText', data: text })); } catch(e) {}
        try { box.focus(); } catch(e) {}
        try { if (box.setSelectionRange) box.setSelectionRange(newValue.length, newValue.length); } catch(e) {}
                // ⭐ FIX XSS: escape preview text sebelum innerHTML
        var __preview = text.length > 30 ? text.substring(0, 30) + '...' : text;
        showIndicator('📝 ' + escHtmlCA(__preview), '#10b981');
        return true;
    }

        function copyToClipboardCA(text) {
        try {
            var __safe = escHtmlCA(text);
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function() { showIndicator('📋 Copied: ' + __safe, '#3b82f6'); }).catch(function() { showIndicator('📋 ' + __safe, '#3b82f6'); });
            } else { showIndicator('📋 ' + __safe, '#3b82f6'); }
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    W.__caInsertToChat = insertTextToChat;
    W.__caCopyClipboard = copyToClipboardCA;

    var __caIPLocCache = null;
    function loadIPLocations() {
        if (__caIPLocCache) return __caIPLocCache;
        try {
            var s = localStorage.getItem('ca_ip_locations');
            __caIPLocCache = s ? JSON.parse(s) : {};
        } catch(e) { __caIPLocCache = {}; }

    }

    function saveIPLocation(ip, info) {
        try {
            var c = loadIPLocations();
            var existing = c[ip] || {};
            var hasNewData = (info.city && info.city.length > 0) || (info.country && info.country.length > 0);
            if (hasNewData || !existing.city || (info.lat != null && existing.lat == null)) {
                c[ip] = {
                    city: info.city || existing.city || '',
                    region: info.region || existing.region || '',
                    country: info.country || existing.country || '',
                    isp: info.isp || existing.isp || '',
                    code: info.code || existing.code || '',
                    lat: (info.lat != null) ? info.lat : (existing.lat != null ? existing.lat : null),
                    lng: (info.lng != null) ? info.lng : (existing.lng != null ? existing.lng : null),
                    accuracyKm: info.accuracyKm || existing.accuracyKm || null,
                    accuracyRadius: (info.accuracyRadius != null) ? info.accuracyRadius : (existing.accuracyRadius != null ? existing.accuracyRadius : null),
                    accuracySource: info.accuracySource || existing.accuracySource || null,
                    confidence: info.confidence || existing.confidence || null,
                    confidenceScore: info.confidenceScore != null ? info.confidenceScore : (existing.confidenceScore || null),
                    confidenceLevel: info.confidenceLevel || existing.confidenceLevel || null,
                    riskLevel: info.riskLevel || existing.riskLevel || null,
                    source: info.source || existing.source || null,
                    ispType: info.ispType || existing.ispType || null,
                    hostname: info.hostname || existing.hostname || '',
                    providerTimezone: info.providerTimezone || existing.providerTimezone || '',
                    tzValid: (info.tzValid != null) ? info.tzValid : (existing.tzValid || null),
                    rdnsHint: info.rdnsHint || existing.rdnsHint || null,
                    conflict: (info.conflict != null) ? info.conflict : (existing.conflict || false),
                    domCode: info.domCode || existing.domCode || null,
                    timestamp: Date.now()
                };
                               // ⭐ FIX BUG #16: prune if > 1000 entries
                var _keys = Object.keys(c);
                if (_keys.length > 1000) {
                    _keys.sort(function(a, b) { return (c[b].timestamp || 0) - (c[a].timestamp || 0); });
                    var _pruned = {};
                    _keys.slice(0, 800).forEach(function(k) { _pruned[k] = c[k]; });
                    __caIPLocCache = _pruned;
                    c = _pruned;
                }
                localStorage.setItem('ca_ip_locations', JSON.stringify(c));
            }
        } catch(e) {
            // ⭐ FIX BUG #16: emergency prune on quota exception
            try {
                var _cache = loadIPLocations();
                var _ks = Object.keys(_cache);
                if (_ks.length > 200) {
                    _ks.sort(function(a, b) { return (_cache[b].timestamp || 0) - (_cache[a].timestamp || 0); });
                    var _emerg = {};
                    _ks.slice(0, 200).forEach(function(k) { _emerg[k] = _cache[k]; });
                    __caIPLocCache = _emerg;
                    localStorage.setItem('ca_ip_locations', JSON.stringify(_emerg));
                }
            } catch(e2) {}
        }
    }

// ⭐ FIX #6: Conditional TTL — kategori high-recycle expire cepat
// VPN/datacenter: 2 jam (IP sering di-recycle antar-user)
// Mobile: 6 jam (carrier NAT share IP)
// Fixed/residential/unknown: 24 jam (aman)
function _getCacheTTLForEntry(e) {
    if (!e) return 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    if (e.ispType === 'vpn' || e.ispType === 'datacenter') return 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    if (e.ispType === 'mobile') return 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    return 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
}

function getIPLocationFromCache(ip) {
    try {
        var c = loadIPLocations();
        var e = c[ip];
        if (!e) return null;
        // ⭐ FIX #6: TTL dinamis berdasarkan kategori ISP (was: flat 24h)
        var CACHE_TTL = _getCacheTTLForEntry(e);
        if (e.timestamp && (Date.now() - e.timestamp) > CACHE_TTL) {
            return null;   // expired → force re-fetch
        }
        if (e.lat != null && e.lng != null) return e;
        if (e.city || e.country) return e;
        return null;
    } catch(e) { return null; }
}

                h = _pruned;

                var _ks = Object.keys(_cache);
                if (_ks.length > 200) {

    function addIPToHistory(ip, info) {
        if (!ip) return;
        try {
            var h = loadIPHistory();
            if (!h[ip]) h[ip] = { count: 0, firstSeen: Date.now(), lastSeen: Date.now(), city: '', country: '', isp: '', code: '' };
            h[ip].count++; h[ip].lastSeen = Date.now();
            if (info) {
                if (info.city) h[ip].city = info.city;
                if (info.country) h[ip].country = info.country;
                if (info.isp) h[ip].isp = info.isp;
                if (info.code) h[ip].code = info.code;
            }
            saveIPHistory(h);
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function removeIPFromHistory(ip) {
        try {
            var h = loadIPHistory();
            if (h[ip]) { delete h[ip]; saveIPHistory(h); }
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function clearAllIPHistory() {
        __caIPHistoryCache = {};
        try { localStorage.removeItem('ca_ip_history'); } catch(e) {}
    }

    function formatTimeAgo(t) {
        if (!t) return 'Unknown';
        var d = Date.now() - t;
        var s = Math.floor(d / 1000);
        if (s < 60) return s + 's ago';
        var m = Math.floor(s / 60);
        if (m < 60) return m + 'm ago';
        var h = Math.floor(m / 60);
        if (h < 24) return h + 'h ago';
        return Math.floor(h / 24) + 'd ago';
    }

    // ===== MODULE I: IP ENRICHMENT =====
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ⭐ VPN DETECTION via is-vpn library (auto-updated data)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var __caIsVpnPromise = null;

function __caLoadIsVpn() {
    if (__caIsVpnPromise) return __caIsVpnPromise;
    __caIsVpnPromise = import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/josephrocca/is-vpn@v0.0.3/mod.js')
        .then(function(mod) {
            try { console.log('[CA-ISVPN] Library dimuat OK'); } catch(e) {}
            return mod.isVpn;
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
            try { console.warn('[CA-ISVPN] Gagal muat:', err); } catch(e) {}
            __caIsVpnPromise = null;
            return null;
        });
    return __caIsVpnPromise;
}

function __caCheckVpnAsync(ip) {
    if (!ip) return;
    __caLoadIsVpn().then(function(isVpn) {
        if (typeof isVpn !== 'function') return;
        var result;
        try { result = isVpn(ip); } catch(e) { return; }
        if (state.currentIP !== ip) return;
        if (!state.currentIPInfo) state.currentIPInfo = {};
        state.currentIPInfo.isVpnDetected = !!result;
        state.currentIPInfo.isVpnSource = 'is-vpn-library';
        if (result && state.currentIPInfo.advVpnScore != null) {
            state.currentIPInfo.advVpnScore = Math.min(100, state.currentIPInfo.advVpnScore + 40);
        }
        // ⬇⬇⬇ PATCH B: recompute riskLevel SETELAH isVpnDetected diketahui
        try {
            var baseRisk = (state.currentIPInfo.confidenceLevel === 'high')
                ? 'low'
                : (state.currentIPInfo.confidenceLevel === 'very-low' ? 'high' : 'medium');
            if (state.currentIPInfo.isVpnDetected === true) {
                state.currentIPInfo.riskLevel = 'high';
            } else if (state.currentIPInfo.advVpnScore != null && state.currentIPInfo.advVpnScore >= 50) {
                state.currentIPInfo.riskLevel = 'high';
            } else if (state.currentIPInfo.advVpnScore != null && state.currentIPInfo.advVpnScore >= 30) {
                state.currentIPInfo.riskLevel = 'medium';
            } else {
                state.currentIPInfo.riskLevel = baseRisk;
            }
            if (state.currentIPInfo.advVpnScore != null) {
                state.currentIPInfo.advVpnLevel = state.currentIPInfo.advVpnScore >= 70 ? 'high'
                    : (state.currentIPInfo.advVpnScore >= 40 ? 'medium' : 'low');
            }
        } catch(e) {}
        // Debug log — muncul setiap partner baru
        try {
            if (result) {
                console.warn('[CA-ISVPN] 🔒 VPN/Datacenter TERDETEKSI — IP: ' + ip);
            } else {
                console.log('[CA-ISVPN] ✅ IP bersih (residential/unknown) — IP: ' + ip);
            }
        } catch(e) {}
        try { updateFloatingBox(); } catch(e) {}
    });
}

        function tryProviderChain(ip, callback) {
        var chain = IP_PROVIDER_CHAIN;
        var N = chain.length;
        var done = 0;
        var settled = false;
        var tried = [];

        function finalize(info) {
            if (settled) return;
            settled = true;
            callback(info, tried);
        }

        chain.forEach(function(p) {
            tried.push(p.name);
            var finished = false;

            function markDone(info) {
                if (finished) return;
                finished = true;
                if (info) { finalize(info); return; }
                done++;
                if (done >= N && !settled) finalize(null);
            }

                    // ⭐ NEW: skip provider yang URL-nya kosong (mis. FindIP tanpa token)
        var _pUrl = '';
        try { _pUrl = p.url(ip); } catch(e) { _pUrl = ''; }
        if (!_pUrl) { markDone(null); return; }

        var timer = setTimeout(function() { markDone(null); }, 2500);

        try {
            GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                method: 'GET',
                url: _pUrl,
                timeout: 2000,
                    onload: function(r) {
                        clearTimeout(timer);
                        try {
                            var info = p.parse(JSON.parse(r.responseText));
                            if (info) { info.source = p.name; info.attempts = tried.length; markDone(info); return; }
                        } catch(e) {}
                        markDone(null);
                    },
                    onerror: function() { clearTimeout(timer); markDone(null); },
                    ontimeout: function() { clearTimeout(timer); markDone(null); }
                });
            } catch(e) {
                clearTimeout(timer);
                markDone(null);
            }
        });
    }

    function validateProviderTimezone(providerTz, countryCode) {
        if (!providerTz || !countryCode) return { valid: null, expected: null };
        var expected = COUNTRY_TZ_PREFIX[countryCode.toLowerCase()];
        if (!expected) return { valid: null, expected: null };
        if (expected.charAt(expected.length - 1) === '/') return { valid: providerTz.indexOf(expected) === 0, expected: expected + '*', actual: providerTz };
        return { valid: providerTz === expected, expected: expected, actual: providerTz };
    }

    function extractCityFromHostname(hostname, countryCode) {
        if (!hostname || !countryCode) return null;
        var cc = countryCode.toLowerCase();
        var parts = hostname.toLowerCase().split(/[.\-]/);
        for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            var p = parts[i];
            if (p.length === 3 && /^[a-z]{3}$/.test(p)) {
                var m = IATA_TO_CITY[p];
                if (m && m.country === cc) return { city: m.city, code: p.toUpperCase(), confidence: 'medium', source: 'IATA' };
            }
        }
        for (var j = 0; j < parts.length; j++) {
            var part = parts[j];
            if (part.length < 5) continue;
            for (var iata in IATA_TO_CITY) {
                var m2 = IATA_TO_CITY[iata];
                if (m2.country !== cc) continue;
                var cityLower = m2.city.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
                if (part === cityLower || part.indexOf(cityLower) !== -1) return { city: m2.city, code: null, confidence: 'low', source: 'city-name' };
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function detectISPType(ispName) {
        if (!ispName) return 'unknown';
        var s = ispName.toLowerCase();
        for (var i = 0; i < ISP_VPN_KEYWORDS.length; i++) if (s.indexOf(ISP_VPN_KEYWORDS[i]) !== -1) return 'vpn';
        for (var j = 0; j < ISP_DC_KEYWORDS.length; j++) if (s.indexOf(ISP_DC_KEYWORDS[j]) !== -1) return 'datacenter';
        for (var k = 0; k < ISP_MOBILE_KEYWORDS.length; k++) if (s.indexOf(ISP_MOBILE_KEYWORDS[k]) !== -1) return 'mobile';
        for (var l = 0; l < ISP_FIXED_KEYWORDS.length; l++) if (s.indexOf(ISP_FIXED_KEYWORDS[l]) !== -1) return 'fixed';
        return 'unknown';
    }

    function computeConfidenceScore(info, domCode) {
        var score = 50;
        if (info.code && domCode) {
            if (info.code === domCode) score += 20;
            else score -= 30;
        }
        if (info.ispType === 'fixed') score += 15;
        else if (info.ispType === 'mobile') score -= 15;
        else if (info.ispType === 'vpn') score -= 25;
        else if (info.ispType === 'datacenter') score -= 20;
        if (info.tzValid === true) score += 10;
        else if (info.tzValid === false) score -= 15;
        if (info.rdnsHint && info.rdnsHint.city) {
            if (info.city && info.rdnsHint.city.toLowerCase() === info.city.toLowerCase()) score += 10;
            else score -= 5;
        }
        if (info.source === 'ipinfo.io') score += 5;
        else if (info.source === 'ipapi.co') score += 2;
        else if (info.source === 'ipwho.is') score -= 2;
        score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score));
        var level = score >= 80 ? 'high' : (score >= 55 ? 'medium' : (score >= 30 ? 'low' : 'very-low'));
        return { score: score, level: level };
    }

    function getPartnerLocalTime(providerTimezone) {
        if (!providerTimezone) return null;
        try {
            var now = new Date();
            var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { timeZone: providerTimezone, hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false }).formatToParts(now);
            var hh = '00', mm = '00';
            for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
                if (parts[i].type === 'hour') hh = parts[i].value;
                if (parts[i].type === 'minute') mm = parts[i].value;
            }
            return { time: hh + ':' + mm, timezone: providerTimezone };
        } catch(e) { return null; }
    }

    function getRegionLabel(countryCode) {
        if (!countryCode) return null;
        var cc = countryCode.toLowerCase();
        var europe = ['de','fr','gb','it','es','nl','be','ch','at','pl','se','no','dk','fi','pt','ie','gr','cz','hu','ro','ua','ru','tr','bg','hr','rs','sk','si','lt','lv','ee','is','lu','mt','cy','al','ba','mk','me','md','by','ad','mc','li','sm','va','gi','im','je','gg','ax','fo','gl'];

        if (europe.indexOf(cc) !== -1) return { name: 'Europe', icon: '🇪🇺', color: '#3b82f6' };
        if (me.indexOf(cc) !== -1) return { name: 'Middle East', icon: '🕌', color: '#f59e0b' };
        if (asia.indexOf(cc) !== -1) return { name: 'Asia', icon: '🌏', color: '#10b981' };

        if (africa.indexOf(cc) !== -1) return { name: 'Africa', icon: '🌍', color: '#ef4444' };
        if (oceania.indexOf(cc) !== -1) return { name: 'Oceania', icon: '🏝️', color: '#06b6d4' };
        return null;
    }

    function computeAccuracyKm(info, conf) {
        if (info.accuracyRadius != null && info.accuracyRadius > 0) {
            if (info.accuracySource !== 'provider-enriched') info.accuracySource = 'provider';
            return Math.round(info.accuracyRadius);
        }
        var baseAcc;
        if (info.ispType === 'fixed') baseAcc = 25;
        else if (info.ispType === 'mobile') baseAcc = 150;
        else if (info.ispType === 'vpn') baseAcc = 500;
        else if (info.ispType === 'datacenter') baseAcc = 300;
        else baseAcc = 100;
        var score = (conf && conf.score != null) ? conf.score : 50;
        var confMult = 2.0 - (score / 100);
        if (!info.city) baseAcc = Math.max(baseAcc, 300);
        info.accuracySource = 'estimated';
        return Math.round(baseAcc * confMult);
    }

    function enrichAccuracyFromIpapi(ip, info, callback) {
        if (!ip || !info) { callback(info); return; }
        if (info.accuracyRadius != null && info.accuracyRadius > 0) { callback(info); return; }
        if (info.ispType === 'mobile' || info.ispType === 'vpn' || info.ispType === 'datacenter') { callback(info); return; }
        var settled = false;
        var timeout = setTimeout(function() { if (settled) return; settled = true; callback(info); }, 2500);
        try {
            GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                method: 'GET', url: 'https://ipapi.co/' + ip + '/json/', timeout: 2000,
                onload: function(r) {
                    if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timeout);
                    try {
                        var d = JSON.parse(r.responseText);
                        if (d && !d.error && typeof d.accuracy_radius === 'number' && d.accuracy_radius > 0) {
                            info.accuracyRadius = d.accuracy_radius;
                            info.accuracySource = 'provider-enriched';
                        }
                    } catch(e) {}
                    callback(info);
                },
                onerror: function() { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timeout); callback(info); },
                ontimeout: function() { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timeout); callback(info); }
            });
        } catch(e) { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timeout); callback(info); }
    }

    function scheduleMultiCandidateCheck() {
        if (__caCandidateCheckScheduled) return;
        __caCandidateCheckScheduled = true;
        setTimeout(function() { __caCandidateCheckScheduled = false; evaluateAllCandidates(); }, 2500);
    }

    function scoreVPN(info, domCode, otherCountries) {
        var score = 0, reasons = [];
        if (info.ispType === 'vpn') { score += 50; reasons.push('ISP name = VPN'); }
        else if (info.ispType === 'datacenter') { score += 45; reasons.push('ISP = datacenter'); }
        else if (info.ispType === 'fixed') { score -= 30; reasons.push('ISP = residential'); }
        else if (info.ispType === 'mobile') { score -= 20; reasons.push('ISP = mobile'); }
        if (info.code && domCode && info.code !== domCode) { score += 25; reasons.push('country ≠ flag'); }
        if (otherCountries && otherCountries.length > 0) {
            for (var i = 0; i < otherCountries.length; i++) {
                if (otherCountries[i] && info.code && otherCountries[i] !== info.code) { score += 10; reasons.push('country ≠ other IP'); break; }
            }
        }
        score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score));
        return { score: score, reasons: reasons };
    }

    function classifyCandidates(results, domCode) {
        if (results.length === 0) return [];
        var allC = [];
        results.forEach(function(r) { if (r.code) allC.push(r.code); });
        results.forEach(function(r) {
            var other = allC.filter(function(c) { return c !== r.code; });
            var s = scoreVPN(r, domCode, other);
            r.vpnScore = s.score; r.vpnReasons = s.reasons;
        });
        var sorted = results.slice().sort(function(a, b) { return b.vpnScore - a.vpnScore; });
        var diff = sorted[0].vpnScore - sorted[sorted.length - 1].vpnScore;
        sorted.forEach(function(r, idx) {
            if (results.length === 1) { r.role = 'unknown'; r.roleLabel = '🌐 Only IP'; return; }
            if (diff < 15) { r.role = 'ambiguous'; r.roleLabel = '❓ Ambiguous'; r.roleColor = '#a78bfa'; return; }
            if (idx === 0 && r.vpnScore >= 40) { r.role = 'vpn'; r.roleLabel = r.vpnScore >= 70 ? '🔒 Likely VPN' : '⚠️ Suspicious'; r.roleColor = r.vpnScore >= 70 ? '#ef4444' : '#f59e0b'; }
            else if (idx === sorted.length - 1) { r.role = 'real'; r.roleLabel = '🌐 Likely Real'; r.roleColor = '#10b981'; }
            else { r.role = 'unknown'; r.roleLabel = '❓ Uncertain'; r.roleColor = '#64748b'; }
        });
        return sorted;
    }

function evaluateAllCandidates() {
    // ⭐ FIX #9 MARKER — set di PAGE scope (W) + sebelum early-return
    try { W.__caFix9 = { applied: true, maxCandidates: 3, at: Date.now() }; } catch(e) {}

if (__caAllSrflxCandidates.length < 1) return;
if (!state.currentIP) {
    // Adopsi kandidat pertama sebagai primary — jangan buang
    state.currentIP = __caAllSrflxCandidates[0];
    state.currentIPType = 'srflx';
    state.currentIPSetAt = Date.now();
    state.ipDetectionStartTime = Date.now();
    try { fetchIPLocation(state.currentIP); } catch(e) {}
    return;
}
var primaryIP = state.currentIP;
    // ⭐ FIX: skip multi-candidate kalau primary IP adalah relay (TURN server)
    if (state.currentIPType === 'relay') {
        state.multiCandidateInfo = null;
        return;
    }
    var domCode = state.lastDetectedCountry ? state.lastDetectedCountry.toLowerCase() : null;
    var list = [primaryIP];

    // ⭐ FIX #9: Multi-candidate limit 3 (was 2) — catch 3+ IP leaks.
    //   Quota-safe: cached IPs tetap skip provider chain (dicek di loop bawah).
    //   Worst case = 3 provider chains × 3 providers racing = sama seperti sebelum
    //   untuk kasus yang tidak cached, karena provider race paralel (wall-time 2.5s).
    var MAX_CANDIDATES = 3;
    for (var i = 0; i < __caAllSrflxCandidates.length && list.length < MAX_CANDIDATES; i++) {
        if (__caAllSrflxCandidates[i] !== primaryIP) list.push(__caAllSrflxCandidates[i]);
    }
    if (list.length < 2) return;

    var results = {}, pending = list.length;
    var finish = function() {
        pending--;
        if (pending > 0) return;
        var arr = list.map(function(ip) { return results[ip]; }).filter(function(r) { return r; });
        if (arr.length === 0) return;
        state.multiCandidateInfo = classifyCandidates(arr, domCode);
        updateFloatingBox();
    };
    list.forEach(function(ip) {
        var cached = getIPLocationFromCache(ip);
        if (cached && (cached.city || cached.country)) {
            if (!cached.ispType && cached.isp) cached.ispType = detectISPType(cached.isp);
            results[ip] = {
                ip: ip, city: cached.city || '', region: cached.region || '', country: cached.country || '',
                code: cached.code || '', isp: cached.isp || '', ispType: cached.ispType || detectISPType(cached.isp), source: cached.source || 'cache'
            };
            finish(); return;
        }
        tryProviderChain(ip, function(info) {
            if (info) {
                info.ispType = detectISPType(info.isp);
                saveIPLocation(ip, info);
                results[ip] = { ip: ip, city: info.city || '', region: info.region || '', country: info.country || '', code: info.code || '', isp: info.isp || '', ispType: info.ispType, source: info.source };
            }
            finish();
        });
    });
}

    var __caLastFetchIP = null, __caLastFetchTime = 0, __caFetchDebounce = 400;

    function fetchIPLocation(ip) {
        if (!ip) return;
        if (state.currentIPType === 'relay') {
            state.currentIPInfo = { isRelay: true, city: '', region: '', country: '', isp: '', code: '', lat: null, lng: null, accuracyKm: null, confidence: 0, confidenceScore: 0, confidenceLevel: 'very-low', source: 'relay-skip', conflict: false, domCode: null };
            addIPToHistory(ip, null);
            updateFloatingBox();
            dispatchIPReady(ip);
            return;
        }
        var now = Date.now();
        if (ip === __caLastFetchIP && (now - __caLastFetchTime) < __caFetchDebounce) return;
        __caLastFetchIP = ip; __caLastFetchTime = now;
var cached = getIPLocationFromCache(ip);
if (cached && (cached.city || cached.country || (cached.lat != null && cached.lng != null))) {
    // ⭐ FIX: reset advVpnScore — stale dari sesi lalu, harus re-analyze fresh
    delete cached.advVpnScore;
    delete cached.advVpnLevel;
    delete cached.advSignals;
    delete cached.advVpnLabel;
    delete cached.reverseDns;
    delete cached.relayAnalysis;
    var domNow = state.lastDetectedCountry ? state.lastDetectedCountry.toLowerCase() : null;
            if (cached.code && domNow) { cached.conflict = cached.code !== domNow; cached.domCode = domNow; }
            if (!cached.ispType && cached.isp) cached.ispType = detectISPType(cached.isp);
            if (cached.providerTimezone && cached.tzValid == null) { var tzC = validateProviderTimezone(cached.providerTimezone, cached.code); cached.tzValid = tzC.valid; }
            if (cached.hostname && !cached.rdnsHint) cached.rdnsHint = extractCityFromHostname(cached.hostname, cached.code);
            var confC = computeConfidenceScore(cached, domNow);
            cached.confidenceScore = confC.score; cached.confidenceLevel = confC.level; cached.confidence = confC.score;
                        var _baseRiskC = confC.level === 'high' ? 'low' : (confC.level === 'very-low' ? 'high' : 'medium');
            if (cached.isVpnDetected === true) cached.riskLevel = 'high';
            else if (cached.advVpnScore != null && cached.advVpnScore >= 50) cached.riskLevel = 'high';
            else if (cached.advVpnScore != null && cached.advVpnScore >= 30) cached.riskLevel = 'medium';
            else cached.riskLevel = _baseRiskC;
            cached.accuracyKm = computeAccuracyKm(cached, confC);
            state.currentIPInfo = cached; addIPToHistory(ip, cached);
            updateFloatingBox(); dispatchIPReady(ip);
            if (cached.accuracySource === 'estimated' && cached.ispType !== 'mobile' && cached.ispType !== 'vpn' && cached.ispType !== 'datacenter') {
                enrichAccuracyFromIpapi(ip, cached, function(enriched) {
                    if (enriched.accuracySource === 'provider-enriched') {
                        enriched.accuracyKm = computeAccuracyKm(enriched, confC);
                        state.currentIPInfo = enriched;
                        saveIPLocation(ip, enriched);
                        updateFloatingBox();
                    }
                });
            }
            return;
        }
        state.currentIPInfo = null; updateFloatingBox();
tryProviderChain(ip, function(info, tried) {
    // ⭐ FIX: skip kalau partner sudah ganti saat provider chain masih jalan
    if (state.currentIP !== ip) return;

    if (info) {
        info.ispType = detectISPType(info.isp);

                    info.tzValid = tzCheck.valid; info.tzActual = info.providerTimezone; info.tzExpected = tzCheck.expected;

                if (info.providerTimezone) info.partnerLocalTime = getPartnerLocalTime(info.providerTimezone);

                info.confidenceScore = conf.score; info.confidenceLevel = conf.level;
                info.conflict = !!(info.code && domCode && info.code !== domCode);
                info.domCode = domCode; info.confidence = conf.score;
                // ⬇ Hitung base risk dari confidence
var baseRisk = conf.level === 'high' ? 'low' : (conf.level === 'very-low' ? 'high' : 'medium');

    info.riskLevel = 'high';
} else if (info.advVpnScore >= 50) {
    info.riskLevel = 'high';
} else if (info.advVpnScore >= 30) {
    info.riskLevel = 'medium';
} else {
    info.riskLevel = baseRisk;
}
                info.sources = info.source; info.accuracyKm = computeAccuracyKm(info, conf);

        __caCheckVpnAsync(ip);   // ⬅ TAMBAHAN: cek VPN via is-vpn

        });
    }

        // ⭐ Timer dihapus — diganti flag `active` (dikontrol scheduler __caOn1000)

        function caAudioWatchdogRepair(pc) {
        return new Promise(function(resolve) {
            if (!pc || pc.connectionState !== 'connected') return resolve(false);
            if (__caAudioWatchdog.repairing) return resolve(false);

            // ⭐ PATCH B: skip repair selama partner transition
            var __adNow = Date.now();
            var __adLastTx = (window.__ca && window.__ca.state && window.__ca.state.lastPartnerTransitionAt) || 0;
            if (__adLastTx && (__adNow - __adLastTx) < 3000) {
                console.log('[CA-WD] ⏸️ skip repair — partner transition (' + (__adNow - __adLastTx) + 'ms ago)');
                return resolve(false);
            }

            var sender = pc.getSenders().find(function(s) { return s.track && s.track.kind === 'audio'; });
            if (!sender) return resolve(false);
            if (sender.track && sender.track.readyState === 'live') return resolve(true);
            if (__caAudioWatchdog.repairs >= 3) return resolve(false);

            __caAudioWatchdog.repairs++;
            __caAudioWatchdog.repairing = true;
            var n = __caAudioWatchdog.repairs;
            console.warn('%c[CA-WD] 🔧 audio ended — repair #' + n, 'color:#f59e0b;font-weight:bold');

            var constraints = { audio: {
                deviceId: window.__mscPreferredMicFakeId ? { exact: window.__mscPreferredMicFakeId } : undefined,
                echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true, autoGainControl: true
            }};
            var getMic = W.navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(constraints)
                .catch(function() { return W.navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }); });

            getMic.then(function(g) {
                var t = g.getAudioTracks()[0];
                if (!t || t.readyState !== 'live') {
                    console.error('[CA-WD] mic baru tidak live — abort');
                    __caAudioWatchdog.repairing = false;
                    return resolve(false);
                }
                return sender.replaceTrack(t).then(function() {
                    var cur = sender.track;
                    if (cur && cur.readyState === 'live') {
                        console.log('%c[CA-WD] ✅ repaired → ' + (cur.label || '?'), 'color:#0f0;font-weight:bold');
                        __caAudioWatchdog.repairing = false;
                        resolve(true);
                    } else {
                        console.error('[CA-WD] replaceTrack selesai tapi track masih ' + (cur && cur.readyState));
                        __caAudioWatchdog.repairing = false;
                        resolve(false);
                    }
                });
            }).catch(function(e) {
                console.error('[CA-WD] repair fail', e);
                __caAudioWatchdog.repairing = false;
                resolve(false);
            });
        });
    }

        function caAudioWatchdogStart(pc) {
        // ⭐ setInterval dihapus — poller global di bawah
        __caAudioWatchdog.pc = pc;
        __caAudioWatchdog.repairs = 0;
        __caAudioWatchdog.repairing = false;

        setTimeout(function() { caAudioWatchdogRepair(pc); }, 400);
    }

        __caOn1000(function() {

        var sender = pc.getSenders().find(function(s) { return s.track && s.track.kind === 'audio'; });

            __caAudioWatchdog.repairs = 0;

        }

        // ===== MODULE N: PANEL GEOMETRY =====
    var PANEL_MIN_W = 300;
    var PANEL_DEFAULT_W = 940;
    var PANEL_SNAP_THRESHOLD = 24;

    function updatePanelCompactMode() {
        if (!customContainer) return;
        if (window.__caCinemaLock) return;
        var w;
        if (state.panelWidth != null) {
            w = state.panelWidth * (state.panelScale || 1.0);
        } else {
            var hostW = window.innerWidth;
            w = Math.min(hostW * 0.84, PANEL_DEFAULT_W) * (state.panelScale || 1.0);
        }
        if (w <= PANEL_COMPACT_THRESHOLD) customContainer.classList.add('ca-compact');
        else customContainer.classList.remove('ca-compact');
    }

    function getSnapTargets() {
        var targets = [];
        var vw = window.innerWidth;
        var maxW = vw - 24;
        try {
            var lw = document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper');
            if (lw) {
                var r = lw.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (r.width > 240 && r.width < maxW) targets.push({ label: 'Your Cam', width: Math.round(r.width), icon: '📷' });
            }
        } catch(e) {}
        try {
            var rw = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
            if (rw) {
                var rr = rw.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (rr.width > 240 && rr.width < maxW) targets.push({ label: 'Partner', width: Math.round(rr.width), icon: '📺' });
            }
        } catch(e) {}
        try {
            var vc = document.querySelector('.video-container__wrapper');
            if (vc) {
                var r2 = vc.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (r2.width > 240 && r2.width < maxW) targets.push({ label: 'Video Wrap', width: Math.round(r2.width), icon: '🎥' });
            }
        } catch(e) {}
        var bps = [
            { label: 'Compact', width: 480, icon: '📱' },
            { label: 'Standard', width: 640, icon: '💻' },
            { label: 'Wide', width: 800, icon: '🖥️' },
            { label: 'Default', width: PANEL_DEFAULT_W, icon: '⭐' },
            { label: 'Half', width: Math.round(vw * 0.5), icon: '↔️' },
            { label: 'Full', width: Math.round(maxW), icon: '🔲' }
        ];
        bps.forEach(function(b) {
            if (b.width >= PANEL_MIN_W && b.width <= maxW) {
                var dup = targets.some(function(t) { return Math.abs(t.width - b.width) < 20; });
                if (!dup) targets.push(b);
            }
        });
        targets.sort(function(a, b) { return a.width - b.width; });
        return targets;
    }

    function ensureBaseCoordinates() {
        if (!customContainer) return;
        if (customContainer.style.display === 'none') return;
        if (state.panelLeft == null || state.panelTop == null) {
            var rect = customContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
            var scale = state.panelScale || 1.0;

            // ⭐ FIX DRAG-EXPLODE: Jangan pernah pakai rect.width jika null.
            //    Gunakan geometri tersimpan atau default 470px.
            var baseWidth = state.panelWidth;
            if (baseWidth == null) {
                try {
                    var saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ca_panel_geometry') || '{}');
                    baseWidth = saved.width || 470;
                    if (state.panelScale == 1.0) {
                        state.panelScale = saved.scale || 0.76;
                        scale = state.panelScale;
                    }
                } catch(e) {
                    baseWidth = 470;
                    state.panelScale = 0.76;
                    scale = 0.76;
                }
            }

            var baseHeight = customContainer.offsetHeight || Math.round(rect.height / scale);
            var originXPct = 0.5, originYPct = 0.5;
            var parts = (state.panelScaleOrigin || '50% 50%').split(' ');
            if (parts[0]) { var p = parseFloat(parts[0]); if (!isNaN(p)) originXPct = p / 100; }
            if (parts[1]) { var p2 = parseFloat(parts[1]); if (!isNaN(p2)) originYPct = p2 / 100; }

            if (state.panelLeft == null) {
                state.panelLeft = Math.round(rect.left - baseWidth * (1 - scale) * originXPct);
            }
            if (state.panelTop == null) {
                state.panelTop = Math.round(rect.top - baseHeight * (1 - scale) * originYPct);
            }
        }
    }

    function clampPanelToViewport() {
        if (!customContainer) return;
        if (customContainer.style.display === 'none') return;
        var rect = customContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
        var PAD = 12;
        var vw = window.innerWidth, vh = window.innerHeight;
        var dx = 0, dy = 0;

        if (rect.width <= vw - 2 * PAD) {
            if (rect.left < PAD) dx = PAD - rect.left;
            else if (rect.right > vw - PAD) dx = (vw - PAD) - rect.right;
        } else {
            if (rect.left > PAD) dx = PAD - rect.left;
            else if (rect.right < vw - PAD) dx = (vw - PAD) - rect.right;
        }

        if (rect.height <= vh - 2 * PAD) {
            if (rect.top < PAD) dy = PAD - rect.top;
            else if (rect.bottom > vh - PAD) dy = (vh - PAD) - rect.bottom;
        } else {
            if (rect.top > PAD) dy = PAD - rect.top;
            else if (rect.bottom < vh - PAD) dy = (vh - PAD) - rect.bottom;
        }

        if (dx !== 0 || dy !== 0) {
            state.panelLeft = Math.round((state.panelLeft || 0) + dx);
            state.panelTop  = Math.round((state.panelTop  || 0) + dy);
            customContainer.style.left = state.panelLeft + 'px';
            customContainer.style.setProperty('top', state.panelTop + 'px', 'important');
            try { savePanelGeometry(); } catch(e) {}
        }
    }
