            // ⭐ FIX: Tambahkan 'important' agar tidak bisa ditimpa oleh CSS transisi 84%
            customContainer.style.setProperty('width', state.panelWidth + 'px', 'important');
            customContainer.style.setProperty('max-width', 'none', 'important');
        } else {
            customContainer.style.width = '84%';
            customContainer.style.maxWidth = PANEL_DEFAULT_W + 'px';
        }

        var baseT = 'translateX(0)';
        if (state.panelLeft != null) {
            customContainer.style.left = state.panelLeft + 'px';
        } else {
            customContainer.style.left = '50%';
            baseT = 'translateX(-50%)';
        }

        if (state.panelTop != null) {
            customContainer.style.setProperty('top', state.panelTop + 'px', 'important');
        } else {
            customContainer.style.removeProperty('top');
        }

        if (state.panelHeight != null) {
            var h = state.panelHeight;
            if (h < 40) h = 40;
            customContainer.style.setProperty('height', h + 'px', 'important');
            customContainer.style.setProperty('max-height', h + 'px', 'important');
        }

        customContainer.style.transform = (scale !== 1.0) ? baseT + ' scale(' + scale + ')' : baseT;
        customContainer.style.transformOrigin = state.panelScaleOrigin || '50% 50%';

        if (!(__caResizeState || __caDragState || __caScaleState || __caVResizeState)) {
            if (state.panelLeft != null || state.panelTop != null) {
                clampPanelToViewport();
            }
        }

        var label = document.getElementById('ca-resize-snap-label');
        if (label) {
            var inv = 1 / (scale || 1);
            label.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%) scale(' + inv + ')';
            label.style.transformOrigin = '50% 100%';
        }
        updatePanelCompactMode();
    }

            function savePanelGeometry() {
        // ⭐ FIX #6: COALESCED WRITE — 5 caller (resize, drag, scale, cinema,
        // reset) sering overlap. Debounce 150ms mencegah partial state write
        // yang inconsistent antar reload.
        if (window.__caPanelSaveTimer) clearTimeout(window.__caPanelSaveTimer);
        window.__caPanelSaveTimer = setTimeout(function() {
            window.__caPanelSaveTimer = 0;
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('ca_panel_geometry', JSON.stringify({
                    width: state.panelWidth,
                    left: state.panelLeft,
                    top: state.panelTop,
                    height: state.panelHeight,
                    scale: state.panelScale
                }));
            } catch(e) {}
        }, 150);
    }

    // ⭐ FIX #6b: Flush pending save sebelum unload — cegah data loss
    // kalau user F5 sebelum debounce 150ms selesai.
    //
    // Dua event dipakai untuk coverage maksimum:
    //   - 'beforeunload' : desktop F5/close (fires synchronously)
    //   - 'pagehide'     : mobile + bfcache + Safari tab close (lebih reliable)
    //
    // TIDAK pakai { once: true } karena:
    //   1. bfcache bisa restore page tanpa re-run script → listener harus tetap ada
    //   2. Guard `if (window.__caPanelSaveTimer)` sudah jadi idempotency check —
    //      setelah flush pertama, timer = 0, call berikutnya no-op
    function __caFlushPanelSave() {
        if (!window.__caPanelSaveTimer) return;
        clearTimeout(window.__caPanelSaveTimer);
        window.__caPanelSaveTimer = 0;
        try {
            localStorage.setItem('ca_panel_geometry', JSON.stringify({
                width: state.panelWidth,
                left: state.panelLeft,
                top: state.panelTop,
                height: state.panelHeight,
                scale: state.panelScale
            }));
        } catch(e) {}
    }
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', __caFlushPanelSave);
    window.addEventListener('pagehide',     __caFlushPanelSave);

            function loadPanelGeometry() {
        try {
            // ⭐ FIX: Jangan load geometri portrait jika Cinema 3 aktif
            if (localStorage.getItem('ca_cinema3_v9_enabled') === '1') {
                state.panelWidth = null;
                state.panelHeight = null;
                state.panelScale = 1.0;
                state.panelLeft = null;
                state.panelTop = null;
                state.panelScaleOrigin = '50% 0%';
                return;
            }

            var s = localStorage.getItem('ca_panel_geometry');
            if (s) {
                var d = JSON.parse(s);
                if (typeof d.width === 'number' && d.width >= PANEL_MIN_W) state.panelWidth = d.width;
                if (typeof d.height === 'number' && d.height >= 40) state.panelHeight = d.height;
                if (typeof d.scale === 'number' && d.scale >= 0.3 && d.scale <= 2.5) state.panelScale = d.scale;
                // ⭐ FIX #12: restore saved position
                if (typeof d.left === 'number') state.panelLeft = d.left;
                if (typeof d.top === 'number') state.panelTop = d.top;
                if (d.leftPercent !== undefined && d.left === undefined) { try { localStorage.removeItem('ca_panel_geometry'); } catch(e) {} }
            }
        } catch(e) {}
        // ⭐ FIX #12: hapus hardcoded null — biarkan saved values dipakai
        // state.panelLeft = null;    REMOVED
        // state.panelTop = null;     REMOVED
        state.panelScaleOrigin = '50% 0%';
    }

        function resetPanelGeometry() {
        if (window.__caVTActive) return;   // ⭐ FIX: defer, jangan fight VT
        state.panelWidth = 470;
        state.panelLeft = null;
        state.panelTop = null;
        state.panelHeight = 807;
        state.panelScale = 0.76;
        state.panelScaleOrigin = '50% 0%';
        savePanelGeometry();
        applyPanelGeometry();
        if (typeof window.__caUpdatePanelHeight === 'function') {
            try { window.__caUpdatePanelHeight(); } catch(e) {}
        }
        showIndicator('↺ Panel size & scale reset', '#38bdf8');
    }

    function createResizeHandles() {
        if (!customContainer) return;
        if (document.getElementById('ca-resize-edge-left')) return;

        var edgeLeft = document.createElement('div');
        edgeLeft.id = 'ca-resize-edge-left';
        edgeLeft.className = 'ca-resize-edge ca-resize-edge-left';
        edgeLeft.title = 'Drag to resize · Shift = free mode · Double-click = reset';
        edgeLeft.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) { startPanelResize(e, 'left'); });
        edgeLeft.addEventListener('dblclick', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); resetPanelGeometry(); });
        customContainer.appendChild(edgeLeft);

        var edgeRight = document.createElement('div');
        edgeRight.id = 'ca-resize-edge-right';
        edgeRight.className = 'ca-resize-edge ca-resize-edge-right';
        edgeRight.title = 'Drag to resize · Shift = free mode · Double-click = reset';
        edgeRight.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) { startPanelResize(e, 'right'); });
        edgeRight.addEventListener('dblclick', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); resetPanelGeometry(); });
        customContainer.appendChild(edgeRight);

        var edgeTop = document.createElement('div');
        edgeTop.id = 'ca-resize-edge-top';
        edgeTop.className = 'ca-resize-edge ca-resize-edge-top';
        edgeTop.title = 'Drag ke atas/bawah untuk resize vertikal · Double-click = reset';
        edgeTop.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) { startPanelResizeVertical(e, 'top'); });
        edgeTop.addEventListener('dblclick', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); resetPanelGeometry(); });
        customContainer.appendChild(edgeTop);

        var edgeBottom = document.createElement('div');
        edgeBottom.id = 'ca-resize-edge-bottom';
        edgeBottom.className = 'ca-resize-edge ca-resize-edge-bottom';
        edgeBottom.title = 'Drag ke atas/bawah untuk resize vertikal · Double-click = reset';
        edgeBottom.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) { startPanelResizeVertical(e, 'bottom'); });
        edgeBottom.addEventListener('dblclick', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); resetPanelGeometry(); });
        customContainer.appendChild(edgeBottom);

        var snap = document.createElement('div');
        snap.id = 'ca-resize-snap-label';
        snap.className = 'ca-resize-snap-label';
        customContainer.appendChild(snap);

        var corners = [
            { pos: 'tl', style: 'cursor:nwse-resize;' },
            { pos: 'tr', style: 'cursor:nesw-resize;' },
            { pos: 'bl', style: 'cursor:nesw-resize;' },
            { pos: 'br', style: 'cursor:nwse-resize;' }
        ];
        corners.forEach(function(c) {
            var el = document.createElement('div');
            el.id = 'ca-resize-corner-' + c.pos;
            el.className = 'ca-resize-corner ca-resize-corner-' + c.pos;
            el.title = 'Drag = Uniform Scale · Double-click = reset scale';
            el.style.cssText = c.style + 'touch-action:none;';
            el.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e) { startPanelScale(e, c.pos); });
            el.addEventListener('dblclick', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); resetPanelScale(); });
            customContainer.appendChild(el);
        });
    }

    function bakeScaleIntoGeometry() {
        if (!state.panelScale || state.panelScale === 1.0) return;
        if (!customContainer) return;
        var visualRect = customContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
        var hostW = window.innerWidth;
        var newWidth = Math.round(visualRect.width);
        var newLeft  = Math.round(visualRect.left);
        if (newWidth > hostW - 24) newWidth = hostW - 24;
        if (newWidth < PANEL_MIN_W) newWidth = PANEL_MIN_W;
        if (newLeft < 12) newLeft = 12;
        if (newLeft + newWidth > hostW - 12) newLeft = hostW - 12 - newWidth;
        var prevTransition = customContainer.style.transition;
        customContainer.style.transition = 'none';
        state.panelWidth = newWidth; state.panelLeft = newLeft;
        state.panelScale = 1.0; state.panelScaleOrigin = '50% 50%';
        applyPanelGeometry();
        void customContainer.offsetWidth;
        customContainer.style.transition = prevTransition || '';
    }

    // ===== MODULE O: RESIZE / DRAG / SCALE =====
    var __caResizeState = null;
    var __caResizeRAF = 0;
    var __caResizeLatest = { clientX: 0, shiftKey: false };

    function startPanelResize(e, mode) {
        if (e.button !== 0) return;
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        if (!customContainer) return;
        if (__caDragState) return;
        var panelRect = customContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
        var currentScale = state.panelScale || 1.0;
        var originXPct = 0.5;
        var parts = (state.panelScaleOrigin || '50% 50%').split(' ');
        if (parts[0]) { var p = parseFloat(parts[0]); if (!isNaN(p)) originXPct = p / 100; }
        var baseWidth = (state.panelWidth != null) ? state.panelWidth : Math.round(panelRect.width / currentScale);
        var visualLeft = panelRect.left;
        var baseLeft = (state.panelLeft != null) ? state.panelLeft : Math.round(visualLeft - baseWidth * (1 - currentScale) * originXPct);
        __caResizeState = {
            mode: mode, startX: e.clientX, startWidth: baseWidth,
            startLeftRel: baseLeft, startRightRel: baseLeft + baseWidth,
            wrapperWidth: window.innerWidth / currentScale,
            scale: currentScale, originXPct: originXPct,
            snapTargets: getSnapTargets(), activeSnap: null, freeMode: e.shiftKey
        };
        __caResizeLatest.clientX = e.clientX;
        __caResizeLatest.shiftKey = e.shiftKey;
        document.body.classList.add('ca-resizing');
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', onPanelResize, true);
        document.addEventListener('mouseup', endPanelResize, true);
    }

    function onPanelResize(e) {
        if (!__caResizeState) return;
        var delta = Math.abs(e.clientX - __caResizeState.startX);
        if (delta < 2 && !__caResizeState.activeSnap) return;
        __caResizeLatest.clientX = e.clientX;
        __caResizeLatest.shiftKey = e.shiftKey;
        if (__caResizeRAF) return;
        __caResizeRAF = requestAnimationFrame(flushPanelResize);
    }

    function flushPanelResize() {
        __caResizeRAF = 0;
        if (!__caResizeState) return;
        var st = __caResizeState;
        var clientX = __caResizeLatest.clientX;
        st.freeMode = __caResizeLatest.shiftKey;
        var dx = (clientX - st.startX) / st.scale;

        var VW = window.innerWidth;
        var PAD = 12;
        var scale = st.scale;
        var oxPct = st.originXPct;
        var factor = oxPct + scale * (1 - oxPct);

        var startVisualLeft  = st.startLeftRel + st.startWidth * (1 - scale) * oxPct;
        var startVisualRight = startVisualLeft + st.startWidth * scale;

        var isRightResize = (st.mode === 'tr' || st.mode === 'right');
        var newWidth, newLeftRel;

        if (isRightResize) {
            newWidth = st.startWidth + dx;
        } else {
            newWidth = st.startWidth - dx;
        }

        var effMinW = Math.max(PANEL_MIN_W, MIN_VIS_W / scale);
        var maxWfixed = isRightResize
            ? (VW - PAD - startVisualLeft) / scale
            : (startVisualRight - PAD) / scale;
        var maxWabs = (VW - 2 * PAD) / scale;
        var maxW = Math.min(maxWfixed, maxWabs);
        if (maxW < effMinW) maxW = effMinW;

        if (newWidth < effMinW) newWidth = effMinW;
        if (newWidth > maxW) newWidth = maxW;

        if (isRightResize) {
            newLeftRel = startVisualLeft - newWidth * (1 - scale) * oxPct;
        } else {
            newLeftRel = startVisualRight - newWidth * factor;
        }

        st.activeSnap = null;
        if (!st.freeMode) {
            var bestDist = PANEL_SNAP_THRESHOLD / scale + 1;
            var best = null;
            for (var i = 0; i < st.snapTargets.length; i++) {
                var t = st.snapTargets[i];
                var snapBaseWidth = t.width / scale;
                var d = Math.abs(snapBaseWidth - newWidth);
                if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; best = { label: t.label, width: snapBaseWidth, icon: t.icon, visualWidth: t.width }; }
            }
            if (best && best.width <= maxW && best.width >= effMinW) {
                newWidth = best.width;
                if (isRightResize) newLeftRel = startVisualLeft - newWidth * (1 - scale) * oxPct;
                else newLeftRel = startVisualRight - newWidth * factor;
                st.activeSnap = best;
            }
        }

        var visualLeft = newLeftRel + newWidth * (1 - scale) * oxPct;
        var visualRight = visualLeft + newWidth * scale;
        if (visualLeft < PAD) { newLeftRel += (PAD - visualLeft); }
        else if (visualRight > VW - PAD) { newLeftRel -= (visualRight - (VW - PAD)); }

        state.panelWidth = Math.round(newWidth);
        state.panelLeft  = Math.round(newLeftRel);
        customContainer.style.width = state.panelWidth + 'px';
        customContainer.style.maxWidth = 'none';
        customContainer.style.left = state.panelLeft + 'px';
        customContainer.style.transform = (st.scale !== 1.0) ? 'translateX(0) scale(' + st.scale + ')' : 'translateX(0)';
        customContainer.style.transformOrigin = state.panelScaleOrigin || '50% 50%';
        if (state.panelWidth * st.scale <= PANEL_COMPACT_THRESHOLD) customContainer.classList.add('ca-compact');
        else customContainer.classList.remove('ca-compact');

        var label = document.getElementById('ca-resize-snap-label');
        if (label) {
            if (st.activeSnap) { label.textContent = st.activeSnap.icon + ' ' + st.activeSnap.label + ' · ' + Math.round(st.activeSnap.visualWidth) + 'px'; label.classList.add('ca-snap-active'); }
            else { label.textContent = '📐 ' + Math.round(state.panelWidth * st.scale) + 'px'; label.classList.remove('ca-snap-active'); }
            label.style.opacity = '1';
        }
    }

    function endPanelResize() {
        if (!__caResizeState) return;
        if (__caResizeRAF) { cancelAnimationFrame(__caResizeRAF); __caResizeRAF = 0; }
        flushPanelResize();
        document.body.classList.remove('ca-resizing');
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onPanelResize, true);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', endPanelResize, true);
        var label = document.getElementById('ca-resize-snap-label');
        if (label) setTimeout(function() { label.style.opacity = '0'; }, 700);
        savePanelGeometry();
        __caResizeState = null;
        applyPanelGeometry();
        if (typeof window.__caUpdatePanelHeight === 'function') { try { window.__caUpdatePanelHeight(); } catch(e) {} }
    }

    var __caVResizeState = null;
    var __caVResizeRAF = 0;
    var __caVResizeLatest = 0;

    function startPanelResizeVertical(e, mode) {
        if (e.button !== 0) return;
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        if (!customContainer) return;
        if (__caResizeState || __caDragState || __caScaleState || __caVResizeState) return;
        var panelRect = customContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
        var startHeight = customContainer.offsetHeight;
        var startTop = (state.panelTop != null) ? state.panelTop : Math.round(panelRect.top);
        __caVResizeState = {
            mode: mode,
            startY: e.clientY,
            startHeight: startHeight,
            startTop: startTop,
            scale: state.panelScale || 1.0
        };
        __caVResizeLatest = e.clientY;
        document.body.classList.add('ca-resizing');
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', onPanelResizeVertical, true);
        document.addEventListener('mouseup', endPanelResizeVertical, true);
    }

    function onPanelResizeVertical(e) {
        if (!__caVResizeState) return;
        if (Math.abs(e.clientY - __caVResizeState.startY) < 2) return;
        __caVResizeLatest = e.clientY;
        if (__caVResizeRAF) return;
        __caVResizeRAF = requestAnimationFrame(flushPanelResizeVertical);
    }

    function flushPanelResizeVertical() {
        __caVResizeRAF = 0;
        if (!__caVResizeState) return;
        var st = __caVResizeState;
        var dy = (__caVResizeLatest - st.startY) / st.scale;
        var V_TOP = 12, V_BOT = 12, minH = 40;
        var wrapperHeight = window.innerHeight;

        var oyPct = 0.5;
        var op = (state.panelScaleOrigin || '50% 50%').split(' ');
        if (op[1]) { var py2 = parseFloat(op[1]); if (!isNaN(py2)) oyPct = py2 / 100; }
        var factorY = oyPct + st.scale * (1 - oyPct);
        if (factorY < 0.01) factorY = 0.01;

        var newTop = st.startTop;
        var newHeight = st.startHeight;

        if (st.mode === 'top') {
            newTop = st.startTop + dy;
            newHeight = st.startHeight - dy;
            if (newTop < V_TOP) { var diff = V_TOP - newTop; newTop = V_TOP; newHeight -= diff; }
            if (newHeight < minH) newHeight = minH;
        } else {
            newHeight = st.startHeight + dy;
            if (newHeight < minH) newHeight = minH;
            var maxH = (wrapperHeight - V_BOT - st.startTop) / factorY;
            if (newHeight > maxH) newHeight = maxH;
        }

        var visualBottom = newTop + newHeight * factorY;
        if (visualBottom > wrapperHeight - V_BOT) {
            newTop -= (visualBottom - (wrapperHeight - V_BOT));
        }
        var visualTop = newTop + newHeight * (1 - st.scale) * oyPct;
        if (visualTop < V_TOP) {
            newTop += (V_TOP - visualTop);
        }

        state.panelTop = Math.round(newTop);
        state.panelHeight = Math.round(newHeight);
        customContainer.style.setProperty('top', state.panelTop + 'px', 'important');
        customContainer.style.setProperty('height', state.panelHeight + 'px', 'important');
        customContainer.style.setProperty('max-height', state.panelHeight + 'px', 'important');
        if (newHeight < 300) customContainer.classList.add('ca-panel-tiny');
        else customContainer.classList.remove('ca-panel-tiny');
        var label = document.getElementById('ca-resize-snap-label');
        if (label) { label.textContent = '↕️ ' + state.panelHeight + 'px'; label.style.opacity = '1'; }
    }

    function endPanelResizeVertical() {
        if (!__caVResizeState) return;
        if (__caVResizeRAF) { cancelAnimationFrame(__caVResizeRAF); __caVResizeRAF = 0; }
        flushPanelResizeVertical();
        document.body.classList.remove('ca-resizing');
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onPanelResizeVertical, true);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', endPanelResizeVertical, true);
        var label = document.getElementById('ca-resize-snap-label');
        if (label) setTimeout(function() { label.style.opacity = '0'; }, 700);
        savePanelGeometry();
        __caVResizeState = null;
        applyPanelGeometry();
        if (typeof window.__caUpdatePanelHeight === 'function') {
            try { window.__caUpdatePanelHeight(); } catch(e) {}
        }
    }

    var __caScaleState = null;
    var __caScaleRAF = 0;
    var __caScaleLatest = null;

    function startPanelScale(e, corner) {
        if (e.button !== undefined && e.button !== 0) return;
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        if (!customContainer) return;
        if (__caDragState || __caResizeState || __caScaleState || __caVResizeState) return;

        var rect = customContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
        var anchorX = (corner === 'tr' || corner === 'br') ? rect.left  : rect.right;
        var anchorY = (corner === 'bl' || corner === 'br') ? rect.top   : rect.bottom;

        var originX = (corner === 'tr' || corner === 'br') ? '0%'       : '100%';
        var originY = (corner === 'bl' || corner === 'br') ? '0%'       : '100%';
        var oxPct = originX === '0%' ? 0 : 1;
        var oyPct = originY === '0%' ? 0 : 1;

        var startDist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(e.clientX - anchorX, 2) + Math.pow(e.clientY - anchorY, 2));
        if (startDist < 30) return;

        var currentScale = state.panelScale || 1.0;

        ensureBaseCoordinates();

        var trueBaseW = customContainer.offsetWidth;
        var trueBaseH = customContainer.offsetHeight;
        if (!trueBaseW || trueBaseW < 1) trueBaseW = Math.round(rect.width  / currentScale);
        if (!trueBaseH || trueBaseH < 1) trueBaseH = Math.round(rect.height / currentScale);

        state.panelLeft = Math.round(rect.left - trueBaseW * (1 - currentScale) * oxPct);
        state.panelTop  = Math.round(rect.top  - trueBaseH * (1 - currentScale) * oyPct);
        state.panelScaleOrigin = originX + ' ' + originY;

        __caScaleState = {
            corner: corner,
            anchorX: anchorX, anchorY: anchorY,
            startDist: startDist,
            startScale: currentScale,
            baseW: trueBaseW,
            baseH: trueBaseH,
            visualLeft0: rect.left,
            visualTop0:  rect.top,
            oxPct: oxPct, oyPct: oyPct,
            pointerId: e.pointerId,
            moved: false
        };

        try { if (e.target && e.target.setPointerCapture) e.target.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch(err) {}
        document.body.classList.add('ca-resizing');
        document.addEventListener('pointermove', onPanelScale, true);
        document.addEventListener('pointerup', endPanelScale, true);
        document.addEventListener('pointercancel', endPanelScale, true);

        var label = document.getElementById('ca-resize-snap-label');
        if (label) { label.textContent = '⤢ ' + Math.round(currentScale * 100) + '%'; label.style.opacity = '1'; }
    }

    function onPanelScale(e) {
        if (!__caScaleState) return;
        if (e.pointerId !== undefined && e.pointerId !== __caScaleState.pointerId) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        __caScaleLatest = e;
        if (__caScaleRAF) return;
        __caScaleRAF = requestAnimationFrame(flushPanelScale);
    }

    function flushPanelScale() {
        __caScaleRAF = 0;
        if (!__caScaleState || !__caScaleLatest) return;
        var e = __caScaleLatest;
        var st = __caScaleState;
        var dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(e.clientX - st.anchorX, 2) + Math.pow(e.clientY - st.anchorY, 2));
        var rawScale = st.startScale * (dist / st.startDist);
        rawScale = Math.max(0.3, Math.min(2.5, rawScale));

        var PAD = 12;
        var VW = window.innerWidth, VH = window.innerHeight;
        var maxScale = rawScale;

        if (st.oxPct > 0 && st.baseW > 0) {
            var sL = st.startScale + (st.visualLeft0 - PAD) / (st.baseW * st.oxPct);
            if (maxScale > sL) maxScale = sL;
        }
        if (st.oyPct > 0 && st.baseH > 0) {
            var sT = st.startScale + (st.visualTop0 - PAD) / (st.baseH * st.oyPct);
            if (maxScale > sT) maxScale = sT;
        }

        if (st.oxPct < 1 && st.baseW > 0) {
            var sR = ((VW - PAD - st.visualLeft0) / st.baseW - st.startScale * st.oxPct) / (1 - st.oxPct);
            if (maxScale > sR) maxScale = sR;
        }
        if (st.oyPct < 1 && st.baseH > 0) {
            var sB = ((VH - PAD - st.visualTop0) / st.baseH - st.startScale * st.oyPct) / (1 - st.oyPct);
            if (maxScale > sB) maxScale = sB;
        }

        if (st.baseW > 0) { var sAbsW = (VW - 2 * PAD) / st.baseW; if (maxScale > sAbsW) maxScale = sAbsW; }
        if (st.baseH > 0) { var sAbsH = (VH - 2 * PAD) / st.baseH; if (maxScale > sAbsH) maxScale = sAbsH; }

        var minFromW = st.baseW > 0 ? (MIN_VIS_W / st.baseW) : 0.3;
        var minFromH = st.baseH > 0 ? (MIN_VIS_H / st.baseH) : 0.3;
        var minScale = Math.max(0.3, minFromW, minFromH);

        if (rawScale > maxScale) rawScale = maxScale;
        if (rawScale < minScale) rawScale = minScale;

        state.panelScale = Math.round(rawScale * 100) / 100;
        st.moved = true;
        applyPanelGeometry();
        var label = document.getElementById('ca-resize-snap-label');
        if (label) { label.textContent = '⤢ ' + Math.round(state.panelScale * 100) + '%'; label.classList.remove('ca-snap-active'); label.style.opacity = '1'; }
    }

    function endPanelScale() {
        if (!__caScaleState) return;
        if (__caScaleRAF) { cancelAnimationFrame(__caScaleRAF); __caScaleRAF = 0; }
        flushPanelScale();
        document.body.classList.remove('ca-resizing');
        document.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPanelScale, true);
        document.removeEventListener('pointerup', endPanelScale, true);
        document.removeEventListener('pointercancel', endPanelScale, true);
        var label = document.getElementById('ca-resize-snap-label');
        if (label) setTimeout(function() { label.style.opacity = '0'; }, 700);
        if (__caScaleState.moved) showIndicator('⤢ Scale: ' + Math.round(state.panelScale * 100) + '%', '#38bdf8');
        savePanelGeometry();
        __caScaleState = null;
        __caScaleLatest = null;
    }

        function resetPanelScale() {
        if (window.__caVTActive) return;
        state.panelScale = 1.0; state.panelScaleOrigin = '50% 50%';
        applyPanelGeometry(); savePanelGeometry();
        showIndicator('↺ Scale reset to 100%', '#38bdf8');
    }

    var __caDragState = null;
    var __caDragRAF = 0;
    var __caDragLatestX = 0;
    var __caDragLatestY = 0;

    function isDragIgnoredTarget(target) {
        if (!target || !target.closest) return false;
        if (target.closest('.ca-toggle-btn'))           return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-ip-hover-toggle-wrap')) return true;
        if (target.closest('#ca-minimize-btn'))         return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-search-wrapper'))       return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-resize-edge'))          return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-resize-corner'))        return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-resize-handle'))        return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-country-item'))         return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-fav-chip'))             return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-all-countries-btn'))    return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-sort-btn'))             return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-btn-action'))           return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-btn-clear-mini'))       return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-card-btn'))             return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-chip-del'))             return true;
        if (target.closest('.ca-blocked-chip'))         return true;
        if (target.closest('button'))                   return true;
        if (target.closest('input'))                    return true;
        if (target.closest('select'))                   return true;
        if (target.closest('textarea'))                 return true;
        if (target.closest('a'))                        return true;
        return false;
    }

    function startPanelDrag(e) {
        if (e.button !== 0) return;
        if (!customContainer) return;
        if (__caResizeState || __caScaleState || __caVResizeState || __caDragState) return;
        if (isDragIgnoredTarget(e.target)) return;

        var isClickTarget = !!(e.target.closest && (
            e.target.closest('.ca-tab') ||
            e.target.closest('.ca-block-wrapper')
        ));

        e.preventDefault();
        if (!isClickTarget) {
            e.stopPropagation();
        }

        var panelRect = customContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
        var scale = state.panelScale || 1.0;

        var originXPct = 0.5, originYPct = 0.5;
        var parts = (state.panelScaleOrigin || '50% 50%').split(' ');
        if (parts[0]) { var p  = parseFloat(parts[0]); if (!isNaN(p))  originXPct = p  / 100; }
        if (parts[1]) { var p2 = parseFloat(parts[1]); if (!isNaN(p2)) originYPct = p2 / 100; }

        ensureBaseCoordinates();

        // ⭐ FIX DRAG-EXPLODE: ensureBaseCoordinates() mungkin baru saja
        //    memperbaiki state.panelScale dari 1.0 ke 0.76. Kita harus
        //    me-refresh variabel lokal `scale` agar drag menggunakan skala
        //    yang sudah terkoreksi, bukan skala stale.
        scale = state.panelScale || 1.0;

        var baseWidth = state.panelWidth;
        if (baseWidth == null) {
            try {
                var saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ca_panel_geometry') || '{}');
                baseWidth = saved.width || 470;
            } catch(e) {
                baseWidth = 470;
            }
        }
        var baseHeight = customContainer.offsetHeight || Math.round(panelRect.height / scale);

        __caDragState = {
            startX: e.clientX, startY: e.clientY,
            startBaseLeft: state.panelLeft, startBaseTop: state.panelTop,
            baseWidth: baseWidth, baseHeight: baseHeight,
            wrapperWidth:  window.innerWidth,
            wrapperHeight: window.innerHeight,
            scale: scale,
            originXPct: originXPct, originYPct: originYPct,
            moved: false, committed: false,
            isClickTarget: isClickTarget,
            effectiveH: baseHeight
        };
        __caDragLatestX = e.clientX;
        __caDragLatestY = e.clientY;

        customContainer.classList.add('ca-dragging');
        document.body.classList.add('ca-dragging-body');

        document.addEventListener('mousemove', onPanelDrag, true);
        document.addEventListener('mouseup',   endPanelDrag, true);
        window.addEventListener('mouseup',     endPanelDrag, true);
        window.addEventListener('blur',        endPanelDrag);
    }

    function onPanelDrag(e) {
        if (!__caDragState) return;
        __caDragLatestX = e.clientX;
        __caDragLatestY = e.clientY;
        if (__caDragRAF) return;
        __caDragRAF = requestAnimationFrame(flushPanelDrag);
    }

    function flushPanelDrag() {
        __caDragRAF = 0;
        if (!__caDragState) return;
        var st = __caDragState;

        var dx = (__caDragLatestX - st.startX) / st.scale;
        var dy = (__caDragLatestY - st.startY) / st.scale;

        if (!st.moved) {
            if (Math.abs(dx) < 3 && Math.abs(dy) < 3) return;
            st.moved = true;
        }
        if (!st.committed) {
            st.committed = true;
            state.panelWidth = st.baseWidth;
            state.panelLeft  = st.startBaseLeft;
            state.panelTop   = st.startBaseTop;
        }

        var H_PAD = 12, V_TOP = 12, V_BOT = 12, minH = 40;
        var vw = window.innerWidth;
        var vh = window.innerHeight;

        var newBaseLeft = st.startBaseLeft + dx;
        var visualWidth = st.baseWidth * st.scale;
        var visualLeft  = newBaseLeft + st.baseWidth * (1 - st.scale) * st.originXPct;
        var visualRight = visualLeft + visualWidth;

        if (visualWidth > vw - 2 * H_PAD) {
            st.baseWidth = Math.max(PANEL_MIN_W, Math.floor((vw - 2 * H_PAD) / st.scale));
            state.panelWidth = st.baseWidth;
            visualWidth  = st.baseWidth * st.scale;
            visualLeft   = newBaseLeft + st.baseWidth * (1 - st.scale) * st.originXPct;
            visualRight  = visualLeft + visualWidth;
        }
        if (visualLeft < H_PAD) {
            newBaseLeft += (H_PAD - visualLeft);
        } else if (visualRight > vw - H_PAD) {
            newBaseLeft -= (visualRight - (vw - H_PAD));
        }
        state.panelLeft = Math.round(newBaseLeft);

        var H = st.baseHeight;
        if (H < minH) H = minH;

        var oy = st.originYPct != null ? st.originYPct : 0.5;
        var sc = st.scale || 1;

        var visualH = H * sc;
        var vTopOf  = function(bt) { return bt + H * (1 - sc) * oy; };

        var newBaseTop = st.startBaseTop + dy;
        var vT = vTopOf(newBaseTop);
        var vB = vT + visualH;

        if (visualH <= vh - V_TOP - V_BOT) {
            if (vT < V_TOP)           newBaseTop += (V_TOP - vT);
            else if (vB > vh - V_BOT) newBaseTop -= (vB - (vh - V_BOT));
        } else {
            if (vT < V_TOP)         newBaseTop += (V_TOP - vT);
            else if (vT > vh - 50)  newBaseTop -= (vT - (vh - 50));
        }

        state.panelTop = Math.round(newBaseTop);
        st.effectiveH  = Math.round(H);

        customContainer.style.width = state.panelWidth + 'px';
        customContainer.style.maxWidth = 'none';
        customContainer.style.left = state.panelLeft + 'px';
        customContainer.style.setProperty('top', state.panelTop + 'px', 'important');
        customContainer.style.transform = (sc !== 1.0)
            ? 'translateX(0) scale(' + sc + ')'
            : 'translateX(0)';
        customContainer.style.transformOrigin = state.panelScaleOrigin || '50% 50%';

        if (state.panelWidth * sc <= PANEL_COMPACT_THRESHOLD)
            customContainer.classList.add('ca-compact');
        else customContainer.classList.remove('ca-compact');

        customContainer.style.setProperty('height',     H + 'px', 'important');
        customContainer.style.setProperty('max-height', H + 'px', 'important');

        if (H < 300) customContainer.classList.add('ca-panel-tiny');
        else         customContainer.classList.remove('ca-panel-tiny');

        var label = document.getElementById('ca-resize-snap-label');
        if (label) {
            label.textContent = '↔️ ' + state.panelLeft + ' · ↕️ ' + state.panelTop + ' · ' + H + 'px (tetap)';
            label.classList.remove('ca-snap-active');
            label.style.opacity = '1';
        }
    }

    function endPanelDrag() {
        if (!__caDragState) return;
        var drag = __caDragState;

        if (__caDragRAF) { cancelAnimationFrame(__caDragRAF); __caDragRAF = 0; }
        try { flushPanelDrag(); } catch(err) { console.warn('[CA] flushPanelDrag:', err); }

        var wasMoved   = drag.moved;
        var isClickTgt = drag.isClickTarget;
        var savedH     = drag.effectiveH || drag.baseHeight;

        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onPanelDrag, true);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup',   endPanelDrag, true);
        window.removeEventListener('mouseup',     endPanelDrag, true);
        window.removeEventListener('blur',        endPanelDrag);
        if (customContainer) customContainer.classList.remove('ca-dragging');
        document.body.classList.remove('ca-dragging-body');
        var label = document.getElementById('ca-resize-snap-label');
        if (label) setTimeout(function() { label.style.opacity = '0'; }, 700);

        __caDragState = null;

        if (wasMoved && isClickTgt) {
            var blockClick = function(ev) {
                ev.stopPropagation();
                ev.preventDefault();
                document.removeEventListener('click', blockClick, true);
            };
            document.addEventListener('click', blockClick, true);
            setTimeout(function() { document.removeEventListener('click', blockClick, true); }, 200);
        }

        if (wasMoved && savedH > 0) {
            state.panelHeight = Math.round(savedH);
            try { savePanelGeometry(); } catch(err) {}
        }

        try {
            applyPanelGeometry();
            if (typeof window.__caUpdatePanelHeight === 'function') {
                try { window.__caUpdatePanelHeight(); } catch(err) {}
            }
        } catch(err) { console.warn('[CA] applyPanelGeometry:', err); }
    }

    function attachPanelDragHandler() {
        if (!customContainer) return;
        if (customContainer.__caDragAttached) return;
        customContainer.__caDragAttached = true;
        customContainer.style.cursor = 'grab';
        customContainer.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
            if (isDragIgnoredTarget(e.target)) return;
            if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.ca-resize-edge')) return;
            if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.ca-resize-corner')) return;
            startPanelDrag(e);
        });
        var headerRow = customContainer.querySelector('.ca-header-row');
        if (headerRow && !headerRow.__caDragAttached) { headerRow.__caDragAttached = true; headerRow.style.cursor = 'grab'; }
    }

    // ===== MODULE Q: KEYBOARD NAV =====
    var __caKbMode = false;
    var __caKbAutoNav = false;
    var KB_TAB_ORDER = ['all', 'block', 'ip', 'history'];
    var __caTooltipTimer = null;
    var __caKbTooltipTimer = null;

   function caIsCompactMode() {
    var __p = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
    return !!(__p && __p.classList.contains('ca-compact'));
}

// ⭐ FIX TOOLTIP-CINEMA3: nama negara hidden di cinema3 (CSS `ca-cinema3-docked`),
//    jadi tooltip WAJIB tampil meski class `ca-compact` tidak ada.
function caShouldShowTooltip() {
    var __p = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
    if (!__p) return false;

    // Signal 1: ca-compact class (normal mode, sempit)
    if (__p.classList.contains('ca-compact')) return true;

    // Signal 2: ca-cinema3-docked (panel docked ke grid cinema3)
    if (__p.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-docked')) return true;

    // Signal 3: box aktif di cinema3 mode (transient race recovery)
    try {
        if (document.querySelector('.roulette-box.ca-cinema3-active')) return true;
    } catch(e) {}

    // Signal 4: nama negara di-hide CSS → tooltip wajib tampil
    try {
        var sampleName = __p.querySelector('.ca-country-item .ca-country-name');
        if (sampleName) {
            var cs = getComputedStyle(sampleName);
            if (cs.display === 'none' || cs.visibility === 'hidden' ||
                parseFloat(cs.opacity) === 0 || parseFloat(cs.maxWidth) <= 1) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    // ⭐ Signal 5 (NEW): Fallback via VISUAL WIDTH — heal race saat `ca-compact`
    //    class nyangkut dari cinema3 reload (panelWidth=null, scale=1). Ini
    //    self-correcting: kalau panel sempit (<500px) → tooltip SHOULD show
    //    regardless of class state. Non-compact intentional (>500px) tetap
    //    supaya tooltip tidak muncul on top of visible names.
    try {
        var rect = __p.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.width > 0 && rect.width <= 500) return true;
    } catch(e) {}

    return false;
}

function caShowTooltip(anchorEl, text) {
    if (!anchorEl || !text || !caShouldShowTooltip()) return;

        // ⭐ FIX: Cegah tooltip muncul saat panel sedang disembunyikan (Exit Cinema)
        var panel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        if (!panel) {
            var stuck0 = document.getElementById('ca-country-tooltip');
            if (stuck0) stuck0.remove();
            return;
        }

        // ⭐ FIX BUG (confirmed via diagnostic): Panel di cinema3-docked sering
        //    punya inline `display: 'none'` yang nyangkut dari createPanel()
        //    karena applyCinemaModeState('1') early-return via mutex sebelum
        //    sempat cleanup inline. CSS `.ca-cinema3-docked` paksa `display:flex
        //    !important` → panel TERLIHAT, tapi inline 'none' tetap → tooltip
        //    guard fail → bubble tidak pernah muncul.
        //
        //    Solusi: Kalau panel DOCKED → percaya COMPUTED display saja
        //    (CSS !important menang atas inline). Kalau TIDAK docked (mode
        //    normal) → tetap cek inline 'none' (perilaku lama untuk minimize).
        var __isDockedC3 = panel.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-docked');
        var __computedDisplay = getComputedStyle(panel).display;
        var __reallyHidden = (__computedDisplay === 'none') ||
                             (!__isDockedC3 && panel.style.display === 'none');

        if (__reallyHidden) {
            var stuck = document.getElementById('ca-country-tooltip');
            if (stuck) stuck.remove();
            return;
        }

        var tt = document.getElementById('ca-country-tooltip');
        if (!tt) { tt = document.createElement('div'); tt.id = 'ca-country-tooltip'; document.body.appendChild(tt); }
        tt.style.display = 'block'; // ⭐ FIX: Munculkan kembali elemen
        tt.classList.remove('ca-tt-show', 'ca-tt-below');
        tt.textContent = text;
        tt.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        var r = anchorEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        var ttr = tt.getBoundingClientRect();
        var ARROW_GAP = 8;
var panelEl = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui') || customContainer;
var panelRect = panelEl ? panelEl.getBoundingClientRect() : null;
        var boundsLeft = 8, boundsRight = window.innerWidth - 8;
        var boundsTop = 8, boundsBottom = window.innerHeight - 8;
        if (panelRect) {
            boundsLeft   = Math.max(8, panelRect.left + 4);
            boundsRight  = Math.min(window.innerWidth - 8, panelRect.right - 4);
            boundsTop    = Math.max(8, panelRect.top + 4);
            boundsBottom = Math.min(window.innerHeight - 8, panelRect.bottom - 4);
        }
        if (r.bottom < boundsTop || r.top > boundsBottom || r.right < boundsLeft || r.left > boundsRight) { return; }
        var top  = r.top - ttr.height - ARROW_GAP;
        var left = r.left + r.width / 2 - ttr.width / 2;
        var placeBelow = false;
        if (top < boundsTop) { top = r.bottom + ARROW_GAP; placeBelow = true; }
        if (top + ttr.height > boundsBottom) {
            top = boundsBottom - ttr.height;
            if (top < boundsTop) top = boundsTop;
        }
        if (left < boundsLeft) left = boundsLeft;
        if (left + ttr.width > boundsRight) left = boundsRight - ttr.width;
        if (left < boundsLeft) left = boundsLeft;
        var arrowX = r.left + r.width / 2 - left;
        arrowX = Math.max(14, Math.min(ttr.width - 14, arrowX));
        tt.style.top = top + 'px';
        tt.style.left = left + 'px';
        tt.style.setProperty('--ca-tt-arrow-x', arrowX + 'px');
        tt.style.visibility = '';
        if (placeBelow) tt.classList.add('ca-tt-below');
        requestAnimationFrame(function() { tt.classList.add('ca-tt-show'); });
    }

           function caHideTooltip() {
        var tt = document.getElementById('ca-country-tooltip');
        if (tt) {
            tt.classList.remove('ca-tt-show');
            tt.remove(); // ⭐ FIX: Hapus total dari DOM agar tidak nyangkut (stuck)
        }
        if (__caTooltipTimer)   { clearTimeout(__caTooltipTimer);   __caTooltipTimer = null; }
        if (__caKbTooltipTimer) { clearTimeout(__caKbTooltipTimer); __caKbTooltipTimer = null; }
    }

    function caAttachTooltipToItem(itemEl, nameText) {
        if (!itemEl || itemEl.__caTtAttached) return;
        itemEl.__caTtAttached = true;
itemEl.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
    if (!caShouldShowTooltip()) return;
    if (__caTooltipTimer) clearTimeout(__caTooltipTimer);
            __caTooltipTimer = setTimeout(function() { caShowTooltip(itemEl, nameText); }, 120);
        });
        itemEl.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
            if (__caTooltipTimer) { clearTimeout(__caTooltipTimer); __caTooltipTimer = null; }
            caHideTooltip();
        });
    }

        function kbGetGridItems() {
    if (!gridDiv) return [];
    var list = gridDiv.querySelectorAll(
        '.ca-country-item, .ca-fav-chip, .ca-all-countries-btn, ' +
        '.ca-view-toggle-btn, .ca-ip-hover-toggle-wrap, ' +
        '.ca-sort-btn, .ca-btn-action, .ca-card-btn, ' +
        '.ca-chip-del, .ca-btn-clear-mini, ' +
        '.ca-history-card, .ca-ip-chip'
    );
    var arr = Array.prototype.slice.call(list);

    // ⭐ FIX: sembunyikan toggle dari navigasi saat panel non-compact
    //    (CSS menyembunyikannya via `:not(.ca-compact) .ca-view-toggle-btn { display:none }`)
    //    Jadi jangan masuk list — arrow key & Enter tidak akan "nyangkut" di item tak terlihat
    var isCompact = customContainer && customContainer.classList.contains('ca-compact');
    if (!isCompact) {
        arr = arr.filter(function(el) {
            return !el.classList.contains('ca-view-toggle-btn');
        });
    }
    return arr;
}
        function kbGetTabs() {
        if (!customContainer) return [];
        return Array.prototype.slice.call(
            customContainer.querySelectorAll('.ca-tab, .ca-block-wrapper')
        ).filter(function(t) {
            // ⭐ FIX: exclude .ca-tab-block yang nested di dalam .ca-block-wrapper
            //    agar index match KB_TAB_ORDER = ['all','block','ip','history']
            if (t.classList.contains('ca-tab') && t.closest('.ca-block-wrapper')) return false;
            return true;
        });
    }
    function kbGetAllBtn() { if (!gridDiv) return null; return gridDiv.querySelector('.ca-all-countries-btn'); }

        function kbClearAllFocus() {
        kbGetGridItems().forEach(function(it) { it.classList.remove('ca-kb-focus'); });
        kbGetTabs().forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove('ca-tab-focus'); });
        var ab = kbGetAllBtn(); if (ab) ab.classList.remove('ca-allbtn-focus');
        if (searchInput && searchInput.parentElement) searchInput.parentElement.classList.remove('ca-search-kb-focus');
        state.kbFocusIdx = -1;
        state.kbTabFocusIdx = 0;
        // ⭐ FIX-3: Reset ke 'tabs' (bukan 'grid').
        //    Bug lama: target='grid' + idx=-1 → kbArrowGrid fallback lompat
        //    ke kbFocusGridAt(0) → SKIP search & tab bar → user merasa "nav mati"
        //    karena tekan Down malah nyangkut di grid item teratas.
        //    Dengan 'tabs': Down berikutnya = kbArrowTabs → kbFocusSearch (correct).
        state.kbFocusTarget = 'tabs';
        caHideTooltip();
    }

    function kbFocusTabsAt(idx) {
        var tabs = kbGetTabs();
        if (tabs.length === 0) return false;
        if (idx < 0) idx = 0;
        if (idx >= tabs.length) idx = tabs.length - 1;
        tabs.forEach(function(t, i) { if (i === idx) t.classList.add('ca-tab-focus'); else t.classList.remove('ca-tab-focus'); });
        if (tabs[idx]) { try { tabs[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' }); } catch(e) {} }        if (tabs[idx]) { try { tabs[idx].focus(); } catch(e) {} }
        kbGetGridItems().forEach(function(it) { it.classList.remove('ca-kb-focus'); });
        var ab = kbGetAllBtn(); if (ab) ab.classList.remove('ca-allbtn-focus');
        if (searchInput && searchInput.parentElement) searchInput.parentElement.classList.remove('ca-search-kb-focus');
        state.kbFocusTarget = 'tabs'; state.kbTabFocusIdx = idx;
        caHideTooltip();
        return true;
    }

    function kbFocusAllBtn() {
    // ⭐ FIX: hanya boleh berfungsi di tab All
    if (state.activeTab !== 'all') return false;

    var ab = kbGetAllBtn();
    if (!ab) return false;

    // ⭐ FIX v2: guard terhadap node detached (transient DOM state)
    if (typeof ab.isConnected === 'boolean' && !ab.isConnected) return false;

    kbGetTabs().forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove('ca-tab-focus'); });
    kbGetGridItems().forEach(function(it) { it.classList.remove('ca-kb-focus'); });
    ab.classList.add('ca-allbtn-focus');
    if (searchInput && searchInput.parentElement) searchInput.parentElement.classList.remove('ca-search-kb-focus');
    try { ab.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' }); } catch(e) {}
    try { ab.focus(); } catch(e) {}
    state.kbFocusTarget = 'allbtn';
    caHideTooltip();
    return true;
}

                     function kbFocusSearch() {
    // ── 1. Re-query kalau stale ──
    if (!searchInput || !searchInput.isConnected) {
        try {
            searchInput = document.querySelector('#my-custom-country-ui .ca-search-input');
        } catch(e) { searchInput = null; }
        if (!searchInput) return false;
    }

    // ⭐ FIX UTAMA: paksa exit tiny mode sebelum cek visibility
    //    — saat user arrow ke search, kita asumsikan user INGIN search,
    //    jadi expand panel kalau perlu (lebih baik daripada skip diam-diam)
    var __panel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
    if (__panel && __panel.classList.contains('ca-panel-tiny')) {
        console.log('[CA-NAV] 🚨 tiny mode terdeteksi → force expand untuk reach search');
        __panel.classList.remove('ca-panel-tiny');

        // Restore panelHeight ke nilai wajar
        if (window.__ca && window.__ca.state) {
            var h = window.__ca.state.panelHeight;
            if (!h || h < 300) {
                // Default: 807 atau 82% viewport, mana yang lebih besar
                window.__ca.state.panelHeight = Math.max(807, Math.round(window.innerHeight * 0.82));
            }
        }
        if (typeof window.__caUpdatePanelHeight === 'function') {
            try { window.__caUpdatePanelHeight(); } catch(e) {}
        }
        // Force reflow supaya offsetWidth langsung update
        void __panel.offsetWidth;

        try {
            if (window.__ca && window.__ca.showIndicator) {
                window.__ca.showIndicator('📐 Panel di-expand untuk reach search', '#38bdf8');
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    // ── 2. Cek visibility ──
    var isReallyVisible = (searchInput.offsetWidth > 0 && searchInput.offsetHeight > 0)
                       || searchInput.getClientRects().length > 0;

    if (!isReallyVisible) {
        console.warn('[CA-NAV] ⚠️ search masih invisible setelah exit tiny — skip');
        return false;
    }

    // ── 3. Bersihkan highlight ──
    try {
        kbGetGridItems().forEach(function(it) { it.classList.remove('ca-kb-focus'); });
        kbGetTabs().forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove('ca-tab-focus'); });
        var ab = kbGetAllBtn(); if (ab) ab.classList.remove('ca-allbtn-focus');
        caHideTooltip();
    } catch(e) {}

        // ── 3b. SAVE previous state untuk rollback jika focus gagal ──
    var __prevTarget = state.kbFocusTarget;
    var __prevIdx    = state.kbFocusIdx;
    var __prevTabIdx = state.kbTabFocusIdx;
    var __prevHadFocusClass = !!(searchInput.parentElement &&
                                 searchInput.parentElement.classList.contains('ca-search-kb-focus'));

    // ── 4. Set state (sementara — akan di-rollback kalau focus gagal) ──
    state.kbFocusIdx = -1;
    state.kbFocusTarget = 'search';
    if (searchInput.parentElement) {
        searchInput.parentElement.classList.add('ca-search-kb-focus');
    }

    // ── 5. Multi-attempt focus ──
    var attempts = [
        function() { searchInput.focus({ preventScroll: true }); },
        function() { void searchInput.offsetWidth; searchInput.focus({ preventScroll: true }); },
        function() { if (!searchInput.hasAttribute('tabindex')) searchInput.setAttribute('tabindex', '0'); searchInput.focus({ preventScroll: true }); },
        function() { searchInput.select && searchInput.select(); searchInput.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }
    ];
    for (var __i = 0; __i < attempts.length; __i++) {
        try { attempts[__i](); } catch(e) {}
        if (document.activeElement === searchInput) {
            console.log('[CA-NAV] ✅ search focused via attempt ' + __i);
            return true;
        }
    }

    // ── 6. Delayed retries ──
    var __retry = function() {
        if (state.kbFocusTarget !== 'search') return;
        if (document.activeElement === searchInput) return;
        try { searchInput.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch(e) {}
        if (document.activeElement === searchInput && searchInput.parentElement) {
            searchInput.parentElement.classList.add('ca-search-kb-focus');
        }
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(__retry);
    setTimeout(__retry, 50);
    setTimeout(__retry, 150);
    setTimeout(__retry, 300);

    // ⭐ FIX KRITIS: kalau focus masih gagal SEKARANG, ROLLBACK state.
    //    Tanpa rollback, caller (`kbArrowTabs`) lihat state='search' bukan
    //    'tabs' → rAF retry di caller MATI → Down berikutnya "skip" search.
    if (document.activeElement === searchInput) {
        return true;
    }

    console.warn('[CA-NAV] ❌ search focus failed — ROLLBACK state to prev');
    state.kbFocusTarget = __prevTarget;
    state.kbFocusIdx    = __prevIdx;
    state.kbTabFocusIdx = __prevTabIdx;
    if (!__prevHadFocusClass && searchInput.parentElement) {
        searchInput.parentElement.classList.remove('ca-search-kb-focus');
    }
    return false;
}

    function kbBlurSearch() {
        if (searchInput && searchInput.parentElement) searchInput.parentElement.classList.remove('ca-search-kb-focus');
        if (searchInput) try { searchInput.blur(); } catch(e) {}
    }

   function kbFocusGridAt(idx, skipScroll) {
    var items = kbGetGridItems();
    if (items.length === 0) return false;
    if (idx < 0) idx = 0;
    if (idx >= items.length) idx = items.length - 1;

    items.forEach(function(it, i) {
        if (i === idx) {
            // ⭐ FIX: Gunakan ca-allbtn-focus jika targetnya adalah tombol ALL COUNTRIES
            if (it.classList.contains('ca-all-countries-btn')) {
                it.classList.add('ca-allbtn-focus');
                it.classList.remove('ca-kb-focus');
            } else {
                it.classList.add('ca-kb-focus');
            }
        } else {
            it.classList.remove('ca-kb-focus');
            if (it.classList.contains('ca-all-countries-btn')) it.classList.remove('ca-allbtn-focus');
        }
    });

    kbGetTabs().forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove('ca-tab-focus'); });
    // ⭐ HAPUS baris `var ab = kbGetAllBtn(); if (ab) ab.classList.remove('ca-allbtn-focus');`
    // Karena sudah ditangani di dalam loop di atas.

    if (searchInput && searchInput.parentElement) searchInput.parentElement.classList.remove('ca-search-kb-focus');
    state.kbFocusTarget = 'grid'; state.kbFocusIdx = idx;
    try {
        if (items[idx]) {
            if (!items[idx].hasAttribute('tabindex')) items[idx].setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
            items[idx].focus();
        }
    } catch(e) {}
    if (!skipScroll && gridDiv) {
        try {
            var itRect = items[idx].getBoundingClientRect();
            var gRect  = gridDiv.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (itRect.top < gRect.top + 2 || itRect.bottom > gRect.bottom - 2) {
                items[idx].scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'auto' });
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    }
    if (__caKbTooltipTimer) { clearTimeout(__caKbTooltipTimer); __caKbTooltipTimer = null; }
    caHideTooltip();
if (caShouldShowTooltip() && items[idx]) {
        var targetIdx  = idx;
        var targetItem = items[idx];
        __caKbTooltipTimer = setTimeout(function() {
            __caKbTooltipTimer = null;
            if (state.kbFocusTarget !== 'grid' || state.kbFocusIdx !== targetIdx) return;
            var curItem = document.contains(targetItem) ? targetItem : null;
            if (!curItem) {
                var curItems = kbGetGridItems();
                if (targetIdx < curItems.length) curItem = curItems[targetIdx];
            }
            if (!curItem) return;
            var nm = curItem.querySelector('.ca-country-name, .ca-fav-chip-name');
            caShowTooltip(curItem, curItem.getAttribute('data-ca-name')
                                 || (nm ? (nm.textContent || '').trim() : ''));
        }, 140);
    }
    return true;
}

        function kbIsTopRow(item) {
        // ⭐ FIX: Pastikan elemen adalah negara, bukan tombol
        if (!item || item.classList.contains('ca-fav-chip') || !item.classList.contains('ca-country-item')) return false;
        var items = kbGetGridItems();
        if (items.length === 0) return false;
        var firstCountryItem = null;
        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
            if (items[i].classList.contains('ca-country-item')) { firstCountryItem = items[i]; break; }
        }
        if (!firstCountryItem) return false;
        var refTop = firstCountryItem.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        var itemTop = item.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        return Math.abs(itemTop - refTop) < 8;
    }

   function kbGridFindNext(curItem, key) {
    var items = kbGetGridItems();
    if (items.length === 0) return -1;
    var curRect = curItem.getBoundingClientRect();
    var curCX = curRect.left + curRect.width / 2;
    var curCY = curRect.top + curRect.height / 2;
    var itemH = curRect.height || 25;
    var TOL_STRICT = Math.max(6, itemH * 0.4);
    var TOL_MAX = itemH * 1.2;

    var best = null, bestDist = Infinity;
    // ⭐ FIX: fallback untuk vertical — izinkan horizontal drift besar
    //         (mis. tombol ALL COUNTRIES yang lebar-terpusat di atas negara kiri)
    var fallbackBest = null, fallbackDist = Infinity;

    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        var it = items[i];
        if (it === curItem) continue;
        var r = it.getBoundingClientRect();
        var x = r.left + r.width / 2;
        var y = r.top + r.height / 2;
        var d, perp;
        if (key === 'ArrowRight') { if (x <= curCX + 2) continue; perp = Math.abs(y - curCY); d = x - curCX; }
        else if (key === 'ArrowLeft') { if (x >= curCX - 2) continue; perp = Math.abs(y - curCY); d = curCX - x; }
        else if (key === 'ArrowDown') { if (y <= curCY + 2) continue; perp = Math.abs(x - curCX); d = y - curCY; }
        else if (key === 'ArrowUp') { if (y >= curCY - 2) continue; perp = Math.abs(x - curCX); d = curCY - y; }
        else continue;

        // Primary: item dalam toleransi horizontal normal
        if (perp <= TOL_MAX) {
            var priority = (perp <= TOL_STRICT) ? 0 : 1;
            var score = priority * 100000 + perp * 5 + d;
            if (score < bestDist) { bestDist = score; best = it; }
        }

        // Fallback (vertical only): closest item, prioritaskan jarak vertikal (d)
        if (key === 'ArrowUp' || key === 'ArrowDown') {
            var fb = d * 3 + perp;
            if (fb < fallbackDist) { fallbackDist = fb; fallbackBest = it; }
        }
    }

    if (best) return items.indexOf(best);
    if (fallbackBest) return items.indexOf(fallbackBest);
    return -1;
}

        function kbActivate() {
        if (state.kbFocusTarget === 'tabs') {
            var tabs = kbGetTabs();
            var t = tabs[state.kbTabFocusIdx];
            if (t) { t.click(); setTimeout(function() { state.kbFocusIdx = -1; state.kbFocusTarget = 'grid'; }, 60); }
        } else if (state.kbFocusTarget === 'allbtn') {
            var ab = kbGetAllBtn();
            if (ab) { setLastClickedHighlight(ab); ab.click(); }
        } else if (state.kbFocusTarget === 'grid' && state.kbFocusIdx >= 0) {
            var items = kbGetGridItems();
            var item = items[state.kbFocusIdx];
            if (!item) return;

            if (item.classList.contains('ca-fav-chip')) { item.click(); return; }

            if (state.activeTab === 'block' && item.classList.contains('ca-country-item')) {
                var cb = item.querySelector('.ca-checkbox');
                if (cb) cb.click();
                return;
            }

            // Jika yang difokuskan adalah tombol (bukan negara)
            if (!item.classList.contains('ca-country-item')) {
                item.click();
                return;
            }

            var flag = item.querySelector('.ca-flag');
            var nameEl = item.querySelector('.ca-country-name');
            if (flag) {
                var mm = flag.src.match(/flagcdn\.com\/[^\/]+\/([a-z]{2})\.png/i);
                if (mm && mm[1]) { setLastClickedHighlight(item); changeCountryInstant(mm[1].toUpperCase(), item.getAttribute('data-ca-name') || (nameEl ? (nameEl.textContent || '').trim() : '')); }
            }
        }
    }

    function kbToggleFav() {
        if (state.activeTab === 'block') { kbActivate(); return; }
        if (state.activeTab !== 'all') return;
        var items = kbGetGridItems();
        var item = items[state.kbFocusIdx];
        if (!item) return;
        if (item.classList.contains('ca-fav-chip')) return;
        var flag = item.querySelector('.ca-flag');
        if (!flag) return;
        var mm = flag.src.match(/flagcdn\.com\/[^\/]+\/([a-z]{2})\.png/i);
        if (!mm || !mm[1]) return;
        var code = mm[1].toUpperCase();
        var lc = code.toLowerCase();
        var wasFav = state.favorites.indexOf(lc) !== -1;
        toggleFavorite(code);
        showIndicator(wasFav ? '☆ Removed: ' + code : '★ Favorite: ' + code, wasFav ? '#64748b' : '#fbbf24');
    }

    function kbCycleTab(dir) {
        var idx = KB_TAB_ORDER.indexOf(state.activeTab);
        if (idx < 0) idx = 0;
        idx = (idx + dir + KB_TAB_ORDER.length) % KB_TAB_ORDER.length;
        var next = KB_TAB_ORDER[idx];
        switchTab(next);
        showIndicator('📑 ' + next.toUpperCase(), '#8b5cf6');
        setTimeout(function() { state.kbFocusIdx = -1; state.kbFocusTarget = 'grid'; }, 60);
    }

             function kbArrowTabs(k) {
    var tabs = kbGetTabs();
    if (tabs.length === 0) return;
    var isCompact = caIsCompactMode();
    var cols = isCompact ? 2 : tabs.length;

    if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight') {
        var next = state.kbTabFocusIdx + (k === 'ArrowLeft' ? -1 : 1);
        if (next < 0) next = tabs.length - 1;
        if (next >= tabs.length) next = 0;
        kbFocusTabsAt(next);
        return;
    }

    if (k === 'ArrowDown') {
        // ⭐ FIX KRITIS: JANGAN fallback ke grid saat search gagal.
        //    Tiny mode akan di-expand otomatis oleh kbFocusSearch.
        //    Kalau masih gagal (edge case), jangan lompat ke grid —
        //    biarkan di tabs, user bisa retry.
        var ok = kbFocusSearch();
        if (!ok) {
            console.warn('[CA-NAV] ❌ search fail — staying on tabs');
            // Retry once via rAF
            requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                if (state.kbFocusTarget === 'tabs') {
                    if (!kbFocusSearch()) {
                        // Very last resort: fallback to first grid item (not ALL COUNTRIES)
                        var items = kbGetGridItems();
                        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                            if (!items[i].classList.contains('ca-all-countries-btn') &&
                                !items[i].classList.contains('ca-view-toggle-btn')) {
                                kbFocusGridAt(i);
                                return;
                            }
                        }
                        kbFocusGridAt(0);
                    }
                }
            });
        }
        return;
    }

    if (k === 'ArrowUp') {
        if (isCompact) {
            var prevRow = state.kbTabFocusIdx - cols;
            if (prevRow >= 0) kbFocusTabsAt(prevRow);
        } else {
            kbFocusTabsAt(tabs.length - 1);
        }
    }
}

function kbArrowAllBtn(k) {
    if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'ArrowRight') {
        // ArrowRight → langsung ke toggle list/grid (jika ada)
        if (k === 'ArrowRight') {
            var toggle = gridDiv && gridDiv.querySelector('.ca-view-toggle-btn');
            if (toggle) {
                var innerItems = kbGetGridItems();
                var tIdx = innerItems.indexOf(toggle);
                if (tIdx >= 0) { kbFocusGridAt(tIdx); return; }
            }
        }

        // ArrowDown → skip tombol ALL & Toggle, langsung ke negara pertama
        var items = kbGetGridItems();
        var targetIdx = -1;
        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
            if (items[i] === kbGetAllBtn()) {
                for (var j = i + 1; j < items.length; j++) {
                    if (!items[j].classList.contains('ca-view-toggle-btn')) {
                        targetIdx = j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                break;
            }
        }

        if (targetIdx >= 0) {
            kbFocusGridAt(targetIdx);
        } else if (!kbFocusTabsAt(KB_TAB_ORDER.indexOf(state.activeTab))) {
            kbFocusGridAt(0);
        }
    } else if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowLeft') {
        // ⭐ FIX: Ke Search dulu, baru ke Tabs
        if (!kbFocusSearch()) {
            kbFocusTabsAt(KB_TAB_ORDER.indexOf(state.activeTab));
        }
    }
}

           // ⭐ FIX: definisi kbArrowGrid yang HILANG (penyebab arrow key crash)
           function kbArrowGrid(k) {
    var items = kbGetGridItems();
    if (items.length === 0) return;

    var curIdx = state.kbFocusIdx;
    var curItem = (curIdx >= 0 && curIdx < items.length) ? items[curIdx] : null;

    if (!curItem) {
        if ((k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'ArrowUp') && state.kbFocusIdx === -1) {
            if (kbFocusSearch()) return;
        }
        kbFocusGridAt(0);
        return;
    }

    // ⭐ FIX: HAPUS early return yang memaksa lompat ke ALL COUNTRIES.
    // Biarkan kbGridFindNext yang mencari target terdekat (Chip Favorit / All Countries).
    var nextIdx = kbGridFindNext(curItem, k);
    if (nextIdx !== -1) { kbFocusGridAt(nextIdx); return; }

    // Boundary: ArrowUp dari baris pertama grid (fallback jika tidak ada elemen di atasnya)
    if (k === 'ArrowUp') {
        var boundAb = kbGetAllBtn();
        if (boundAb && boundAb !== curItem) {
            var abRect = boundAb.getBoundingClientRect();
            var curRect = curItem.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (abRect.bottom <= curRect.top + 4) {
                var boundAbIdx = items.indexOf(boundAb);
                if (boundAbIdx !== -1) {
                    kbFocusGridAt(boundAbIdx);
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        // ⭐ FIX UTAMA: Ke Search dulu sebelum ke Tabs
        if (!kbFocusSearch()) {
            kbFocusTabsAt(KB_TAB_ORDER.indexOf(state.activeTab));
        }
    }
}
function caEnableAutoNav() {
    // ⭐ FIX: Resync stale refs SEBELUM apapun — panel bisa di-replace React
    //    antara boot dan call ini. gridDiv/searchInput/customContainer yang
    //    stale = renderGrid ke detached node = panel visible tampak kosong
    //    → kbGetGridItems() = [] → ArrowDown no-op.
    var __livePanel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
    if (__livePanel && __livePanel !== customContainer) {
        customContainer = __livePanel;
        var __liveGrid = __livePanel.querySelector('.ca-country-grid');
        if (__liveGrid) gridDiv = __liveGrid;
        var __liveSearch = __livePanel.querySelector('.ca-search-input');
        if (__liveSearch) searchInput = __liveSearch;
        var __liveFooter = __livePanel.querySelector('.ca-footer');
        if (__liveFooter) footerDiv = __liveFooter;
        var __liveToggle = __livePanel.querySelector('.ca-block-wrapper .ca-toggle-btn');
        if (__liveToggle) toggleBtn = __liveToggle;
    }

    __caKbMode = true;
    __caKbAutoNav = true;
    state.kbFocusIdx = -1;

    // ⭐ FIX-2: FORCE ke 'tabs' tanpa condition.
    //    Sebelumnya: if (document.activeElement !== searchInput) { state.kbFocusTarget='tabs'; }
    //    Bug: kalau activeElement IS searchInput (edge case saat panel hidden tapi
    //    searchInput sempat fokus), state.kbFocusTarget TIDAK di-set → tetap 'grid'
    //    dari default atau dari kbClearAllFocus sebelumnya → ArrowDown skip search.
    state.kbFocusTarget = 'tabs';
    state.kbTabFocusIdx = 0;

    try {
        if (gridDiv && state.activeTab !== 'ip' && state.activeTab !== 'history') renderGrid();
    } catch(e) {}
}

    function caDisableAutoNav() {
        __caKbAutoNav = false;
        __caKbMode = false;
        kbClearAllFocus();
        caHideTooltip();
        try { if (gridDiv && state.activeTab !== 'ip' && state.activeTab !== 'history') renderGrid(); } catch(e) {}
    }

                       function handlePanelKeyboard(e) {
    // ⭐ FIX: Guard — cegah 1 keypress diproses 2x oleh listener ganda
    if (window.__caLastKbEvent === e) return;
    window.__caLastKbEvent = e;

        var isCinema3 = document.querySelector('.roulette-box.ca-cinema3-active');
    if (!__caKbAutoNav && !isCinema3) {
        // ⭐ Self-heal: kalau panel visible tapi nav mati, hidupkan ulang
        var __pnlVis = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        var __isVisible = __pnlVis &&
                          __pnlVis.style.display !== 'none' &&
                          getComputedStyle(__pnlVis).display !== 'none';
        if (__isVisible) {
            try { caEnableAutoNav(); } catch(err) {}
            if (!__caKbAutoNav) return;
        } else {
            return;
        }
    }

    // ⭐ FIX: Resync stale module-scope references.
    // React reconciliation bisa re-mount #my-custom-country-ui → customContainer
    // & gridDiv pointer ke node DETACHED. Akibatnya kbGetGridItems() return
    // node detached → items[idx].focus() silent no-op → user lihat "nav mati".
    // Inilah kenapa exit→normal→reopen (forceOpenPanel resync customContainer)
    // menyembuhkan: karena reference kembali sync.
        var __caLivePanel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
    if (__caLivePanel && __caLivePanel !== customContainer) {
        customContainer = __caLivePanel;
        var __caLiveGrid = __caLivePanel.querySelector('.ca-country-grid');
        if (__caLiveGrid && __caLiveGrid !== gridDiv) {
            gridDiv = __caLiveGrid;
            if (typeof caAttachGridDelegation === 'function') {
                try { caAttachGridDelegation(gridDiv); } catch(err) {}
            }
        }
        var __caLiveSearch = __caLivePanel.querySelector('.ca-search-input');
        if (__caLiveSearch) searchInput = __caLiveSearch;
        var __caLiveFooter = __caLivePanel.querySelector('.ca-footer');
        if (__caLiveFooter) footerDiv = __caLiveFooter;
        var __caLiveToggle = __caLivePanel.querySelector('.ca-block-wrapper .ca-toggle-btn');
        if (__caLiveToggle) toggleBtn = __caLiveToggle;
    }

    // ⭐ FIX-4: Robust guard — cek isConnected + computed style
    //    Bug lama: `customContainer.style.display === 'none'` cek INLINE saja.
    //    Kalau customContainer node stale (React replace) tapi inline-nya 'none'
    //    (dari createPanel), keyboard mati total meski panel visible di DOM.
    //    Sekarang: auto-resync + clear stale inline 'none' kalau panel di-docked.
    if (!customContainer || !customContainer.isConnected) {
        var __caLiveFix = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        if (__caLiveFix) customContainer = __caLiveFix;
    }
    if (!customContainer) return;

    var __caCS = getComputedStyle(customContainer);
    if (__caCS.display === 'none') {
        // Safety: kalau inline style.display='none' tapi panel di-dock (React replace
        // atau applyCinemaModeState bail early), paksa clear — panel HARUS visible.
        if (customContainer.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-docked') &&
            customContainer.style.display === 'none') {
            customContainer.style.removeProperty('display');
            try { customContainer.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important'); } catch(e) {}
        }
        var __recheck = getComputedStyle(customContainer);
        if (__recheck.display === 'none') return;
    }

                var ae = document.activeElement;
        var tag = ae ? ae.tagName : '';
        if (caIsChatElement(ae)) return;
        // ⭐ FIX: Deteksi STATE DRIFT — kalau state says 'search' tapi
        //    focus BUKAN di search input, berarti kbFocusSearch pernah
        //    gagal tanpa rollback. Reset ke 'tabs' supaya Down berikutnya
        //    mengulang dari tabs → kbFocusSearch akan retry dengan bersih.
        if (state.kbFocusTarget === 'search' &&
            searchInput && ae !== searchInput) {
            console.warn('[CA-NAV] ⚠️ STATE DRIFT detected: focusTarget=search but active≠searchInput → reset to tabs');
            state.kbFocusTarget = 'tabs';
            state.kbFocusIdx = -1;
            if (searchInput.parentElement) {
                searchInput.parentElement.classList.remove('ca-search-kb-focus');
            }
        }

        if (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA') {
            if (ae === searchInput) {
                state.kbFocusTarget = 'search';
            } else return;
        }

        var k = e.key;

                        if (state.kbFocusTarget === 'search') {
    if (k === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); kbBlurSearch(); kbFocusTabsAt(KB_TAB_ORDER.indexOf(state.activeTab)); return; }
    if (k === 'ArrowDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        e.stopImmediatePropagation();  // ⭐ FIX: Stop listener kedua
        var hasQuery = searchInput && searchInput.value.trim().length > 0;

        if (hasQuery) {
            // ⭐ v2: SKIP ALL COUNTRIES / toggle / sort, hanya ke real content
            var searchItems = kbGetGridItems();
            for (var si = 0; si < searchItems.length; si++) {
                var sc = searchItems[si].classList;
                if (sc.contains('ca-country-item') ||
                    sc.contains('ca-fav-chip') ||
                    sc.contains('ca-history-card') ||
                    sc.contains('ca-ip-chip')) {
                    kbFocusGridAt(si);
                    return;
                }
            }
            // Fallback: any non-button item (skip ALL COUNTRIES & toggle)
            for (var si2 = 0; si2 < searchItems.length; si2++) {
                var sc2 = searchItems[si2].classList;
                if (!sc2.contains('ca-all-countries-btn') &&
                    !sc2.contains('ca-view-toggle-btn')) {
                    kbFocusGridAt(si2);
                    return;

        function movePanelKb(dir, fast) {
        if (state.panelWidth == null) state.panelWidth = Math.round(customContainer.getBoundingClientRect().width);
        ensureBaseCoordinates();
        var step = fast ? 50 : 10;
        var newLeft = state.panelLeft + dir * step;
        var PAD = 12;
        // ⭐ FIX #17: gunakan visual width (base × scale)
        var sc = state.panelScale || 1.0;
        var visualWidth = state.panelWidth * sc;
        var maxLeft = window.innerWidth - visualWidth - PAD;
        if (maxLeft < PAD) maxLeft = PAD;
        if (newLeft < PAD) newLeft = PAD;
        if (newLeft > maxLeft) newLeft = maxLeft;
        state.panelLeft = Math.round(newLeft);
        applyPanelGeometry();
        showIndicator('↔️ Panel: ' + state.panelLeft + 'px', '#8b5cf6');
    }

        function resizePanelKb(dir, fast) {
        if (state.panelWidth == null) state.panelWidth = Math.round(customContainer.getBoundingClientRect().width);
        ensureBaseCoordinates();
        var step = fast ? 100 : 20;
        var newW = state.panelWidth + dir * step;
        if (newW < PANEL_MIN_W) newW = PANEL_MIN_W;
        var sc = state.panelScale || 1.0;
        var maxWVisual = window.innerWidth - 24;
        var maxW = Math.floor(maxWVisual / sc);
        if (newW > maxW) newW = maxW;
        state.panelWidth = Math.round(newW);
        var maxLeftVisual = window.innerWidth - (state.panelWidth * sc) - 12;
        var maxLeft = Math.floor(maxLeftVisual / sc);
        if (maxLeft < 12) maxLeft = 12;
        if (state.panelLeft > maxLeft) state.panelLeft = maxLeft;
        applyPanelGeometry();
        showIndicator('📐 Panel: ' + state.panelWidth + 'px', '#8b5cf6');
    }
 }

    function fmtBytesRate(kbps) {
        if (kbps == null || kbps <= 0) return '—';
        var kbs = kbps / 8;
        if (kbs >= 1024) return (kbs / 1024).toFixed(2) + ' MB/s';
        if (kbs >= 100) return Math.round(kbs) + ' KB/s';
        return kbs.toFixed(1) + ' KB/s';
    }
