window.__caToastPos = function() {
    try {
        if (document.querySelector('.roulette-box.ca-cinema3-active')) {
            var w = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
            if (w) {
                var r = w.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (r.width > 10 && r.height > 10) {
                    var topVal = Math.round(r.top + 10);
                    if (topVal < 10) topVal = 10; // Clamp biar tidak off-screen ke atas
                    var leftVal = Math.round(r.left + r.width / 2);
                    if (leftVal < 50) leftVal = 50; // Clamp biar tidak off-screen ke kiri
                    return {
                        top: topVal + 'px',
                        left: leftVal + 'px'
                    };
                }
            }
        }
    } catch(e) {}
    return { top: '24px', left: '50%' };
};

    function showIndicator(html, bgColor) {

                try { oldToast.parentNode.removeChild(oldToast); } catch(e) {}
            }

            var pos;
            try {

                    ? window.__caToastPos()

            } catch (e) {

            var el = document.createElement('div');
            el.id = 'ca-indicator';

            // cssText full reset — KEBAL dari inherited style, backdrop-filter bug, isolation bug
            el.style.cssText =

                }

            try { console.error('[CA-TOAST]', err); } catch(_) {}
        }

(function setupDeviceSwitchListener() {
    var __mscPending = null, __mscTimer = null;
    var __DEBOUNCE_MS = 200;

    W.addEventListener('msc-device-switched', function(e) {
        if (!e.detail) return;
        if (!W.__mscUserSwitching) return;    // skip: bukan aksi user (mis. auto-recover watchdog)

        if (!__mscPending) __mscPending = { video: null, audio: null };
        __mscPending[e.detail.type] = e.detail;

        if (__mscTimer) clearTimeout(__mscTimer);
        __mscTimer = setTimeout(function() {
            var p = __mscPending;
            __mscPending = null;
            __mscTimer = null;
            if (!p) return;

            var lines = [];
            var color = '#8b5cf6';

                       if (p.video) {
                lines.push('🎥 Real cam: <span style="color:#fbbf24;">' + escHtmlCA(p.video.realLabel) + '</span>');
            }
            if (p.audio) {
                if (!p.video) color = '#10b981';
                lines.push('🎤 Real mic: <span style="color:#fbbf24;">' + escHtmlCA(p.audio.realLabel) + '</span>');
            }

            if (!lines.length) return;

            if (lines.length === 1) {
                showIndicator(lines[0], color);
            } else {
                var html = '<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;line-height:1.4;">' +
                    lines[0] +
                    '<div style="height:1px;width:70%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.28);"></div>' +
                    lines[1] +
                    '</div>';
                showIndicator(html, color);
            }
        }, __DEBOUNCE_MS);
    });
})();

    function findSkipButton(strictNext) {
        var s = document.querySelector('.buttons__button.start-button');
        if (s && !s.classList.contains('disabled')) {
            var sTxt = (s.textContent || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            if (!strictNext || sTxt !== 'stop') return s;
        }
        var all = document.querySelectorAll('.buttons__button');
        for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
            var b = all[i];
            if (b.classList.contains('disabled')) continue;
            var t = (b.textContent || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            if (t === 'next' || t === 'start') return b;
        }
        if (!strictNext) {
            var st = document.querySelector('.buttons__button.stop-button');
            if (st && !st.classList.contains('disabled')) return st;
        }
        return null;
    }

    function fireClick(el) {
        try {
            ['mousedown', 'mouseup', 'click'].forEach(function(t) {
                el.dispatchEvent(new W.MouseEvent(t, { view: W, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, buttons: 1, button: 0 }));
            });
        } catch(e) {}
    }

        function doSkip(reason, strictNext) {
        if (strictNext === undefined) strictNext = true;
        var now = Date.now();
        if (now - lastGlobalSkipTime < GLOBAL_SKIP_COOLDOWN) return false;
        var btn = findSkipButton(strictNext);
        if (!btn) return false;
        lastGlobalSkipTime = now;

        // ⭐ TAMBAHKAN BARIS INI
        if (window.__caForceNoSignalShow) window.__caForceNoSignalShow();

        showIndicator('🚫 AUTO SKIP: ' + reason, '#dc2626');
        fireClick(btn);
        return true;
    }

    function autoSkipPoll() {
        if (!state.blockEnabled) return;
        var now = Date.now();
        if (mirrorState.pc && mirrorState.pc.connectionState === 'connected'
    && state.currentIPSetAt && (now - state.currentIPSetAt) > 8000
    && state.lastPartnerTransitionAt > state.currentIPSetAt) {
    resetIPState('watchdog');
    return;
}
        if (state.currentIP && state.currentIPType !== 'relay' && state.blockedIPs.indexOf(state.currentIP) !== -1) {
            if (!state.partnerConnected) return;
            if (state.currentIPSetAt && state.lastPartnerTransitionAt && state.currentIPSetAt < state.lastPartnerTransitionAt) return;
            if (state.lastSkippedIP === state.currentIP && (now - state.lastIPSkipTime) < IP_SKIP_COOLDOWN) return;
            var fired = doSkip('Blocked IP Detected', true);
            if (fired) { state.lastSkippedIP = state.currentIP; state.lastIPSkipTime = now; }
            return;
        }
        var code = getCurrentCountryCode();
        if (!code) {
            if (state.lastSeenCountry !== null) {
                state.lastSeenCountry = null; state.countrySkipAttempt = 0; state.lastSkippedCountry = null;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (code !== state.lastSeenCountry) {
            state.lastSeenCountry = code; state.countrySkipAttempt = 0; state.lastSkippedCountry = null;
            if (state.blockedList.indexOf(code) !== -1) showIndicator('⚠️ Country Blocked ' + flagImgHtml(code, 24, 18, 'vertical-align:middle;border-radius:3px;margin-left:8px;'), '#d97706');
        }
        if (state.blockedList.indexOf(code) !== -1) {
            if (state.countrySkipAttempt >= MAX_COUNTRY_ATTEMPTS) return;
            if (now - state.lastCountrySkipTime < COUNTRY_SKIP_COOLDOWN) return;
            var fired2 = doSkip('Blocked Country ' + flagImgHtml(code, 20, 15, 'vertical-align:middle;border-radius:2px;margin-left:6px;'), true);
            if (fired2) {
                state.lastCountrySkipTime = now;
                state.countrySkipAttempt++;
            } else {
                state.lastCountrySkipTime = now - COUNTRY_SKIP_COOLDOWN + 300;
            }
        }
    }

        // ═══ BYPASS REFCOUNT (race-safe, backward-compat) ═══
    // Replaces boolean flag with refcount-backed getter/setter.
    // Existing code using W.__caBypassIntercept = true/false still works.
    W.__caBypassCount = 0;
    (function setupBypassRefcount() {
        try {
            // Remove any existing plain property first
            try { delete W.__caBypassIntercept; } catch(e) {}
            Object.defineProperty(W, '__caBypassIntercept', {
                configurable: true,
                get: function() { return W.__caBypassCount > 0; },
                set: function(v) {
                    if (v === true) {
                        W.__caBypassCount++;
                    } else if (v === false && W.__caBypassCount > 0) {
                        W.__caBypassCount--;
                    }
                    // Safety: leak guard (should never happen in practice)
                    if (W.__caBypassCount > 8) {
                        try { console.warn('[CA-BYPASS] refcount leak (' + W.__caBypassCount + ') → reset'); } catch(e) {}
                        W.__caBypassCount = 0;
                    }
                    if (W.__caBypassCount < 0) W.__caBypassCount = 0;
                }
            });
        } catch(e) { /* fallback: keep plain property */ }
    })();
    // ===== MODULE L: COUNTRY POPUP BRIDGE =====
    function dispatchMousedownReact(el) {
        if (!el) return;
        var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        var cx = r.left + r.width / 2;
        var cy = r.top + r.height / 2;
        try {
            var evt = new W.MouseEvent('mousedown', {
                view: W, bubbles: true, cancelable: true,
                button: 0, buttons: 1,
                clientX: cx, clientY: cy, screenX: cx, screenY: cy
            });
            el.dispatchEvent(evt);
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function findPopupTarget(upperCode) {
        var lower = upperCode.toLowerCase();
        var sels = [
            '.country-filter-popup__countries [data-tr="' + upperCode + '"]',
            '.country-filter-popup__countries [data-tr="' + lower + '"]',
            '.country-filter-popup [data-tr="' + upperCode + '"]',
            '.country-filter-popup [data-tr="' + lower + '"]'
        ];
        for (var i = 0; i < sels.length; i++) {
            try { var el = document.querySelector(sels[i]); if (el) return el; } catch(e) {}
        }
        return null;
    }

        function waitForPopupTarget(upperCode, callback, maxTries, intervalMs, isCancelled) {
        maxTries = maxTries || 20;
        intervalMs = intervalMs || 120;
        var tries = 0;
        function tryOnce() {
            if (isCancelled && isCancelled()) { callback(null); return; }   // ⭐ NEW
            tries++;
            var t = findPopupTarget(upperCode);
            if (t) { callback(t); return; }
            if (tries >= maxTries) { callback(null); return; }
            setTimeout(tryOnce, intervalMs);
        }
        tryOnce();
    }

    function forceShowPopup(popup) {
        if (!popup) popup = document.querySelector('.country-filter-popup');
        if (!popup) return false;
        try {
            popup.style.setProperty('display', 'block', 'important');
            popup.style.setProperty('visibility', 'visible', 'important');
            popup.style.setProperty('opacity', '0', 'important');
            popup.style.setProperty('pointer-events', 'none', 'important');
            popup.style.setProperty('position', 'fixed', 'important');
            popup.style.setProperty('left', '-99999px', 'important');
            popup.style.setProperty('top', '-99999px', 'important');
            popup.style.setProperty('z-index', '-2147483647', 'important');
            popup.classList.add('visible');
        } catch(e) {}
        return true;
    }

    function hidePopup() {
        var popup = document.querySelector('.country-filter-popup');
        if (!popup) return;
        try {
            popup.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
            popup.style.setProperty('left', '', 'important');
            popup.style.setProperty('top', '', 'important');
            popup.style.setProperty('opacity', '', 'important');
            popup.style.setProperty('pointer-events', '', 'important');
            popup.style.setProperty('position', '', 'important');
            popup.style.setProperty('z-index', '', 'important');
            popup.classList.remove('visible');
        } catch(e) {}
    }

        var __caCountrySelectToken = 0;   // ⭐ NEW — monotonic cancel token

        function doCountrySelect(upperCode, countryName) {
        var myToken = ++__caCountrySelectToken;
        // ⭐ PATCH: own refcount++ (paired with every exit path)
        W.__caBypassIntercept = true;
        var __caCleanup = function() { W.__caBypassIntercept = false; };

        forceShowPopup();
        waitForPopupTarget(upperCode, function(target) {
            // Stale → still cleanup our refcount (refcount invariant)
            if (myToken !== __caCountrySelectToken) { __caCleanup(); return; }

            if (!target) {
                try { localStorage.setItem('ca_pending_target', upperCode); } catch(e) {}
                showIndicator('⚠️ ' + upperCode + ' not found in popup', '#f59e0b');
                hidePopup();
                __caCleanup();
                return;
            }
                        var parentItem = target.closest('.country-filter-popup__country') || target;
            // ⭐ FIX: Gunakan fireClick agar React mendeteksi klik secara utuh
            fireClick(parentItem);
            if (parentItem !== target) fireClick(target);
            showIndicator('🎯 ' + upperCode + ' (' + countryName + ')', '#0078d4');
            setTimeout(function() {
                hidePopup();
                if (typeof renderGrid === 'function') { try { renderGrid(); } catch(e) {} }
            }, 150);
            try { localStorage.removeItem('ca_pending_target'); } catch(e) {}
            setTimeout(__caCleanup, 250);
        }, 20, 120, function() {
            return myToken !== __caCountrySelectToken;
        });
    }

        function changeCountryInstant(countryCode, countryName) {
        var upperCode = countryCode.toUpperCase();
        state.targetCountry = upperCode;
        state.targetCountryName = countryName;
        try { localStorage.setItem('selected_country', upperCode); } catch(e) {}

        // ⭐ PATCH: popup-exists → doCountrySelect owns its own refcount (no double-inc)
        var popup = document.querySelector('.country-filter-popup');
        if (popup) { doCountrySelect(upperCode, countryName); return; }

        // No popup: we own the refcount while we wait for it to open
        W.__caBypassIntercept = true;

                var btnOuter = document.querySelector('.buttons__button.country-filter, .buttons__button[class*="country"]');
        var btnInner = document.querySelector('.country-filter__button');
        var btnTarget = btnInner || btnOuter;

        // Fallback pintar jika class berubah
        if (!btnTarget) {
            var allBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.buttons__button');
            for (var i = 0; i < allBtns.length; i++) {
                var txt = (allBtns[i].textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                if (txt.includes('country') || txt.includes('negara')) {
                    btnTarget = allBtns[i];
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!btnTarget) {
            showIndicator('❌ Country button not found', '#991b1b');
            W.__caBypassIntercept = false;
            return;
        }
                // ⭐ FIX: Gunakan fireClick untuk membuka popup native
        fireClick(btnTarget);
        setTimeout(function() {
            var p = document.querySelector('.country-filter-popup');
            if (p) forceShowPopup(p);
            doCountrySelect(upperCode, countryName);
            W.__caBypassIntercept = false;
        }, 300);
    }
    function getCurrentCountryCode() {
        var now = Date.now();
        if (__caCachedCountry !== null && (now - __caCachedCountryTime) < __caCountryCacheTTL) return __caCachedCountry || null;
        var result = null;
        var chatMsgs = document.querySelectorAll('.message.connection-established-message .message-bubble');
        if (chatMsgs.length > 0) {
            var lastMsg = chatMsgs[chatMsgs.length - 1];
            var chatCountry = lastMsg.querySelector('span.tr-country[data-tr]');
            if (chatCountry) {
                var chatCode = chatCountry.getAttribute('data-tr');
                if (chatCode && chatCode.length === 2) result = chatCode.toLowerCase();
            }
            if (!result) {
                var chatImg = lastMsg.querySelector('img[src*="flagcdn"]');
                if (chatImg && chatImg.src) {
                    var mm = chatImg.src.match(/flagcdn\.com\/[^\/]*\/([a-z]{2})\.png/i);
                    if (mm && mm[1]) result = mm[1].toLowerCase();
                }
            }
        }
        __caCachedCountry = result; __caCachedCountryTime = now;
        return result;
    }

        });

        function updateFloatingBoxVisibility() {
        if (!floatingBox) return;

        // ⭐ FIX: Sembunyikan total saat Idle (belum ada partner / user klik Stop)
        if (state.userStopped || !state.partnerConnected) {
            floatingBox.classList.add('ca-floating-hidden');
            floatingBox.classList.remove('ca-pinned', 'ca-hover', 'ca-panel-hover');
            return;
        }

        if (!state.ipHoverEnabled) {
            floatingBox.classList.add('ca-floating-hidden');
            floatingBox.classList.remove('ca-pinned', 'ca-hover');
        }
        else {
            floatingBox.classList.remove('ca-floating-hidden');
            if (state.ipPinEnabled) floatingBox.classList.add('ca-pinned');
            else floatingBox.classList.remove('ca-pinned');
        }
    }

    function blockCurrentIP() {
        if (!state.currentIP) { showIndicator('❌ No IP to block', '#991b1b'); return; }
        if (state.blockedIPs.indexOf(state.currentIP) !== -1) { showIndicator('ℹ️ IP Already Blocked', '#334155'); return; }
        var blockedIP = state.currentIP;
        state.blockedIPs.push(blockedIP); saveIPs();
                // ⭐ FIX XSS: escape blockedIP (attacker-controlled via ICE candidate)
        showIndicator('🚫 BLOCKED: ' + escHtmlCA(blockedIP), '#dc2626');
        renderGrid();
        if (state.currentIPType !== 'relay' && state.partnerConnected) {
            setTimeout(function() {
                var fired = doSkip('IP blocked: ' + blockedIP, true);
                if (fired) { state.lastSkippedIP = blockedIP; state.lastIPSkipTime = Date.now(); }
            }, 300);
        }
    }

    function attachFloatingBoxToVideo() {
    var wrapper = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper'); if (!wrapper) return;
    createFloatingBox();
    if (floatingBox.parentNode === wrapper && document.body.contains(floatingBox)) {
        updateFloatingBoxVisibility(); updateFloatControls(); return;
    }
    try { if (floatingBox.parentNode && floatingBox.parentNode !== wrapper) floatingBox.parentNode.removeChild(floatingBox); } catch(e) {}
    wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
    wrapper.appendChild(floatingBox);
    updateFloatingBox(); updateFloatingBoxVisibility(); updateFloatControls();
}
                  function startCountryWatcher() {
        __caOn250(function() {
            if (state.userStopped && !state.targetCountry) return;
            var code = getCurrentCountryCode();
                    if (!code) {
            if (state.partnerConnected) {
                // ⭐ FIX: Jangan hapus state jika WebRTC PC masih aktif!
                var pc = mirrorState.pc;
                if (!pc || pc.connectionState === 'closed' || pc.connectionState === 'failed' || pc.connectionState === 'disconnected') {
                    state.partnerConnected = false;
                    state.lastDetectedCountry = null;
                    if (__caPendingCountryChangeTimer) { clearTimeout(__caPendingCountryChangeTimer); __caPendingCountryChangeTimer = null; }
                    __caPendingCountryChange = null;
                    resetIPState('disconnected');
                }
            }
            return;
        }
            if (!state.partnerConnected) {
                state.partnerConnected = true;
                state.lastDetectedCountry = code;
                resetIPState('connected');
                return;
            }
            if (code !== state.lastDetectedCountry) {
                if (state.lastPartnerTransitionAt && (Date.now() - state.lastPartnerTransitionAt) < 200) return;
                if (__caPendingCountryChange === code) return;
                __caPendingCountryChange = code;
                if (__caPendingCountryChangeTimer) clearTimeout(__caPendingCountryChangeTimer);
                __caPendingCountryChangeTimer = setTimeout(function() {
                    __caPendingCountryChangeTimer = null;
                    if (__caPendingCountryChange !== code) return;
                    if (state.lastDetectedCountry === code) { __caPendingCountryChange = null; return; }
                    state.lastDetectedCountry = code;
                    __caLastCountryChangeAt = Date.now();
                    __caPendingCountryChange = null;
                    resetIPState('changed');
                }, 120);
            }
        });
    }
    function startChatMessageWatcher() {
        if (startChatMessageWatcher.__attached) return;
        startChatMessageWatcher.__attached = true;
        window.__caBodyBus.subscribe(function(node) {
            if (__caProcessedNodes.has(node)) return;
            if (!node.matches) return;
            var selfMatches = node.matches('.message, .message__system, .connection-established-message');
            if (!selfMatches) {
                var inChatArea = node.closest && node.closest(
                    '.chat__messages, .chat__body, .chat, [class*="chat-"], [class*="message-"]'
                );
                if (!inChatArea) return;
            }
            var msgList = [];
            if (node.classList && node.classList.contains('connection-established-message')) {
                msgList.push(node);
            } else if (node.querySelectorAll) {
                var found = node.querySelectorAll('.message.connection-established-message');
                for (var _i = 0; _i < found.length; _i++) msgList.push(found[_i]);
            }
            if (msgList.length === 0) return;
            for (var _j = 0; _j < msgList.length; _j++) {
                var msgEl = msgList[_j];
                if (__caProcessedNodes.has(msgEl)) continue;
                __caProcessedNodes.add(msgEl);
                var code = null;
                var img = msgEl.querySelector('img[src*="flagcdn"]');
                if (img && img.src) { var mm = img.src.match(/flagcdn\.com\/[^\/]*\/([a-z]{2})\.png/i); if (mm && mm[1]) code = mm[1].toLowerCase(); }
                if (!code) { var span = msgEl.querySelector('span.tr-country[data-tr]'); if (span) { var c = span.getAttribute('data-tr'); if (c && c.length === 2) code = c.toLowerCase(); } }
                if (code) { __caCachedCountry = code; __caCachedCountryTime = Date.now(); }
                var now = Date.now();
var isLikelyRerender = !!(code && code === __caLastConnectCode && (now - __caLastConnectTime) < 500);
__caLastConnectCode = code; __caLastConnectTime = now; __caLastConnectNode = msgEl;
                                 if (!isLikelyRerender) {
                    state.partnerConnected = true;
                    state.lastDetectedCountry = code || state.lastDetectedCountry;

                    // ⭐ FIX: Hapus antrean kandidat IP dari partner sebelumnya agar tidak dobel
                    resetMultiCandidateState();

                    // ⭐ SYNC PLACEHOLDER — render di rAF yang SAMA dengan status bubble.
                    //    Karena subscriber ini dipanggil dari __caBodyBus rAF (bersama
                    //    subscriber status), panggilan sinkron = paint frame identik.
                    state.currentIP = null;
                    state.currentIPType = null;
                    state.currentIPInfo = null;
                    state.currentIPSetAt = 0;
                    state.ipDetectionStartTime = Date.now();
                    try { updateFloatingBox(true); } catch(e) {}

                    if (__caPendingMsgResetTimer) clearTimeout(__caPendingMsgResetTimer);
                    __caPendingMsgResetTimer = setTimeout(function() {
                        __caPendingMsgResetTimer = null;
                        resetIPState('msg');            // reset penuh + trigger provider chain
                        setTimeout(function() { try { autoSkipPoll(); } catch(e) {} }, 30);
                    }, 20);
                } else { state.partnerConnected = true; }
            }
        });
    }

    function caHandleGridClick(e) {
        var chip = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.ca-fav-chip') : null;
        if (chip) {
            var chipCode = chip.getAttribute('data-ca-code');
            if (!chipCode) return;
            var chipNameEl = chip.querySelector('.ca-fav-chip-name');
            changeCountryInstant(chipCode, chip.getAttribute('data-ca-name')
                                         || (chipNameEl ? (chipNameEl.textContent || '').trim() : ''));
            return;
        }
        var item = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.ca-country-item') : null;
        if (!item) return;
        var code = item.getAttribute('data-ca-code');
        if (!code) return;
        if (e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains('ca-star')) { e.stopPropagation(); toggleFavorite(code); return; }
        if (e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains('ca-checkbox')) { e.stopPropagation(); toggleBlock(code); return; }
        if (state.activeTab === 'block') return;
        setLastClickedHighlight(item);
        var nameEl = item.querySelector('.ca-country-name');
        changeCountryInstant(code, item.getAttribute('data-ca-name')
                                || (nameEl ? (nameEl.textContent || '').trim() : ''));
        caHideTooltip();
    }

function caHandleGridMouseOver(e) {
    if (!caShouldShowTooltip()) return;
        var target = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.ca-country-item, .ca-fav-chip') : null;
        if (!target) return;
        var rel = e.relatedTarget;
        if (rel && target.contains(rel)) return;
        if (__caTooltipTimer) clearTimeout(__caTooltipTimer);
        var nameEl = target.querySelector('.ca-country-name, .ca-fav-chip-name');
        var txt = target.getAttribute('data-ca-name')
               || (nameEl ? (nameEl.textContent || '').trim() : '');
        __caTooltipTimer = setTimeout(function() { caShowTooltip(target, txt); }, 120);
    }

    function caHandleGridMouseOut(e) {
        var target = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.ca-country-item, .ca-fav-chip') : null;
        if (!target) return;
        var rel = e.relatedTarget;
        if (rel && target.contains(rel)) return;
        if (__caTooltipTimer) { clearTimeout(__caTooltipTimer); __caTooltipTimer = null; }
        caHideTooltip();
    }

    function caAttachGridDelegation(gridEl) {
        if (!gridEl || gridEl.__caDelegated) return;
        gridEl.__caDelegated = true;
        gridEl.addEventListener('click',     caHandleGridClick,     false);
        gridEl.addEventListener('mouseover', caHandleGridMouseOver, false);
        gridEl.addEventListener('mouseout',  caHandleGridMouseOut,  false);
    }

    function doSearchAction() {
    if (!searchInput) return;
    var val = (searchInput.value || '').trim();
    var icon = searchInput.parentElement ? searchInput.parentElement.querySelector('.ca-search-icon') : null;
    if (!val) {
        try { searchInput.focus(); } catch(e) {}
        if (icon) { icon.classList.add('ca-search-icon-active'); setTimeout(function() { icon.classList.remove('ca-search-icon-active'); }, 350); }
        return;
    }
    // ⭐ FIX: JANGAN blur — tetap di search supaya user bisa edit lanjut
    if (icon) { icon.classList.add('ca-search-icon-active'); setTimeout(function() { icon.classList.remove('ca-search-icon-active'); }, 500); }
    var __safeVal = escHtmlCA(val);
    showIndicator('🔍 Search: <b>' + __safeVal + '</b> · ' + (state.activeTab === 'history' ? 'filtered' : 'applied'), '#3b82f6');
    // ⭐ HAPUS: searchInput.blur() + kbFocusAllBtn() — ini penyebab "skip"
}

        function switchTab(tabName) {
    document.body.classList.add('ca-switching-tab');
    state.activeTab = tabName; state.searchQuery = ''; state.historySearchQuery = '';
    if (__caKbMode) { try { kbClearAllFocus(); } catch(e) {} }
            caHideTooltip();

    // ⭐ v3: Restore focus target to 'tabs' after click — supaya Down
    //         berikutnya lewat kbArrowTabs → Search (bukan langsung ALL COUNTRIES)
    if (__caKbMode) {
        var tabIdx = KB_TAB_ORDER.indexOf(tabName);
        if (tabIdx >= 0) {
            state.kbFocusTarget = 'tabs';
            state.kbTabFocusIdx = tabIdx;
        }
    }

    if (searchInput) {
            searchInput.value = '';
            var sw = searchInput.parentElement; if (sw) sw.classList.remove('ca-has-text');

            searchInput.style.display = 'block';
            var sa = searchInput.parentElement ? searchInput.parentElement.querySelector('.ca-search-actions') : null;
            if (sa) sa.style.display = 'flex';
        }
    updateTabVisual(); renderGrid();
    requestAnimationFrame(function() { requestAnimationFrame(function() { document.body.classList.remove('ca-switching-tab'); }); });
}

        function updateTabVisual() {

        if (state.activeTab === 'all') customContainer.querySelector('.ca-tab-all').classList.add('active');
        if (state.activeTab === 'block') customContainer.querySelector('.ca-block-wrapper').classList.add('active');
        if (state.activeTab === 'ip') customContainer.querySelector('.ca-tab-ip').classList.add('active');
        if (state.activeTab === 'history') customContainer.querySelector('.ca-tab-history').classList.add('active');
        updateBlockTabVisual();
    }

    function updateToggleVisual() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.ca-toggle-btn').forEach(function(tb) {
            if (tb.closest('#my-custom-country-ui') && tb.style.verticalAlign === 'middle') return;
            if (tb.classList.contains('ca-toggle-mini')) return;
            tb.innerHTML = '';
            var on = document.createElement('div'); on.className = 'toggle-half'; on.innerText = 'ON';
            var off = document.createElement('div'); off.className = 'toggle-half'; off.innerText = 'OFF';
            if (state.blockEnabled) { on.classList.add('on-active'); off.classList.add('inactive'); } else { off.classList.add('off-active'); on.classList.add('inactive'); }
            on.onclick = function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); if (!state.blockEnabled) { state.blockEnabled = true; state.lastSeenCountry = null; state.countrySkipAttempt = 0; updateToggleVisual(); saveState(); } };
            off.onclick = function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); if (state.blockEnabled) { state.blockEnabled = false; state.lastSeenCountry = null; state.countrySkipAttempt = 0; updateToggleVisual(); saveState(); } };
            tb.appendChild(on); tb.appendChild(off);
        });
        updateBlockTabVisual();
    }

    function createCountryItem(c, isBlockTab) {
        var item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'ca-country-item';
        if (isBlockTab) item.classList.add('ca-item-block');
        item.setAttribute('data-ca-code', c.code);
        item.setAttribute('data-ca-name', c.name);
        var isBlocked = state.blockedList.indexOf(c.code.toLowerCase()) !== -1;
        var isTarget = state.targetCountry === c.code.toUpperCase();
        var isFavorite = state.favorites.indexOf(c.code.toLowerCase()) !== -1;
        if (isBlockTab) { var cb = document.createElement('input'); cb.type = 'checkbox'; cb.className = 'ca-checkbox'; cb.checked = isBlocked; item.appendChild(cb); }
        var flag = makeFlagImg(c.code, 'ca-flag'); item.appendChild(flag);
        var n = document.createElement('span'); n.className = 'ca-country-name'; n.innerText = c.name; item.appendChild(n);
        if (!isBlockTab) { var star = document.createElement('span'); star.className = 'ca-star' + (isFavorite ? ' ca-star-active' : ''); star.innerText = isFavorite ? '★' : '☆'; item.appendChild(star); }
        if (isBlocked && isBlockTab) item.classList.add('blocked');
        if (isTarget) { item.classList.add('ca-item-target'); item.classList.add('ca-last-clicked'); }
        return item;
    }

    function toggleFavorite(code) {

        if (i === -1) state.favorites.push(lc);
        else state.favorites.splice(i, 1);
        saveFavorites();
        renderGrid();
    }

    function toggleBlock(code) {

        renderGrid();
    }

       // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  🔧 DEVICE ENUM — STABLE ORDER CACHE (v2 — ROBUST)
//  Cegah urutan device berubah-ubah akibat warm-up getUserMedia
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var __caDeviceOrderCache = {};

function caDeviceKey(d) {
    if (!d) return '';
    // Gunakan deviceId (stabil within session) sebagai key utama.
    // Label hanya sebagai fallback jika deviceId kosong.
    var id  = String(d.deviceId || '').trim();
    var lbl = String(d.label    || '').trim();
    if (id)  return 'id:'  + id;
    if (lbl) return 'lbl:' + lbl;
    return '';
}

function caEnforceDeviceOrder(list, kind) {
    if (!list || list.length === 0) return list;

    // Hanya cache saat semua device punya deviceId + label LENGKAP.
    // Pre-permission state label kosong & urutannya tidak stabil → skip.
    var allLabeled = list.every(function(d) { return !!(d.deviceId && d.label); });
    if (!allLabeled) return list;

    var keys = list.map(caDeviceKey);

    // Guard terhadap duplicate key → kalau ada, jangan enforce
    // (mencegah device ter-drop saat reorder).
    var seen = {}, hasDupes = false;
    keys.forEach(function(k) {
        if (!k) { hasDupes = true; return; }
        if (seen[k]) hasDupes = true;
        seen[k] = true;
    });
    if (hasDupes) return list;

    // Cache belum ada → simpan urutan natural sekarang
    if (!__caDeviceOrderCache[kind]) {
        __caDeviceOrderCache[kind] = keys.slice();
        return list;
    }

    var cached = __caDeviceOrderCache[kind];
    var ordered = [];
    var used = {};

    // 1. Device lama: ikuti urutan cache
    cached.forEach(function(key) {
        if (used[key]) return;
        var idx = keys.indexOf(key);
        if (idx !== -1) {
            ordered.push(list[idx]);
            used[key] = true;
        }
    });

    // 2. Device baru (belum ada di cache): append di belakang, urutan native
    list.forEach(function(d, idx) {
        var k = keys[idx];
        if (!used[k]) {
            ordered.push(d);
            used[k] = true;
        }
    });

    // Update cache jika set device berubah (unplug/plug)
    if (ordered.length !== cached.length) {
        __caDeviceOrderCache[kind] = ordered.map(caDeviceKey);
    }

    return ordered;
}

window.__caResetDeviceOrder = function() {
    __caDeviceOrderCache = {};
    try {
        var micSel = document.getElementById('ca-mic-native-select');
        if (micSel && typeof populateMicSelect === 'function') populateMicSelect(micSel);
        var camSel = document.getElementById('ca-camera-native-select');
        if (camSel && typeof populateSelect === 'function') populateSelect(camSel);
    } catch(e) {}
    console.log('[CA] ✅ Device order cache cleared — rebuilt from current enumeration');
};
async function enumerateWithLabels(kind, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    var retries    = opts.retries    != null ? opts.retries    : 2;
    var retryDelay = opts.retryDelay != null ? opts.retryDelay : 400;
    var constraints = kind === 'audioinput' ? { audio: true } : { video: true };
    var lastList = [];

    for (var attempt = 0; attempt <= retries; attempt++) {
        var list = [];
        try {
            var all = await W.navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices();
            list = all.filter(function(d) { return d.kind === kind; });
        } catch (e) { list = []; }

        lastList = list;

        var allLabeled = list.length > 0 && list.every(function(d) { return !!d.label; });

        if (allLabeled) {
            return caEnforceDeviceOrder(list, kind);
        }
        if (attempt >= retries) {
            return caEnforceDeviceOrder(list, kind);
        }

        try {
            var s = await W.navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(constraints);
            s.getTracks().forEach(function(t) { try { t.stop(); } catch(e) {} });
        } catch (warmErr) {
            if (warmErr && warmErr.name === 'NotAllowedError') {
                return caEnforceDeviceOrder(list, kind);
            }
        }

        await new Promise(function(r) { setTimeout(r, retryDelay); });
    }

    return caEnforceDeviceOrder(lastList, kind);
}
    async function getMics() { return enumerateWithLabels('audioinput'); }

             async function switchMic(id) {
    // ⭐ FIX #16: JANGAN set preference dulu — set setelah verifikasi sukses
    W.__mscUserSwitching = true;
    setTimeout(function() { W.__mscUserSwitching = false; }, 1500);

    showIndicator('🎤 Switching mic…', '#3b82f6');

    var newTrack = null;
    try {
        var pc = mirrorState.pc;
        var newStream = await W.navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
            video: false,
            audio: {
                deviceId: { exact: id },
                echoCancellation: true,
                noiseSuppression: true,
                autoGainControl: true
            }
        });
        newTrack = newStream.getAudioTracks()[0];
        if (!newTrack) { showIndicator('❌ Mic not available', '#ef4444'); return; }
        if (newTrack.readyState !== 'live') {
            // ⭐ FIX #15: stop dead track sebelum return
            try { newTrack.stop(); } catch(e) {}
            newTrack = null;
            showIndicator('❌ Mic not live', '#ef4444');
            return;
        }
        if (pc && (pc.connectionState === 'closed' || pc.signalingState === 'closed')) {
            // ⭐ FIX #11: feedback ke user + simpan preference untuk next session
            setPreferredMic(id);
            try { newTrack.stop(); } catch(e) {}
            newTrack = null;
            showIndicator('ℹ️ Mic saved — akan dipakai next session', '#3b82f6');
            return;
        }

        if (pc) {
            var audioSender = pc.getSenders().find(function(s) { return s.track && s.track.kind === 'audio'; });
            if (audioSender) {
                try {
                    await audioSender.replaceTrack(newTrack);
                } catch (replaceErr) {
                    if (replaceErr && replaceErr.name === 'InvalidStateError') {
                        // ⭐ FIX #15: stop track saat InvalidState
                        try { newTrack.stop(); } catch(e) {}
                        newTrack = null;
                        return;
                    }
                    throw replaceErr;
                }
                var st = audioSender.track;
                if (!(st && st.readyState === 'live')) {
                    try {
                        var g2 = await W.navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
                            video: false,
                            audio: { deviceId: { exact: id }, echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true, autoGainControl: true }
                        });
                        var t2 = g2.getAudioTracks()[0];
                        if (t2 && t2.readyState === 'live') {
                            await audioSender.replaceTrack(t2);
                        } else {
                            // ⭐ FIX #15: stop both dead tracks
                            try { if (t2) t2.stop(); } catch(e) {}
                            try { newTrack.stop(); } catch(e) {}
                            newTrack = null;
                            showIndicator('❌ Mic repair failed', '#ef4444');
                        }
                    } catch (e2) {
                        try { newTrack.stop(); } catch(e) {}
                        newTrack = null;
                        showIndicator('❌ Mic repair failed', '#ef4444');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // ⭐ FIX #16: set preference HANYA setelah semua sukses
        setPreferredMic(id);
        newTrack = null;   // ownership transferred ke audioSender
                // ✅ Success toast otomatis dari event listener: "🎤 Real mic: [realLabel]"
    } catch (e) {
        if (newTrack) { try { newTrack.stop(); } catch(_) {} }
        showIndicator('❌ Mic switch failed', '#ef4444');
    }
}
        var __caMicPopulateRetries = 0;
        async function populateMicSelect(sel) {
        // ⭐ FIX #5: retry counter per-select (bukan module-level)
        if (!sel.__caRetries) sel.__caRetries = 0;
        var mics = await getMics();
        if (mics.length === 0) {
            sel.__caRetries++;
            __caMicPopulateRetries = sel.__caRetries;
            if (sel.__caRetries <= 5) {
                setTimeout(function() { populateMicSelect(sel); }, 1500);
            } else {
                console.warn('[CA-EXT] ⚠️ Mic populate stopped after 5 retries — check extension');
            }
            return;
        }
        sel.__caRetries = 0;
        __caMicPopulateRetries = 0;
        var cv = sel.value; sel.innerHTML = '';
        mics.forEach(function(m, i) {
            var o = document.createElement('option');
            o.value = m.deviceId;
            o.textContent = m.label || ('Microphone ' + (i + 1));
            o.title = o.textContent; // ⭐ FIX: Tambah title agar bisa di-hover
            sel.appendChild(o);
        });
        if (cv) {
            for (var i = 0; i < sel.options.length; i++) {
                if (sel.options[i].value === cv) {
                    sel.selectedIndex = i;
                    sel.title = sel.options[i].textContent; // ⭐ FIX: Set title pada select
                    break;
                }
            }
        } else if (sel.options.length > 0) {
            sel.title = sel.options[0].textContent; // ⭐ FIX: Set title jika tidak ada yang terpilih
        }
    }

    function buildMicSelector() {
        var c = document.createElement('div'); c.id = 'ca-mic-container';
        var icon = document.createElement('span'); icon.className = 'ca-mic-icon'; icon.textContent = '🎤';
        var box = document.createElement('div'); box.id = 'ca-mic-box';
        var sel = document.createElement('select'); sel.id = 'ca-mic-native-select';
        var arrow = document.createElement('span'); arrow.className = 'ca-mic-arrow';
        box.appendChild(sel); box.appendChild(arrow); c.appendChild(icon); c.appendChild(box);
        populateMicSelect(sel);
               sel.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
            var opt = e.target.options[e.target.selectedIndex];
            e.target.title = opt ? opt.textContent : '';
            switchMic(e.target.value);
            // ⭐ FIX #4: release :focus-within setelah OS dropdown menutup.
            //    Guard: hanya blur kalau select MASIH aktif (cegah race kalau user
            //    langsung klik select lagi sebelum timeout).
            setTimeout(function() {
                if (document.activeElement === e.target) {
                    try { e.target.blur(); } catch(err) {}
                }
            }, 120);
        });
        return c;
    }

             async function switchCam(id) {

        }

        function locateAndHideNativeControls() {
        var style = document.getElementById('ca-native-hide-style');
        if (!style) {
            style = document.createElement('style'); style.id = 'ca-native-hide-style';
            style.innerHTML = '.ca-native-hidden { display: none !important; visibility: hidden !important; opacity: 0 !important; pointer-events: none !important; width: 0 !important; height: 0 !important; position: absolute !important; left: -99999px !important; top: -99999px !important; z-index: -99999 !important; }';
            document.head.appendChild(style);
        }
        var fsBtn = document.querySelector('.video-container__button.fullscreen-button');
        if (fsBtn && !fsBtn.classList.contains('ca-native-hidden')) fsBtn.classList.add('ca-native-hidden');
        var stBtn = document.querySelector('.video-container__button.settings-button');
        if (stBtn && !stBtn.classList.contains('ca-native-hidden')) stBtn.classList.add('ca-native-hidden');
        document.querySelectorAll('.video-container__button').forEach(function(btn) {
            var text = (btn.innerText || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            if (text.includes('report') && !text.includes('abuse') && !btn.classList.contains('ca-native-hidden')) {
                btn.classList.add('ca-native-hidden');
            }
        });
    }

    function triggerNativeAction(action) {
        var targetElement = null;
        if (action === 'full screen') targetElement = document.querySelector('.video-container__button.fullscreen-button');
        else if (action === 'settings') targetElement = document.querySelector('.video-container__button.settings-button');
        else if (action === 'report') {
            var all = document.querySelectorAll('.video-container__button');
            for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
                var text = (all[i].innerText || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                if (text.includes('report') && !text.includes('abuse')) { targetElement = all[i]; break; }
            }
        }
        if (targetElement) {
            try {
                targetElement.click();
                ['mousedown', 'mouseup', 'click'].forEach(function(evt) {
                    targetElement.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(evt, { view: window, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, buttons: 1 }));
                });
                return true;
            } catch(e) {}
        }
        return false;
    }

        function updateBlurBackground() {

        var video = __caBgVideoCache;

        var now = Date.now();

       function updateLocalVideoTransform() {
        var v = document.getElementById('local-video');
        if (!v) return;

if (window.__caLogicV25) {
    // ⭐ FIX ZOOM-EXPLODE: preserve zoom scale, jangan strip scale(1.8)

        ? 'scale(1.8) ' + __flip

    if (__isZoom) {
        v.style.setProperty('transform-origin', 'center center', 'important');
    }
    v.style.setProperty('top', '0', 'important');
    v.style.setProperty('left', '0', 'important');

    v.style.setProperty('height', '100%', 'important');

        // Simpan status flip ke dataset agar bisa dibaca oleh lockVideoSizes

        if (isLandscape) {
            // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            // [CA-FLIP-LS] PATCH 1: Tulis inline transform langsung
            // ke #local-video (parity dengan portrait)
            // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            var __lsIsZoomed  = box && box.classList.contains('ca-zoom-active');

            v.style.setProperty('transition', 'transform 0.35s ease-in-out', 'important');
            v.style.setProperty('-webkit-transition', 'transform 0.35s ease-in-out', 'important');

            var __lsAngle = 0;
            var __lsCurT  = v.style.transform || '';
            var __lsMRot  = __lsCurT.match(/rotate\((-?[0-9.]+)deg\)/);
            if (__lsMRot) {
                __lsAngle = parseFloat(__lsMRot[1]);
            } else {
                var __lsMMat = __lsCurT.match(/matrix\(([^)]+)\)/);
                if (__lsMMat) {
                    var __lsP = __lsMMat[1].split(',').map(parseFloat);
                    if (__lsP.length >= 2) {
                        __lsAngle = Math.round(Math.atan2(__lsP[1], __lsP[0]) * 180 / Math.PI);
                    }
                }
            }
            __lsAngle = ((__lsAngle % 360) + 360) % 360;

            var __lsRotPart = __lsAngle ? ' rotate(' + __lsAngle + 'deg)' : '';
            var __lsTransform = 'translate(-50%, -50%)' + __lsRotPart +
                                ' scale(' + __lsZoomScale + ') ' + __lsFlipPart;

            v.style.setProperty('transform', __lsTransform, 'important');

        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 🟢 CANVAS 2D REPLACEMENT (Anti-Freeze & Zero Latency)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    var glCanvas = null; // Tetap pakai nama variabel ini agar tidak error
    var glCtx2D = null;
    var renderInterval = null;
    var __caRVFCId = 0;
    var __caRVFCVideo = null;
    var __caLastFrameTime = 0;
    var __caFrozenRestartAttempts = 0;

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ⭐ FLIP FIX v1 — Canvas track wrapper (contentHint-aware)
//    Wajib: contentHint = 'motion' agar WebRTC encoder perlakukan
//    canvas sebagai camera stream, BUKAN screen-share (yang bikin blur)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function __caSetCanvasTrack(track) {
    if (!track) return null;
    try { track.contentHint = 'motion'; } catch(e) {}
    return track;
}
    function initWebGL() {
        if (glCanvas && glCtx2D) return true;

        glCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        glCanvas.id = 'ca-flip-canvas';
        // ⭐ FIX: gunakan dimensi sumber — diupdate ulang di renderFrame() jika berubah
        var hv = mirrorState.hiddenVideo;
        var srcW = (hv && hv.videoWidth)  ? hv.videoWidth  : 1280;
        var srcH = (hv && hv.videoHeight) ? hv.videoHeight : 720;
        glCanvas.width  = srcW;
        glCanvas.height = srcH;

        glCtx2D = glCanvas.getContext('2d', {
            alpha: false
            // ⭐ FIX: hapus desynchronized:true — tidak sinkron dengan captureStream.requestFrame()
        });
        glCanvas.style.cssText = 'position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.01; z-index: -99999;';
        if (!document.getElementById('ca-flip-canvas')) {
            document.body.appendChild(glCanvas);
        }

        return !!glCtx2D;
    }

        function renderFrame(v) {
        if (!glCtx2D || !v || v.readyState < 2) {
            __caLastFrameTime = Date.now();
            return;
        }

        var srcW = v.videoWidth, srcH = v.videoHeight;
        if (!srcW || !srcH) return;

        // ⭐ FIX: canvas mengikuti resolusi sumber 1:1 — tanpa letterbox, tanpa downscale
        if (glCanvas.width !== srcW || glCanvas.height !== srcH) {
            glCanvas.width  = srcW;
            glCanvas.height = srcH;
        }

        // ⭐ FIX: draw 1:1 ke canvas penuh (tidak ada Math.min letterbox logic)
        glCtx2D.save();
        glCtx2D.translate(srcW, 0);
        glCtx2D.scale(-1, 1);
        glCtx2D.drawImage(v, 0, 0, srcW, srcH);
        glCtx2D.restore();

        __caLastFrameTime = Date.now();
        __caFrozenRestartAttempts = 0;
    }

        function createHiddenVideo() {
        if (mirrorState.hiddenVideo) return;
        var v = document.createElement('video');
        v.id = 'ca-flip-hidden-video';
        // ⭐ FIX: Taruh di pojok layar dengan opacity 0.01 agar Chrome tidak menidurkannya
        v.style.cssText = 'position: fixed; bottom: 0; right: 0; width: 10px; height: 10px; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.01; z-index: -99999;';
        v.autoplay = true; v.muted = true; v.playsInline = true;
        document.body.appendChild(v);
        mirrorState.hiddenVideo = v;
    }

        function startStreamRenderLoop() {
        if (!initWebGL()) return;

        // Stop previous loop
        if (__caRVFCId && __caRVFCVideo && __caRVFCVideo.cancelVideoFrameCallback) {
            try { __caRVFCVideo.cancelVideoFrameCallback(__caRVFCId); } catch(e) {}
        }
        __caRVFCId = 0;
        if (renderInterval) { clearInterval(renderInterval); renderInterval = null; }

        var hv = mirrorState.hiddenVideo;
        if (!hv) return;
        __caRVFCVideo = hv;
        __caLastFrameTime = Date.now();

        // ⭐ FIX: buat stream SEBELUM render loop — supaya requestFrame tersedia saat loop start
        var needNewStream = !mirrorState.canvasStream || !mirrorState.canvasTrack || mirrorState.canvasTrack.readyState !== 'live';
        if (needNewStream) {
    try {
        if (mirrorState.canvasStream) {
            mirrorState.canvasStream.getTracks().forEach(function(t) { try { t.stop(); } catch(e) {} });
        }
    } catch(e) {}
    try {
        mirrorState.canvasStream = glCanvas.captureStream(0);
        mirrorState.canvasTrack = __caSetCanvasTrack(mirrorState.canvasStream.getVideoTracks()[0]);   // ⭐ FIX
        if (!mirrorState.canvasTrack || typeof mirrorState.canvasTrack.requestFrame !== 'function') {
            try { mirrorState.canvasTrack && mirrorState.canvasTrack.stop(); } catch(e) {}
            try { mirrorState.canvasStream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ try{t.stop();}catch(e){} }); } catch(e) {}
            mirrorState.canvasStream = glCanvas.captureStream(30);
            mirrorState.canvasTrack = __caSetCanvasTrack(mirrorState.canvasStream.getVideoTracks()[0]);   // ⭐ FIX
            console.log('[CA-FLIP] ⚠️ requestFrame unavailable → fallback 30fps auto');
        } else {
            console.log('[CA-FLIP] ✅ Manual FPS mode (requestFrame per camera frame)');
        }
    } catch(e) {
        try {
            mirrorState.canvasStream = glCanvas.captureStream(30);
            mirrorState.canvasTrack = __caSetCanvasTrack(mirrorState.canvasStream.getVideoTracks()[0]);   // ⭐ FIX
        } catch(e2) {
            mirrorState.canvasStream = null;
            mirrorState.canvasTrack = null;
        }
    }
}

        var useRVFC = typeof hv.requestVideoFrameCallback === 'function';
        var renderLoop = function() {
            if (!flipActive) return;
            if (!mirrorState.hiddenVideo) return;
            renderFrame(mirrorState.hiddenVideo);
            // ⭐ FIX: paksa capture frame yang baru saja digambar
            try {
                if (mirrorState.canvasTrack && typeof mirrorState.canvasTrack.requestFrame === 'function') {
                    mirrorState.canvasTrack.requestFrame();
                }
            } catch(e) {}
            if (useRVFC) {
                __caRVFCId = mirrorState.hiddenVideo.requestVideoFrameCallback(renderLoop);
            }
        };

        if (useRVFC) {
            __caRVFCId = hv.requestVideoFrameCallback(renderLoop);
        } else {
            var rafTick = function() {
                if (!flipActive) return;
                if (mirrorState.hiddenVideo) {
                    renderFrame(mirrorState.hiddenVideo);
                    try {
                        if (mirrorState.canvasTrack && typeof mirrorState.canvasTrack.requestFrame === 'function') {
                            mirrorState.canvasTrack.requestFrame();
                        }
                    } catch(e) {}
                }
                renderInterval = requestAnimationFrame(rafTick);
            };
            renderInterval = requestAnimationFrame(rafTick);
        }
    }

        function stopStreamRenderLoop(keepSource) {
        if (renderInterval) {
            try { cancelAnimationFrame(renderInterval); } catch(e) {}
            renderInterval = null;
        }
        if (__caRVFCId && __caRVFCVideo && __caRVFCVideo.cancelVideoFrameCallback) {
            try { __caRVFCVideo.cancelVideoFrameCallback(__caRVFCId); } catch(e) {}
        }
        __caRVFCId = 0;
        __caRVFCVideo = null;
        // ⭐ FIX: hanya clear srcObject kalau bukan restart-loop (Attempt 1 recovery)
        if (!keepSource && mirrorState.hiddenVideo) mirrorState.hiddenVideo.srcObject = null;
    }


        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 🔧 HELPER: restoreOriginalToPc (sebelumnya HILANG — penyebab boomerang)
    //    Safety: idempotent, no-op kalau PC tidak connected atau sudah original
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                async function restoreOriginalToPc() {
    var pc = mirrorState.pc;
    if (!pc) return false;

    // ── Kalau PC belum connected: attach listener sekali, tunggu ──
    if (pc.connectionState !== 'connected') {
        if (!pc.__caFlipReconnectAttached) {
            pc.__caFlipReconnectAttached = true;
            try {
                pc.addEventListener('connectionstatechange', function onFlipReconnect() {
                    if (pc.connectionState === 'connected') {
                        pc.removeEventListener('connectionstatechange', onFlipReconnect);
                        pc.__caFlipReconnectAttached = false;
                        restoreOriginalToPc().catch(function(){});
                    } else if (pc.connectionState === 'closed' || pc.connectionState === 'failed') {
                        // ⭐ FIX 8: cleanup listener saat PC mati (cegah leak)
                        pc.removeEventListener('connectionstatechange', onFlipReconnect);
                        pc.__caFlipReconnectAttached = false;
                    }
                });
            } catch(e) { pc.__caFlipReconnectAttached = false; }
        }
        return false;
    }

    var sender = pc.getSenders().find(function(s) {
        return s.track && s.track.kind === 'video';
    });
    if (!sender) return false;

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ⭐ FIX 6: originalTrack recovery — 3 fallback berlapis
    //    Bug sebelumnya: setelah partner transition, mirrorState.originalTrack
    //    di-null-kan oleh HookedRTC, tapi restoreOriginalToPc hanya cek
    //    sender.track (yang saat flip aktif = canvasTrack) → fail silent.
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    // Fallback 1: sender.track (jika bukan canvas)
    if (!mirrorState.originalTrack || mirrorState.originalTrack.readyState !== 'live') {
        if (sender.track && sender.track.readyState === 'live' &&
            sender.track !== mirrorState.canvasTrack) {
            mirrorState.originalTrack = sender.track;
            console.log('[CA-FLIP] 🔄 originalTrack recovered from sender');
        }
    }

    // Fallback 2: hiddenVideo.srcObject (kamera masih hidup di hidden player)
    if ((!mirrorState.originalTrack || mirrorState.originalTrack.readyState !== 'live') &&
        mirrorState.hiddenVideo && mirrorState.hiddenVideo.srcObject) {
        try {
            var hvTracks = mirrorState.hiddenVideo.srcObject.getVideoTracks();
            if (hvTracks[0] && hvTracks[0].readyState === 'live') {
                mirrorState.originalTrack = hvTracks[0];
                console.log('[CA-FLIP] 🔄 originalTrack recovered from hiddenVideo');
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    // Fallback 3: local-video.srcObject (preview kamera user)
    if (!mirrorState.originalTrack || mirrorState.originalTrack.readyState !== 'live') {
        try {
            var lv = document.getElementById('local-video');
            if (lv && lv.srcObject) {
                var lvTracks = lv.srcObject.getVideoTracks();
                if (lvTracks[0] && lvTracks[0].readyState === 'live' &&
                    lvTracks[0] !== mirrorState.canvasTrack) {
                    mirrorState.originalTrack = lvTracks[0];
                    console.log('[CA-FLIP] 🔄 originalTrack recovered from local-video');
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    if (!mirrorState.originalTrack || mirrorState.originalTrack.readyState !== 'live') {
        console.warn('[CA-FLIP] ⚠️ no live originalTrack to restore');
        return false;
    }

    // Sudah original? tidak perlu replaceTrack
    if (sender.track === mirrorState.originalTrack) {
        console.log('[CA-FLIP] ✅ sender already has original track');
        return true;
    }

    // ── Restore ──
    try {
        await sender.replaceTrack(mirrorState.originalTrack);
        console.log('[CA-FLIP] ✅ original track restored');
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[CA-FLIP] restore replaceTrack failed:', e);
        return false;
    }

    // ⭐ FIX 5: reset encoder params — hapus cap bitrate & degradation lama
    try {
        var p = sender.getParameters();
        if (!p.encodings || p.encodings.length === 0) p.encodings = [{}];
        p.encodings[0].maxBitrate = 8000000;         // 8 Mbps cukup untuk 1080p30
        p.encodings[0].scaleResolutionDownBy = 1;
        p.degradationPreference = 'balanced';
        await sender.setParameters(p);
        console.log('[CA-FLIP] ✅ encoder params reset (8 Mbps, balanced)');
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[CA-FLIP] ⚠️ reset params failed:', e);
    }

    // ⭐ FIX 5b: hapus contentHint canvas supaya tidak linger
    try { if (mirrorState.canvasTrack) mirrorState.canvasTrack.contentHint = ''; } catch(e) {}

    return true;
}
        async function applyFlipToPc() {
    var pc = mirrorState.pc;
    if (!pc) return;
    if (pc.connectionState !== 'connected') return;
    var sender = pc.getSenders().find(function(s) { return s.track && s.track.kind === 'video'; });
    if (!sender || !mirrorState.canvasTrack) return;

    // ── Guard: canvas track harus live + producing frames ──
    if (mirrorState.canvasTrack.readyState !== 'live') {
        console.warn('[CA-FLIP] 🛡️ block replace: canvas track state=' + mirrorState.canvasTrack.readyState);
        return;
    }
    var st = (mirrorState.canvasTrack.getSettings ? mirrorState.canvasTrack.getSettings() : {}) || {};
    if (st.width === 0 || st.height === 0) {
        console.warn('[CA-FLIP] 🛡️ block replace: canvas 0-dim');
        return;
    }

    // ⭐ FIX 1: contentHint = 'motion' (defense-in-depth)
    try { mirrorState.canvasTrack.contentHint = 'motion'; } catch(e) {}

    // ── Inject canvas track ──
    try { await sender.replaceTrack(mirrorState.canvasTrack); } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[CA-FLIP] replaceTrack failed:', e);
        return;
    }

    // ⭐ FIX 2+3: adaptive bitrate + degradationPreference='balanced'
    try {
        var p = sender.getParameters();
        if (!p.encodings || p.encodings.length === 0) p.encodings = [{}];

        var w  = st.width  || 1280;
        var h  = st.height || 720;
        var px = w * h;

        var targetBitrate =
            px >= 1920 * 1080 ? 6000000 :
            px >= 1280 *  720 ? 3500000 :
                                2000000;

        p.encodings[0].maxBitrate = targetBitrate;
        p.encodings[0].scaleResolutionDownBy = 1;
        p.degradationPreference = 'balanced';

        await sender.setParameters(p);
        console.log('[CA-FLIP] ✅ Encoder: ' + w + '×' + h +
                    ' @ ' + (targetBitrate / 1e6).toFixed(1) + ' Mbps, balanced');
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[CA-FLIP] ⚠️ setParameters failed (fallback to browser default):', e);
    }
}

    var forceInterval = null;
                        function startForceApply() {
        if (forceInterval) clearInterval(forceInterval);
            forceInterval = setInterval(async function() {
        if (!flipActive) return;
        if (flipProcessing) return;
        var pc = mirrorState.pc;
        if (!pc) return;
        if (pc.connectionState !== 'connected') return;

        // ── Guard 0: hiddenVideo paused → nudge play (cheap)
        try {
            var _hv = mirrorState.hiddenVideo;
            if (_hv && _hv.paused && _hv.srcObject) _hv.play().catch(function(){});
        } catch(e) {}

        // ── Guard 1: canvas track dead → restore
        if (!mirrorState.canvasTrack || mirrorState.canvasTrack.readyState !== 'live') {
            console.warn('[CA-FLIP] 🛡️ canvas dead → auto restore');
            flipActive = false;
            __caFrozenRestartAttempts = 0;
            stopForceApply();
            try { await restoreOriginalToPc(); } catch(e) {}
            try { stopStreamRenderLoop(); } catch(e) {}
            try { updateLocalVideoTransform(); } catch(e) {}
            return;
        }

                // ── Guard 2: canvas FROZEN (live track, 0 frame >2s)
        if (__caLastFrameTime > 0 && (Date.now() - __caLastFrameTime) > 2000) {
            if (__caFrozenRestartAttempts < 3) {
                __caFrozenRestartAttempts++;
                console.warn('[CA-FLIP] 🛡️ frozen → recovery attempt ' + __caFrozenRestartAttempts + '/3');
                                if (__caFrozenRestartAttempts === 1) {
                    // Attempt 1: restart render loop (cheap) — ⭐ FIX: keepSource agar video tidak blank
                    try { stopStreamRenderLoop(true); } catch(e) {}
                    try { startStreamRenderLoop(); } catch(e) {}
                } else if (__caFrozenRestartAttempts === 2) {
                    // Attempt 2: nudge hidden video (may be paused/throttled)
                    /* jshint ignore:start */
                    // ⭐ FIX: deklarasi eksplisit (strict-mode safe) — sebelumnya `_hv = ...` tanpa var
                    //        menyebabkan ReferenceError yang tertangkap silent → Attempt 2 no-op
                    _hv = null;
                    try {
                        if (window.mirrorState) {
                            _hv = window.mirrorState.hiddenVideo;
                        } else if (typeof mirrorState !== 'undefined') {
                            _hv = mirrorState.hiddenVideo;
                        }
                    } catch(_e2) { _hv = null; }
                    /* jshint ignore:end */
                        if (_hv && _hv.paused) {
                            var p1 = _hv.play();
                            if (p1 && p1.catch) p1.catch(function(){});
                        }
                        if (_hv && typeof _hv.load === 'function' && _hv.srcObject) {
                            var _s = _hv.srcObject;
                            _hv.srcObject = null;
                            _hv.srcObject = _s;
                            var p2 = _hv.play();
                            if (p2 && p2.catch) p2.catch(function(){});
                        }
                    try { stopStreamRenderLoop(true); } catch(e) {} //
                    try { startStreamRenderLoop(); } catch(e) {}
                } else {
                    // Attempt 3: full canvas stream recreate
                    try {
                        if (mirrorState.canvasStream) {
                            mirrorState.canvasStream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ try{t.stop()}catch(e){} });
                        }
                    } catch(e) {}
                    mirrorState.canvasStream = null;
                    mirrorState.canvasTrack = null;
                    try { stopStreamRenderLoop(); } catch(e) {}
                    try { startStreamRenderLoop(); } catch(e) {}
                }
                __caLastFrameTime = Date.now(); // grace 2s before next check
                return;
            }
            // 3 failed attempts (~6s total) → auto restore (unchanged)
            console.warn('[CA-FLIP] 🛡️ canvas still frozen after 3 attempts → auto restore');
            flipActive = false;
            __caFrozenRestartAttempts = 0;
            stopForceApply();
            try { await restoreOriginalToPc(); } catch(e) {}
            try { stopStreamRenderLoop(); } catch(e) {}
            try { updateLocalVideoTransform(); } catch(e) {}
            __caLastFrameTime = 0;
            return;
        }

        var sender = pc.getSenders().find(function(s) { return s.track && s.track.kind === 'video'; });
        if (!sender) return;
        if (sender.track !== mirrorState.canvasTrack) {
            // ⭐ FIX: rate-limit 800ms — cegah churn saat Ome.tv sesekali replaceTrack sendiri
            var __now = Date.now();
            if (__now - (window.__caLastForceReplaceAt || 0) < 800) return;
            window.__caLastForceReplaceAt = __now;
            try { await sender.replaceTrack(mirrorState.canvasTrack); } catch(e) {}
        }
    }, 100);
}
               function stopForceApply() {
        if (forceInterval) { clearInterval(forceInterval); forceInterval = null; }
        __caFrozenRestartAttempts = 0;   // ⭐ reset so next flip starts fresh
        window.__caLastForceReplaceAt = 0;   // ⭐ FIX: reset rate-limit gate
    }

    var lastWatchedPc = null;
    function watchPc() {

        if (pc !== lastWatchedPc) {

            if (sender && sender.track && !flipActive) mirrorState.originalTrack = sender.track;
            if (flipActive) applyFlipToPc();
        }
    }

       async function toggleFlip() {
    return; // ⭐ DISABLED UNTUK HEMAT CPU/GPU

            if (sender && sender.track &&
                sender.track !== mirrorState.canvasTrack &&
                sender.track.readyState === 'live') {
                track = sender.track;

            if (!track && mirrorState.originalTrack &&
                mirrorState.originalTrack.readyState === 'live' &&

                    if (tracks[i].readyState === 'live' && tracks[i] !== mirrorState.canvasTrack) {
                        track = tracks[i];

                showIndicator('❌ Camera not ready', '#991b1b');
                flipProcessing = false;
                return;

                        try { t.stop(); } catch(e) {}
                    });
                }

                hv.oncanplay = finish;

                if (hv.readyState >= 1) finish();
            });

            startStreamRenderLoop();

            : (currentTransform.indexOf('rotate(' + currentRotation + 'deg)') !== -1);

        if (!force && __caLastRotSize.w === WW && __caLastRotSize.h === HH && __caLastRotSize.rot === currentRotation && isStyleIntact) return;

    function applyRotation(force) {
        if (__caRotRAF) cancelAnimationFrame(__caRotRAF);
        __caRotRAF = requestAnimationFrame(function() {
            __caRotRAF = 0;
            // ⭐ FIX: Gunakan fungsi rotasi V25 jika aktif
            if (window.__caLogicV25 && window.doApplyRotation) {
                window.doApplyRotation(force);
            } else {
                doApplyRotation(force);
            }
        });
    }

    // 🔥 KUNCI PERBAIKAN: Loop di setiap frame selama rotation aktif
       function ensureRotationLoop() {
        if (window.__caLogicV25) return; // ⭐ FIX: Matikan total loop 60fps jika V25 aktif
        if (__caRotLoopRAF) return;
        if (currentRotation === 0) return;

        function loop() {
            if (currentRotation === 0) {
                __caRotLoopRAF = 0;
                return;
            }
            doApplyRotation(false);
            __caRotLoopRAF = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        }
        __caRotLoopRAF = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }

                                           function rotateLeft() {
        currentRotation = (currentRotation - 90 + 360) % 360;
        window.currentRotation = currentRotation;
        if (window.__caLogicV25) {
            if (window.__caClearLayoutInlineStyles) window.__caClearLayoutInlineStyles();
            if (window.doApplyRotation) window.doApplyRotation(true);
            if (window.__caEnforceGridStructure) window.__caEnforceGridStructure();
            if (window.__caApplyAdaptiveLayout) window.__caApplyAdaptiveLayout(true);
        } else {
            applyRotation(true);
            ensureRotationLoop();
        }
    }
        function rotateRight() {
        currentRotation = (currentRotation + 90) % 360;
        window.currentRotation = currentRotation;
        if (window.__caLogicV25) {
            if (window.__caClearLayoutInlineStyles) window.__caClearLayoutInlineStyles();
            if (window.doApplyRotation) window.doApplyRotation(true);
            if (window.__caEnforceGridStructure) window.__caEnforceGridStructure();
            if (window.__caApplyAdaptiveLayout) window.__caApplyAdaptiveLayout(true);
        } else {
            applyRotation(true);
            ensureRotationLoop();
        }
    }

              function watchRemoteVideo() {
        var remoteVideo = document.getElementById('remote-video');
        if (!remoteVideo) return;
        if (currentRemoteVideo === remoteVideo) return;
        currentRemoteVideo = remoteVideo;

        // FIX: Pantau perubahan ukuran & stream saat partner baru masuk
        if (!remoteVideo.dataset.caRotListener) {
            remoteVideo.dataset.caRotListener = 'true';
            remoteVideo.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function() {
                if (currentRotation !== 0) applyRotation(true);
            });
            remoteVideo.addEventListener('resize', function() {
                if (currentRotation !== 0) applyRotation(true);
            });
        }

        // FIX: Pantau jika wrapper bergeser/resize akibat layout grid
        var remoteWrapper = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
        if (remoteWrapper && !remoteWrapper.dataset.caRotObs) {
            remoteWrapper.dataset.caRotObs = 'true';
            window.__caResizeBus.subscribe(remoteWrapper, function() {
                if (currentRotation !== 0) applyRotation(true);
            });
        }
    }

                catch(err) {
                    window.__caAspectToggling = false;

                    aspectBtn.innerText = aspectOriginalActive ? 'Fit' : 'Fill';
                    applyAspectMode(); applyAspectInline(); applyRotation(true);

                aspectBtn.innerText = aspectOriginalActive ? 'Fit' : 'Fill';

       function ensureVideoObjectFit() {
    var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
    if (box && box.classList.contains('ca-aspect-switching')) return;
    if (box && box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-landscape-mode')) return;

    var rv = document.getElementById('remote-video');
    var lv = document.getElementById('local-video');

    var useContain = (currentRotation !== 0) ? true : (typeof aspectOriginalActive !== 'undefined' && aspectOriginalActive);
    var fitMode = useContain ? 'contain' : 'cover';

    [rv, lv].forEach(function (video) {
        if (!video || video.readyState < 2 || !video.videoWidth) return;

        // ⭐ FIX: Local video SELALU cover — rotasi/aspect-toggle hanya untuk remote
        var vFit = (video.id === 'local-video') ? 'cover' : fitMode;

        var key = video.videoWidth + 'x' + video.videoHeight + '|' + vFit;
        if (video.__caLastFitKey === key) return;
        video.__caLastFitKey = key;

        video.style.setProperty('object-fit', vFit, 'important');

        if (video.style.opacity && video.style.opacity !== '1') {
            video.style.setProperty('opacity', '1', 'important');
        }

        if (video.id === 'remote-video') {
            var blurDiv = document.getElementById('ca-blur-bg-div');
            if (blurDiv) blurDiv.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
        }
    });
}

        if (mirrorActive && initialMirrorDirection !== null) {
            var w = document.querySelector('.video-container__wrapper');
            if (w) {
                var opposite = (initialMirrorDirection === 'row-reverse') ? 'row' : 'row-reverse';
                if (w.style.flexDirection !== opposite) w.style.setProperty('flex-direction', opposite, 'important');
            }
        }
        if (!state.partnerConnected) nativeControls.rp = null;
        var v2 = document.getElementById('remote-video');
        if (v2) {
            var isVideoActive = (v2.readyState >= 2 && v2.videoWidth > 0 && v2.currentTime > 0);
            if (isVideoActive && videoActiveSince === 0) {
                videoActiveSince = Date.now();
                setTimeout(function() {
                    if (aspectOriginalActive && currentRotation === 0) applyAspectInline();
                }, 500);
            } else if (!isVideoActive) {
                videoActiveSince = 0;
            }
            if (isVideoActive) updateBlurBackground();
        }
    }

    function tickCamera() { placeMicAndCamera(); }
    function tickFloatingBox() { attachFloatingBoxToVideo(); }

    function updateIPHoverState(clientX, clientY) {
        if (!floatingBox) return;
        if (!state.ipHoverEnabled) {
            if (ipHoverState) { ipHoverState = false; floatingBox.classList.remove('ca-hover'); }
            if (ipPanelHoverState) { ipPanelHoverState = false; floatingBox.classList.remove('ca-panel-hover'); }
            return;
        }
        var wrapper = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper'); var inside = false;
        if (wrapper) {
            var r = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
            inside = (clientX >= r.left && clientX <= r.right && clientY >= r.top && clientY <= r.bottom);
        }
        if (!inside) {
            var fr = floatingBox.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (clientX >= fr.left && clientX <= fr.right && clientY >= fr.top && clientY <= fr.bottom) inside = true;
        }
        if (inside !== ipHoverState) {
            ipHoverState = inside;
            if (inside) floatingBox.classList.add('ca-hover');
            else floatingBox.classList.remove('ca-hover');
        }
        var overPanel = false;
        if (inside) {
            var fRect = floatingBox.getBoundingClientRect();
            overPanel = (clientX >= fRect.left && clientX <= fRect.right && clientY >= fRect.top && clientY <= fRect.bottom);
        }
        if (overPanel !== ipPanelHoverState) {
            ipPanelHoverState = overPanel;
            if (overPanel) floatingBox.classList.add('ca-panel-hover');
            else floatingBox.classList.remove('ca-panel-hover');
        }
    }
