    function setupDynamicPanelHeight() {
        var panel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        if (!panel) { setTimeout(setupDynamicPanelHeight, 1000); return; }
                var updatePanelGeometry = function() {
            if (window.__caCinemaLock) return
            if (window.__caVTActive) return;   // ⭐ FIX: jangan race dengan VT
            if (__caResizeState) return;
            if (__caDragState)   return;
            if (__caVResizeState) return;
            if (__caScaleState) return;
            if (panel.style.display === 'none') return;

            var panelTop = (state.panelTop != null) ? state.panelTop : 12;
            var minH = 40;
            var panelHeight;
            var sc = state.panelScale || 1.0;
            var originParts = (state.panelScaleOrigin || '50% 50%').split(' ');
            var oyPct = 0.5;
            if (originParts[1]) { var py = parseFloat(originParts[1]); if (!isNaN(py)) oyPct = py / 100; }
            var factorY = oyPct + sc * (1 - oyPct);
            if (factorY < 0.01) factorY = 0.01;

            if (state.panelHeight != null) {
                panelHeight = state.panelHeight;
                if (panelHeight < minH) panelHeight = minH;
            } else {
                var preferred = Math.round((window.innerHeight * 0.82) / factorY);
                var maxH2 = (window.innerHeight - 12 - panelTop) / factorY;
                panelHeight = Math.min(preferred, maxH2);
                if (panelHeight < minH) panelHeight = minH;
            }

            panel.style.setProperty('top', panelTop + 'px', 'important');
            panel.style.setProperty('height', panelHeight + 'px', 'important');
            panel.style.setProperty('max-height', panelHeight + 'px', 'important');

            if (panelHeight < 300) panel.classList.add('ca-panel-tiny');
            else panel.classList.remove('ca-panel-tiny');
        };
        window.__caUpdatePanelHeight = updatePanelGeometry;
        updatePanelGeometry();
        window.addEventListener('resize', updatePanelGeometry);
    }

        async function autoSelectPreferredDevices() {
        try {
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500));
            if (!W.__mscPreferredCamFakeId) {
                var cams = await enumerateWithLabels('videoinput');
                if (cams.length > 0) {
                    setPreferredCam(cams[0].deviceId);
                    console.log('[CA-AUTO] ✅ Auto-selected CAM: ' + cams[0].label);
                }
            }
            if (!W.__mscPreferredMicFakeId) {
                var mics = await enumerateWithLabels('audioinput');
                if (mics.length > 0) {
                    setPreferredMic(mics[0].deviceId);
                    console.log('[CA-AUTO] ✅ Auto-selected MIC: ' + mics[0].label);
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[CA-AUTO] Failed to auto-select', e);
        }
    }

        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // FUNGSI: Cari tombol Country dengan ULTRA-ROBUST detection
        //  - Cek direct text (bukan descendant text)
        //  - Walk up DOM sampai 15 level
        //  - Fallback: cari di seluruh halaman jika perlu
        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                function __caFindCountryButton(startEl) {
            // ⭐ TAMBAHKAN BARIS INI: Deteksi instan via class
            if (startEl && startEl.closest) {
                var specificBtn = startEl.closest('.buttons__button.country-filter, .country-filter__button, .buttons__button[class*="country"]');
                if (specificBtn) return specificBtn;
            }

            var current = startEl;
            var depth = 0;
            while (current && current !== document.body && current !== document.documentElement && depth < 15) {
                // Cek direct text (hanya node text langsung, bukan descendant)
                var directText = '';
                try {
                    for (var i = 0; i < current.childNodes.length; i++) {
                        if (current.childNodes[i].nodeType === 3) {
                            directText += current.childNodes[i].textContent;
                        }
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
                directText = directText.trim().toLowerCase();

                var cls = '';
                try { cls = String(current.className || '').toLowerCase(); } catch(e) {}

                // Prioritas 1: direct text mengandung "country"/"negara"
                if (directText === 'country' || directText === 'negara' ||
                    directText.indexOf('country ') === 0 || directText.indexOf('negara ') === 0 ||
                    directText.indexOf('country\n') === 0 || directText.indexOf('negara\n') === 0) {
                    return current;
                }
                if ((directText.indexOf('country') !== -1 || directText.indexOf('negara') !== -1) && directText.length < 30) {
                    return current;
                }

                // Prioritas 2: class mengandung "country" (bukan popup)
                if ((cls.indexOf('country') !== -1 || cls.indexOf('negara') !== -1) &&
                    cls.indexOf('popup') === -1 && cls.indexOf('filter-popup') === -1) {
                    var rect = current.getBoundingClientRect();
                    if (rect.width > 20 && rect.width < 600 && rect.height > 15 && rect.height < 200) {
                        return current;
                    }
                }

                current = current.parentElement;
                depth++;
            }
            return null;
        }

       function caVideoWatchdogRepair(pc) {
        return new Promise(function(resolve) {
            if (typeof flipProcessing !== 'undefined' && flipProcessing) return resolve(true);
            if (!pc || pc.connectionState !== 'connected') return resolve(false);
            if (__caVideoWatchdog.repairing) return resolve(false);

            // ⭐ PATCH A: skip repair selama partner transition — cegah
            //      race dengan Ome.tv's own WebRTC renegotiation.
            //      Symptom yang dicegah: "TypeError .incoming" di main.js
            //      saat ND.render dipanggil dengan Redux state inconsistent.
            var __vdNow = Date.now();
            var __vdLastTx = (window.__ca && window.__ca.state && window.__ca.state.lastPartnerTransitionAt) || 0;
            if (__vdLastTx && (__vdNow - __vdLastTx) < 3000) {
                console.log('[CA-VD] ⏸️ skip repair — partner transition (' + (__vdNow - __vdLastTx) + 'ms ago)');
                return resolve(false);
            }

            var sender = pc.getSenders().find(function(s){ return s.track && s.track.kind === 'video'; });
            if (!sender) return resolve(false);
            if (sender.track && sender.track.readyState === 'live') return resolve(true);
            if (__caVideoWatchdog.repairs >= 3) return resolve(false);

            __caVideoWatchdog.repairs++;
            __caVideoWatchdog.repairing = true;
            console.warn('%c[CA-VD] 🔧 video ended — repair #' + __caVideoWatchdog.repairs, 'color:#f59e0b;font-weight:bold');

            var localVideo = document.getElementById('local-video');
            var liveTrack = null;
            if (localVideo && localVideo.srcObject) {
                var tracks = localVideo.srcObject.getVideoTracks();
                liveTrack = tracks.find(function(t) { return t.readyState === 'live'; });
            }

            var getVideo = liveTrack ? Promise.resolve(liveTrack) : W.navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
                video: { deviceId: window.__mscPreferredCamFakeId ? { exact: window.__mscPreferredCamFakeId } : undefined, width: { ideal: 1280 }, height: { ideal: 720 } },
                audio: false
            }).then(function(g) { return g.getVideoTracks()[0]; });

            getVideo.then(function(t) {
                if (!t || t.readyState !== 'live') {
                    __caVideoWatchdog.repairing = false;
                    return resolve(false);
                }
                    return sender.replaceTrack((window.__caFlipState && window.__caFlipState.active && window.mirrorState && window.mirrorState.canvasTrack && window.mirrorState.canvasTrack.readyState === 'live') ? window.mirrorState.canvasTrack : t).then(function() {
                    try { /* t.enabled = false; setTimeout(function(){ t.enabled = true; }, 200); */ } catch(e){}
                    try {
                        var p = sender.getParameters();
                        if (!p.encodings || p.encodings.length === 0) p.encodings = [{}];
                        p.encodings[0].maxBitrate = 2500000;
                        p.encodings[0].maxFramerate = 30;
                        sender.setParameters(p).catch(function(){});
                    } catch(e) {}
                    console.log('%c[CA-VD] ✅ video repaired + FPS forced', 'color:#0f0;font-weight:bold');
                    __caVideoWatchdog.repairing = false;
                    resolve(true);
                });
            }).catch(function(e){
                __caVideoWatchdog.repairing = false;
                resolve(false);
            });
        });
    }

        if (!enc.maxBitrate)             verdict.push('⚠️ maxBitrate auto');
        if (enc.maxBitrate && enc.maxBitrate < 2000000) verdict.push('❌ maxBitrate < 2Mbps');
        if (p.degradationPreference === 'maintain-framerate') verdict.push('❌ degradation=maintain-framerate');
        if (!isCanvas)                   verdict.push('❌ sender bukan canvas (flip tidak aktif di wire)');
    }

    return {
        ok: flipOn ? (verdict.length === 0) : true,
        flipActive: flipOn,
        processing: !!(W.__caFlipState && W.__caFlipState.processing),
        senderIsCanvas: isCanvas,
        canvasLive: !!(mirrorState && mirrorState.canvasTrack && mirrorState.canvasTrack.readyState === 'live'),
        contentHint: ct ? ct.contentHint : null,
        resolution: settings.width && settings.height ? (settings.width + '×' + settings.height) : 'unknown',
        maxBitrate: bitrateKbps === 'auto' ? 'auto' : (bitrateKbps + ' kbps'),
        degradationPreference: p.degradationPreference || 'default',
        frameRate: settings.frameRate || 'unknown',
        pcState: pc.connectionState,
        problems: verdict
    };
};

console.log('[CA-FLIP-FIX] ✅ Loaded — run window.__caFlipDiag() saat flip aktif untuk verifikasi');
})(); // <--- INI HARUSNYA TIDAK MERAH LAGI
(function nativeImageHider() {
    var CONFIG = {
        videoWatermark:   true,
        captionLogo:      true,
        avatarLogo:       true,
        loginPopupLogo:   true,
        footerLogoTop:    true,
        heroImage:        true,
        footerLogoRight:  true,
        copyrightText:    true,
        emojiButton:      'full',
        appButtonsVideo:  true,
        appButtonsAbout:  true,
        aboutVisuals:     true,
        qrPopup:          true,
        socialIcons:      true,
        marketingSection: true,
        shareButtons:     true,
        onlineCounter:    false,
        bottomFooter:     true
    };

    function injectCSS() {
        if (document.getElementById('ca-nuke-css')) return;
        var style = document.createElement('style');
        style.id = 'ca-nuke-css';
        (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(style);
        style.innerHTML = `
            html, body {
                overflow: hidden !important;
                height: 100vh !important;
                background-color: #0f1014 !important;
                background-image: none !important;
            }
            #page-wrap > *:not(.app):not(.roulette):not(script):not(style):not(#my-custom-country-ui) {
                display: none !important;
            }
            header, #header, .header, footer, nav, .footer, #footer, .page-footer { display: none !important; }
            .remote-video__watermark, div[class*="watermark"] {
                display: none !important; visibility: hidden !important; opacity: 0 !important; width: 0 !important; height: 0 !important; pointer-events: none !important;
            }
            .social-buttons, .remote-video__likes, .caption__share, .share__wrapper { display: none !important; }
            #about, main#about, .about-content, [class*="about-top"], [class*="about-bottom"] { display: none !important; }
            .emoji-button { display: none !important; }
            .app, .roulette, .roulette-box {
                height: 100vh !important;
                background-color: transparent !important;
            }
        `;
    }

    function applyHides() {
        var containers = document.querySelectorAll('#page-wrap, header, footer, #about, .app, .roulette');
        containers.forEach(function(container) {
            if (container.getAttribute('data-ca-hidden-checked')) return;
            container.setAttribute('data-ca-hidden-checked', '1');

            container.querySelectorAll('span, p, small, div').forEach(function(el) {
                if (el.id === 'page-wrap' || el.closest('#my-custom-country-ui')) return;
                if (el.getAttribute('data-ca-hidden')) return;
                var txt = (el.textContent || '').trim();
                if (txt.length > 200) return;

                if (txt.includes('About Chat') && txt.includes('Why OmeTV') && el.offsetHeight < 150) {
                    el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
                    el.setAttribute('data-ca-hidden', '1');
                }
                if (txt.includes('Refund') && txt.includes('Contacts') && el.offsetHeight < 150) {
                    el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
                    el.setAttribute('data-ca-hidden', '1');
                }
                if (txt.includes("Bad Kitty's Dad") && el.offsetHeight < 150) {
                    el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
                    el.setAttribute('data-ca-hidden', '1');
                }
                if (/^©\s*\d{4}(?:\s*[-–—]\s*\d{4})?\s*Ome\.TV/i.test(txt) && el.children.length === 0) {
                    el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
                    el.setAttribute('data-ca-hidden', '1');
                }
            });
        });

        var SEL = {
            captionLogo:     ['.caption__logo', '.caption__logo img'],
            avatarLogo:      ['.message-avatar img.logo', '.message-avatar img[alt*="OmeTV"]'],
            loginPopupLogo:  ['.login-popup__item .logo'],
            footerLogoTop:   ['img[alt*="OmeTV free random video chat"]', 'img[alt*="OmeTV"]'],
            heroImage:       ['picture img[alt*="to meet"]', 'picture img[alt*="new"]'],
            footerLogoRight: ['.footer-right img'],
            appButtonsVideo: ['.app-button.googleplay', '.app-button.appstore', '.caption__buttons .app-button'],
            appButtonsAbout: ['#about-bottom-blocks .googleplay-button', '#about-bottom-blocks .appstore-button'],
            aboutVisuals:    ['#about-phone .poster', '#about-phone .frame', '#about-phone .play'],
            qrPopup:         ['#qr-code-popup .qr-code-popup__qr-code', '#qr-code-popup .qr-code-popup__poster'],
            socialIcons:     ['.footer-left .fb', '.footer-left .ig', '.footer-left .yt', '.footer-left .tw', '.footer-left .pi', '.footer-left .tt']
        };

        for (var key in SEL) {
            if (!CONFIG[key]) continue;
            SEL[key].forEach(function(sel) {
                document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(function(el) {
                    if (key === 'loginPopupLogo') {
                        if ((el.textContent || '').trim().length === 0) el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
                        else el.style.setProperty('background-image', 'none', 'important');
                    } else {
                        el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
                    }
                });
            });
        }
    }

    injectCSS();
    applyHides();

    var rafScheduled = false;
    function scheduleApply() {
        if (rafScheduled) return;
        rafScheduled = true;
        requestAnimationFrame(function() {
            rafScheduled = false;
            injectCSS();
            applyHides();
        });
    }

              function startObserver() {
        if (window.__caBodyBus) {
            var __caHidesSched = false;
            window.__caBodyBus.subscribe(function(node) {
                if (!node || node.nodeType !== 1) return;
                // ⭐ Pre-filter: hanya trigger kalau di area yang di-hide
                if (node.closest && !node.closest('#page-wrap, header, footer, #about, .app, .roulette, .caption__logo, .login-popup__item')) {
                    return;
                }
                if (__caHidesSched) return;
                __caHidesSched = true;
                requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                    __caHidesSched = false;
                    scheduleApply();
                });
            });
        }
    }
    startObserver();
})();

    var SNAP_SUBFOLDER = 'OmeTV_Snaps';
    var SNAP_DB_NAME   = 'ca_snap_db';
    var SNAP_STORE     = 'handles';
    var SNAP_KEY       = 'snapRoot';
    var __snapDirMem   = null;

    function snapToast(msg) {
    try {
        var el = document.createElement('div');
        el.textContent = msg;
        var pos = (typeof window.__caToastPos === 'function')
            ? window.__caToastPos()
            : { top: '24px', left: '50%' };
        el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:' + pos.top + ';left:' + pos.left + ';transform:translateX(-50%);' +
            'background:rgba(15,23,42,0.9);color:#fff;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:30px;' +
            'font-family:"Google Sans",Roboto,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;' +
            'z-index:2147483647;box-shadow:0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);' +
            'border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);pointer-events:none;' +
            'transition:opacity 0.25s;';
        document.body.appendChild(el);
        setTimeout(function(){ el.style.opacity = '0'; }, 1600);
        setTimeout(function(){ el.remove(); }, 2000);
    } catch(e) {}
}

    function snapDbOpen() {
        return new Promise(function(res, rej) {
            var req = indexedDB.open(SNAP_DB_NAME, 1);
            req.onupgradeneeded = function() {
                var db = req.result;
                if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(SNAP_STORE)) db.createObjectStore(SNAP_STORE);
            };
            req.onsuccess = function(){ res(req.result); };
            req.onerror   = function(){ rej(req.error); };
        });
    }
    function snapDbGet(key) {
        return snapDbOpen().then(function(db) {
            return new Promise(function(res, rej) {
                var tx = db.transaction(SNAP_STORE, 'readonly');
                var r  = tx.objectStore(SNAP_STORE).get(key);
                r.onsuccess = function(){ res(r.result || null); };
                r.onerror   = function(){ rej(r.error); };
            });
        });
    }
    function snapDbSet(key, val) {
        return snapDbOpen().then(function(db) {
            return new Promise(function(res, rej) {
                var tx = db.transaction(SNAP_STORE, 'readwrite');
                var r  = tx.objectStore(SNAP_STORE).put(val, key);
                r.onsuccess = function(){ res(true); };
                r.onerror   = function(){ rej(r.error); };
            });
        });
    }
    function snapDbDel(key) {
        return snapDbOpen().then(function(db) {
            return new Promise(function(res, rej) {
                var tx = db.transaction(SNAP_STORE, 'readwrite');
                var r  = tx.objectStore(SNAP_STORE).delete(key);
                r.onsuccess = function(){ res(true); };
                r.onerror   = function(){ rej(r.error); };
            });
        });
    }

    async function getSnapDir() {
        if (__snapDirMem) return __snapDirMem;
        if (!window.showDirectoryPicker) return null;

        var root = null;
        try { root = await snapDbGet(SNAP_KEY); } catch(e) {}
        if (!root) {
            try {
                root = await window.showDirectoryPicker({
                    id: 'ca-snap-root',
                    mode: 'readwrite',
                    startIn: 'downloads'
                });
            } catch(e) { return null; }
            try { await snapDbSet(SNAP_KEY, root); } catch(e) {}
        }
        try {
            var perm = await root.queryPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });
            if (perm !== 'granted') perm = await root.requestPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });
            if (perm !== 'granted') return null;
        } catch(e) { return null; }

        try {
            __snapDirMem = await root.getDirectoryHandle(SNAP_SUBFOLDER, { create: true });
            return __snapDirMem;
        } catch(e) { return null; }
    }

    window.__caSnapResetFolder = function() {
        __snapDirMem = null;
        return snapDbDel(SNAP_KEY).then(function() {
            snapToast('📁 Snap folder reset — pick again on next snap');
        });
    };
    function bruteForceDropdown() {
        var btn = document.querySelector('.buttons__gender');
        if (!btn) return;
        var popup = document.querySelector('.gender-selector__popup') || document.querySelector('.gender-selector__dropdown');
        if (!popup) return;
        var computed = window.getComputedStyle(popup);
        if (computed.display === 'none' || computed.visibility === 'hidden' || parseFloat(computed.opacity) < 0.1) return;
        if (popup.parentNode !== document.body) {
            document.body.appendChild(popup);
            popup.classList.add('ca-portal-dropdown');
        }
        var rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
        popup.removeAttribute('style');
        popup.style.setProperty('position', 'fixed', 'important');
        popup.style.setProperty('z-index', '2147483647', 'important');
        popup.style.setProperty('bottom', (window.innerHeight - rect.top + 8) + 'px', 'important');
        popup.style.setProperty('left', rect.left + 'px', 'important');
        popup.style.setProperty('width', rect.width + 'px', 'important');
        popup.style.setProperty('min-width', rect.width + 'px', 'important');
        popup.style.setProperty('max-width', rect.width + 'px', 'important');
        popup.style.setProperty('top', 'auto', 'important');
        popup.style.setProperty('right', 'auto', 'important');
        popup.style.setProperty('transform', 'none', 'important');
        popup.style.setProperty('margin', '0', 'important');
        popup.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
        popup.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
    }

             function enforceCustomTheme() {

            if (parent) {
                if (parent.classList.contains('start-button')) bgStyle = 'linear-gradient(145deg, #10b981, #047857)';
                if (parent.classList.contains('stop-button'))  bgStyle = 'linear-gradient(145deg, #ef4444, #991b1b)';
            } else {
                var text = bg.innerText.trim().toLowerCase();
                if (text.includes('start')) bgStyle = 'linear-gradient(145deg, #10b981, #047857)';
                if (text.includes('stop'))  bgStyle = 'linear-gradient(145deg, #ef4444, #991b1b)';

            bg.style.setProperty('background-image', bgStyle, 'important');

        // ⭐ FIX SUPER RINGAN: Observer khusus untuk container tombol
        //    Instant color on button appearance — NO full-body scan
        var __caBtnObs = null;
        function attachBtnObserver() {
            var btns = document.querySelector('.buttons');
            if (!btns || (__caBtnObs && __caBtnObs.target === btns)) return;
            if (__caBtnObs) { try { __caBtnObs.disconnect(); } catch(e) {} }
            __caBtnObs = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
                // Debounce via rAF — batch semua mutasi jadi 1 call
                if (__caBtnObs.__sched) return;
                __caBtnObs.__sched = true;
                requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                    __caBtnObs.__sched = false;
                    enforceCustomTheme();
                });
            });
            __caBtnObs.observe(btns, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        }
                // ⭐ FIX FOUC: Jalankan instan setelah DOM siap
        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                enforceCustomTheme();
                attachBtnObserver();
            }, { once: true });
        } else {
            enforceCustomTheme();
            attachBtnObserver();
        }
        __caOn2000(attachBtnObserver);
                function processMessageNode(msg) {
        if (msg.hasAttribute('data-ca-dir')) return;
        var bubble = msg.querySelector('.message-bubble');
        var avatar = msg.querySelector('.message-avatar');

        if (msg.classList.contains('message__system') || !bubble) {
            msg.setAttribute('data-ca-dir', 'true');
            return;
        }

        var isSelf = false;

        // 1. Cek Class bawaan Ome.tv (jika ada)
        if (msg.classList.contains('message--self') || msg.classList.contains('message--outgoing')) {
            isSelf = true;
        }
        // 2. LOGIKA REFERENSI: Cek Titik Tengah Container
        else if (avatar) {
            var avatarRect = avatar.getBoundingClientRect();
            var msgRect = msg.getBoundingClientRect();

            // Jika posisi Avatar berada di sebelah KANAN dari titik tengah layar chat,
            // maka pesan tersebut PASTI milik Anda (Self).
            if (avatarRect.left > (msgRect.left + (msgRect.width / 2))) {
                isSelf = true;
            }
        }
        // 3. Fallback
        else if (msg.previousElementSibling && msg.previousElementSibling.classList.contains('ca-msg-self')) {
            isSelf = true;
        }

        if (isSelf) msg.classList.add('ca-msg-self');
        else msg.classList.remove('ca-msg-self');

        msg.setAttribute('data-ca-dir', 'true');
    }
        window.__caBodyBus.subscribe(function (node) {
        if (!node || node.nodeType !== 1) return;
        // ⭐ PATCH: relaxed chat detection
        var inChat = node.closest && (
            node.closest('.chat') ||
            node.closest('[class*="chat"]') ||
            node.closest('[class*="message"]')
        );
        if (!inChat) return;
        if (node.classList && (node.classList.contains('message') ||
                               node.classList.contains('message__system'))) {
            processMessageNode(node);
        } else if (node.querySelectorAll) {
            // ⭐ PATCH: process ALL messages, not just first
            var allMsgs = node.querySelectorAll('.message, .message__system');
            for (var _i = 0; _i < allMsgs.length; _i++) {
                processMessageNode(allMsgs[_i]);
            }
        }
    });

           function injectUI() {

        var rotateButtons = document.getElementById('ca-rotate-buttons');
        if (!rotateButtons) {
            rotateButtons = document.createElement('div');
            rotateButtons.id = 'ca-rotate-buttons';
            remoteWrapper.appendChild(rotateButtons);
        } else if (rotateButtons.parentNode !== remoteWrapper) {
            remoteWrapper.appendChild(rotateButtons);
        }

        var cinemaBtn = document.getElementById('ca-cinema-btn');
        if (!cinemaBtn) {
            cinemaBtn = document.createElement('button');
            cinemaBtn.id = 'ca-cinema-btn';
            cinemaBtn.innerText = 'Cinema';
            cinemaBtn.onclick = function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); toggleCinemaMode(); };
            rotateButtons.appendChild(cinemaBtn);
        } else if (cinemaBtn.parentNode !== rotateButtons) {
            rotateButtons.appendChild(cinemaBtn);
        }

        var zoomBtn = document.getElementById('ca-zoom-btn');
        if (!zoomBtn) {
            zoomBtn = document.createElement('button');
            zoomBtn.id = 'ca-zoom-btn';
            zoomBtn.innerText = 'Zoom';
            zoomBtn.onclick = function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); toggleZoomMode(); };
            rotateButtons.appendChild(zoomBtn);
        } else if (zoomBtn.parentNode !== rotateButtons) {
            rotateButtons.appendChild(zoomBtn);
        }

        var snapBtn = document.getElementById('ca-snap-btn');
        if (!snapBtn) {
            snapBtn = document.createElement('button');
            snapBtn.id = 'ca-snap-btn';
            snapBtn.innerText = 'Snap';
            snapBtn.onclick = function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); takeScreenshot(); };
            rotateButtons.appendChild(snapBtn);
        } else if (snapBtn.parentNode !== rotateButtons) {
            rotateButtons.appendChild(snapBtn);
        }

        setupAutoHide(remoteWrapper);
    }

        function updateCinemaBarHoverState(x, y) {
        var bar = document.querySelector('.ca-custom-cinema-bar');
        if (!bar) { __caBarVisibleState = false; return; }

        // ⭐ FIX: 3-col mode punya wrapper-level hover sendiri (ensure3ColBar).
        //         Jangan biarkan mouse-bus nge-toggle class — cegah race flicker.
        if (document.querySelector('.roulette-box.ca-cinema3-active')) return;

        if (!document.querySelector('.roulette-box.ca-cinema-active')) {
            if (__caBarVisibleState) {
                bar.classList.remove('ca-bar-visible');
                __caBarVisibleState = false;
            }
            return;
        }

        var rw = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
        if (!rw) return;

        var r = rw.getBoundingClientRect();
        var inside = (x >= r.left && x <= r.right && y >= r.top && y <= r.bottom);

        if (!inside) {
            var br = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (br.width > 0 && br.height > 0 &&
                x >= br.left && x <= br.right && y >= br.top && y <= br.bottom) {
                inside = true;
            }
        }

        if (inside !== __caBarVisibleState) {
            __caBarVisibleState = inside;
            if (inside) bar.classList.add('ca-bar-visible');
            else        bar.classList.remove('ca-bar-visible');
        }
    }

        window.__caMouseBus.subscribe(function(x, y) {
        __caLastMouseX = x;
        __caLastMouseY = y;
        updateCinemaBarHoverState(x, y);
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        var bar = document.querySelector('.ca-custom-cinema-bar');
        if (bar) {
            bar.classList.remove('ca-bar-visible');
            __caBarVisibleState = false;
        }
    });

    function removeCustomBar() {

        function toggleCinemaMode() {
        cinemaModeActive = !cinemaModeActive;
        var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        var btn = document.getElementById('ca-cinema-btn');
        if (!box) return;

        // ⭐ FIX BUG #6: refuse if 3-col is active (grid layout conflict)
        if (cinemaModeActive && box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-active')) {
            cinemaModeActive = false;
            try {
                if (window.__ca && window.__ca.showIndicator) {
                    window.__ca.showIndicator('⚠️ Exit Cinema 3-Col first', '#f59e0b');
                } else if (typeof snapToast === 'function') {
                    snapToast('⚠️ Exit Cinema 3-Col first');
                }
            } catch(e) {}
            return;
        }

        if (cinemaModeActive) {
            box.classList.add('ca-cinema-active');
            if (btn) btn.innerText = 'Exit';
            createCustomBar();
        }
        else {
            box.classList.remove('ca-cinema-active');
            if (btn) btn.innerText = 'Cinema';
            removeCustomBar();
        }
    }

        function toggleZoomMode() {
        zoomModeActive = !zoomModeActive;
        var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        var btn = document.getElementById('ca-zoom-btn');
        if (!box) return;

        // ⭐ FIX: Pindahkan deklarasi variabel ke sini (hanya sekali)
        var lv = document.getElementById('local-video');
        var rv = document.getElementById('remote-video');
        var lw = document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper');
        var rw = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');

        // Paksa wadah memotong video saat zoom
        var newOverflow = zoomModeActive ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
        if (lw) lw.style.setProperty('overflow', newOverflow, 'important');
        if (rw) rw.style.setProperty('overflow', newOverflow, 'important');

        if (zoomModeActive) {
            box.classList.add('ca-zoom-active');
            if (btn) btn.innerText = 'Unzoom';

            [lv, rv].forEach(function(v) {
                if (v) {
                    v.style.setProperty('position', 'absolute', 'important');
                    v.style.setProperty('width', '100%', 'important');
                    v.style.setProperty('height', '100%', 'important');
                    v.style.setProperty('object-fit', 'cover', 'important');
                }
            });
        }
        else {
            box.classList.remove('ca-zoom-active');
            if (btn) btn.innerText = 'Zoom';

            [lv, rv].forEach(function(v) {
                if (v) {
                    // ⭐ Cukup hapus style tanpa 'var' baru
                    v.style.removeProperty('position');
                    v.style.removeProperty('width');
                    v.style.removeProperty('height');
                    v.style.removeProperty('object-fit');
                }
            });
        }

        // ⭐ FIX: Paksa update rotasi secara instan agar zoom diterapkan pada video yang dirotasi
        if (window.doApplyRotation) {
            window.doApplyRotation(true);
        }
    }

    async function takeScreenshot() {
        var v       = document.getElementById('remote-video');
        var wrapper = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
        if (!v || v.readyState < 2 || !wrapper) return;
        if (!v.videoWidth || !v.videoHeight) return;

        var dir = null;
        try { dir = await getSnapDir(); } catch(e) { dir = null; }

        var visW = wrapper.clientWidth;
        var visH = wrapper.clientHeight;
        if (visW <= 0 || visH <= 0) return;

        var cs = getComputedStyle(v);
        var objectFit = (cs.objectFit || cs.getPropertyValue('object-fit') || 'cover').toLowerCase();
        if (objectFit !== 'contain') objectFit = 'cover';

        var rotation = 0;
        var zoomScale = 1;
        var ctf = cs.transform;
        if (ctf && ctf !== 'none') {
            var mMatch = ctf.match(/matrix\(([^)]+)\)/);
            if (mMatch) {
                var mp = mMatch[1].split(',').map(function(s){ return parseFloat(s.trim()); });
                if (mp.length >= 4) {
                    var ma = mp[0], mb = mp[1];
                    var deg = Math.round(Math.atan2(mb, ma) * 180 / Math.PI);
                    if (deg < 0) deg += 360;
                    rotation = deg % 360;
                    zoomScale = Math.sqrt(ma*ma + mb*mb);
                    if (Math.abs(zoomScale - 1) < 0.01) zoomScale = 1;
                }
            }
        }

        var vW = v.videoWidth, vH = v.videoHeight;
        var longVis = Math.max(visW, visH);
        var longVid = Math.max(vW, vH);
        var targetLong = Math.max(1920, Math.min(3840, longVid));
        var factor = targetLong / longVis;
        if (factor < 1) factor = 1;
        var canvasW = Math.round(visW * factor);
        var canvasH = Math.round(visH * factor);
        var CAP = 4096;
        if (canvasW > CAP) { canvasH = Math.round(canvasH * CAP / canvasW); canvasW = CAP; }
        if (canvasH > CAP) { canvasW = Math.round(canvasW * CAP / canvasH); canvasH = CAP; }

        var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width  = canvasW;
        canvas.height = canvasH;
        var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        if (objectFit === 'contain') {
            try {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.filter = 'blur(24px) brightness(0.4) saturate(1.2)';
                var bgPad = 0.15;
                drawVideoInto(ctx, v, 'cover',
                    -canvasW * bgPad / 2, -canvasH * bgPad / 2,
                    canvasW * (1 + bgPad), canvasH * (1 + bgPad));
                ctx.restore();
            } catch(e) {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasW, canvasH);
            }
        }

        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(canvasW / 2, canvasH / 2);
        if (rotation) ctx.rotate(rotation * Math.PI / 180);
        if (zoomScale !== 1) ctx.scale(zoomScale, zoomScale);

        var elW = (rotation === 90 || rotation === 270) ? canvasH : canvasW;
        var elH = (rotation === 90 || rotation === 270) ? canvasW : canvasH;
        var elX = -elW / 2;
        var elY = -elH / 2;

        if (objectFit === 'contain') {
            var va = vW / vH, ea = elW / elH;
            var dw, dh, dx, dy;
            if (va > ea) { dw = elW; dh = elW / va; dx = 0;               dy = (elH - dh) / 2; }
            else         { dh = elH; dw = elH * va; dx = (elW - dw) / 2; dy = 0; }
            ctx.drawImage(v, 0, 0, vW, vH, elX + dx, elY + dy, dw, dh);
        } else {
            drawVideoInto(ctx, v, 'cover', elX, elY, elW, elH);
        }
        ctx.restore();

        var filename = 'OmeTV_Snap_' + Date.now() + '.png';
        var blob = await new Promise(function(res) { canvas.toBlob(res, 'image/png'); });
        if (!blob) { snapToast('❌ Snap failed'); return; }

        if (dir) {
            try {
                var fh = await dir.getFileHandle(filename, { create: true });
                var wr = await fh.createWritable();
                await wr.write(blob);
                await wr.close();
                snapToast('📸 Saved → ' + SNAP_SUBFOLDER + '/');
                return;
            } catch(e) {}
        }

        var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        var link = document.createElement('a');
        link.download = filename;
        link.href = url;
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        setTimeout(function() { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); link.remove(); }, 2000);
        snapToast('📸 Downloaded');
    }

    function drawVideoInto(ctx, v, fit, x, y, w, h) {
        var vW = v.videoWidth, vH = v.videoHeight;
        var va = vW / vH, ba = w / h;
        if (fit === 'contain') {
            var dw, dh, dx, dy;
            if (va > ba) { dw = w; dh = w / va; dx = 0;               dy = (h - dh) / 2; }
            else         { dh = h; dw = h * va; dx = (w - dw) / 2;    dy = 0; }
            ctx.drawImage(v, 0, 0, vW, vH, x + dx, y + dy, dw, dh);
        } else {
            var sx, sy, sw, sh;
            if (va > ba) { sh = vH; sw = sh * ba; sx = (vW - sw) / 2; sy = 0; }
            else         { sw = vW; sh = sw / ba; sx = 0;             sy = (vH - sh) / 2; }
            ctx.drawImage(v, sx, sy, sw, sh, x, y, w, h);
        }
    }

    function setupAutoHide(container) {
        container.addEventListener('mousemove', function() {
            container.classList.remove('ca-ui-hidden');
            if (__caUiTimer) clearTimeout(__caUiTimer);
            __caUiTimer = setTimeout(function() { container.classList.add('ca-ui-hidden'); }, 3000);
        });
        container.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
            if (__caUiTimer) clearTimeout(__caUiTimer);
            container.classList.remove('ca-ui-hidden');
        });
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        var tag = document.activeElement ? document.activeElement.tagName : '';
        if (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA') return;
        if (e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || e.metaKey) return;
        var key = e.key.toLowerCase();
        if (key === 'c') { e.preventDefault(); toggleCinemaMode(); }
        if (key === 'z') { e.preventDefault(); toggleZoomMode(); }
        if (key === 's') { e.preventDefault(); takeScreenshot(); }
    });

       var injectAttempts = 0;
    var injectInterval = setInterval(function() {
        injectAttempts++;
        injectUI();
        if (document.getElementById('ca-cinema-btn') || injectAttempts > 30) {
            clearInterval(injectInterval);
        }
    }, 1000);

    console.log('✅ [CA-PATCH V48.10 (V8)] color match + emoji removed + snap subfolder');
})();

// ⭐ CHAT INPUT CLEAR BUTTON (✕)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
(function() {
    'use strict';

    var clearBtn = null;
    var attachedTo = null;

    function syncVisibility() {
        if (!clearBtn || !attachedTo) return;
        var hasText = attachedTo.value && attachedTo.value.length > 0;
        clearBtn.style.display = hasText ? 'flex' : 'none';
    }

    function positionBtn(box, parent, btn) {
        try {
            var pr = parent.getBoundingClientRect();
            var br = box.getBoundingClientRect();
            var rightOffset = Math.max(4, pr.right - br.right + 4);
            var topInParent = (br.top - pr.top) + br.height / 2;
            btn.style.right = rightOffset + 'px';
            btn.style.top = topInParent + 'px';
            btn.style.transform = 'translateY(-50%)';
            var curPad = parseInt(getComputedStyle(box).paddingRight) || 0;
            if (curPad < 32) {
                if (!box.dataset.caOrigPad) box.dataset.caOrigPad = box.style.paddingRight || '';
                box.style.paddingRight = '32px';
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    }

        function attach() {
        // ⭐ PERF FAST-PATH: skip 14 querySelector kalau masih attached & visible
        if (attachedTo && attachedTo.isConnected &&
            clearBtn && clearBtn.parentNode === attachedTo.parentElement &&
            !attachedTo.disabled && !attachedTo.readOnly &&
            (attachedTo.offsetWidth > 0 || attachedTo.offsetHeight > 0)) {
            positionBtn(attachedTo, attachedTo.parentElement, clearBtn);
            syncVisibility();
            return;
        }
        var sels = ['.chat__textarea', '.chat__textfield', '#chat-text',
                    'textarea[placeholder*="message" i]', 'textarea[placeholder*="Write" i]',
                    'textarea[placeholder*="Type" i]', 'input[placeholder*="message" i]',
                    'input[placeholder*="Type" i]', '.chat-input textarea', '.chat-input input',
                    '.message-input textarea', '.message-input input', 'form textarea',
                    'textarea:not([readonly]):not([disabled])'];
                        var box = null;
                for (var i = 0; i < sels.length; i++) {
                    try {
                        var el = document.querySelector(sels[i]);
                        // ⭐ FIX: Ganti offsetParent !== null dengan offsetWidth > 0
                        if (el && el.offsetWidth > 0 && !el.disabled && !el.readOnly) { box = el; break; }
                    } catch(e) {}
                }
        if (!box) {
            if (clearBtn && clearBtn.parentNode) clearBtn.parentNode.removeChild(clearBtn);
            clearBtn = null; attachedTo = null;
            return;
        }

        var parent = box.parentElement;
        if (!parent) return;

        if (attachedTo === box && clearBtn && clearBtn.parentNode === parent) {
            positionBtn(box, parent, clearBtn);
            syncVisibility();
            return;
        }

        if (clearBtn && clearBtn.parentNode) clearBtn.parentNode.removeChild(clearBtn);
        attachedTo = box;

        if (getComputedStyle(parent).position === 'static') {
            parent.style.position = 'relative';
        }

        clearBtn = document.createElement('span');
        clearBtn.id = 'ca-chat-clear-btn';
        clearBtn.textContent = '✕';
        clearBtn.title = 'Clear message';
        clearBtn.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;width:24px;height:24px;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(148,163,184,0.2);border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;color:#e2e8f0;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;z-index:100;transition:background 0.15s,color 0.15s;pointer-events:auto;';
        clearBtn.onmouseenter = function() {
            clearBtn.style.background = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.5)';
            clearBtn.style.color = '#fff';
        };
        clearBtn.onmouseleave = function() {
            clearBtn.style.background = 'rgba(148,163,184,0.2)';
            clearBtn.style.color = '#e2e8f0';
        };
        clearBtn.onclick = function(e) {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
            box.value = '';
            try { box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } catch(err) {}
            try { box.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } catch(err) {}
            syncVisibility();
            try { box.focus(); } catch(err) {}
        };
        parent.appendChild(clearBtn);

        positionBtn(box, parent, clearBtn);

        box.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility);
        box.addEventListener('keyup', syncVisibility);
        syncVisibility();
    }

        __caOn1000(attach);
    setTimeout(attach, 200);

    document.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
        if (attachedTo && e.target === attachedTo) syncVisibility();
    }, true);

    console.log('✅ [CA-CHAT-CLEAR] Chat input clear button active');
})();

// ⭐ NO-SIGNAL ONLINE — IDLE VS SKIP V10
// Muncul HANYA saat Idle (Stop). Hilang saat Skip.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
(function() {
    'use strict';

    var SELECTORS = [
        '.footer__online', '.online-counter', '.online-counter__value',
        '.roulette__online', '[class*="online-count"]', '[class*="onlineCount"]',
        '[class*="users-online"]', '[class*="usersOnline"]',
        '[class*="online-counter"]', '[class*="online"]', '[class*="Online"]'
    ];
    var RX = /online|user|people|viewer|orang|pengguna/i;

    var __src = null;
    var __lastHTML = '';

        var __caCachedNativeOnline = null;
    function findNative() {
        // ⭐ PERF: Kembalikan cache jika elemen masih ada di DOM
        if (__caCachedNativeOnline && __caCachedNativeOnline.isConnected) {
            return __caCachedNativeOnline;
        }
        for (var i = 0; i < SELECTORS.length; i++) {
            var els;
            try { els = document.querySelectorAll(SELECTORS[i]); } catch(e) { continue; }
            for (var j = 0; j < els.length; j++) {
                var el = els[j];
                if (!el || !el.textContent) continue;
                           if (el.closest && (
                el.closest('#ca-ns-online-anchor') ||
                el.closest('#my-custom-country-ui') ||
                el.closest('#ca-floating-box')
            )) continue;
                var t = el.textContent.trim();
                if (!t || t.length > 80) continue;
                if (!RX.test(t)) continue;
                               if (!/\d/.test(t)) continue;
                __caCachedNativeOnline = el; // ⭐ Simpan cache
                return el;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    var COPY_PROPS = [
        'color','font-family','font-size','font-weight','font-style',
        'line-height','letter-spacing','text-shadow','text-decoration',
        'text-transform','text-align','white-space','word-spacing',
        'background','background-color','background-image',
        'background-size','background-position','background-repeat',
        'border','border-top','border-right','border-bottom','border-left',
        'border-color','border-width','border-style','border-radius',
        'padding','padding-top','padding-right','padding-bottom','padding-left',
        'margin','margin-top','margin-right','margin-bottom','margin-left',
        'box-shadow','filter','vertical-align','display','align-items',
        'justify-content','gap','flex-direction','flex-wrap','flex-shrink','flex-grow'
    ];

    function copyStyles(src, dst, isRoot) {
        var cs;
        try { cs = getComputedStyle(src); } catch(e) { return; }
        for (var i = 0; i < COPY_PROPS.length; i++) {
            var p = COPY_PROPS[i];
            var v = cs.getPropertyValue(p);
            if (!v) continue;
            if (p === 'display' && v === 'none') continue;
            dst.style.setProperty(p, v, 'important');
        }
        dst.style.setProperty('position', 'static', 'important');
        dst.style.removeProperty('top');
        dst.style.removeProperty('left');
        dst.style.removeProperty('right');
        dst.style.removeProperty('bottom');
        dst.style.removeProperty('transform', 'important');
        dst.style.setProperty('visibility', 'visible', 'important');
        dst.style.setProperty('opacity', '1', 'important');
        dst.style.removeProperty('pointer-events');

        if (isRoot) {
            dst.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            dst.style.setProperty('align-items', 'center', 'important');
            dst.style.setProperty('justify-content', 'center', 'important');
            dst.style.setProperty('width', 'auto', 'important');
            dst.style.setProperty('margin', '0', 'important');
            dst.style.setProperty('padding', '0', 'important');
            dst.style.setProperty('text-align', 'center', 'important');
        }
    }

    function cloneDeep(src) {
        var clone = src.cloneNode(true);
        try { clone.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(function(s){ s.remove(); }); } catch(e) {}
        var a = [src].concat(Array.prototype.slice.call(src.querySelectorAll('*')));
        var b = [clone].concat(Array.prototype.slice.call(clone.querySelectorAll('*')));
        var n = Math.min(a.length, b.length);
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) copyStyles(a[i], b[i], i === 0);
        return clone;
    }

    function ensureAnchor() {
        // Target di dalam container No-Signal agar ikut pudar saat partner masuk
        var target = document.getElementById('ca-custom-ns-container');
        if (!target) target = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
        if (!target) return null;

        var a = document.getElementById('ca-ns-online-anchor');
        if (!a) {
            a = document.createElement('div');
            a.id = 'ca-ns-online-anchor';
            // Posisi absolute di tengah
            a.style.cssText = [
                'position: absolute',
                'top: 0', 'left: 0', 'width: 100%', 'height: 100%',
                'pointer-events: none',
                'z-index: 100',
                'display: flex',
                'align-items: center',
                'justify-content: center'
            ].join(';') + ';';
        }

        if (a.parentNode !== target) target.appendChild(a);
        return a;
    }

    // Fungsi untuk cek apakah kita sedang IDLE (Stop) atau SKIP (Start/Searching)
    function isIdleState() {
        // 1. Cek dari state script utama (Paling Akurat)
        if (window.__ca && window.__ca.state) {
            // userStopped = true HANYA saat kondisi Stop. Saat Start/Skip nilainya false.
            return window.__ca.state.userStopped;
        }

        // 2. Fallback: Cek teks tombol
        var startBtn = document.querySelector('.buttons__button.start-button');
        if (startBtn) {
            var txt = (startBtn.innerText || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            // Jika teks tombolnya "start" (bukan "next"/"stop"/"searching"), berarti Idle
            if (txt === 'start') return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function refresh() {
        var anchor = ensureAnchor();
        if (!anchor) return;

        // Cek Idle atau Skip
        if (!isIdleState()) {
            // Jika sedang Skip/Searching, sembunyikan total
            anchor.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
            return;
        } else {
            // Jika sedang Idle/Stop, tampilkan
            anchor.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
        }

        var src = findNative();
        if (!src) {
            if (!__src) anchor.innerHTML = '';
            return;
        }
        __src = src;

        var sig = src.innerHTML + '|' + getComputedStyle(src).color;
        if (sig === __lastHTML && anchor.firstChild) return;
        __lastHTML = sig;

        try {
            var clone = cloneDeep(src);
            anchor.innerHTML = '';
            anchor.appendChild(clone);
        } catch(e) {
            anchor.textContent = src.textContent.trim();
        }
    }

    // ═══ REACTIVE REFRESH — event-driven, bukan polling 100ms ═══
    function attachNoSignalReactive() {
        // 1. Chat container: status "searching / connection established" berubah
        var chatRoot = document.querySelector('.chat__messages, .chat__body');
        if (chatRoot && !chatRoot.__caNsReactAttached) {
            chatRoot.__caNsReactAttached = true;
            new MutationObserver(function() {
                if (window.__caNsRefreshRAF) return;
                window.__caNsRefreshRAF = requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                    window.__caNsRefreshRAF = 0;
                    try { refresh(); } catch(e) {}
                });
            }).observe(chatRoot, {
                childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true
            });
        }

        // 2. Start/Stop button = state.userStopped flip
        document.querySelectorAll(
            '.buttons__button.start-button, .buttons__button.stop-button'
        ).forEach(function(btn) {
            if (btn.__caNsReactClick) return;
            btn.__caNsReactClick = true;
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                setTimeout(refresh, 50);
                setTimeout(refresh, 250);
            }, true);
        });
    }

    attachNoSignalReactive();

    // Safety net — cegah macet kalau observer terlewat.
    // 2000ms (bukan 100ms) = 20x lebih ringan dari sebelumnya.
                __caOn5000(function() {
        attachNoSignalReactive();
        refresh();
    });
        // Re-attach via shared bus (was: separate MutationObserver)
    if (window.__caBodyBus) {
        window.__caBodyBus.subscribe(function(n) {
            if (n.id === 'ca-custom-ns-container' ||
                n.id === 'remote-video-wrapper' ||
                (n.querySelector && n.querySelector('#ca-custom-ns-container'))) {
                __lastHTML = '';
                refresh();
            }
        });
    }

    console.log('✅ [CA-NS-ONLINE-V11] Counter reactive (event-driven + safety net 2s)');
})();

        function ensureOverlay() {

            if (overlay.parentNode !== document.body) {

        return overlay;

               function classifyText(el) {
        if (!el || !el.textContent) return null;
        var t = el.textContent.toLowerCase();
        if (t.indexOf('connection established') !== -1) return 'connected';
        if (t.indexOf('searching for')         !== -1) return 'searching';
        return null;
    }

    function extractCountryCode(foundEl, fullText) {
        // Strategy 1: [data-tr] in element
        var trEl = foundEl.querySelector('[data-tr]');
        if (trEl) {
            var code = (trEl.getAttribute('data-tr') || '').toLowerCase();
            if (/^[a-z]{2}$/.test(code)) return { code: code, src: 'data-tr' };
        }

        // Strategy 2: img with flagcdn URL
        var imgs = foundEl.querySelectorAll('img');
        for (var i = 0; i < imgs.length; i++) {
            var mm = (imgs[i].src || '').match(/flagcdn\.com\/[^\/]+\/([a-z]{2})\.png/i);
            if (mm && mm[1]) return { code: mm[1].toLowerCase(), src: 'img-flagcdn' };
        }

        // Strategy 3: class with flag/tr-country + 2-letter code
        var flagCls = foundEl.querySelector('[class*="flag"], [class*="tr-country"], [class*="country-code"]');
        if (flagCls) {
            var cls = (flagCls.className || '').toString();
            var mm2 = cls.match(/[-_]([a-z]{2})(?:\s|$|-)/i);
            if (mm2 && mm2[1]) return { code: mm2[1].toLowerCase(), src: 'class-attr' };
            var txt = (flagCls.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            if (/^[a-z]{2}$/.test(txt)) return { code: txt, src: 'class-text' };
        }

        // Strategy 4: Check parent element
        if (foundEl.parentElement) {
            var pTr = foundEl.parentElement.querySelector('[data-tr]');
            if (pTr) {
                var pc = (pTr.getAttribute('data-tr') || '').toLowerCase();
                if (/^[a-z]{2}$/.test(pc)) return { code: pc, src: 'parent-data-tr' };
            }
        }

       // Strategy 5: state.lastDetectedCountry from main script
try {
    var caState = __caStatusGetCaState();
    if (caState && caState.lastDetectedCountry) {
        var lc = String(caState.lastDetectedCountry).toLowerCase();
        if (/^[a-z]{2}$/.test(lc)) return { code: lc, src: 'main-script-state' };
    }
} catch(e) {}

        // Strategy 6: Text-to-code mapping
        var nameMap = {
            'indonesia':'id','germany':'de','united states':'us','usa':'us','america':'us',
            'united kingdom':'gb','uk':'gb','britain':'gb','england':'gb','france':'fr',

            'sweden':'se','norway':'no','denmark':'dk','finland':'fi','iceland':'is',

        };
        var lower = fullText.toLowerCase();
        for (var name in nameMap) {

    function buildFullClone(foundEl) {
        var bubble = foundEl.querySelector('.message-bubble') || foundEl;

        var fullText = bubble.textContent.replace(/Report(?: abuse)?\.?/gi, '').trim();
        fullText = fullText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

        var isConnected = fullText.toLowerCase().indexOf('connection established') !== -1;

        var line1 = '';
        var line3 = '';

        if (isConnected) {
            line1 = 'Connection established';
            line3 = fullText.replace(/connection established/i, '').trim();
            // ⭐ FIX: Bersihkan emoji bendera dan titik berlebih
            line3 = line3.replace(/[\u{1F1E6}-\u{1F1FF}]/gu, '').replace(/\.+\s*$/, '').trim();

            // ⭐ FIX: Fallback nama negara dari state jika teks kosong atau hanya kode 2 huruf
            var caState = __caStatusGetCaState();
            if ((!line3 || line3.length <= 2) && caState && caState.lastDetectedCountry) {
                var rawCode = caState.lastDetectedCountry.toUpperCase();
                var fullName = rawCode;
                try {
                    // Gunakan Intl API untuk konversi kode (US) ke nama (United States)
                    fullName = new Intl.DisplayNames(['en'], { type: 'region' }).of(rawCode) || rawCode;
                } catch(e) {}
                line3 = fullName;
            } // <--- INI KURUNG PENUTUP YANG HILANG
        } else { // <--- INI BLOK ELSE YANG HILANG
            line1 = fullText;
        } // <--- INI KURUNG PENUTUP IF(CONNECTED) YANG HILANG

        var extraction = isConnected ? extractCountryCode(foundEl, fullText) : { code: null, src: 'skip' };
        var isCustomDetection = false;
        var __ipInfoForBubble = null; // ⭐ TAMBAHAN: Penampung data IP untuk Dual Flag

                        if (isConnected && extraction.code) {
            try {
                var caState = __caStatusGetCaState();
                var ipInfo = caState ? caState.currentIPInfo : null;

                // ⭐ FIX: Relay yang mencurigakan (Suspicious Relay) harus tetap dicek VPN-nya
                var isRelaySuspicious = ipInfo && ipInfo.isRelay && (
                    (ipInfo.relayAnalysis && ipInfo.relayAnalysis.isSuspiciousRelay) ||
                    ipInfo.advVpnLevel === 'high' ||
                    ipInfo.advVpnLevel === 'medium'
                );

                // Hapus syarat !ipInfo.isRelay. Ganti dengan logika: Bukan Relay ATAU Relay yang mencurigakan
                if (ipInfo && (!ipInfo.isRelay || isRelaySuspicious)) {
                    if (!ipInfo.advVpnLevel) ipInfo.advVpnLevel = 'clean'; // Fallback jika belum terisi

                    var ipCodeLc = String(ipInfo.code || '').toLowerCase();
                    var domCodeLc = extraction.code.toLowerCase();

                    var isCountryMismatch = (ipCodeLc !== '' && ipCodeLc !== domCodeLc);
                    var isWebRtcVpn = (
                        ipInfo.ispType === 'vpn' ||
                        ipInfo.ispType === 'datacenter' ||
                        ipInfo.advVpnLevel === 'high' ||
                        ipInfo.advVpnLevel === 'medium' ||
                        isRelaySuspicious
                    );

                    // ⭐ FIX: Deteksi jika ada mismatch ATAU jika ASN-nya VPN (meski negara sama)
                    if (isCountryMismatch || isWebRtcVpn) {
                        isCustomDetection = true;

                        // Hanya tampilkan 2 bendera jika IP-nya punya kode negara (bukan relay unknown)
                        if (isCountryMismatch && ipInfo.code) {
                            __ipInfoForBubble = ipInfo;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch(e) {
                // Silent — normal flow TIDAK boleh rusak karena error disini
                try { console.warn('[CA-STATUS] swap check error:', e); } catch(_) {}
            }
        }
        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        if (isConnected) {
            console.log('[CA-STATUS] Country extract → code=' + extraction.code +
                        ' | src=' + extraction.src +
                        ' | custom=' + isCustomDetection +
                        ' | text=' + line3);
        }

        var flagEl = null;
        if (extraction.code) {
            flagEl = document.createElement('img');
            flagEl.src = 'https://flagcdn.com/w80/' + extraction.code + '.png';
            flagEl.srcset = 'https://flagcdn.com/w160/' + extraction.code + '.png 2x, https://flagcdn.com/w320/' + extraction.code + '.png 3x';
            flagEl.onerror = function() {
                console.error('[CA-STATUS] Flag load failed for code: ' + extraction.code);
            };
        }

        var container = document.createElement('div');
        container.className = 'message-bubble';

        // ⭐ Tentukan Tema Warna (Merah untuk 1 Bendera, Kuning untuk 2 Bendera)
        var isYellowTheme = !!(isCustomDetection && __ipInfoForBubble);
        var themeColor = isYellowTheme ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444';

        if (isCustomDetection) {
            if (isYellowTheme) {
                container.classList.add('ca-yellow-bubble');
            } else {
                container.classList.add('ca-vpn-bubble');
            }
        }

        // ⭐ 1. Line 1 (Connection Established)
        if (line1) {
            var el1 = document.createElement('div');
            el1.className = 'ca-status-line1';
            el1.textContent = line1;
            if (isCustomDetection) {
                el1.style.setProperty('color', themeColor, 'important'); // Pakai warna tema
                el1.style.setProperty('font-size', '12px', 'important');
            }
            container.appendChild(el1);
        }

        try {
            if (isCustomDetection && __ipInfoForBubble) {
                // ⭐ UI 1: Beda Negara (Tema Kuning) - Layout Vertikal Anti-Berantakan
                var elCustom = document.createElement('div');
                elCustom.className = 'ca-status-flag';
                elCustom.style.display = 'flex';
                elCustom.style.flexDirection = 'column';
                elCustom.style.alignItems = 'center';
                elCustom.style.gap = '6px'; // Jarak antar baris
                elCustom.style.padding = '10px 0';
                elCustom.style.width = '100%';

                // 1. Badge & Teks Header
                var badge = document.createElement('div');
                badge.className = 'ca-custom-badge';
                badge.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#f59e0b !important; font-size:12px; font-weight:900;">VPN Detected</span><br><span style="color:#f59e0b !important; font-size:10px; font-weight:500; opacity:0.9;">Could be between</span>';
                badge.style.textAlign = 'center';
                badge.style.lineHeight = '1.3';
                badge.style.marginBottom = '4px'; // Jarak tambahan sebelum bendera
                elCustom.appendChild(badge);

                // 2. Bendera Pertama (Ome.tv)
                var f1 = document.createElement('img');
                f1.src = 'https://flagcdn.com/w80/' + extraction.code.toLowerCase() + '.png';
                f1.style.width = '36px'; f1.style.height = '24px'; f1.style.borderRadius = '4px'; f1.style.boxShadow = '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
                elCustom.appendChild(f1);

                // 3. Nama Negara Pertama
                var leftName = extraction.code.toUpperCase();
                try { leftName = new Intl.DisplayNames(['en'], { type: 'region' }).of(leftName) || leftName; } catch(e) {}
                var nameLeft = document.createElement('span');
                nameLeft.innerText = leftName;
                nameLeft.style.setProperty('color', '#f59e0b', 'important');
                nameLeft.style.fontSize = '11px';
                nameLeft.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
                nameLeft.style.textAlign = 'center';
                elCustom.appendChild(nameLeft);

                // 4. Teks "or"
                var orText = document.createElement('span');
                orText.textContent = 'or';
                orText.style.fontSize = '11px';
                orText.style.fontWeight = '900';
                orText.style.setProperty('color', '#f59e0b', 'important');
                orText.style.margin = '2px 0'; // Sedikit jarak ekstra atas/bawah
                elCustom.appendChild(orText);

                // 5. Bendera Kedua (WebRTC)
                var f2 = document.createElement('img');
                f2.src = 'https://flagcdn.com/w80/' + __ipInfoForBubble.code.toLowerCase() + '.png';
                f2.style.width = '36px'; f2.style.height = '24px'; f2.style.borderRadius = '4px'; f2.style.boxShadow = '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
                elCustom.appendChild(f2);

                // 6. Nama Negara Kedua
                var rightName = __ipInfoForBubble.code.toUpperCase();
                try { rightName = new Intl.DisplayNames(['en'], { type: 'region' }).of(rightName) || rightName; } catch(e) {}
                var nameRight = document.createElement('span');
                nameRight.innerText = rightName;
                nameRight.style.setProperty('color', '#f59e0b', 'important');
                nameRight.style.fontSize = '11px';
                nameRight.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
                nameRight.style.textAlign = 'center';
                elCustom.appendChild(nameRight);

                // Masukkan ke container utama
                container.appendChild(elCustom);

            } else if (isCustomDetection && !__ipInfoForBubble) {
                // ⭐ UI 2: Negara Sama tapi VPN (Tema Merah)
                var elCustomVpn = document.createElement('div');
                elCustomVpn.className = 'ca-status-flag';
                elCustomVpn.style.display = 'flex';
                elCustomVpn.style.flexDirection = 'column';

                badgeVpn.style.marginBottom = '2px';

                if (flagEl) {
                    flagEl.style.marginBottom = '4px';
                    elCustomVpn.appendChild(flagEl);
                }

                var nameRowVpn = document.createElement('div');
                nameRowVpn.style.fontSize = '12px';
                nameRowVpn.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
                nameRowVpn.style.setProperty('color', '#ef4444', 'important');
                nameRowVpn.style.display = 'flex';
                nameRowVpn.style.flexDirection = 'row';
                nameRowVpn.style.alignItems = 'center';
