            console.error('[CA-STATUS] UI Build Error:', err);
        }

        if (isConnected && line3 && !isCustomDetection) {
            var el3 = document.createElement('div');
            el3.className = 'ca-status-line3';
            el3.textContent = line3;
            container.appendChild(el3);
        }

        return container;
    }

function renderFull(ov, foundEl) {
    var tmp;
    try {
        tmp = buildFullClone(foundEl);
    } catch(e) {
        console.error('[CA-STATUS] renderFull failed:', e);
        ov.innerHTML = '';
        try { foundEl.classList.remove('ca-native-hidden'); } catch(_) {}
        return;
    }
    if (!tmp) { ov.innerHTML = ''; return; }

    // ⭐ FIX: Signature Guard untuk Status Bubble
    var newSig = tmp.innerHTML;
    if (ov.getAttribute('data-ca-sig') === newSig && ov.children.length > 0) {
        return; // Konten sama, skip render ulang
    }
    ov.setAttribute('data-ca-sig', newSig);

    ov.innerHTML = '';
    ov.appendChild(tmp);
}

    function updateHoverZone(x, y) {
        // ⭐ FIX: Dinonaktifkan agar sifatnya statis seperti chat box (tidak hilang saat mouse bergerak)
        return;
    }

        window.__caMouseBus.subscribe(function (x, y) {
        mouseX = x;
        mouseY = y;
        updateHoverZone(x, y);
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
        hoverZone = false;
        if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('ca-hover');
    });

    window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
        if (mouseX >= 0) updateHoverZone(mouseX, mouseY);
    }, true);
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
        if (mouseX >= 0) updateHoverZone(mouseX, mouseY);
    });

function syncStatus() {
    try {
        var ov = ensureOverlay();
        if (!ov) return;

        // ⭐ FIX ANTI-NYANGKUT SAAT RELOAD (F5)
        // 1. Jangan tampilkan apa-apa jika halaman masih dalam mode booting
        if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-booting') ||
            document.documentElement.classList.contains('ca-normal-booting')) {
            ov.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
            return;
        }

        // 2. Jangan tampilkan apa-apa jika kontainer chat utama belum dirender oleh React
        // atau jika spinner loading bawaan situs masih terlihat
        var chatContainer = document.querySelector('.chat, .chat__body, .chat__messages');
        var nativeSpinner = document.querySelector('.spinner, .preloader, .loading, [class*="spinner"]');

        if (!chatContainer || (nativeSpinner && nativeSpinner.offsetWidth > 0)) {
            ov.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
            return;
        }

        var btn = document.querySelector('.buttons__button.start-button');
        var btnTxt = btn ? (btn.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase() : '';

        // Collect native DOM
        var msgs = document.querySelectorAll('.message.system, .message__system, .message, .connection-established-message');
        var foundConnected = null;
        var foundSearching = null;
        for (var i = 0; i < msgs.length; i++) {
            var t = classifyText(msgs[i]);
            if (!t) continue;
            msgs[i].classList.add('ca-native-hidden');
            if (t === 'connected' && !foundConnected) foundConnected = msgs[i];
            if (t === 'searching' && !foundSearching) foundSearching = msgs[i];
        }

        // ⭐ KUNCI FIX: BOTH present → DOM order determines NEWER (higher index = newer)
        //   Karena React append ke DOM, elemen yang muncul belakangan = lebih baru
        if (foundConnected && foundSearching) {
            var cIdx = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(msgs, foundConnected);
            var sIdx = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(msgs, foundSearching);
            if (sIdx > cIdx) {
                // Searching newer → user baru klik Next → TAMPILKAN SEARCHING
                ov.classList.remove('ca-state-connected');
                ov.classList.add('ca-state-searching');
                ov.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
                renderFull(ov, foundSearching);
            } else {
                // Connected newer → partner baru masuk → TAMPILKAN CONNECTED
                ov.classList.remove('ca-state-searching');
                ov.classList.add('ca-state-connected');
                ov.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
                renderFull(ov, foundConnected);
            }
            return;
        }

        // ⭐ Hanya connected (tidak ada searching)
        if (foundConnected) {
            ov.classList.remove('ca-state-searching');
            ov.classList.add('ca-state-connected');
            ov.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            renderFull(ov, foundConnected);
            return;
        }

        // ⭐ Hanya searching
        if (foundSearching) {
            ov.classList.remove('ca-state-connected');
            ov.classList.add('ca-state-searching');
            ov.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            renderFull(ov, foundSearching);
            return;
        }

        // ⭐ Native empty + button "start" → idle → hide
        if (btnTxt === 'start') {
            ov.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
            ov.classList.remove('ca-hover-mode', 'ca-hover', 'ca-state-searching', 'ca-state-connected');
            return;
        }

        // ⭐ Native empty + button active → transisi React → show placeholder
        ov.classList.remove('ca-state-connected');
        ov.classList.add('ca-state-searching');
        ov.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
        ov.innerHTML = '<div class="message-bubble"><div class="ca-status-line1">Searching for partner...</div></div>';
    } catch(e) {
        try { console.error('[CA-STATUS] syncStatus:', e); } catch(_) {}
    }
}
    function isRelevantNode(node) {
        if (!node || node.nodeType !== 1) return false;
        if (node.id === OVERLAY_ID) return false;
        if (node.closest && node.closest('#' + OVERLAY_ID)) return false;
        if (node.matches && node.matches('.message, .message__system')) return true;
        if (node.closest  && node.closest('.message, .message__system')) return true;
        if (node.querySelector &&
            node.querySelector('.message, .message__system')) return true;
        return false;
    }

                // ═══ STATUS VIA BODY BUS — observer lokal dihapus ═══
    // ⭐ FIX #23: hapus __caStatusRoot — dead code
    function reattachStatusObserver() {
        // no-op — kompatibilitas panggilan lama
    }

    window.__caBodyBus.subscribe(function (node) {
        if (!node || node.nodeType !== 1) return;
        if (node.id === OVERLAY_ID) return;
        if (node.closest && node.closest('#' + OVERLAY_ID)) return;
        var isStatus =
            (node.matches && node.matches('.message, .message__system')) ||
            (node.closest && node.closest('.message, .message__system')) ||
            (node.querySelector && node.querySelector('.message, .message__system'));
               if (isStatus) syncStatus();
    });

            // ⭐ FIX: Segera update bubble saat IP/VPN terdeteksi (Anti Race-Condition)
    window.addEventListener('ca-ip-ready', function() {
        setTimeout(syncStatus, 100); // Delay 100ms agar data state.currentIPInfo benar-benar final
    });

    // ⭐ NEW: VPN state updated (Fase3, rDNS, relay, Tor, IPv6, Kitsune) — INSTANT SYNC
    //    Anti-loop: dedicated event, tidak memicu onIPReady/Fase3/analyzeRelayIP
    //    Langsung render tanpa delay agar sinkron 100% dengan Floating Box
    (function () {
        window.addEventListener('ca-vpn-updated', function (e) {
            var detail = e.detail || {};

            var caState = null;
            try {
                var W = typeof unsafeWindow !== 'undefined' ? unsafeWindow : window;
                if (W.__ca && W.__ca.state) caState = W.__ca.state;
            } catch (err) {}

            // Partner berubah saat event pending → skip (partner baru akan render sendiri)
            if (caState && detail.ip && caState.currentIP !== detail.ip) {
                return;
            }

            // Force re-render: hapus signature guard agar renderFull tidak skip
            var ov = document.getElementById('ca-global-status');
            if (ov) {
                ov.removeAttribute('data-ca-sig');
                syncStatus();
                console.log('%c[CA-STATUS-VPN] ⚡ Instant Status Sync (' + (detail.reason || '?') + ')',
                            'color:#10b981;font-weight:bold');
            }
        });
    })();

    syncStatus();

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        var s = document.getElementById(STYLE_ID);
        if (s && document.head && !document.head.contains(s)) {
            document.head.appendChild(s);
        }
        syncStatus();
    }, { once: true });

                                window.addEventListener('load', syncStatus, { once: true });

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ⭐ FIX: Refresh status instan saat user klik Start/Stop/Next
    //    Supaya placeholder "Searching..." muncul tanpa delay 2s
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
        var btn = e.target.closest(
            '.buttons__button.start-button, .buttons__button.stop-button'
        );
        if (!btn) return;
        setTimeout(function () { try { syncStatus(); } catch (_) {} }, 50);
        setTimeout(function () { try { syncStatus(); } catch (_) {} }, 350);
    }, true);

// ⭐ Throttled safety net — 5s, bukan 2s (kurangi noise)
__caOn5000(syncStatus);

    var stopBtn = document.querySelector('.buttons__button.stop-button');

    var ov = document.getElementById('ca-global-status');
    var s = unsafeWindow.__ca && unsafeWindow.__ca.state;

    return {
        button_start: btn ? { text: (btn.textContent||'').trim(), disabled: btn.classList.contains('disabled') } : null,
        button_stop: stopBtn ? { text: (stopBtn.textContent||'').trim() } : null,
        state: s ? { userStopped: s.userStopped, partnerConnected: s.partnerConnected, lastDetectedCountry: s.lastDetectedCountry } : null,
        native_messages: Array.from(msgs).map(function(m) {

        }),
        overlay: ov ? {
            display: getComputedStyle(ov).display,
            classes: ov.className,
            text: (ov.textContent||'').substring(0, 80)
        } : null
    };
};
console.log('[CA-STATUS] Diagnostic ready: window.__caStatusDiag()');
})();

    function injectContainer(wrapper) {
        if (!wrapper) return null;
        var existing = document.getElementById(CONFIG.idContainer);
        if (existing) return existing;

        var container = document.createElement('div');
        container.id = CONFIG.idContainer;
        container.innerHTML = [
            '<div class="ca-gp-wrap">',
            '  <div class="ca-gp-l1"></div>',
            '  <div class="ca-gp-l2"></div>',
            '  <div class="ca-gp-l3"></div>',
            '  <div class="ca-gp-l4"></div>',
            '  <div class="ca-gp-l5"></div>',
            '</div>'
        ].join('');

        wrapper.appendChild(container);
        wrapper.style.setProperty('background', 'transparent', 'important');
        return container;
    }

    if (!window.__caNsObserver) {
        window.__caNsObserver = window.__caBodyBus.subscribe(function (n) {
            if (n.tagName === 'VIDEO' && n.id !== 'remote-video' &&
                !n.closest('#' + CONFIG.idContainer)) {
                n.remove();
            }
            if (n.id === 'remote-video-wrapper' || (n.querySelector && n.querySelector('#remote-video-wrapper'))) {
                var wrapper = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
                if (wrapper) {
                    var c = injectContainer(wrapper);
                    if (c) c.classList.remove('ca-ns-hidden');
                    attachNsSyncObserver(wrapper); // ⬅️ TAMBAHAN BARU
                }
            }
        });
        if (document.body) {
            var wrapper = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
            if (wrapper) {
                injectContainer(wrapper);
                attachNsSyncObserver(wrapper); // ⬅️ TAMBAHAN BARU
            }
        }
        if (!document.getElementById(CONFIG.idSvgDefs)) injectSVGDefs();
    }

    // ⭐ TAMBAHKAN FUNGSI BARU DI BAWAH BLOK DI ATAS
    var __caNsSyncObs = null;
    function attachNsSyncObserver(wrapper) {
        if (!wrapper) return;
        if (__caNsSyncObs && __caNsSyncObs._w === wrapper) return;
        if (__caNsSyncObs) { try { __caNsSyncObs.disconnect(); } catch(e) {} }

        __caNsSyncObs = new MutationObserver(function() {
            // Microtask — sinkron, PASTI sebelum browser paint
            var w = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
            if (!w) return;
            if (!w.querySelector('#' + CONFIG.idContainer)) {
                var c = injectContainer(w);
                if (c) c.classList.remove('ca-ns-hidden');
            }
        });
        __caNsSyncObs._w = wrapper;
        __caNsSyncObs.observe(wrapper, { childList: true });
    }
    window.__caAttachNsSyncObserver = attachNsSyncObserver;

    window.__caForceNoSignalShow = function() {
        var wrapper = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
        if (!wrapper) return;
        var c = document.getElementById(CONFIG.idContainer);
        if (!c) {
            c = injectContainer(wrapper);
        }
        if (c) {
            c.classList.remove('ca-ns-hidden');
            void c.offsetWidth; // Paksa browser paint saat itu juga
        }
    };

    var prevCT         = -1;
    var frozenSince    = 0;
    var lastReparentAt = 0;

            function isPartnerActive(remoteVideo) {
            if (!remoteVideo || !remoteVideo.srcObject || !remoteVideo.srcObject.active) {
                prevCT = -1; frozenSince = 0;
                return false;
            }
            var tracks = remoteVideo.srcObject.getVideoTracks();
            var hasLive = false;
            for (var i = 0; i < tracks.length; i++) {
                if (tracks[i].readyState === 'live') { hasLive = true; break; }
            }
            if (!hasLive || remoteVideo.videoWidth <= 0 || remoteVideo.readyState < 2) {
                prevCT = -1; frozenSince = 0;
                return false;
            }

            // ⭐ FIX: Jangan biarkan Neural Pulse berkedip karena WebRTC stuttering.
            // Jika PC terhubung, abaikan pengecekan currentTime.
            var pc = window.__caLastRTC;
            if (pc && (pc.connectionState === 'connected' || pc.connectionState === 'connecting')) {
                return true;
            }

            var ct = remoteVideo.currentTime;
            if (ct !== prevCT) {
                prevCT = ct;
                frozenSince = 0;
                return true;
            }
            if (!frozenSince) frozenSince = Date.now();
            return (Date.now() - frozenSince) < CONFIG.freezeThresholdMs;
        }

    function hasVisibleSnapshot(wrapper) {
    // ✅ FIX: HANYA cek element dengan class eksplisit preview/snapshot
    // JANGAN cek semua <img> — native TV animation sering pakai <img>/poster!
    var previews = wrapper.querySelectorAll(
        '[class*="preview"], [class*="snapshot"], [class*="last-frame"], [class*="lastframe"]'
    );
    for (var j = 0; j < previews.length; j++) {
        if (previews[j].offsetWidth > 0 &&
            getComputedStyle(previews[j]).opacity > 0) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

    function ensureHelperButtons() {
        var rotateButtons = document.getElementById('ca-rotate-buttons');
        if (!rotateButtons) return;

        if (!document.getElementById('ca-cinema-btn')) {
            var cBtn = document.createElement('button');
            cBtn.id = 'ca-cinema-btn'; cBtn.innerText = 'Cinema';
            cBtn.onclick = function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'c' })); };
            rotateButtons.appendChild(cBtn);
        }
        if (!document.getElementById('ca-zoom-btn')) {
            var zBtn = document.createElement('button');
            zBtn.id = 'ca-zoom-btn'; zBtn.innerText = 'Zoom';

    function enforceGridStructureInner() {
        if (localStorage.getItem(MODE_KEY) !== '1') return;
        var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box.ca-cinema3-active');
        if (!box) return;

                // ⭐ TAMBAHAN: Cegah eksekusi JS Math jika V25 aktif,
        // tapi tetap pertahankan display:contents agar React tidak merusak struktur
        if (window.__caLogicV25) {
            ['remote-video-wrapper', 'local-video-wrapper'].forEach(function(id) {
                var el = box.querySelector('#' + id) || document.getElementById(id);
                if (!el) return;

                // ⭐ FIX MENTAL-ON-RELOAD: guard terhadap transient React detach.
                // Tanpa guard ini, walk-up bisa menyentuh <body>/<html> dan men-set
                // display:contents → layout collapse → video lokal tampak "mental".
                // Pola ini IDENTIK dengan legacy branch (yang sudah terbukti aman).
                if (!box.contains(el)) {
                    try { box.appendChild(el); }
                    catch (e) { return; }   // kalau re-parent gagal, skip tick ini
                }

                var parent = el.parentElement;
                while (parent && parent !== box) {
                    if (parent.style.display !== 'contents') {
                        parent.style.setProperty('display', 'contents', 'important');
                    }
                    parent = parent.parentElement;
                }
            });
            var chat = box.querySelector('.chat');
            if (chat) {
                // ⭐ FIX: same guard untuk chat
                if (!box.contains(chat)) {
                    try { box.appendChild(chat); }
                    catch (e) { chat = null; }
                }
                if (chat) {
                    var parent = chat.parentElement;
                    while (parent && parent !== box) {
                        if (parent.style.display !== 'contents') {
                            parent.style.setProperty('display', 'contents', 'important');
                        }
                        parent = parent.parentElement;
                    }
                }
            }
            return; // Hentikan eksekusi ke bawah (jangan jalankan JS Math)
        }

        // ⭐ FIX: Healing — bersihkan sisa display:contents di body/html dari bug sebelumnya
        try {

            }

        // ⭐ FIX: Walk-up HANYA jika wrapper benar-benar descendant box.

            }

                } else {
                    var __px1 = parseFloat(__parts[0]);
                    var __px2 = parseFloat(__parts[1]);
                    if (isNaN(__px1) || isNaN(__px2)) {

                    } else {

                            __needsEnforce = true;

                                __needsEnforce = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (__needsEnforce) {
                if (window.__caEnforceLayoutOnce) {
                    try { window.__caEnforceLayoutOnce(true); } catch(e) {}
                }
            }

        // ⭐ FIX: Robust Native Click Simulator (React & Vanilla Compatible)
        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        function triggerNativeClick(el) {
            if (!el) return;
            const W = typeof unsafeWindow !== 'undefined' ? unsafeWindow : window;

            // 1. Coba klik native
            try { el.click(); } catch(e) {}

            // 2. Dispatch Pointer & Mouse Events dari scope halaman (unsafeWindow)
            try {
                const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                const cx = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
                const cy = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
                const opts = { view: W, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0, buttons: 1, clientX: cx, clientY: cy };

                if (W.PointerEvent) {
                    ['pointerdown', 'pointerup'].forEach(t => {
                        el.dispatchEvent(new W.PointerEvent(t, { ...opts, pointerType: 'mouse', isPrimary: true }));
                    });
                }
                ['mousedown', 'mouseup', 'click'].forEach(t => {
                    el.dispatchEvent(new W.MouseEvent(t, opts));
                });
            } catch(e) {}

            // 3. Cari elemen anak (jika tombol native dibungkus div lagi)
            try {
                const inner = el.querySelector('button, .btn__content, [role="button"]');
                if (inner && inner !== el) {
                    triggerNativeClick(inner);
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        }

        // 2. Pastikan Tombol Play Ada
        if (!bar.querySelector('.ca-btn-play')) {
            const btnPlay = document.createElement('div');
            btnPlay.className = 'ca-custom-btn ca-btn-play';
            btnPlay.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg>';
            bar.appendChild(btnPlay);
        }

        // 3. Pastikan Tombol Stop Ada
        if (!bar.querySelector('.ca-btn-stop')) {
            const btnStop = document.createElement('div');
            btnStop.className = 'ca-custom-btn ca-btn-stop';
            btnStop.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="6" y="6" width="12" height="12"/></svg>';
            bar.appendChild(btnStop);
        }

        // 4. Bind Ulang Handler (Idempotent) agar tidak hilang saat bar di-render ulang
               const btnPlay = bar.querySelector('.ca-btn-play');
        if (btnPlay) {
            btnPlay.onclick = (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (window.__caForceNoSignalShow) window.__caForceNoSignalShow(); // ⭐ TAMBAHKAN INI
                let target = document.querySelector('.buttons__button.start-button')
                          || document.querySelector('.buttons__button.stop-button');

                // Fallback pencarian berdasarkan teks jika selector gagal
                if (!target) {
                    const allBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.buttons__button, button');
                    for (let b of allBtns) {
                        const txt = (b.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                        if (txt === 'start' || txt === 'next') { target = b; break; }
                    }
                }
                if (target) triggerNativeClick(target);
            };
        }

                const btnStop = bar.querySelector('.ca-btn-stop');
        if (btnStop) {
            btnStop.onclick = (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (window.__caForceNoSignalShow) window.__caForceNoSignalShow(); // ⭐ TAMBAHKAN INI
                let target = document.querySelector('.buttons__button.stop-button');

                // Fallback pencarian berdasarkan teks jika selector gagal
                if (!target) {
                    const allBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.buttons__button, button');
                    for (let b of allBtns) {
                        const txt = (b.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                        if (txt === 'stop') { target = b; break; }
                    }
                }
                if (target) triggerNativeClick(target);
            };
        }

        // Sembunyikan tombol Country (karena kita di mode 3-kolom)
        const countryBtn = bar.querySelector('.ca-btn-country');

            // ── FUNGSI MIRROR LAYOUT (FIX SMOOTH & KOMPAK) ──
    function bindMirrorBtn() {
        const mirrorBtn = document.getElementById('test-mirror-btn');
        if (mirrorBtn && !mirrorBtn.dataset.caCinema3Mirror) {
            mirrorBtn.dataset.caCinema3Mirror = 'true';
            mirrorBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                const box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
                const panel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
                if (!box) return;

                           // 1. Toggle class pada Grid Video (instan) — sync-based (anti-drift)
            var wasMirrored = box.classList.contains('ca-mirrored') || box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-mirrored');
            if (wasMirrored) {
                box.classList.remove('ca-mirrored', 'ca-cinema3-mirrored');
            } else {
                box.classList.add('ca-mirrored', 'ca-cinema3-mirrored');
            }

                const isMirrored = box.classList.contains('ca-mirrored') || box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-mirrored');

                // 2. Sinkronisasi class Panel UI secara INSTAN (Jangan tunggu interval 1000ms)
                if (panel) {
                    if (isMirrored) {
                        panel.classList.add('ca-mirrored-panel', 'ca-cinema3-mirrored');
                    } else {
                        panel.classList.remove('ca-mirrored-panel', 'ca-cinema3-mirrored');
                    }
                }

                // 3. Paksa update layout berdasarkan mode yang sedang aktif
                if (box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-landscape-mode')) {
                    // Jika di mode Landscape, hitung ulang grid secara instan
                    if (window.__caEnforceLayoutOnce) window.__caEnforceLayoutOnce();
                    if (window.__caApplyAdaptiveLayout) window.__caApplyAdaptiveLayout(true);
                } else {
                    // Jika di mode Portrait (3-kolom), bersihkan inline style agar CSS Grid bekerja mulus
                    box.style.removeProperty('grid-template-columns');
                }

                // 4. Paksa browser melakukan reflow agar animasi transisi CSS berjalan mulus (tidak patah-patah)
                void box.offsetWidth;
            });
        }
    }

    return 'cover';
}

    const lv = document.getElementById('local-video');
    const isZoomed = box.classList.contains('ca-zoom-active');
    const zoomScale = isZoomed ? 1.8 : 1;

    const applySize = (video) => {
        if (!video) return;
        const wrapper = video.parentElement;
        if (!wrapper) return;

        const rect = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
        const w = Math.round(rect.width);
        const h = Math.round(rect.height);
        if (w < 10 || h < 10) return;

        const isFlipped = video.dataset.caFlipActive === '1';
        const flipPart = video.id === 'local-video' ? (isFlipped ? ' scaleX(1)' : ' scaleX(-1)') : '';
        const t = video.style.transform || '';
        const isRot = t.includes('rotate') || t.includes('matrix');

        let angle = 0;
        if (isRot) {
            const mRot = t.match(/rotate\((-?[0-9.]+)deg\)/);
            if (mRot) angle = parseFloat(mRot[1]);
            else {
                const mMat = t.match(/matrix\(([^)]+)\)/);
                if (mMat) {
                    const p = mMat[1].split(',').map(parseFloat);
                    if (p.length >= 2) angle = Math.round(Math.atan2(p[1], p[0]) * 180 / Math.PI);
                }
            }
        }

                // ⭐ FIX: Hanya center jika dirotasi. Untuk local video tanpa rotasi,
        // biarkan V25 CSS Grid yang mengatur (top:0, left:0, width:100%).
        const isLocal = video.id === 'local-video';
        const needsCenter = isRot || (isLocal && angle !== 0);

        if (isRot) {
            if (angle === 90 || angle === 270) {
                video.style.setProperty('width', h + 'px', 'important');
                video.style.setProperty('height', w + 'px', 'important');
            } else {
                video.style.setProperty('width', '100%', 'important');
                video.style.setProperty('height', '100%', 'important');
            }
        } else {
            video.style.setProperty('width', '100%', 'important');
            video.style.setProperty('height', '100%', 'important');
        }

        video.style.setProperty('right', 'auto', 'important');
        video.style.setProperty('bottom', 'auto', 'important');

        if (needsCenter) {
            video.style.setProperty('transform', `translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(${angle}deg) scale(${zoomScale})${flipPart}`, 'important');
            video.style.setProperty('top', '50%', 'important');
            video.style.setProperty('left', '50%', 'important');
        } else {
            video.style.setProperty('transform', `scale(${zoomScale})${flipPart}`, 'important');
            video.style.setProperty('top', '0', 'important');
            video.style.setProperty('left', '0', 'important');
        }

        var isLocalPip = (video.id === 'local-video');
        var fitModeLS;
if (isLocalPip) {
    fitModeLS = 'cover';
} else {
    // ⭐ FIX D: guard undefined + default 'cover' (identik native landscape)
    fitModeLS = (typeof currentRotation !== 'undefined' && currentRotation !== 0) ? 'contain' : 'cover';
}
video.style.setProperty('object-fit', fitModeLS, 'important');
    };

    applySize(rv);
    applySize(lv);
}
    // ⭐ FIX #18: hapus updateLandscapeLayout() — dead code, digantikan __caEnforceLayoutOnce()

    // ── FUNGSI OBSERVER: DETEKSI INSTAN SAAT TOMBOL ROTASI DIKLIK ──
                function setupRotationObserver() {
        const video = document.getElementById('remote-video');
        if (!video || video.dataset.caRotObs) return;
        video.dataset.caRotObs = 'true';
        const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
            mutations.forEach((m) => {
                if (m.attributeName === 'style') {
                    if (window.__caVTActive) return;
                    if (window.__caVTKick) window.__caVTKick();
                    // else: VT Bridge wajib loaded sebelum Cinema 3-col — no fallback
                }
            });
        });
        observer.observe(video, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] });
    }

    // ── FUNGSI KLIK SWAP OVERLAY (SMOOTH ANIMATION) ──
    function bindSwapVideo() {
        const localWrapper  = document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper');
        const remoteWrapper = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
        const box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        if (!localWrapper || !remoteWrapper || !box) return;

                              const handleSwap = (e) => {
            if (e) {
                if (e.target.closest('button') ||
                    e.target.closest('.ca-custom-btn') ||
                    e.target.closest('#ca-cinema3-btn-container') ||
                    e.target.closest('.ca-custom-cinema-bar') ||
                    e.target.closest('#ca-floating-box') ||
                    e.target.closest('#ca-rotate-buttons') ||
                    e.target.closest('#ca-buttons-wrapper') ||
                    e.target.closest('#ca-global-status')) return;
            }
            if (!box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-active') ||
                !box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-landscape-mode')) return;

            const now = Date.now();
            if (box.__caLastSwap && (now - box.__caLastSwap) < 400) return;
            box.__caLastSwap = now;

            box.classList.toggle('ca-swapped');

            if (window.__caLogicV25) {
                // ⭐ 1. Bersihkan inline style agar proses swap CSS mulus (Anti-Mental)
                if (window.__caClearLayoutInlineStyles) window.__caClearLayoutInlineStyles();
                if (window.__caEnforceGridStructure) window.__caEnforceGridStructure();

                // ⭐ 2. Tunda rotasi pakai requestAnimationFrame ganda
                // agar CSS Grid selesai memindahkan kotak sebelum di-rotate
                requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                    requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                        if (window.doApplyRotation) window.doApplyRotation(true);
                    });
                });
            } else {
                if (window.__caApplyAdaptiveLayout) window.__caApplyAdaptiveLayout(true);
                if (typeof updateLocalVideoTransform === 'function') updateLocalVideoTransform();
            }

            ensure3ColBar();
        };

        if (!localWrapper.dataset.caLandscapeBound) {
            localWrapper.dataset.caLandscapeBound = 'true';
            localWrapper.addEventListener('click', handleSwap);
        }
        if (!remoteWrapper.dataset.caLandscapeBound) {
            remoteWrapper.dataset.caLandscapeBound = 'true';
            remoteWrapper.addEventListener('click', handleSwap);
        }
    }

            function applyCinemaModeState(forcePref) {
    // ⭐ FIX #1: MUTEX — cegah double-execution saat 4 caller (bootFast,
    // classGuard, __caOn500, handleToggle) overlap dalam frame yang sama.
    // Tanpa ini, race menghasilkan state berbeda antar reload.
        // ⭐ FIX Catatan 3: pending sekarang track pref yang diinginkan,
    // bukan boolean. Kalau user klik OFF saat mutex active, retry akan
    // apply '0' — bukan skip karena kondisi lama.
    var __mutex = window.__caCinemaApplyMutex || (window.__caCinemaApplyMutex = { active: false, pending: null });
    if (__mutex.active) {
        // Track pref terbaru (bukan hanya "true"). Kalau caller berikutnya
        // pass forcePref eksplisit, pakai itu. Kalau tidak, 'live' = baca
        // localStorage saat retry nanti.
        __mutex.pending = (forcePref !== undefined) ? forcePref : 'live';
        return;
    }
    __mutex.active = true;
    try {
        __caApplyCinemaModeStateInner(forcePref);
    } finally {
        __mutex.active = false;
        if (__mutex.pending !== null) {
            var __pendingPref = __mutex.pending;
            __mutex.pending = null;
            requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                try {
                    var __target = (__pendingPref === 'live')
                        ? (localStorage.getItem('ca_cinema3_v9_enabled') || '0')
                        : __pendingPref;
                    window.__caApplyCinemaModeState && window.__caApplyCinemaModeState(__target);
                } catch(e) {}
            });
        }
    }
}

                         function isAllLayoutReady(b, pnl) {

        if (!pnl.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-docked')) return false;

        // ⭐ FIX F5: strict — cek INLINE !important only

        var __trVal  = pnl.style.getPropertyValue('transform');
        var __trPrio = pnl.style.getPropertyPriority('transform');

        if ((__leftVal === '50%' && __leftPrio === 'important') ||
            (__trVal && __trVal.indexOf('translateX(-50%)') !== -1 && __trPrio === 'important')) {
            return false;
        }

        var rv = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
        var lv = document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper');
        if (!rv || !lv) return false;

        var rvr = rv.getBoundingClientRect();

    }

            function handleToggle(e) {
    if (e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); }
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastToggleTime < 300) return;
    lastToggleTime = now;

    let pref = '0';
    try { pref = localStorage.getItem(MODE_KEY) || '0'; } catch(e) {}

    // ⭐ FIX: Toggle preference
    let newPref = (pref === '1') ? '0' : '1';
    try { localStorage.setItem(MODE_KEY, newPref); } catch(e) {}

    // ⭐ FIX: Paksa applyCinemaModeState menggunakan nilai terbaru (bypass localStorage read error)
    applyCinemaModeState(newPref);
}

        function ensureToggleBtn() {
        let btnContainer = document.getElementById('ca-cinema3-btn-container');
        if (!btnContainer) {
            btnContainer = document.createElement('div');
            btnContainer.id = 'ca-cinema3-btn-container';
        }
                // ⭐ GABUNGKAN KE DALAM SATU CONTAINER AGAR GAP RATA
        const btnWrapper = document.getElementById('ca-buttons-wrapper');
        const host = btnWrapper || document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper') || document.body;

        if (btnContainer.parentNode !== host) {
            if (btnWrapper) {
                btnWrapper.insertBefore(btnContainer, btnWrapper.firstChild); // Taruh paling atas
            } else {
                host.appendChild(btnContainer);
            }
        }
        let btn = document.getElementById('ca-cinema3-toggle-btn');
        if (!btn) {
            btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.id = 'ca-cinema3-toggle-btn';
            btnContainer.appendChild(btn);
        }
        // ⭐ PERF: tidak clone — reassign onclick idempotent, tidak ada reflow
        if (btn.onclick !== handleToggle) btn.onclick = handleToggle;
        updateToggleVisual();
    }

        (function caCinemaBootFast() {
        var pref = '0';

                        function tryApply() {
            var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
            var pnl = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
            // Sudah applied? treat as success — biarkan verify yang release
            if (box && pnl && box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-active') && pnl.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-docked')) {
                // ⭐ FIX: Gunakan getComputedStyle karena V25 murni pakai CSS (tanpa inline style)
                                if (box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-landscape-mode')) {
                    var cols = getComputedStyle(box).gridTemplateColumns;
                    if (!cols || cols === 'none' || cols.split(/\s+/).length < 2) {
                        if (typeof window.__caEnforceLayoutOnce === 'function') {
                            try { window.__caEnforceLayoutOnce(true); } catch(e) {}
                        }
                        cols = getComputedStyle(box).gridTemplateColumns;
                        if (!cols || cols === 'none' || cols.split(/\s+/).length < 2) return false;
                    }
                    // ⭐ FIX F5: V25 pakai pure CSS — inline width KOSONG.
                    // Ganti cek ke getBoundingClientRect
                    var __pr = pnl.getBoundingClientRect();
                    if (__pr.width < 100) return false;
                }
                return true;
            }
            var rv  = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
            var lv  = document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper');
            if (!box || !rv || !lv || !pnl) return false;
            if (!window.__caApplyCinemaModeState) return false;
            try {
                window.__caApplyCinemaModeState('1');
                // ⭐ VERIFIKASI apply riil — jangan set __caCinemaBootDone di sini.
                //    applyCinemaModeState bisa bail silent kalau <video> belum ada.
                //    Flag __caCinemaBootDone akan di-set oleh __verifyReleaseBootGate
                //    setelah 3-col benar-benar stabil.
                return box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-active') && pnl.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-docked');
            } catch(e) {
                console.warn('[CA-CINEMA-BOOT] apply fail:', e);
                return false;
            }
        }

        if (tryApply()) return;

        var obs = new MutationObserver(function() {
            if (tryApply()) { try { obs.disconnect(); } catch(e) {} }
        });
        obs.observe(document.documentElement || document, {
            childList: true, subtree: true
        });

        // Backup poller — lebih cepat dari __caOn500 (500ms)
        // jaga-jaga kalau MutationObserver miss event
        var __pollIv = setInterval(function() {
            if (tryApply()) { clearInterval(__pollIv); }
        }, 80);

                // ⭐ FIX F5: Safety single release — 2.5s (was 8s duplicate)
        setTimeout(function() {
            try { obs.disconnect(); } catch(e) {}
            try { clearInterval(__pollIv); } catch(e) {}
            if (!window.__caCinemaBootDone && !window.__caVerifyReleaseActive) {
                try { document.documentElement.classList.remove('ca-cinema3-booting'); } catch(e) {}
                console.warn('[CA-CINEMA-BOOT] 2.5s timeout — boot gate dilepas paksa');
            }
        }, 2500);
    })();   // ← close caCinemaBootFast (EARLY — sebelum class guard)

    (function caCinemaClassGuard() {
        if (window.__caCinemaClassGuardActive) return;
        window.__caCinemaClassGuardActive = true;

        var currentBox = null;
        var currentObs = null;

                function reapply() {
            if (localStorage.getItem(MODE_KEY) !== '1') return;
            if (window.__caVTActive) return;
            var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
            if (!box) return;

                                                if (box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-active')) {
                // ⭐ EDIT 8: JANGAN add class manual — delegate ke VT Bridge
                //   via __caVTKick agar hanya SATU penulis class landscape.
                //   Fallback ke add+enforce hanya kalau VT Bridge tidak ada.
                var hasLandscape = box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-landscape-mode');
                var video = document.getElementById('remote-video');
                if (!hasLandscape && video && video.videoWidth > 0 && video.videoHeight > 0) {
                    var ratio = video.videoWidth / video.videoHeight;
                    if (ratio > 1.05) {
                        if (typeof window.__caVTKick === 'function') {
                            try { window.__caVTKick(); } catch(e) {}
                        } else {
                            // Fallback (VT Bridge tidak loaded — jarang)
                            box.classList.add('ca-cinema3-landscape-mode');
                            if (window.__caEnforceGridStructure) {
                                try { window.__caEnforceGridStructure(); } catch(e) {}
                            }
                            if (window.__caEnforceLayoutOnce) window.__caEnforceLayoutOnce(true);
                        }
                    }
                }
                var pnl0 = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
                if (pnl0) pnl0.classList.add('ca-cinema3-docked');
                return;
            }
            try {
                if (window.__caApplyCinemaModeState) window.__caApplyCinemaModeState('1');
            } catch(e) {}
        }

        function attach() {
            var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
            if (!box || box === currentBox) return;
            if (currentObs) { try { currentObs.disconnect(); } catch(e) {} }
            currentBox = box;
                        currentObs = new MutationObserver(function() {
                if (!box.isConnected) return;
                if (localStorage.getItem(MODE_KEY) !== '1') return;
                if (!box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-active')) {
                    reapply();
                    return;
                }
                // ⭐ FIX: juga picu reapply kalau class landscape hilang padahal aspect landscape.
                //   `reapply()` sendiri sudah guard terhadap __caVTActive dan cek aspect,
                //   jadi tidak akan fight dengan VT yang memang mau portrait.
                if (!box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-landscape-mode')) {
                    var __v = document.getElementById('remote-video');
                    if (__v && __v.videoWidth > 0 && __v.videoHeight > 0) {
                        if (__v.videoWidth / __v.videoHeight > 1.05) reapply();
                    }
                }
            });
            currentObs.observe(box, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
        }

        attach();

        // React kadang replace .roulette-box element utuh → re-attach
        if (window.__caBodyBus) {
            window.__caBodyBus.subscribe(function(node) {
                if (!node || node.nodeType !== 1) return;
                if (node.classList && node.classList.contains('roulette-box')) attach();
                else if (node.querySelector && node.querySelector('.roulette-box')) attach();
            });
        }

        // Safety net — reconnect kalau target stale
        if (window.__caOn2000) {
            window.__caOn2000(function() {
                if (!currentBox || !currentBox.isConnected) {
                    currentBox = null;
                    attach();
                }
            });
        }
    })();

    function isLandscapeMode() {
        var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        return !!(box &&
                  box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-active') &&
                  box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-landscape-mode'));
    }

    function getChat() {
        if (!chatEl || !chatEl.isConnected) {
            chatEl = document.querySelector('.roulette-box.ca-cinema3-landscape-mode .chat');
        }
        return chatEl;
    }

    function getChatInput() {
        var chat = getChat();
        if (chat) {
            var i = chat.querySelector('textarea, .chat__textfield, .chat__textarea, input[type="text"]');
            if (i) return i;
        }
        return document.querySelector('.chat__textfield, .chat__textarea, textarea[placeholder*="message" i], input[placeholder*="message" i]');
    }

    function triggerStaticPhase() {
        if (!isLandscapeMode()) return;

        var chat = getChat();
        if (!chat) return;

        chatPhase = 'static';
        chat.classList.add('ca-chat-visible');

        if (staticTimer) clearTimeout(staticTimer);
        staticTimer = setTimeout(function() {
            chatPhase = 'hover';
            checkHover();
        }, HOLD_MS);
    }

    function forceFocusInput() {
        var box = getChatInput();
        if (box && document.activeElement !== box) {
            try {
                box.focus();
                if (box.setSelectionRange) box.setSelectionRange(box.value.length, box.value.length);
            } catch(e) {}
        }
    }

    function setupChatInput() {
        var input = getChatInput();
        if (!input) return;

        input.setAttribute('data-ca-allow-keyboard', 'true');

        if (!input.dataset.caMousedownFixed) {
            input.dataset.caMousedownFixed = 'true';
            input.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
            }, true);
        }

        if (!input.dataset.caEnterFallback) {
            input.dataset.caEnterFallback = 'true';
            input.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                    triggerStaticPhase();

                    var currentVal = (input.value || '').trim();
                    if (!currentVal) return;

                    setTimeout(function() {
                        if ((input.value || '').trim() === currentVal) {
                            var form = input.closest('form');
                            var sendBtn = form ? form.querySelector('button[type="submit"], .chat__send-button, .chat__button') : null;

                            if (sendBtn) sendBtn.click();
                            else if (form) {
                                if (form.requestSubmit) form.requestSubmit();
                                else form.dispatchEvent(new Event('submit', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
                            }
                        }
                    }, 100);
                }
            }, true);
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
        var target = e.target.closest('.ca-clickable-text');
        if (!target || !target.closest('#ca-floating-box')) return;
        triggerStaticPhase();
    }, true);

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var target = e.target.closest('.ca-clickable-text');
        if (!target || !target.closest('#ca-floating-box')) return;
        if (e.shiftKey) return;

        setTimeout(function() {
            var box = getChatInput();
            if (!box) return;

            var currentValue = box.value;
            if (!currentValue) return;

            var proto = box.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ? window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype : window.HTMLInputElement.prototype;
            var nativeSetter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto, "value").set;
            nativeSetter.call(box, currentValue);

            box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            box.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));

            forceFocusInput();
            setupChatInput();
        }, 50);
    }, true);

    function checkHover() {
        rafId = 0;
        if (!isLandscapeMode() || mouseX < 0) {
            if (chatPhase === 'hover') {
                var c = getChat();
                if (c) c.classList.remove('ca-chat-visible', 'ca-chat-new-msg');
            }
            return;
        }

        var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        if (!box) return;

                // ✅ FIX: Gunakan wrapper utama, bukan PiP
        var isSwapped = box.classList.contains('ca-swapped');
        var mainWrapper = isSwapped ? document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper') : document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
        if (!mainWrapper) return;

        var rect = mainWrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.width === 0 || rect.height === 0) return;

        var isMirrored = box.classList.contains('ca-mirrored') || box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-mirrored');

        var chatBottom = rect.bottom - 16;
        var chatTop = chatBottom - CHAT_HEIGHT;
        var chatLeft, chatRight;

        if (isMirrored) {
            // Mirror: Chat di Kanan Bawah
            chatRight = rect.right - 16;
            chatLeft = chatRight - CHAT_WIDTH;
        } else {
            // Normal: Chat di Kiri Bawah
            chatLeft = rect.left + 16;
            chatRight = chatLeft + CHAT_WIDTH;
        }

        var triggerTop = rect.bottom - 400;

        var inChatArea = (mouseX >= chatLeft - 10 && mouseX <= chatRight + 10 &&
                          mouseY >= chatTop - 10 && mouseY <= chatBottom + 10);

        var inTriggerArea;
        if (isMirrored) {
            inTriggerArea = (mouseX >= chatLeft - 80 && mouseX <= chatRight + 10 &&
                             mouseY >= triggerTop && mouseY <= window.innerHeight);
        } else {
            inTriggerArea = (mouseX >= chatLeft - 10 && mouseX <= chatRight + 80 &&
                             mouseY >= triggerTop && mouseY <= window.innerHeight);
        }

        var chat = getChat();
        if (!chat) return;

        if (chatPhase === 'static') {
            chat.classList.add('ca-chat-visible');
        } else {
            if (inChatArea || inTriggerArea) {
                chat.classList.add('ca-chat-visible');
            } else {
                chat.classList.remove('ca-chat-visible', 'ca-chat-new-msg');
            }
        }
    }

        window.__caMouseBus.subscribe(function(x, y) {
        mouseX = x;
        mouseY = y;
        checkHover();
    });

    var msgObserver = null;
        function attachMessageObserver() {
        var chat = getChat();
        if (!chat) return;
        if (window.__caLandscapeMsgSub) {
            try { window.__caBodyBus.unsubscribe(window.__caLandscapeMsgSub); } catch(e) {}
        }
        window.__caLandscapeMsgSub = window.__caBodyBus.subscribe(function (node) {
            if (!node || node.nodeType !== 1) return;
            if (!chat.contains(node)) return;
            if (!(node.matches && node.matches('.message, .message__system')) &&
                !(node.closest && node.closest('.message, .message__system'))) return;
            triggerStaticPhase();
            chat.classList.add('ca-chat-new-msg');
            if (window.caLandscapeMsgTimeout) clearTimeout(window.caLandscapeMsgTimeout);
            window.caLandscapeMsgTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
                var c = getChat();
                if (c) c.classList.remove('ca-chat-new-msg');
            }, HOLD_MS);
        });
    }

                      function updateChatPosition() {
            var isLandscape = isLandscapeMode();
            var chat = getChat();

            if (isLandscape) {
                if (chat && !chat.dataset.caLandscapeObserver) {
                    chat.dataset.caLandscapeObserver = 'true';
                    attachMessageObserver();
                }
                setupChatInput();

                if (chat) {
                    var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
                    if (box) {
                        var isSwapped = box.classList.contains('ca-swapped');
                        var mainWrapper = isSwapped ? document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper') : document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
                        if (mainWrapper) {
                            var rect = mainWrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
                            var boxRect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
                            var isMirrored = box.classList.contains('ca-mirrored') || box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-mirrored');5
                            if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) {
                                var relativeBottom = boxRect.bottom - rect.bottom + 45;
                                chat.style.setProperty('bottom', relativeBottom + 'px', 'important');
                                chat.style.setProperty('top', 'auto', 'important');

                                if (isMirrored) {
                                    var relativeRight = boxRect.right - rect.right + 16;
                                    chat.style.setProperty('right', relativeRight + 'px', 'important');
                                    chat.style.setProperty('left', 'auto', 'important');
                                } else {
                                    var relativeLeft = rect.left - boxRect.left + 16;
                                    chat.style.setProperty('left', relativeLeft + 'px', 'important');
                                    chat.style.setProperty('right', 'auto', 'important');
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if (chat) {
                    chat.classList.remove('ca-chat-visible', 'ca-chat-new-msg');
                    delete chat.dataset.caLandscapeObserver;
                    chat.style.removeProperty('left');
                    chat.style.removeProperty('bottom');
                    chat.style.removeProperty('right');
                    chat.style.removeProperty('top');
                    chat.style.removeProperty('transform');
                    chat.style.removeProperty('opacity');
                    chat.style.removeProperty('visibility');
                    chat.style.removeProperty('position');
                }
                if (window.__caLandscapeMsgSub) {
                    try { window.__caBodyBus.unsubscribe(window.__caLandscapeMsgSub); } catch(e) {}
                    window.__caLandscapeMsgSub = null;
                }
                setupChatInput();
                chatPhase = 'hover';
            }
        }

                // ⭐ Pemicu instan saat layout berubah (menggantikan setInterval 1000ms)
        document.addEventListener('ca-layout-updated', updateChatPosition);
        __caOn1000(updateChatPosition);

        // ⭐ ResizeObserver untuk memantau perubahan ukuran secara real-time
        (function() {
            var mainWrapper = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
            if (mainWrapper && window.__caResizeBus) {
                window.__caResizeBus.subscribe(mainWrapper, updateChatPosition);
            }
        })();

    injectStyle();
    console.log('[CA-LANDSCAPE-CHAT v6.1] ✅ True Status Machine Ready');
})();

    // ─── Fungsi Apply Class ke Panel ───
    function applyViewMode() {
        var panel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        if (!panel) return;
        if (window.__caViewMode === 'list') {
            panel.classList.add('ca-view-list');
        } else {
            panel.classList.remove('ca-view-list');
        }
    }

    // ─── Inject Tombol Secara Cerdas ───
    function injectViewToggle() {
        var panel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        if (!panel) return;

        var toggleBtn = document.getElementById('ca-global-view-toggle');
        if (!toggleBtn) {
            toggleBtn = document.createElement('div');
            toggleBtn.id = 'ca-global-view-toggle';
            toggleBtn.className = 'ca-view-toggle-btn';
            toggleBtn.title = 'Ganti Tampilan (Grid/List)';

            toggleBtn.onclick = function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();

                window.__caViewMode = window.__caViewMode === 'grid' ? 'list' : 'grid';
                localStorage.setItem('ca_country_view_mode', window.__caViewMode);
                toggleBtn.innerHTML = window.__caViewMode === 'list' ? '⊞' : '☰';
                applyViewMode();
            };
        }

        toggleBtn.innerHTML = window.__caViewMode === 'list' ? '⊞' : '☰';

        // ⭐ TAMBAHKAN BARIS INI: Paksa sinkronisasi class setiap 500ms
        applyViewMode();

        // Deteksi Tab Aktif langsung dari DOM (Sangat Akurat)
        var isBlockTab = !!panel.querySelector('.ca-block-wrapper.active');
        var isAllTab = !!panel.querySelector('.ca-tab-all.active');

        // 1. Bersihkan wadah baris search jika kita tidak berada di tab Block
        var searchRow = panel.querySelector('.ca-search-row');
        if (searchRow && !isBlockTab) {
            var sw = searchRow.querySelector('.ca-search-wrapper');
            if (sw) searchRow.parentNode.insertBefore(sw, searchRow); // Kembalikan search ke posisi aslinya
            searchRow.parentNode.removeChild(searchRow); // Hapus wadah flex
        }

        // 2. Pindahkan tombol ke tempat yang tepat
        if (isAllTab) {
            var allBtn = panel.querySelector('.ca-all-countries-btn');
            if (allBtn && allBtn.parentElement) {
                var wrapper = allBtn.parentElement;
                wrapper.style.setProperty('position', 'relative', 'important');
                wrapper.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
                wrapper.style.setProperty('justify-content', 'center', 'important');
                wrapper.style.setProperty('align-items', 'center', 'important');
                wrapper.style.setProperty('width', '100%', 'important');
                wrapper.style.setProperty('margin-bottom', '6px', 'important');

                if (toggleBtn.parentElement !== wrapper) {
                    wrapper.appendChild(toggleBtn);
                }
            }
        }
        else if (isBlockTab) {
            var searchWrapper = panel.querySelector('.ca-search-wrapper');
            if (searchWrapper) {
                var sRow = panel.querySelector('.ca-search-row');
                if (!sRow) {
                    sRow = document.createElement('div');
                    sRow.className = 'ca-search-row';
                    // Bungkus Search ke dalam baris flex
                    searchWrapper.parentNode.insertBefore(sRow, searchWrapper);
                    sRow.appendChild(searchWrapper);
                }
                // Taruh tombol di dalam baris flex tersebut
                if (toggleBtn.parentElement !== sRow) {
                    sRow.appendChild(toggleBtn);
                }
            }
        }
        else {
            // Tab History / IP / Engine Lab: Hilangkan tombol
            if (toggleBtn.parentElement) {
                toggleBtn.parentElement.removeChild(toggleBtn);
            }
        }
    }

    // MutationObserver pada grid — tangkap wipe dari renderGrid internal
    var __v14GridObs = null;
    var __v14GridTarget = null;
    function __v14AttachGridObs() {
        var panel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        if (!panel) return false;
        var grid = panel.querySelector('.ca-country-grid');
        if (!grid) return false;
        if (grid === __v14GridTarget && __v14GridObs) return true;
        if (__v14GridObs) { try { __v14GridObs.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} }
        var scheduled = false;

    function favToast(msg, bg) {

        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function injectFavX(chip) {
        if (!chip || chip.querySelector('.ca-fav-chip-x')) return;
        var code = chip.getAttribute('data-ca-code');
        if (!code) return;

        var x = document.createElement('span');
        x.className = 'ca-fav-chip-x';
        x.innerText = '✖';
        x.title = 'Remove ' + code.toUpperCase() + ' from favorites';
        x.setAttribute('role', 'button');
        x.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Remove ' + code + ' from favorites');

        x.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();   // cegah drag panel
        }, true);

        x.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            e.preventDefault();

            // ✅ FIX: pakai getCaAPI() — unsafeWindow-aware
            var caApi = getCaAPI();
            var state = caApi && caApi.state;
            if (!state || !Array.isArray(state.favorites)) {
                console.error('[CA-FAV-X] ⚠️ __ca.state.favorites tidak dapat diakses');
                return;
            }

            var lc = code.toLowerCase();
            var idx = state.favorites.indexOf(lc);
            if (idx === -1) {
                console.warn('[CA-FAV-X] Code "' + lc + '" tidak ada di state.favorites');
                return;
            }

            var nameEl = chip.querySelector('.ca-fav-chip-name');
            var name = chip.getAttribute('data-ca-name')
                    || (nameEl ? (nameEl.textContent || '').trim() : code.toUpperCase());

            // ⚡ INSTANT remove (identik blocked chip)
            state.favorites.splice(idx, 1);
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('ca_favorites', JSON.stringify(state.favorites));
            } catch(err) {}

            // Re-render via unsafeWindow API
            if (typeof caApi.renderGrid === 'function') {
                try { caApi.renderGrid(); }
                catch(err) { console.error('[CA-FAV-X] renderGrid error:', err); }
            }

            favToast('☆ Removed: ' + name, '#64748b');
        }, true);

        chip.appendChild(x);
    }

    function injectAllFavX() {
        document.querySelectorAll('#my-custom-country-ui .ca-fav-chip').forEach(injectFavX);
    }

    var favXObserver = null;
    var favXObservedGrid = null;

    function attachFavXObserver() {
        var grid = document.querySelector('#my-custom-country-ui .ca-country-grid');
        if (!grid || grid === favXObservedGrid) return;
        favXObservedGrid = grid;

        if (favXObserver) favXObserver.disconnect();
        favXObserver = new MutationObserver(function(muts) {
            for (var i = 0; i < muts.length; i++) {
                var added = muts[i].addedNodes;
                for (var j = 0; j < added.length; j++) {
                    var node = added[j];
                    if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue;
                    if (node.classList && node.classList.contains('ca-fav-chip')) {
                        injectFavX(node);
                    } else if (node.querySelectorAll) {
                        node.querySelectorAll('.ca-fav-chip').forEach(injectFavX);
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        favXObserver.observe(grid, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    function bootFavX() {
        injectAllFavX();
        attachFavXObserver();
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bootFavX);
    } else {
        bootFavX();
    }

    });

    //   BUKAN parse dari style.transform.
    //
    //   Alasan: setelah EDIT 1, saat ca-swapped=true, remote-video di PiP
    //   tidak lagi punya `rotate(90deg)` di inline transform (dihapus).
    //   Kalau kita tetap parse dari transform, computeRatio() akan salah
    //   baca (0.75 portrait) → VT tick akan switch balik ke portrait mode
    //   setelah swap → swap "batal" secara visual.
    //
    //   currentRotation selalu di-set oleh rotateLeft/rotateRight/resetRotation
    //   dan tidak pernah dibersihkan oleh swap → ini satu-satunya nilai
    //   yang benar di SEMUA state (main slot / PiP slot / non-rotated).
    function computeRatio(video) {
        var ratio = video.videoWidth / video.videoHeight;
        var angle = window.currentRotation || 0;
        angle = ((angle % 360) + 360) % 360;
        if (angle === 90 || angle === 270) ratio = 1 / ratio;
        return ratio;
    }

    function readAngle(video) {
        // ⭐ FIX SWAP-PIP: Baca dari currentRotation (bukan transform).
        //   Tetap return nilai yang sama dengan sebelumnya untuk semua
        //   kasus non-swapped, PLUS benar untuk kasus swapped.
        var angle = window.currentRotation || 0;
        angle = ((angle % 360) + 360) % 360;
        return angle;
    }

    // ── Single writer ──
        function applyLayoutSingle(mode) {
    // ⭐ FIX: symmetric — pure CSS owns both modes (V25 tidak butuh JS math)
    // Landscape & portrait: NO-OP. CSS .ca-cinema3-docked / landscape-mode owns geometry.
}

    // ── VT wrapper ──
       function switchModeWithVT(targetMode) {
        var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        if (!box) return;

                if (lock.vtActive) {
            pendingSwitch = targetMode;
            return;
        }

        var rvWrapper = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
        var lvWrapper = document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper');

        // ⭐ FIX: Deteksi Rotasi Manual. Jika baru saja dirotasi, HARD SNAP tanpa View Transition.
        var isManualRotation = window.__caLastManualRotateAt && (Date.now() - window.__caLastManualRotateAt < 1500);

        var mutate = function () {
    // ⭐ [FIX LAYOUT RUSAK] Bersihkan sisa inline style dari script lama
    // ⭐ TAMBAHAN: Bersihkan inline style di box agar tidak bentrok dengan V25 Pure CSS Grid
    box.style.removeProperty('grid-template-columns');
    box.style.removeProperty('grid-template-rows');
    box.style.removeProperty('grid-template-areas');

    var rvW = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
    var lvW = document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper');
    [rvW, lvW].forEach(function(w) {
        if (!w) return;
        w.style.removeProperty('width');
        w.style.removeProperty('max-width');
        w.style.removeProperty('height');
        w.style.removeProperty('max-height');
        w.style.removeProperty('grid-area');
        w.style.removeProperty('margin');
        w.style.removeProperty('position');
        w.style.removeProperty('justify-self');
        w.style.removeProperty('align-self');
        w.style.removeProperty('z-index');
        w.style.removeProperty('aspect-ratio');
    });

                if (targetMode === 'landscape') {

                box.classList.remove('ca-swapped');
                // ⭐ EDIT 1: persist landscape intent
                try { localStorage.setItem('ca_cinema3_last_orientation', 'landscape'); } catch(e) {}

                // ⭐ 1 SHOT FIX: Segera rotasi video saat layout berubah
                if (window.currentRotation && window.currentRotation !== 0 && window.doApplyRotation) {
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        try { window.doApplyRotation(true); } catch(e) {}
                    }, 0);
                }
                        } else {
                box.classList.remove('ca-cinema3-landscape-mode', 'ca-swapped');
                try { localStorage.setItem('ca_cinema3_last_orientation', 'portrait'); } catch(e) {}

                // ⭐ FIX: BERSIHKAN INLINE STYLES DARI MODE LANDSCAPE
                box.style.removeProperty('grid-template-columns');
                box.style.removeProperty('grid-template-rows');   // ← NEW

                var panel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
                if (panel) {
                    panel.style.removeProperty('width');
                    panel.style.removeProperty('max-width');
                    panel.style.removeProperty('min-width');
                    panel.style.removeProperty('transform');
                    panel.style.removeProperty('left');
                    panel.style.removeProperty('top');
                    panel.style.removeProperty('right');
                    panel.style.removeProperty('bottom');
                    panel.style.removeProperty('height');
                    panel.style.removeProperty('max-height');
                    panel.style.removeProperty('position');
                    panel.style.removeProperty('margin');
                }

                                var rv = document.getElementById('remote-video');
                var lv = document.getElementById('local-video');
                [rv, lv].forEach(function(v){
                    if (!v) return;
                    // ⭐ FIX: Jangan strip style video yang sedang dirotasi
                    var _t = v.style.transform || '';
                    var _m = _t.match(/rotate\((-?[0-9.]+)deg\)/);
                    var _angle = _m ? parseFloat(_m[1]) : 0;
                    if (_angle !== 0) return;   // rotated video → skip all removals

                    v.style.removeProperty('width');
                    v.style.removeProperty('height');
                    v.style.removeProperty('top');
                    v.style.removeProperty('left');
                    v.style.removeProperty('right');
                    v.style.removeProperty('bottom');
                    v.style.removeProperty('object-fit');
                    v.style.removeProperty('transform');

                    if (v.id === 'local-video') {

                    }
                });

                // Reset state adaptive layout jika ada
                if (typeof window.__caResetAdaptiveState === 'function') {
                    window.__caResetAdaptiveState();
                }
                        }
            if (window.__caEnforceGridStructure) window.__caEnforceGridStructure(); // ⭐ FIX: Instan anti-terlempar
            applyLayoutSingle(targetMode);
        };

                var finish = function () {
    lock.vtActive = false;
    lock.switchTimerStart = 0;
    window.__caVTActive = false;
    box.removeAttribute('data-ca-vt-active');

    document.documentElement.classList.remove('ca-vt-active');

    // ⭐ FIX RACE: unpause SMIL hanya jika freeze resize juga sudah selesai
    var stillFrozen = document.documentElement.classList.contains('ca-pulse-resizing');
    if (!stillFrozen) {
        try { if (__svgDefs && __svgDefs.unpauseAnimations) __svgDefs.unpauseAnimations(); } catch(e) {}
    } else {
        try { console.log('[CA-VT] freeze still active — SMIL stays paused'); } catch(_) {}
    }

                try { window.__caScheduleLockSizes && window.__caScheduleLockSizes(); } catch (e) {}
            try { window.__caApplyAdaptiveLayout && window.__caApplyAdaptiveLayout(true); } catch (e) {}

            // ⭐ FIX: verifikasi class benar-benar match aspect setelah VT selesai.
            //    Browser boleh skip `mutate` saat tab hidden — kalau kejadian,
            //    class tertinggal dan tidak ada yang retry. Ini retry-nya.
            try {
                var __v = document.getElementById('remote-video');
                if (__v && __v.videoWidth > 0 && __v.videoHeight > 0) {
                                        var __r = __v.videoWidth / __v.videoHeight;
                    var __ang = 0;
                    try {
                        var __t = __v.style.transform || '';
                        var __mR = __t.match(/rotate\((-?[0-9.]+)deg\)/);
                        if (__mR) __ang = parseFloat(__mR[1]);
                        else {
                            var __mM = __t.match(/matrix\(([^)]+)\)/);
                            if (__mM) {
                                var __p = __mM[1].split(',').map(parseFloat);
                                if (__p.length >= 2) __ang = Math.round(Math.atan2(__p[1], __p[0]) * 180 / Math.PI);
                            }
                        }
                    } catch(_) {}
                    __ang = ((__ang % 360) + 360) % 360;
                    if (__ang === 90 || __ang === 270) __r = 1 / __r;
                    var __shouldLS = __r > 1.05;
                    var __isLS = box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-landscape-mode');
                    if (__shouldLS && !__isLS) {
                        console.warn('[CA-VT] ⚠️ finish: class missing for landscape aspect — retry');
                        lock.targetMode = null;   // buka lock supaya boleh retry
                        lock.pending = null;
                        pendingSwitch = null;
                        setTimeout(function() { switchModeWithVT('landscape'); }, 16);
                        return;
                    } else if (!__shouldLS && __isLS) {
                        console.warn('[CA-VT] ⚠️ finish: class present but aspect portrait — retry');
                        lock.targetMode = null;
                        lock.pending = null;
                        pendingSwitch = null;
                        setTimeout(function() { switchModeWithVT('portrait'); }, 16);
                        return;
                    }
                }
            } catch(e) {}

            if (pendingSwitch !== null && pendingSwitch !== targetMode) {
                var p = pendingSwitch;
                pendingSwitch = null;
                switchModeWithVT(p);
            } else {
                pendingSwitch = null;
            }
        };

                var canVT = (typeof document.startViewTransition === 'function') &&
                    !matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

        if (isManualRotation) {
    // ⭐ HARD SNAP: Matikan CSS transisi & langsung eksekusi mutate() secara instan
    document.documentElement.classList.add('ca-switch-guard');
    mutate();
    void box.offsetWidth; // Paksa reflow agar 4:3 langsung terkunci

    // ⭐ FIX C: resize video element SINKRON dalam frame yang sama
    try { window.__caLockVideoSizesForce && window.__caLockVideoSizesForce(); } catch(e) {}
    void box.offsetWidth;

    document.documentElement.classList.remove('ca-switch-guard');

    // ⭐ FIX C: sync adaptive layout + chat position (sebelumnya hanya di finish())
    try { window.__caApplyAdaptiveLayout && window.__caApplyAdaptiveLayout(true); } catch(e) {}

    lock.targetMode = targetMode;
    return; // Keluar dari fungsi tanpa memicu animasi View Transition
}

        if (canVT) {
            lock.vtActive = true;
            lock.switchTimerStart = Date.now();
            window.__caVTActive = true;
            box.setAttribute('data-ca-vt-active', '');

            // Mutate dijalankan secara SINKRON (tanpa async/await) agar tidak tertahan
            var vt = document.startViewTransition(mutate);
            vt.finished.finally(finish);
        } else {
            // Fallback universal
            var wrappers = [rvWrapper, lvWrapper, document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui')].filter(Boolean);
            wrappers.forEach(function (w) {
