            });

            requestAnimationFrame(function () {
                mutate();
                void box.offsetWidth;
                wrappers.forEach(function (w) { w.style.setProperty('opacity', '1', 'important'); });
                setTimeout(function () {
                    wrappers.forEach(function (w) {
                        w.style.removeProperty('transition');
                        w.style.removeProperty('opacity');
                    });
                    finish();
                }, 140);
            });
        }
    }

    // ── Detection loop (locked) ──
        var __caCachedVtBox = null;
    function tick() {
        if (lock.vtActive) {
            // Anti-macet
            if (Date.now() - lock.switchTimerStart > 2000) {
                lock.vtActive = false;
                lock.switchTimerStart = 0;
                window.__caVTActive = false;
                var stuck = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
                if (stuck) stuck.removeAttribute('data-ca-vt-active');
            }
            return;
        }

        // ⭐ PERF: Cache element .roulette-box
        if (!__caCachedVtBox || !__caCachedVtBox.isConnected) {
            __caCachedVtBox = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        }
        var box = __caCachedVtBox;

                                                          if (!box || !box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-active')) return;
        // ⭐ FIX D: skip VT switch selama fase boot (grid masih hidden)
        if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-booting')) {
            // ⭐ FIX: Jangan biarkan booting menggantung. Jika sudah >2.5s, paksa lepas.
            if (!window.__caBootStuckTimer) {
                window.__caBootStuckTimer = setTimeout(function() {
                    document.documentElement.classList.remove('ca-cinema3-booting');
                }, 2500);
            }
            return;
        }

   // ✅ FIX: ca-swapped TIDAK block aspect detection.
// Saat mode switch, mutate() otomatis clears ca-swapped (sudah ada di kode).
// Ini mencegah dead-lock saat partner ganti dari landscape→portrait.
        var video = document.getElementById('remote-video');
                if (!video || video.readyState < 1 || !video.videoWidth) return;

        var now = Date.now();
        if (lock.lastMetadataAt && (now - lock.lastMetadataAt) < METADATA_MS) return;

        var pid = (window.__ca && window.__ca.state && window.__ca.state.lastPartnerTransitionAt) || 0;

                if (pid !== lock.partnerId) {
            lock.partnerId = pid;
            lock.targetMode = null;
            lock.pending = null;
        }

        // ⬇️ TAMBAH: reset kalau sudut video berubah (rotate L/R)
        var currentAngle = readAngle(video);
        var lockKey = pid + '_' + currentAngle;
        if (lockKey !== lock.lockKey) {
            lock.lockKey = lockKey;
            lock.targetMode = null;
            lock.pending = null;
        }
        // ⬆️ SELESAI TAMBAH

       // if (lock.targetMode) return; // sudah di-lock untuk partner ini

        var ratio = computeRatio(video);
        var target = null;
        if (ratio > MAX_RATIO) target = 'landscape';
        else if (ratio < MIN_RATIO) target = 'portrait';
        else {
            lock.pending = null;
            return;
        }

        if (!lock.pending || lock.pending.ratio !== target) {
    lock.pending = { ratio: target, since: now };
    // ⭐ FIX B: STABLE_MS=0 → langsung proceed, tidak perlu return prematur
}
if (now - lock.pending.since < STABLE_MS) return;

        lock.targetMode = target;
        lock.pending = null;

                if (target === 'landscape') {
            if (!box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-landscape-mode')) {
                switchModeWithVT('landscape');
            } else {
                // ⭐ FIX: class landscape sudah ada, tapi inline grid bisa saja
                //   STALE (boot-landscape race). Validasi & re-enforce tanpa VT.
                               var __cols = (box.style.gridTemplateColumns || '').trim();
                var __parts = __cols.split(/\s+/);
                var __stale = (__parts.length !== 2);
                if (!__stale) {
                    var __sum = parseFloat(__parts[0]) + parseFloat(__parts[1]);
                    var __expected = window.innerWidth - 36;
                    // ⭐ EDIT 7: toleransi 40 → 4px
                    if (isNaN(__sum) || Math.abs(__sum - __expected) > 4) __stale = true;
                }
                if (__stale) {
                    try {
                        if (window.__caEnforceGridStructure) window.__caEnforceGridStructure();
                        if (window.__caEnforceLayoutOnce) window.__caEnforceLayoutOnce(true);
                    } catch(e) {}
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-landscape-mode')) switchModeWithVT('portrait');
        }
    }
        // ⭐ KICK — panggil tick() segera dari event (loadedmetadata, rotate)
    window.__caVTKick = function() {
        try { tick(); } catch(e) {}
    };


    __caOn250(tick);

    // ── Debug helper ──
    window.__caVTDebug = {
        state: lock,
                reset: function () {
            lock.partnerId = -1;
            lock.targetMode = null;
            lock.pending = null;
            lock.vtActive = false;
            lock.switchTimerStart = 0;
            lock.lastMetadataAt = 0;
            lock.lastMetaW = 0;
            lock.lastMetaH = 0;
            lock.lockKey = '';              // ← TAMBAH
            pendingSwitch = null;
            console.log('[CA-VT] lock reset');
        },
        force: function (mode) {

            lock.targetMode = mode;
            switchModeWithVT(mode);
        }
    };

    console.log('[CA-VT-BRIDGE v1] ✅ Loaded — VT-based aspect switch with per-partner lock');
})();

    function optimizePulse() {

            disp1.setAttribute('scale', targetScale);

            disp2.setAttribute('scale', targetScale2);
        }

// ⭐ FINAL FIX v6 (REVISED) — CSS KEPT, JS FORMULA EXPORTED
//    • CSS anti-glitch + PiP + object-fit : TETAP (static)
//    • Formula grid 4:3 : dipindah ke window.__caEnforceLayoutOnce()
//      → dipanggil SEKALI per switch (bukan 50ms poll)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
(function() {
    'use strict';

    // ─── Expose formula 4:3 untuk dipanggil SEKALI dari VT Bridge ───
    window.__caEnforceLayoutOnce = function(force) {
    var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box.ca-cinema3-active.ca-cinema3-landscape-mode');
    if (!box || !box.isConnected) return;
    if (box.offsetWidth === 0 && !force) return; // Cegah eksekusi saat elemen tersembunyi

        var W = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth;
    var H = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
        if (!W || !H || W < 400 || H < 300) {
        // ⭐ EDIT 4: log + retry lebih panjang (30 frame) — jangan silent fail
        try { console.warn('[CA-ENFORCE] viewport invalid W=' + W + ' H=' + H + ' (retry)'); } catch(e) {}
        if (!window.__caEnforceLayoutRetry) window.__caEnforceLayoutRetry = 0;
        if (window.__caEnforceLayoutRetry < 30) {
            window.__caEnforceLayoutRetry++;
            requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                try { window.__caEnforceLayoutOnce(force); } catch(e) {}
            });
        } else {
            try { console.error('[CA-ENFORCE] GAVE UP after 30 retries — layout will fallback to CSS'); } catch(e) {}
            window.__caEnforceLayoutRetry = 0;
        }
        return;
    }
    window.__caEnforceLayoutRetry = 0;
    var PAD = 12, GAP = 12;
    var vh = H - (PAD * 2);
    var vw = Math.round(vh * (4 / 3));
    var pw = W - (PAD * 2) - GAP - vw;

    if (pw < 320) { pw = 320; vw = W - (PAD * 2) - GAP - pw; }
    if (vw < 100) vw = 100; // ⭐ Cegah nilai minus
    if (pw < 100) pw = 100; // ⭐ Cegah nilai minus

      var isMirrored = box.classList.contains('ca-mirrored') || box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-mirrored');
    var cols = isMirrored ? (vw + 'px ' + pw + 'px') : (pw + 'px ' + vw + 'px');
    box.style.setProperty('grid-template-columns', cols, 'important');
    box.style.setProperty('grid-template-rows', 'minmax(0, 1fr)', 'important'); // ⭐ Tambahan: Kunci 1 baris

    var panel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
    if (panel) {
        panel.style.setProperty('width', pw + 'px', 'important');
        panel.style.setProperty('max-width', pw + 'px', 'important');
        panel.style.setProperty('min-width', pw + 'px', 'important');
        panel.style.setProperty('transform', 'none', 'important');
        panel.style.setProperty('left', 'auto', 'important');
        panel.style.setProperty('right', 'auto', 'important');
        panel.style.removeProperty('height');
        panel.style.removeProperty('max-height');
        panel.style.removeProperty('top');
        panel.style.removeProperty('bottom');
    }

    // ⭐ Pemicu event kustom agar Chatbox & PIP langsung reposisi
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ca-layout-updated'));
};

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [S3-1]  @property fallback — deteksi + matikan animasi sudut
//         (rule dasar sudah pakai var(--a1, 135deg) jadi visual aman;
//          hanya animasi caL1A / caL2A / caL5A yang perlu dimatikan

(function () {
    'use strict';
    if (window.__caSprint3Prop) return;
    window.__caSprint3Prop = true;

    var supports = false;
    try {
        if (window.CSS && typeof CSS.registerProperty === 'function') {
            // Probe sungguhan (nama sementara) — akan throw di stub implementation
            CSS.registerProperty({
                name: '--ca-probe-' + Date.now(),
                syntax: '<angle>',
                initialValue: '0deg',
                inherits: false
            });
            supports = true;
        }
    } catch (e) { supports = false; }

    if (!supports) {
        var s = document.createElement('style');
        s.id = 'ca-s3-property-fallback';
        s.textContent = `
            /* Variabel --aN statis (dipakai rule gradient dasar) */
            #ca-custom-ns-container .ca-gp-l1 { --a1: 135deg !important; }
            #ca-custom-ns-container .ca-gp-l2 { --a2:  45deg !important; }
            #ca-custom-ns-container .ca-gp-l5 { --a5: 160deg !important; }

            /* Matikan animasi sudut — butuh @property untuk interpolasi */
            #ca-custom-ns-container .ca-gp-l1 {
                animation: caL1X 23s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) infinite,
                           caL1Y 17s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) -6s infinite,

                           caL1Transform 13s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) infinite !important;
            }
            #ca-custom-ns-container .ca-gp-l2 {
                animation: caL2X 31s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) -10s infinite,
                           caL2Y 23s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) -14s infinite,
                           caL2Surge 11s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) -3s infinite,
                           caL2Transform 19s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) infinite !important;
            }
            #ca-custom-ns-container .ca-gp-l5 {

                           caL5Y 13s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) -12s infinite,

                           caL5Transform 11s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) infinite !important;
            }
        `;
        (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(s);
        console.log('[CA-S3-1] ⚠️ @property tidak didukung — sudut statis + animasi sudut dimatikan');
    } else {
        console.log('[CA-S3-1] ✅ @property didukung — animasi tetap utuh');
    }
})();

// [S3-2]  Mobile overflow + pointer-event drag
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
(function () {
    'use strict';
    if (window.__caSprint3Mobile) return;
    window.__caSprint3Mobile = true;

    // ── 2a. CSS — layout mobile + target sentuh lebih besar ──
    var s = document.createElement('style');
    s.id = 'ca-s3-mobile';
    s.textContent = `
        @media (max-width: 640px) {
            #my-custom-country-ui {
                max-width: calc(100vw - 16px) !important;
                touch-action: manipulation !important;
                -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch !important;
                overscroll-behavior: contain !important;
            }
            #my-custom-country-ui .ca-country-grid {
                overscroll-behavior: contain !important;
            }
            /* Hit-zone resize lebih besar untuk jari */
            #my-custom-country-ui .ca-resize-edge { width: 14px !important; }
            #my-custom-country-ui .ca-resize-edge-top,
            #my-custom-country-ui .ca-resize-edge-bottom { height: 14px !important; }
            #my-custom-country-ui .ca-resize-corner { width: 32px !important; height: 32px !important; }
            #my-custom-country-ui .ca-resize-corner::after {
                width: 14px !important; height: 14px !important; opacity: .85 !important;
            }
        }
    `;
    (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(s);

    // ── 2b. Drag berbasis pointer untuk touch / pen (jalur mouse tetap) ──
    var __dragAttached = false;

    function attachPointerDrag() {
        var cc = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        if (!cc || __dragAttached) return;
        __dragAttached = true;

        cc.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
            if (e.pointerType === 'mouse') return;              // biarkan mousedown yang urus
            if (e.button !== 0 && e.button !== undefined) return;
            if (window.__caDragState || window.__caResizeState ||
                window.__caScaleState || window.__caVResizeState) return;

            var t = e.target;
            if (t.closest && t.closest(
                'button, input, select, textarea, a, .ca-tab, .ca-block-wrapper, ' +
                '.ca-country-item, .ca-fav-chip, .ca-all-countries-btn, .ca-search-wrapper, ' +
                '.ca-toggle-btn, ' +
                '.ca-sort-btn, .ca-card-btn, .ca-chip-del, .ca-star, .ca-checkbox, ' +
                '.ca-resize-edge, .ca-resize-corner'
            )) return;

            var state = window.__ca && window.__ca.state;
            if (!state) return;

            e.preventDefault();   // cegah mouse event sintetis

            var rect   = cc.getBoundingClientRect();
            var scale  = state.panelScale || 1.0;
            var ox = 0.5, oy = 0.5;
            var parts = (state.panelScaleOrigin || '50% 50%').split(' ');
            if (parts[0]) { var px = parseFloat(parts[0]); if (!isNaN(px)) ox = px / 100; }
            if (parts[1]) { var py = parseFloat(parts[1]); if (!isNaN(py)) oy = py / 100; }

            var baseW = (state.panelWidth  != null) ? state.panelWidth  : Math.round(rect.width  / scale);
            var baseH = cc.offsetHeight || Math.round(rect.height / scale);

            var ds = {
                pid: e.pointerId,
                sx: e.clientX, sy: e.clientY,
                sl: (state.panelLeft != null) ? state.panelLeft : Math.round(rect.left - baseW * (1 - scale) * ox),
                st: (state.panelTop  != null) ? state.panelTop  : Math.round(rect.top  - baseH * (1 - scale) * oy),
                bw: baseW, bh: baseH, sc: scale, ox: ox, oy: oy,
                moved: false
            };

            try { cc.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}

            function move(ev) {
                if (ev.pointerId !== ds.pid) return;
                var dx = (ev.clientX - ds.sx) / ds.sc;
                var dy = (ev.clientY - ds.sy) / ds.sc;
                if (!ds.moved) {
                    if (Math.abs(dx) < 3 && Math.abs(dy) < 3) return;
                    ds.moved = true;
                }

                var nl = ds.sl + dx, nt = ds.st + dy;
                var vL = nl + ds.bw * (1 - ds.sc) * ds.ox;
                var vT = nt + ds.bh * (1 - ds.sc) * ds.oy;
                var vW = ds.bw * ds.sc, vH = ds.bh * ds.sc;
                var PAD = 12;
                if (vL < PAD) nl += PAD - vL;
                else if (vL + vW > window.innerWidth - PAD) nl -= (vL + vW) - (window.innerWidth - PAD);
                if (vT < PAD) nt += PAD - vT;
                else if (vT + vH > window.innerHeight - PAD) nt -= (vT + vH) - (window.innerHeight - PAD);

                state.panelLeft = Math.round(nl);
                state.panelTop  = Math.round(nt);
                cc.style.setProperty('left', nl + 'px', 'important');
                cc.style.setProperty('top',  nt + 'px', 'important');
                cc.style.setProperty('transform', 'translateX(0) scale(' + ds.sc + ')', 'important');
            }

            function end(ev) {
                if (ev.pointerId !== ds.pid) return;
                document.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);
                document.removeEventListener('pointerup', end);
                document.removeEventListener('pointercancel', end);
                try { cc.releasePointerCapture(ds.pid); } catch (err) {}
                if (ds.moved) {
                    try {
                        localStorage.setItem('ca_panel_geometry', JSON.stringify({
                            width:  state.panelWidth,
                            left:   state.panelLeft,
                            top:    state.panelTop,
                            height: state.panelHeight,
                            scale:  state.panelScale
                        }));
                    } catch (err) {}
                }
            }

            document.addEventListener('pointermove', move);
            document.addEventListener('pointerup',   end);
            document.addEventListener('pointercancel', end);
        }, { passive: false });
    }

    // ── 2c. Safety — perkecil scale panel kalau overflow viewport mobile ──
    function clampMobileViewport() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 640) return;
        var cc = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        if (!cc || cc.style.display === 'none') return;
        var state = window.__ca && window.__ca.state;
        if (!state) return;

        var bw = state.panelWidth  || 470;
        var sc = state.panelScale  || 1.0;
        var vw = bw * sc;

        if (vw > window.innerWidth - 16) {
            var newSc = (window.innerWidth - 16) / bw;
            if (newSc < 0.30) newSc = 0.30;
            if (newSc > 1.00) newSc = 1.00;
            state.panelScale = Math.round(newSc * 100) / 100;
            cc.style.setProperty('transform', 'translateX(-50%) scale(' + state.panelScale + ')', 'important');
            cc.style.setProperty('transform-origin', state.panelScaleOrigin || '50% 0%', 'important');
        }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            attachPointerDrag();
            clampMobileViewport();
        });
    } else {
        attachPointerDrag();
        clampMobileViewport();
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', clampMobileViewport, { passive: true });
    window.__caOn5000(attachPointerDrag);
    window.__caOn2000(clampMobileViewport);

    console.log('[CA-S3-2] ✅ Mobile overflow guard + pointer-drag (touch/pen) aktif');
})();

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [S3-3]  BUG #10 — Tab trap (soft escape di boundary)
//         Hanya aktif kalau: panel visible DAN bukan autoNav
//         DAN bukan Cinema 3-col (jalur itu sudah pegang Tab via kbCycleTab)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
(function () {
    'use strict';
    if (window.__caSprint3Tab) return;
    window.__caSprint3Tab = true;

    var FOCUS_SEL =
    'input:not([type="hidden"]):not([disabled]), ' +
    'textarea:not([disabled]), ' +
    'select:not([disabled]), ' +
    'button:not([disabled]), ' +
    '[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"]), ' +
    '.ca-tab, .ca-block-wrapper, .ca-country-item, .ca-fav-chip, ' +
    '.ca-all-countries-btn, .ca-sort-btn, .ca-card-btn';

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
        if (e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || e.metaKey) return;

        var cc = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        if (!cc || cc.style.display === 'none') return;

        // Sudah diurus jalur lain
        if (window.__caKbAutoNav) return;
        if (document.querySelector('.roulette-box.ca-cinema3-active')) return;

        var ae = document.activeElement;
        if (!ae || !cc.contains(ae)) return;
        if (typeof window.__ca.caIsChatElement === 'function' && window.__ca.caIsChatElement(ae)) return;

        // Input search punya handling Tab sendiri (kbCycleTab)
        if (ae.closest && ae.closest('.ca-search-wrapper')) return;

        var all = cc.querySelectorAll(FOCUS_SEL);
        var vis = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
            if (all[i].offsetParent !== null) vis.push(all[i]);
        }
        if (vis.length === 0) return;

        var idx = vis.indexOf(ae);

        // ── Soft escape di boundary ──
        if (!e.shiftKey && idx === vis.length - 1) return;  // terakhir → biarkan Tab keluar
        if (e.shiftKey  && idx === 0)              return;  // pertama → biarkan Shift+Tab keluar

        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

        var next;
        if (idx === -1) {
            next = e.shiftKey ? vis.length - 1 : 0;
        } else {
            next = e.shiftKey
                ? (idx - 1 + vis.length) % vis.length
                : (idx + 1) % vis.length;
        }
        try { vis[next].focus(); } catch (err) {}
    }, true);

    console.log('[CA-S3-3] ✅ Tab trap dipoles (soft escape di boundary)');
})();

    // JS — paksa feDisplacementMap scale = 0 (asuransi murah)
    function neutralizeSVG() {
        var svg = document.getElementById('ca-svg-defs');
        if (!svg) return;

// [S4-4]  Toast race fix — min-show delay + dedup
//         Intercept appendChild/removeChild di root untuk mencegah
//         toast pengganti memotong toast yang belum MIN_SHOW_MS.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [S4-5]  Watchdog edge polish
//         • Reset repairs counter saat user ganti device (mencegah false-fail)
//         • Fail toast setelah repairs>=3 (throttled 30s)
//         • Log state detail untuk debug
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
(function () {
    'use strict';
    if (window.__caS4Watchdog) return;
    window.__caS4Watchdog = true;

    var FAIL_THROTTLE_MS = (window.__caConst && window.__caConst.WATCHDOG.FAIL_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS) || 30000;
    var lastFailToastAt  = 0;

    // Reset repair counters on manual device switch
       try {
        var W = typeof unsafeWindow !== 'undefined' ? unsafeWindow : window;
        W.addEventListener('msc-device-switched', function () {
            // ⭐ FIX #3: pakai live reference (snapshot copy dihapus — useless)
            if (window.__caAudioWatchdog) window.__caAudioWatchdog.repairs = 0;
            if (window.__caVideoWatchdog) window.__caVideoWatchdog.repairs = 0;
            console.log('[CA-S4-5] repairs reset on device switch');
        });
    } catch (e) {}

    // Periodic fail detection → single throttled toast
        if (window.__caOn2000) {
        window.__caOn2000(function () {
            var aw = window.__caAudioWatchdog;
            var vw = window.__caVideoWatchdog;
            // ⭐ FIX #4: tambah `active` guard — cegah toast saat device sengaja dimatikan
            var awDead = aw && aw.active && aw.repairs >= 3 && !aw.repairing;
            var vwDead = vw && vw.active && vw.repairs >= 3 && !vw.repairing;
            if (!awDead && !vwDead) return;

            var now = Date.now();
            if (now - lastFailToastAt < FAIL_THROTTLE_MS) return;
            lastFailToastAt = now;

            var msg = (awDead && vwDead) ? '🎤🎥 Device lost — reconnect'
                    : awDead            ? '🎤 Mic lost — reconnect'
                    :                     '🎥 Cam lost — reconnect';
            try {
                if (typeof window.__ca?.showIndicator === 'function') {
                    window.__ca.showIndicator(msg, '#dc2626');
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        });
    }

    // Diagnostic helper
    window.__caWatchdogDiag = function () {
        return {
            audio: window.__caAudioWatchdog || null,
            video: window.__caVideoWatchdog || null,
            lastFailToastAt: lastFailToastAt
        };
    };

    console.log('[CA-S4-5] ✅ Watchdog edge polish active (reset + fail toast)');
})();

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [S4-6]  Cinema mode mutual exclusion
//         Normal Cinema ↔ 3-Col Cinema tidak bisa aktif bersamaan.
//         Entry ke salah satu mode memaksa exit yang lain dulu.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
(function () {
    'use strict';
    if (window.__caS4CinemaDedup) return;
    window.__caS4CinemaDedup = true;

    function currentMode() {
        var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        if (!box) return 'off';
        if (box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-active')) return '3col';
        if (box.classList.contains('ca-cinema-active'))  return 'normal';
        return 'off';
    }

            function forceExit3Col(cb) {
        try { localStorage.setItem('ca_cinema3_v9_enabled', '0'); } catch (e) {}
        var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        var panel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
                        if (box) {
            box.classList.remove('ca-cinema3-active', 'ca-cinema3-landscape-mode',
                                 'ca-mirrored', 'ca-cinema3-mirrored', 'ca-swapped');
            box.style.removeProperty('grid-template-columns');
            box.style.removeProperty('grid-template-rows');   // ← NEW

            // ⭐ FIX DELAY: Paksa tombol native muncul seketika
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-ca-cinema-hidden="true"]').forEach(function(el) {
                el.style.removeProperty('display');
                el.style.removeProperty('visibility');
                el.style.removeProperty('opacity');
                el.style.removeProperty('pointer-events');
                el.style.removeProperty('width');
                el.style.removeProperty('height');
                el.style.removeProperty('position');
                el.style.removeProperty('z-index');
                delete el.dataset.caCinemaHidden;
            });
        }
        if (panel) {
            panel.classList.remove('ca-cinema3-docked', 'ca-mirrored-panel', 'ca-cinema3-mirrored');
            panel.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); // ⭐ Tutup Panel
            if (window.__ca && typeof window.__ca.caHideTooltip === 'function') window.__ca.caHideTooltip(); // ⭐ Hapus Bubble
            if (window.__ca && window.__ca.caDisableAutoNav) window.__ca.caDisableAutoNav();
        }
        try { window.__caCinemaLock = false; } catch (e) {}
        if (typeof cb === 'function') setTimeout(cb, 60);
    }

    function forceExitNormal(cb) {
        var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        var btn = document.getElementById('ca-cinema-btn');
        if (box) box.classList.remove('ca-cinema-active');
        var bar = document.querySelector('.ca-custom-cinema-bar');
        if (bar) bar.remove();
        if (btn && btn.innerText !== 'Cinema') {
            try { btn.innerText = 'Cinema'; } catch (e) {}
        }
        if (typeof cb === 'function') setTimeout(cb, 60);
    }

    // Hook entry buttons (capture phase — before handlers fire)
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var t = e.target;
        if (!t || !t.closest) return;

        var normalBtn  = t.closest('#ca-cinema-btn');
        var threeColBtn = t.closest('#ca-cinema3-toggle-btn');
        var cur = currentMode();

        if (normalBtn && cur === '3col') {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            forceExit3Col(function () { try { normalBtn.click(); } catch (err) {} });
            return;
        }
        if (threeColBtn && cur === 'normal') {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            forceExitNormal(function () { try { threeColBtn.click(); } catch (err) {} });
            return;
        }
    }, true);

    function getMirrorState() {
        try { return W.mirrorState || null; } catch (e) { return null; }
    }

    function isFlipActive() {
        try { return !!(W.__caFlipState && W.__caFlipState.active); } catch (e) { return false; }
    }

    function getCanvasTrack() {
        var ms = getMirrorState();
        if (!ms) return null;
        var t = ms.canvasTrack;
        if (t && t.readyState === 'live') return t;
        return null;
    }

    function substituteVideoSender(pc, context) {
        if (!isFlipActive()) return;
        var canvasTrack = getCanvasTrack();
        if (!canvasTrack) return;

        try {
            var senders = pc.getSenders();
            for (var i = 0; i < senders.length; i++) {
                var s = senders[i];
                if (!s.track || s.track.kind !== 'video') continue;
                if (s.track === canvasTrack) continue;

                console.log('[CA-FLIP-PRE] 🔒 substitute @ ' + context);
                s.replaceTrack(canvasTrack).catch(function (e) {
                    console.warn('[CA-FLIP-PRE] replaceTrack fail @ ' + context + ':', e);
                });
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[CA-FLIP-PRE] ' + context + ':', e);
        }
    }

    function patchProto() {
        var RTC = W.RTCPeerConnection;
        var Sender = W.RTCRtpSender;
        var patchedAny = false;

        if (RTC && RTC.prototype && !RTC.prototype.__caFlipPreconnectPatched) {
            RTC.prototype.__caFlipPreconnectPatched = true;

            // ── 1. addTrack → substitute SEBELUM SDP ──
            var origAddTrack = RTC.prototype.addTrack;
            if (origAddTrack) {
                RTC.prototype.addTrack = function (track, stream) {
                    if (track && track.kind === 'video' && isFlipActive()) {
                        var ct = getCanvasTrack();
                        if (ct && track !== ct) {
                            console.log('[CA-FLIP-PRE] 🔒 addTrack → canvas');
                            return origAddTrack.call(this, ct, stream);
                        }
                    }
                    return origAddTrack.apply(this, arguments);
                };
            }

            // ── 2. addTransceiver → substitute SEBELUM SDP ──
            var origAddTransceiver = RTC.prototype.addTransceiver;
            if (origAddTransceiver) {
                RTC.prototype.addTransceiver = function (trackOrKind, init) {
                    if (trackOrKind && (trackOrKind.kind === 'video' || trackOrKind === 'video') && isFlipActive()) {
                        var ct = getCanvasTrack();
                        if (ct && trackOrKind !== ct) {
                            console.log('[CA-FLIP-PRE] 🔒 addTransceiver → canvas');
                            return origAddTransceiver.call(this, ct, init);
                        }
                    }
                    return origAddTransceiver.apply(this, arguments);
                };
            }

            // ── 3. setLocalDescription → safety net ──
            var origSetLocal = RTC.prototype.setLocalDescription;
            if (origSetLocal) {
                RTC.prototype.setLocalDescription = function () {
                    var self = this;
                    var result = origSetLocal.apply(this, arguments);
                    substituteVideoSender(self, 'setLocalDescription');
                    if (result && result.then) {
                        result.then(function () {
                            substituteVideoSender(self, 'setLocalDescription.done');
                        }).catch(function () {});
                    }
                    return result;
                };
            }

            // ── 4. setRemoteDescription → safety net ──
            var origSetRemote = RTC.prototype.setRemoteDescription;
            if (origSetRemote) {
                RTC.prototype.setRemoteDescription = function () {
                    var self = this;
                    var result = origSetRemote.apply(this, arguments);
                    substituteVideoSender(self, 'setRemoteDescription');
                    if (result && result.then) {
                        result.then(function () {
                            substituteVideoSender(self, 'setRemoteDescription.done');
                        }).catch(function () {});
                    }
                    return result;
                };
            }
            patchedAny = true;
        }

        // ── 5. RTCRtpSender.prototype.replaceTrack → KUNCI UTAMA OME.TV ──
        if (Sender && Sender.prototype && !Sender.prototype.__caFlipPreconnectPatched) {
            Sender.prototype.__caFlipPreconnectPatched = true;
            var origReplaceTrack = Sender.prototype.replaceTrack;
            if (origReplaceTrack) {
                Sender.prototype.replaceTrack = function (track) {
                    if (track && track.kind === 'video' && isFlipActive()) {
                        var ct = getCanvasTrack();
                        if (ct && track !== ct) {
                            console.log('[CA-FLIP-PRE] 🔒 sender.replaceTrack → canvas');
                            return origReplaceTrack.call(this, ct);
                        }
                    }
                    return origReplaceTrack.apply(this, arguments);
                };
            }
            patchedAny = true;
        }

        if (patchedAny) {
            console.log('[CA-FLIP-PRE v2] ✅ RTCPeerConnection + RTCRtpSender patched');
        }
        return patchedAny;
    }

    // Patch segera; retry kalau RTC belum ready
    if (!patchProto()) {
        var tries = 0;
        var iv = setInterval(function () {
            tries++;
            if (patchProto() || tries > 100) clearInterval(iv);
        }, 50);
    }

    W.addEventListener('msc-rtc-created', function (ev) {
        var pc = ev.detail && ev.detail.pc;
        if (!pc) return;
        pc.addEventListener('connectionstatechange', function () {
            if (pc.connectionState === 'connected' && isFlipActive()) {
                substituteVideoSender(pc, 'connected-safety-net');
            }
        });
    });

    console.log('[CA-FLIP-PRE v2] ✅ Pre-connect flip substitution active');
})();

    function extractASN(org) {
        if (!org) return null;

        return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : null;

    function getAsnName(org) {
        return org ? String(org).replace(/^AS\d+\s+/, '').trim() : '';

        var VPN_ASNS_SET = new Set([9009, 62240, 202425, 209854, 216071]);

    // ⭐ PATCH G.2: Cloudflare WARP detection helper
    // WARP exit ranges (Cloudflare docs 2024): 104.28.x, 172.71.x, 162.158.10-11.x
    function isCloudflareWARP(ip) {
        if (!ip || ip.indexOf(':') !== -1) return false;   // IPv4 only
        var warpPrefixes = ['104.28.', '172.71.', '162.158.10.', '162.158.11.'];
        for (var i = 0; i < warpPrefixes.length; i++) {
            if (ip.indexOf(warpPrefixes[i]) === 0) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

function classifyASN(asn, asnName) {
    // ⭐ FIX: inline VPN ASN check — tidak butuh VPN_ASNS_SET eksternal
    // VPN providers: M247(9009), Clouvider(62240), IP Volume(202425),
    //                Fly.io(209854), Serverwise(216071)
    if (asn === 9009 || asn === 62240 || asn === 202425 ||
        asn === 209854 || asn === 216071) {
        return { type: 'vpn', source: 'asn-blacklist', asn: asn };
    }
    // Hosting/cloud/vps ASN
    if (asn && HOSTING_VPN_ASNS.has(asn)) {
        return { type: 'hosting', source: 'asn-blacklist', asn: asn };
    }
    // Fallback: name-based
    if (asnName) {
        for (var i = 0; i < ASN_NAME_VPN_PATTERNS.length; i++) {
            if (ASN_NAME_VPN_PATTERNS[i].test(asnName)) {
                return { type: 'vpn', source: 'asn-name-vpn', asn: asn };
            }
        }
        for (var j = 0; j < ASN_NAME_HOSTING_PATTERNS.length; j++) {
            if (ASN_NAME_HOSTING_PATTERNS[j].test(asnName)) {
                return { type: 'hosting', source: 'asn-name-hosting', asn: asn };
            }
        }
        // ⭐ PATCH H.1: recognize ISP names → 'isp' (prevents UNKNOWN-ASN +15 false positive)
        if (/\b(telecom|telekom|telco|broadband|fiber|ftth|dsl|cable|mobile|cellular|wireless|communications?|networks?|telephone|dacom|pldt|converge|globe|smart|telstra|optus|vodafone|telenor|kt corp|lg uplus)\b/i.test(asnName)) {
            return { type: 'isp', source: 'asn-name-isp', asn: asn };
        }
    }
    return null;
}

    function checkLanguageMismatch(countryCode) {
        if (!countryCode) return null;
        var cc = String(countryCode).toLowerCase();
        if (HIGHLY_MULTILINGUAL.has(cc)) return null;  // skip false positive

        var expected = COUNTRY_LANGUAGES[cc];
        if (!expected || expected.length === 0) return null;

        var browserLangs = [];
        try {
            if (navigator.languages && navigator.languages.length) {
                browserLangs = Array.prototype.slice.call(navigator.languages).map(function(l) {
                    return String(l).split('-')[0].toLowerCase();
                });
            } else if (navigator.language) {
                browserLangs = [String(navigator.language).split('-')[0].toLowerCase()];
            }
        } catch(e) { return null; }

        if (browserLangs.length === 0) return null;

        // 'en' selalu dianggap netral (banyak orang pakai English UI)
        var hasCommon = browserLangs.some(function(bl) {
            return bl === 'en' || expected.indexOf(bl) !== -1;
        });
        if (hasCommon) return null;

        return {
            mismatch: true,
            browserLangs: browserLangs, expected: expected, country: cc
        };
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 🔍 Reverse DNS via Google DoH
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function reverseDNSLookup(ip, callback) {
        if (!ip || typeof GM_xmlhttpRequest !== 'function') { callback(null); return; }
        var reverse;
        var m = String(ip).match(/^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)$/);
        if (m) {
            reverse = m[4] + '.' + m[3] + '.' + m[2] + '.' + m[1] + '.in-addr.arpa';
        } else if (ip.indexOf(':') !== -1) {
            // ⭐ PATCH D.3: IPv6 → nibble reverse arpa
            var v6 = String(ip).split('%')[0].toLowerCase();
            var expanded = '';
            if (v6.indexOf('::') === -1) {
                var segs = v6.split(':');
                while (segs.length < 8) segs.push('0');
                expanded = segs.map(function(g){ return ('0000'+g).slice(-4); }).join('');
            } else {
                var halves = v6.split('::');
                var left = halves[0] ? halves[0].split(':') : [];
                var right = halves.length > 1 && halves[1] ? halves[1].split(':') : [];
                var missing = 8 - (left.length + right.length);
                if (missing < 0) missing = 0;
                var middle = [];
                for (var mi = 0; mi < missing; mi++) middle.push('0');
                expanded = left.concat(middle, right).map(function(g){ return ('0000'+g).slice(-4); }).join('');
            }
            reverse = expanded.split('').reverse().join('.') + '.ip6.arpa';
        } else {
            callback(null);
            return;
        }

    var settled = false;
    // ⭐ FIX #5: safety timer 3000 → 4200 (harus > inner timeout 3500 + buffer)
    var timer = setTimeout(function() {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true; callback(null);
    }, 4200);

    try {
        GM_xmlhttpRequest({
            method: 'GET',
            url: 'https://dns.google/resolve?name=' + encodeURIComponent(reverse) + '&type=PTR',
            timeout: 3500,   // ⭐ FIX #5: 2500 → 3500 (ISP DNS lambat coverage)
                onload: function(r) {
                    if (settled) return;
                    settled = true; clearTimeout(timer);
                    try {
                        var d = JSON.parse(r.responseText);
                        var ptrs = (d.Answer || [])
                            .filter(function(a) { return a.type === 12; })
                            .map(function(a) { return a.data; });
                        callback(ptrs.length ? ptrs : null);
                    } catch(e) { callback(null); }
                },
                onerror:   function() { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); callback(null); },
                ontimeout: function() { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); callback(null); }
            });
        } catch(e) { if (!settled) { settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); callback(null); } }
    }

        // ⭐ FIX 1.2 (Patch A.1): helper module-scope — recalc level + label dari score
    // Sebelumnya nested di rDNS callback. Sekarang bisa dipakai initial score + callback.
    function _caRecalcLevel(info) {
        if (!info) return;
        var sc = info.advVpnScore || 0;
        info.advVpnLevel = sc >= 50 ? 'high' : sc >= 30 ? 'medium' : sc > 0 ? 'low' : 'clean';
        info.advVpnLabel = sc >= 50 ? '🔴 VPN HOSTING/VPN ASN TERDETEKSI'
                         : sc >= 30 ? '🟠 SUSPICIOUS ASN/TZ'
                         : sc > 0   ? '🟡 MINOR SIGNAL'
                         :             '🟢 CLEAN';
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 🔬 ANALYSIS: IP publik → skor VPN lanjutan
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function analyzeIPAdvanced(ip, info) {
        if (!info || info.advVpnScore !== undefined) return;
        var score = 0;
        var signals = [];

        // ⭐ PATCH G.2: Cloudflare WARP check (independen dari org ASN)
        if (isCloudflareWARP(ip)) {
            info.asnType = 'vpn';
            info.asnName = info.asnName || 'Cloudflare WARP';
            score += 50;
            signals.push({ tag: 'CLOUDFLARE-WARP', delta: 50 });
        }

        var orgStr = info.org || info.isp || '';
        if (orgStr) {
            var asn = extractASN(orgStr);
            var asnName = getAsnName(orgStr);
            info.asn = asn;
            info.asnName = asnName;
            var cls = classifyASN(asn, asnName);
            // ⭐ PATCH I.1: UNKNOWN-ASN hanya kalau asn benar-benar null (tidak terdeteksi)
            // Kalau asn ada angkanya, partner adalah user jaringan nyata — bukan indikasi VPN
            if (!asn && !cls && info.ispType === 'unknown') {
                score += 15; signals.push({ tag: 'UNKNOWN-ASN', delta: 15 });
            }
            if (cls) {
                info.asnType = cls.type;
                if (cls.type === 'hosting')  { score += 35; signals.push({ tag: 'HOSTING-ASN', delta: 35 }); }
                else if (cls.type === 'vpn') { score += 50; signals.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN',     delta: 50 }); }
            }
        }

    info.advVpnScore = Math.min(100, score);
    info.advSignals = signals;
    _caRecalcLevel(info);   // ⭐ FIX Patch B: pakai helper module-scope

    // ⭐ PATCH F: kalau ASN tidak ada di org string → async lookupASN (Team Cymru + ipinfo fallback)
    if (!asn && W.__caVpnEnhancedAPI && typeof W.__caVpnEnhancedAPI.lookupASN === 'function') {
        W.__caVpnEnhancedAPI.lookupASN(ip, function(asnData) {
            if (!asnData || !asnData.asn) return;
            var aNum = parseInt(asnData.asn, 10);
            if (isNaN(aNum)) return;
            var aName = asnData.name || '';
            var aType = asnData.type || null;
            var cls = aType ? { type: aType } : classifyASN(aNum, aName);
            if (!cls) return;

            info.asn = aNum;
            info.asnName = aName;
            info.asnType = cls.type;

            // Remove provisional UNKNOWN-ASN
            if (info.advSignals) {
                info.advSignals = info.advSignals.filter(function(x) { return x.tag !== 'UNKNOWN-ASN'; });
            }
            if (!info.advSignals) info.advSignals = [];

            // Add proper signal
            if (cls.type === 'hosting' && !info.advSignals.some(function(x){return x.tag==='HOSTING-ASN';})) {
                info.advSignals.push({ tag: 'HOSTING-ASN', delta: 35 });
            } else if (cls.type === 'vpn' && !info.advSignals.some(function(x){return x.tag==='VPN-ASN';})) {
                info.advSignals.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN', delta: 50 });
            }

            // Recompute score dari signals (jangan tinggalkan UNKNOWN-ASN +15)
            var newScore = 0;
            for (var si = 0; si < info.advSignals.length; si++) newScore += (info.advSignals[si].delta || 0);
            info.advVpnScore = Math.min(100, newScore);
            _caRecalcLevel(info);

            try { W.__caUnifiedVerdictRefresh && W.__caUnifiedVerdictRefresh(); } catch(e) {}
            try { scheduleBadgeRender(); } catch(e) {}
            try { W.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ca-ip-ready')); } catch(e) {}
        });
    }

reverseDNSLookup(ip, function(ptrs) {
    // ⭐ JIKA rDNS KOSONG TOTAL (Sangat umum untuk VPS murah / Smart Link)
if (!ptrs || !ptrs.length) {
    // ⭐ PATCH I.2: skip NO-RDNS kalau ASN sudah diketahui (bukan anonymous)
    // Kalau asn terisi = jaringan nyata, PTR kosong itu normal di banyak ISP
    var _knownISP = (
        info.ispType === 'fixed' ||
        info.ispType === 'mobile' ||
        info.asnType === 'isp' ||
        info.asnType === 'hosting' ||   // signal sendiri sudah ada

        info.advVpnScore = Math.min(100, (info.advVpnScore || 0) + 15);

        _caRecalcLevel(info);
    }
    try { W.__caUnifiedVerdictRefresh && W.__caUnifiedVerdictRefresh(); } catch(e) {}
    try { scheduleBadgeRender(); } catch(e) {}
    try { W.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ca-ip-ready')); } catch(e) {}
    return;
}

    info.reverseDns = ptrs;
    var s = ptrs.join(' ').toLowerCase();

    // 1. Cek VPN komersial
// (_caRecalcLevel sudah di module scope — lihat Patch A.1)
if (/\b(vpn|proxy|m247|nord|surfshark|expressvpn|cyberghost|ipvanish|mullvad|private internet|torguard|windscribe|protonvpn|purevpn|hidemyass)\b/.test(s)) {
    info.advVpnScore = Math.min(100, (info.advVpnScore || 0) + 25);
    info.advSignals = (info.advSignals || []).concat([{ tag: 'RDNS-VPN', delta: 25 }]);
    _caRecalcLevel(info);                                    // ⭐ FIX
    try { W.__caUnifiedVerdictRefresh && W.__caUnifiedVerdictRefresh(); } catch(e) {}
    try { scheduleBadgeRender(); } catch(e) {}
    try { W.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ca-ip-ready')); } catch(e) {}
}
else if (!/\b(dsl|dynamic|ppp|broadband|fiber|ftth|cable|client|user|home|adsl|vdsl|static|ip|pool|cust)\b/.test(s)) {
    info.advVpnScore = Math.min(100, (info.advVpnScore || 0) + 15);      // ⭐ FIX
    info.advSignals = (info.advSignals || []).concat([{ tag: 'RDNS-NON-RESIDENTIAL', delta: 15 }]);
    _caRecalcLevel(info);                                    // ⭐ FIX
    try { W.__caUnifiedVerdictRefresh && W.__caUnifiedVerdictRefresh(); } catch(e) {}
    try { scheduleBadgeRender(); } catch(e) {}
    try { W.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ca-ip-ready')); } catch(e) {}
}
});
    }


    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 🔬 ANALYSIS: Relay IP → cek apakah TURN server di hosting ASN
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function analyzeRelayIP(ip, info) {
        if (!info || !ip) return;
        info.relayAnalysis = { ip: ip, loading: true };

        var token = '';
        try {
            if (typeof GM_getValue === 'function') token = GM_getValue('ca_ipinfo_token', '') || '';
            if (!token) { try { token = localStorage.getItem('ca_ipinfo_token') || ''; } catch(e) {} }
        } catch(e) {}
        token = String(token).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 32);

        var url = token
            ? 'https://ipinfo.io/' + ip + '/json?token=' + encodeURIComponent(token)
            : 'https://ipinfo.io/' + ip + '/json';

        if (typeof GM_xmlhttpRequest !== 'function') {
            info.relayAnalysis.loading = false;
            return;
        }

        GM_xmlhttpRequest({
            method: 'GET', url: url, timeout: 3000,
            onload: function(r) {
                try {
                    var d = JSON.parse(r.responseText);
                    if (!d || d.error) { info.relayAnalysis.loading = false; return; }

                    var asn = extractASN(d.org);
                    var asnName = getAsnName(d.org);
                    var asnClass = classifyASN(asn, asnName);

// ⭐ FIX P1: whitelist TURN legal — Cloudflare/AWS/GCP/Azure/Akamai
var _isSuspicious = !!(asnClass && (asnClass.type === 'hosting' || asnClass.type === 'vpn'));
var _isLegitTurn  = !!(asn && LEGIT_TURN_ASNS.has(asn));
if (_isSuspicious && _isLegitTurn) _isSuspicious = false;
info.relayAnalysis = {
    ip: ip, asn: asn, asnName: asnName,
    asnType: asnClass ? asnClass.type : 'unknown',
    isSuspiciousRelay: _isSuspicious,
    legitTurn: _isLegitTurn,
    loading: false
};

                    // ⭐ PATCH G.1: append signals, JANGAN overwrite (cegah downgrade Tor → relay)
                    if (!info.advSignals) info.advSignals = [];

                    if (info.relayAnalysis.isSuspiciousRelay) {
                        if (!info.advSignals.some(function(x){return x.tag==='SUSPICIOUS-RELAY';})) {
                            info.advSignals.push({
                                tag: 'SUSPICIOUS-RELAY', delta: 40,
                                detail: 'TURN on ' + asnClass.type + ' AS' + asn
                            });
                            info.advVpnScore = Math.min(100, (info.advVpnScore || 0) + 40);
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (!info.advSignals.some(function(x){return x.tag==='LEGIT-RELAY';})) {
                            info.advSignals.push({ tag: 'LEGIT-RELAY', delta: 0, detail: 'TURN on legit AS' + asn });
                        }
                        // Score tetap — jangan force 0
                    }
                    _caRecalcLevel(info);
                    scheduleBadgeRender();
                } catch(e) { info.relayAnalysis.loading = false; }
            },
            onerror:   function() { info.relayAnalysis.loading = false; },
            ontimeout: function() { info.relayAnalysis.loading = false; }
        });
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 🎨 RENDER: Badge di floating box
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function renderAdvBadge() {
        // ⭐ Batch C-2: skip adv badge kalau unified verdict sudah render (cegah duplikasi + kontradiksi)
    var content = document.getElementById('ca-float-content');
    if (content && content.querySelector('.ca-unified-verdict')) return;

        var content = document.getElementById('ca-float-content');
        if (!content || content.children.length === 0) return;

        var caState = W.__ca && W.__ca.state;
        var info = caState && caState.currentIPInfo;
        if (!info || !info.advVpnLabel) return;

        // Remove existing badge (idempotent re-render)
        var existing = content.querySelector('.ca-adv-vpn-badge');
        if (existing) existing.remove();

        var colors = {
            high:   { bg: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.18)',   border: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.5)'  },
            medium: { bg: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.18)',  border: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.5)' },
            low:    { bg: 'rgba(251,191,36,0.18)',  border: 'rgba(251,191,36,0.5)' },
            clean:  { bg: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.18)',  border: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.5)' }
        };
        var c = colors[info.advVpnLevel] || colors.clean;

        var badge = document.createElement('div');
        badge.className = 'ca-adv-vpn-badge';
        badge.style.cssText =
            'margin-top:8px;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:10px;' +
            'font-weight:700;line-height:1.35;text-align:center;color:#fff;' +
            'background:' + c.bg + ';border:1px solid ' + c.border + ';';

        var html = '<div style="font-size:11px;">' + info.advVpnLabel + '</div>';

        if (info.advSignals && info.advSignals.length > 0) {
            html += '<div style="margin-top:4px;font-size:9px;opacity:0.85;font-weight:500;">' +
                info.advSignals.map(function(s) {
                    return '<span style="display:inline-block;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.25);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;margin:1px;">' +
                        s.tag + '</span>';
                }).join('') + '</div>';
        }

        if (info.asn) {
            html += '<div style="margin-top:3px;font-size:9px;opacity:0.7;font-family:monospace;">' +
    'AS' + info.asn + ' · ' + W.escHtmlCA((info.asnName || '').substring(0, 24)) + '</div>';
        }
        if (info.reverseDns && info.reverseDns.length > 0) {
            html += '<div style="margin-top:2px;font-size:8px;opacity:0.6;font-family:monospace;">' +
    'PTR: ' + W.escHtmlCA(info.reverseDns[0].substring(0, 32)) + '</div>';
        }
        if (info.relayAnalysis && info.relayAnalysis.asn) {
            html += '<div style="margin-top:3px;font-size:9px;opacity:0.7;">' +
                '🌐 Relay: AS' + info.relayAnalysis.asn + ' (' + info.relayAnalysis.asnType + ')</div>';
        }

        badge.innerHTML = html;
        content.appendChild(badge);
    }

        var __badgeTimer = null;
    function scheduleBadgeRender() {
        if (__badgeTimer) clearTimeout(__badgeTimer);
        __badgeTimer = setTimeout(function() {
            __badgeTimer = null;
            try { renderAdvBadge(); } catch(e) {}
        }, 100);

        // ⭐ NEW: dedicated event — cakup relay, rDNS, lookupASN callback
        //    Loop-safe: 'ca-vpn-updated' TIDAK memicu onIPReady/Fase3/analyzeRelayIP
        try {
            W.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ca-vpn-updated', {
                detail: {
                    ip: (W.__ca && W.__ca.state && W.__ca.state.currentIP) || '',
                    reason: 'schedule-badge'
                }
            }));
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 🎧 TRIGGER: dengarkan ca-ip-ready
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    W.addEventListener('ca-ip-ready', function(ev) {
        var detail = ev.detail || {};
        var ip = detail.ip;
        if (!ip) return;

        var caState = W.__ca && W.__ca.state;
        if (!caState) return;
        var info = caState.currentIPInfo;
        if (!info) return;

        try {
            if (info.isRelay) {
                if (!info.relayAnalysis) analyzeRelayIP(ip, info);
                        } else {
                if (info.advVpnScore === undefined && typeof analyzeIPAdvanced === 'function') {
                    analyzeIPAdvanced(ip, info);
                }
            }
            scheduleBadgeRender();

            // Debug log
            try {
                console.log(
                    '%c[CA-ADV-VPN] ' + (info.advVpnLabel || '—') +
                    ' (score ' + (info.advVpnScore || 0) + ')',
                    'color:' + ({
                        high: '#ef4444', medium: '#f59e0b',
                        low: '#fbbf24', clean: '#10b981'
                    }[info.advVpnLevel] || '#94a3b8') + ';font-weight:bold'
                );
            } catch(e) {}
        } catch(e) { console.warn('[CA-ADV-VPN] error:', e); }
    });

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 🛟 SAFETY NET: re-analyze jika info diganti (enrich) & re-render
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (window.__caOn1000) {
        window.__caOn1000(function() {
            var caState = W.__ca && W.__ca.state;
            var info = caState && caState.currentIPInfo;
            if (!info) return;

            // Info diganti oleh enrich (field adv hilang) → re-analyze
            if (info.isRelay) {
                if (!info.relayAnalysis) analyzeRelayIP(caState.currentIP, info);
            } else {
                                if (info.advVpnScore === undefined && caState.currentIP && typeof analyzeIPAdvanced === 'function') {
                    analyzeIPAdvanced(caState.currentIP, info);
                }
            }

            // Pastikan badge selalu muncul
            var content = document.getElementById('ca-float-content');
            if (content && content.children.length > 0) {
                if (!content.querySelector('.ca-adv-vpn-badge') && info.advVpnLabel) {
                    renderAdvBadge();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 🔓 Public API
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    W.__caAdvVpn = {
        version: '2.0',
        classifyASN: classifyASN,
        checkLanguageMismatch: checkLanguageMismatch,
        reverseDNSLookup: reverseDNSLookup,
        hostingAsns: HOSTING_VPN_ASNS,
        analyzeCurrent: function() {
            var caState = W.__ca && W.__ca.state;
            if (!caState || !caState.currentIPInfo) return null;
            var i = caState.currentIPInfo;
            return {
                ip: caState.currentIP,
                advVpnScore: i.advVpnScore,
                advVpnLabel: i.advVpnLabel,
                advVpnLevel: i.advVpnLevel,
                advSignals: i.advSignals,
                asn: i.asn,
                asnName: i.asnName,
                asnType: i.asnType,
                tzMismatch: i.tzMismatch,
                langMismatch: i.langMismatch,
                reverseDns: i.reverseDns,
                relayAnalysis: i.relayAnalysis
            };
        },
        // Tambah ASN baru tanpa restart
        addHostingAsn: function(asn) {
            var n = parseInt(asn, 10);
            if (!isNaN(n) && n > 0) { HOSTING_VPN_ASNS.add(n); return true; }
            return false;
        }
    };

    console.log(
        '%c[CA-ADV-VPN v2] ✅ Advanced VPN Detection loaded',
        'color:#10b981;font-weight:900;font-size:12px'
    );
    console.log('[CA-ADV-VPN]   ASN blacklist: ' + HOSTING_VPN_ASNS.size + ' entries');
    console.log('[CA-ADV-VPN]   API: window.__caAdvVpn');
})();
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ⭐ UNIFIED VERDICT v1 — Satu kesimpulan, tanpa kontradiksi
//    - Auto-enrich ispType dari rDNS (Unknown → Mobile/Fixed/VPN/DC)
//    - Sembunyikan conclusion lama (NEGARA COCOK / VPN LEAK / PARTNER VPN)
//    - Satu unified verdict: border box + halo konsisten
//    - Sertakan ASN, rDNS, signals di verdict (replace adv badge)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
(function() {
    'use strict';
    if (window.__caUnifiedVerdict) return;
    window.__caUnifiedVerdict = true;

    var W = typeof unsafeWindow !== 'undefined' ? unsafeWindow : window;

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 1️⃣ AUTO-ENRICH ispType dari rDNS (fix "❓ Unknown")
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    var ISP_TYPE_BADGE = {
        mobile:     { icon: '📱', label: 'Mobile',     color: '#f59e0b', bg: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.15)',  border: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.4)'  },
        fixed:      { icon: '🏠', label: 'Fixed',      color: '#10b981', bg: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.15)',  border: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.4)'  },
        vpn:        { icon: '🔒', label: 'VPN/Proxy',  color: '#ef4444', bg: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.15)',   border: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.4)'   },
        datacenter: { icon: '🖥️', label: 'Datacenter', color: '#a78bfa', bg: 'rgba(167,139,250,0.15)', border: 'rgba(167,139,250,0.4)' },
        unknown:    { icon: '❓', label: 'Unknown',    color: '#64748b', bg: 'rgba(100,116,139,0.15)', border: 'rgba(100,116,139,0.4)' }
    };

function enrichIspTypeFromRdns(info) {
    if (!info || !info.reverseDns || !info.reverseDns.length) return false;
    // ⭐ FIX: allow upgrade datacenter→vpn (higher severity). Unknown → any. Fixed/Mobile → jangan turunkan.
    var _current = info.ispType || 'unknown';
    var _allowUpgrade = (_current === 'unknown') || (_current === 'datacenter') || (_current === 'mobile') || (_current === 'fixed');
    if (!_allowUpgrade) return false;

        var ptrStr = info.reverseDns.join(' ').toLowerCase();
        var newType = null;

        if (/(^|[^a-z])(vpn|proxy|m247|nord|surfshark|express|cyberghost|ipvanish|mullvad|private internet|torguard|windscribe|protonvpn|purevpn|hidemyass)([^a-z]|$)/.test(ptrStr)) {
            newType = 'vpn';
        } else if (/(^|[^a-z])(datacenter|hosting|cloud|vps|colocation|server)([^a-z]|$)/.test(ptrStr)) {
            newType = 'datacenter';
        } else if (/(^|[^a-z])(mobile|cellular|lte|gsm|4g|5g|3g|umts|hspa)([^a-z]|$)/.test(ptrStr)) {
            newType = 'mobile';
        } else if (/(^|[^a-z])(broadband|fiber|ftth|dsl|cable|fixed|adsl|vdsl)([^a-z]|$)/.test(ptrStr)) {
            newType = 'fixed';
        }

if (newType) {
    // ⭐ FIX: hanya upgrade, jangan downgrade (vpn > datacenter > mobile > fixed > unknown)
    var _severity = { vpn: 4, datacenter: 3, mobile: 2, fixed: 1, unknown: 0 };
    if ((_severity[newType] || 0) > (_severity[_current] || 0)) {
        info.ispType = newType;
        info.ispTypeSource = 'rDNS-enrich';
        return true;
    }
}
        return false;
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 2️⃣ COMPUTE VERDICT — satu kesimpulan terpadu
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        function computeVerdict(info, caState) {
        if (!info) return null;

        var domCode = caState.lastDetectedCountry ? caState.lastDetectedCountry.toLowerCase() : null;
        var ipCode  = info.code ? info.code.toLowerCase() : null;
        var countryMatch = !!(domCode && ipCode && domCode === ipCode);
        var level = info.advVpnLevel || 'clean';
        var isRelay = info.isRelay;
        var isRelaySuspicious = !!(info.relayAnalysis && info.relayAnalysis.isSuspiciousRelay);

        // ── PRIORITAS 1: VPN HIGH ──
        if (level === 'high') {
            return {
                icon: '🔴', color: '#ef4444', level: 'high',
                title: 'VPN TERDETEKSI — HIGH CONFIDENCE',
                subtitle: countryMatch
                    ? 'IP konsisten tapi ISP indikasi VPN/Hosting'
                    : 'Negara berbeda: ' + (domCode||'?').toUpperCase() + ' ≠ ' + (ipCode||'?').toUpperCase()
            };
        }

        // ── PRIORITAS 2: VPN MEDIUM ──
        if (level === 'medium') {
            return {
                icon: '🟠', color: '#f59e0b', level: 'medium',
                title: 'SUSPICIOUS — MEDIUM VPN',
                subtitle: countryMatch
                    ? 'Ada sinyal mencurigakan (lihat detail di bawah)'
                    : 'Negara tidak cocok + indikasi VPN/Proxy'
            };
        }

        // ── PRIORITAS 3: Relay mencurigakan ──
        if (isRelay && isRelaySuspicious) {
            return {
                icon: '🟠', color: '#f59e0b', level: 'medium',
                title: 'RELAY MENCURIGAKAN',
                subtitle: 'IP disembunyikan via TURN server di ASN ' + (info.relayAnalysis.asnType || '?')
            };
        }

             // ── PRIORITAS 4: Country mismatch (Beda Jaringan / VPN) ──
     if (domCode && ipCode && domCode !== ipCode) {
         return {
             icon: '⚠️', color: '#f59e0b', level: 'medium',
             title: 'BEDA NEGARA (VPN/PROXY)',
             subtitle: 'Ome.tv: ' + domCode.toUpperCase() + ' · Exit IP: ' + ipCode.toUpperCase()
         };
     }

        // ── PRIORITAS 5: Relay normal ──
if (isRelay) {
    // ⭐ FIX: legit relay (Cloudflare/AWS TURN) → verdict netral, bukan warning
    var _isLegitRelay = !!(info.relayAnalysis && info.relayAnalysis.legitTurn);
    if (_isLegitRelay) {
        return {
            icon: 'ℹ️', color: '#64748b', level: 'clean',
            title: 'RELAY (Peer IP Hidden)',
            subtitle: 'Koneksi lewat TURN server — bukan indikasi VPN'
        };
    }
    return {
        icon: '⚠️', color: '#f59e0b', level: 'medium',
        title: 'RELAY SERVER',
        subtitle: 'IP partner tidak terlihat langsung (TURN)'
    };
}

                    // ── PRIORITAS 5.5: Multi-candidate VPN leak (Batch C-2) ──
        var __multi = caState.multiCandidateInfo;
        if (__multi && __multi.length >= 2) {
            var __otherVPN = __multi.some(function(r) {
                return r.ip !== caState.currentIP && r.role === 'vpn';
            });
            if (__otherVPN) {
                return {
                    icon: '🔒', color: '#ef4444', level: 'high',
                    title: 'VPN LEAK — MULTIPLE IP DETECTED',
                    subtitle: 'IP partner saat ini clean, tapi candidate lain terindikasi VPN (lihat detail di bawah)'
                };
            }
        }

        // ── PRIORITAS 6: CLEAN / AMAN (Tanpa Timezone False Positive) ──
        return {
            icon: '✅', color: '#10b981', level: 'clean',
            title: countryMatch ? 'TERLIHAT AMAN' : 'KONEKSI INTERNASIONAL (Aman)',
            subtitle: countryMatch ? 'Negara cocok (Ome.tv = IP WebRTC)' : 'Tidak ada indikator VPN terdeteksi'
        };
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 3️⃣ APPLY: rebuild UI floating box
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function applyUnifiedVerdict() {
        var caState = W.__ca && W.__ca.state;
        var info = caState && caState.currentIPInfo;
        if (!info) return;

        var content = document.getElementById('ca-float-content');
        if (!content || content.children.length === 0) return;

        // ── 3a. Enrich ispType dari rDNS ──
        enrichIspTypeFromRdns(info);

        // ── 3b. Update badge ISP "Unknown" → "Mobile" tanpa re-render full ──
        updateIspBadgeDOM(content, info);

        // ── 3c. Hitung verdict ──
        var verdict = computeVerdict(info, caState);
        if (!verdict) return;

        // ── 3d. Sembunyikan konklusi lama (penyebab kontradiksi) ──
        hideOldConclusions(content);

                        // ⭐ FIX: Signature Guard untuk Unified Verdict agar tidak flicker
        var sigStr = verdict.title + '|' + verdict.subtitle + '|' + (info.advVpnScore || 0) + '|' + (info.asn || '') + '|' + (info.reverseDns ? info.reverseDns[0] : '');
        var existingVerdict = content.querySelector('.ca-unified-verdict');

        if (existingVerdict && existingVerdict.getAttribute('data-ca-sig') === sigStr) {
            // Verdict sama, jangan hapus/render ulang
        } else {
            // ── 3e. Hapus verdict lama (idempotent) ──
            content.querySelectorAll('.ca-unified-verdict, .ca-adv-vpn-badge').forEach(function(el) {
                el.remove();
            });

            // ── 3f. Render verdict baru ──
            var verdictEl = renderVerdictElement(info, verdict);
            verdictEl.setAttribute('data-ca-sig', sigStr);

            // Insert sebelum tombol Block/Copy IP
            var buttonsRow = findButtonsRow(content);
            if (buttonsRow && buttonsRow.parentNode === content) {
                content.insertBefore(verdictEl, buttonsRow);
            } else {
                content.appendChild(verdictEl);
            }
        }

        // ── 3g. Sinkron border floating box ──
        var box = document.getElementById('ca-floating-box');
        if (box) {
            box.style.borderColor = verdict.color;
            box.style.boxShadow = '0 8px 24px ' + verdict.color + '40';
        }
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // HELPERS
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function updateIspBadgeDOM(content, info) {
        if (!info.ispType) return;
        var badge = ISP_TYPE_BADGE[info.ispType] || ISP_TYPE_BADGE.unknown;

        // Cari span yang menampilkan ISP type lama (Unknown / Mobile / Fixed / dst)
        var spans = content.querySelectorAll('span');
        for (var i = 0; i < spans.length; i++) {
            var txt = (spans[i].textContent || '').trim();
            if (/^(📱|🏠|🔒|🖥️|❓)\s+(Mobile|Fixed|VPN\/Proxy|Datacenter|Unknown)$/.test(txt)) {
                spans[i].innerHTML = badge.icon + ' ' + badge.label;
                spans[i].style.background = badge.bg;
                spans[i].style.borderColor = badge.border;
                spans[i].style.color = badge.color;
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    function hideOldConclusions(content) {
        // Logika lama: <div style*="font-weight:700"> dengan text tertentu
        var allDivs = content.querySelectorAll('div');
        for (var i = 0; i < allDivs.length; i++) {
            var el = allDivs[i];
            // Skip kalau sudah verdict kita sendiri
            if (el.classList.contains('ca-unified-verdict')) continue;
            if (el.classList.contains('ca-adv-vpn-badge')) continue;

            var txt = (el.textContent || '').toUpperCase();
            if (txt.includes('NEGARA COCOK') ||
                txt.includes('VPN LEAK TERDETEKSI') ||
                txt.includes('PARTNER MEMAKAI VPN')) {
                // Cek ini benar-benar top-level conclusion div, bukan wrapper
                if (el.children.length < 3 && txt.length < 200) {
                    el.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }
        }
    }

    function findButtonsRow(content) {
        var children = content.children;
        for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
            if (children[i].querySelector('#ca-float-block')) {
                return children[i];
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function renderVerdictElement(info, verdict) {
        var el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'ca-unified-verdict';
        el.style.cssText =
            'margin: 8px 0; padding: 10px 8px; border-radius: 10px; ' +
            'background: ' + verdict.color + '22; ' +
            'border: 1.5px solid ' + verdict.color + '88; ' +
            'text-align: center; color: #fff; line-height: 1.35;';

        var html = '';

        // Title
        html += '<div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: ' + verdict.color + ';">' +
            verdict.icon + ' ' + verdict.title +
        '</div>';

        // Subtitle
        html += '<div style="font-size: 10px; opacity: 0.92; margin-top: 3px;">' +
            verdict.subtitle +
        '</div>';

        // Signals chips
        if (info.advSignals && info.advSignals.length > 0) {
            html += '<div style="margin-top: 6px; font-size: 9px; opacity: 0.85;">' +
                info.advSignals.map(function(s) {
                    return '<span style="display:inline-block;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3);' +
                        'padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;margin:2px 1px;">' + s.tag + '</span>';
                }).join('') + '</div>';
        }

        // ASN line
        if (info.asn) {
           html += '<div style="margin-top: 5px; font-size: 9px; opacity: 0.7; font-family: monospace;">AS' + info.asn + ' · ' +
    W.escHtmlCA((info.asnName || '').substring(0, 26)) + '</div>';
        }

        // PTR line
        if (info.reverseDns && info.reverseDns.length > 0) {
            html += '<div style="margin-top: 2px; font-size: 8px; opacity: 0.6; font-family: monospace;">PTR: ' +
    W.escHtmlCA(info.reverseDns[0].substring(0, 34)) + '</div>';
        }

        // Relay analysis
        if (info.relayAnalysis && info.relayAnalysis.asn) {
            html += '<div style="margin-top: 3px; font-size: 9px; opacity: 0.75;">' +
                '🌐 Relay AS' + info.relayAnalysis.asn + ' (' +
                info.relayAnalysis.asnType + ')' +
            '</div>';
        }

        // ISP type hint (kalau di-enrich dari rDNS)
        if (info.ispTypeSource === 'rDNS-enrich' && info.ispType) {
            var b = ISP_TYPE_BADGE[info.ispType] || ISP_TYPE_BADGE.unknown;
            html += '<div style="margin-top: 4px; font-size: 9px; opacity: 0.85;">' +
                'ISP: <span style="color:' + b.color + ';font-weight:700;">' +
                b.icon + ' ' + b.label + '</span> (via rDNS)' +
            '</div>';
        }

        // ⭐ FIX P4: confidence % (deterministik dari kekuatan signal)
        var _vpnConf = 0;
        if (info.advSignals && info.advSignals.length > 0) {
            var _hasStrong = false;
            for (var _si = 0; _si < info.advSignals.length; _si++) {
                if (info.advSignals[_si].tag === 'VPN-ASN' ||
                    info.advSignals[_si].tag === 'TOR-EXIT') { _hasStrong = true; break; }
            }
            var _sc = info.advVpnScore || 0;
            if (_hasStrong)                    _vpnConf = 90;
            else if (_sc >= 50)                _vpnConf = 80;
            else if (_sc >= 30)                _vpnConf = 60;
            else if (_sc > 0)                  _vpnConf = 40;
            else                               _vpnConf = 90;
        } else {
            _vpnConf = 90; // clean — yakin tidak ada sinyal
        }
        var _confColor = _vpnConf >= 80 ? '#10b981' : _vpnConf >= 50 ? '#f59e0b' : '#64748b';
        html += '<div style="margin-top:5px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:' + _confColor + ';">' +
            'Confidence: ' + _vpnConf + '% · raw ' + (info.advVpnScore || 0) +
        '</div>';

        el.innerHTML = html;
        return el;
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 4️⃣ TRIGGER via MutationObserver
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    var __unifiedSched = false;
    function scheduleApply() {
        if (__unifiedSched) return;
        __unifiedSched = true;
        requestAnimationFrame(function() {
            __unifiedSched = false;
            try { applyUnifiedVerdict(); } catch(e) { console.warn('[CA-UNIFIED]', e); }
        });
    }

    var __unifiedObs = null;

    function attachObserver() {
        var content = document.getElementById('ca-float-content');
        if (!content) {
            setTimeout(attachObserver, 500);
            return;
        }
        if (__unifiedObs) { try { __unifiedObs.disconnect(); } catch(e) {} }

        __unifiedObs = new MutationObserver(function(muts) {
            // Skip kalau kita yang mutasi (hindari loop)
            if (__unifiedSched) return;
            for (var i = 0; i < muts.length; i++) {
                if (muts[i].type === 'childList' && muts[i].addedNodes.length > 0) {
                    scheduleApply();
                    return;
                }
            }
        });
        __unifiedObs.observe(content, { childList: true });

        // Initial pass
        scheduleApply();
    }

    // React to events
    W.addEventListener('ca-ip-ready', function() {
        // Beri waktu adv-vpn selesai analysis
        setTimeout(scheduleApply, 300);
        setTimeout(scheduleApply, 800);
        setTimeout(scheduleApply, 1800);
    });

    // Safety net
    if (window.__caOn1000) {
        window.__caOn1000(function() {
            var content = document.getElementById('ca-float-content');
            if (!content || content.children.length === 0) return;
            if (!content.querySelector('.ca-unified-verdict')) {
                scheduleApply();
            }
        });
    }

    // Init
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', attachObserver);
    } else {
        attachObserver();
    }

    // Public API
    W.__caUnifiedVerdictRefresh = scheduleApply;

    console.log('[CA-UNIFIED-VERDICT v1] ✅ Single verdict engine loaded');
})();
