    // Fungsi pembersih sampah
    function ensureDeviceWrapper() {
        let wrapper = document.querySelector('.media-devices__wrapper');
        if (!wrapper) {
            const nativeMic = document.getElementById('audio-devices');
            if (nativeMic && nativeMic.parentElement) wrapper = nativeMic.parentElement;
        }

        var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        var isZoomed = box && box.classList.contains('ca-zoom-active');
        var isCinema = box && box.classList.contains('ca-cinema-active');

        ['local-video-wrapper', 'remote-video-wrapper'].forEach(function(id) {
            var el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el) {
                // Cegah video meledak/melar saat zoom/cinema
                el.style.setProperty('overflow', (isZoomed || isCinema) ? 'hidden' : 'visible', 'important');
                el.style.setProperty('clip-path', 'none', 'important');
                el.style.setProperty('-webkit-clip-path', 'none', 'important');
            }
        });

                if (wrapper) {
            wrapper.style.setProperty('overflow', 'visible', 'important');
            // ⭐ pointer-events: di-handle CSS hover (FIX #1) — jangan force inline
            wrapper.style.setProperty('z-index', '2147483647', 'important');
            wrapper.style.setProperty('backdrop-filter', 'none', 'important');
            wrapper.style.setProperty('-webkit-backdrop-filter', 'none', 'important');
            wrapper.style.setProperty('background', 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95)', 'important');
        }
    }

        ensureDeviceWrapper();
    if (window.__caOn250) {
        window.__caOn250(ensureDeviceWrapper);
    } else {
        setInterval(ensureDeviceWrapper, 250);
    }

    // ⭐ FIX #5: SAFETY NET — strip inline opacity/pointer-events kalau
    //    bukan sedang hover / focus. Cegah dead-lock kalau ada kode lain
    //    yang force inline style (extension / versi lama / React quirk).
    function stripStaleInlineForcing() {
        var w = document.querySelector('.media-devices__wrapper');
        if (!w) return;
        // Skip kalau memang sedang aktif (hover atau focus di dalam wrapper)
        if (w.matches(':hover') || w.contains(document.activeElement)) return;
        // Strip hanya kalau ada inline forcing yang salah
        if (w.style.opacity && w.style.opacity !== '0') {
            w.style.removeProperty('opacity');
        }
        if (w.style.pointerEvents && w.style.pointerEvents !== 'none') {
            w.style.removeProperty('pointer-events');
        }
        if (w.style.visibility && w.style.visibility !== 'hidden') {
            w.style.removeProperty('visibility');
        }
    }
    if (window.__caOn500) window.__caOn500(stripStaleInlineForcing);
    else setInterval(stripStaleInlineForcing, 500);

        // ⭐ KUNCI KONSISTENSI: Pemantau Mutasi DOM (MutationObserver)
    // Begitu React selesai me-render elemen baru saat reload, kita langsung panggil placeMicAndCamera()
    if (window.__caBodyBus) {
        window.__caBodyBus.subscribe(function(node) {
            if (!node || node.nodeType !== 1) return;
            // Cek apakah node baru adalah video wrapper atau media wrapper
            if (node.id === 'local-video-wrapper' ||
                node.id === 'remote-video-wrapper' ||
                node.classList.contains('media-devices__wrapper') ||
                (node.querySelector && node.querySelector('.media-devices__wrapper'))) {

                // ⭐ FIX #4: pakai window.__ca.placeMicAndCamera (bukan bare reference)
                if (window.__ca && typeof window.__ca.placeMicAndCamera === 'function') {
                    window.__ca.placeMicAndCamera();
                }
                ensureDeviceWrapper();
            }
        });
    }
})();

// ⭐ PATCH FINAL v16: BOOT GATE + CLEAN TOGGLE
//    - Panel ditahan (opacity:0) sampai layout stabil → no jump
//    - Toggle tanpa style-wipe → no stuck
//    - stopImmediatePropagation selalu jalan → Gender/Start/Stop
//      tidak bisa memicu panel
//    - 100% Aman untuk mode Cinema 3-Kolom
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
(function() {
    'use strict';
    if (window.__caCountryButtonFixV16) return;
    window.__caCountryButtonFixV16 = true;

    // ═══ 1. BOOT GATE — Sembunyikan panel sampai layout siap ═══
    (function bootGate() {
        if (document.getElementById('ca-boot-gate-v16')) return;
        var s = document.createElement('style');
        s.id = 'ca-boot-gate-v16';
        s.textContent = `
            #my-custom-country-ui:not(.ca-layout-ready) {
                opacity: 0 !important;
                visibility: hidden !important;
                pointer-events: none !important;
                transition: none !important;
            }
        `;
        (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(s);
    })();

    // ═══ 2. CLOSEST PATCH — Blokir fallback bug ═══
    (function patchClosest() {
        if (window.__caClosestPatchedV16) return;
        window.__caClosestPatchedV16 = true;
        var orig = Element.prototype.closest;
        Element.prototype.closest = function(sel) {
            if (sel === 'button, [role="button"], .buttons__button, .country-filter__button') {
                var el = orig.call(this, sel);
                if (el) {
                    var t = (el.textContent || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                    var c = String(el.className || '').toLowerCase();
                    if (!(t.includes('country') || t.includes('negara') || c.includes('country') || c.includes('filter'))) {
                        return null;
                    }
                }
                return el;
            }
            return orig.apply(this, arguments);
        };
    })();

    // ═══ 3. APPLY GEOMETRY — Tanpa style wipe ═══
    function applyGeometry(cc) {
        var state = window.__ca && window.__ca.state;
        if (!state || !cc) return;

        cc.style.setProperty('transition', 'none', 'important');
        cc.style.setProperty('animation', 'none', 'important');
        cc.style.setProperty('opacity', '1', 'important'); /* ⭐ Paksa instan */
        cc.style.setProperty('visibility', 'visible', 'important'); /* ⭐ Paksa instan */

        if (state.panelWidth != null) {
            cc.style.setProperty('width', state.panelWidth + 'px', 'important');
            cc.style.setProperty('max-width', 'none', 'important');
        }

        var baseT = 'translateX(0)';
        if (state.panelLeft != null) {
            cc.style.setProperty('left', state.panelLeft + 'px', 'important');
        } else {
            cc.style.setProperty('left', '50%', 'important');
            baseT = 'translateX(-50%)';
        }

        if (state.panelTop != null) {
            cc.style.setProperty('top', state.panelTop + 'px', 'important');
        }

        if (state.panelHeight != null) {
            var h = state.panelHeight;
            if (h < 40) h = 40;
            cc.style.setProperty('height', h + 'px', 'important');
            cc.style.setProperty('max-height', h + 'px', 'important');
        }

        var scale = state.panelScale || 1.0;
        cc.style.setProperty('transform', (scale !== 1.0) ? baseT + ' scale(' + scale + ')' : baseT, 'important');
        cc.style.setProperty('transform-origin', state.panelScaleOrigin || '50% 50%', 'important');
    }

    // ═══ 4. SHOW / HIDE ═══
function showPanel(cc) {
    if (!cc) return;

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ⭐ FIX RC-PANEL-FLICKER: RENDER DULU (hidden) → REVEAL (sekali)
    //    Sebelumnya: `ca-layout-ready` di-add PERTAMA → panel visible →
    //    renderGrid jalan → user lihat grid kosong, lalu re-render.
    //    Sekarang: layout → geometry → render → reflow → reveal.
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    // 1) Remove leftover cinema classes dulu (pengaruhi layout)
    cc.classList.remove('ca-cinema3-docked', 'ca-mirrored-panel', 'ca-cinema3-mirrored');

    // 2) Set display:flex agar panel punya layout (tapi masih hidden)
    cc.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');

    // 3) Apply geometry — panel punya size/posisi benar (masih hidden)
    applyGeometry(cc);

    // ⭐ FIX: Sync `ca-compact` class dengan visual width. Root cause bug:
    //    setelah F5 di cinema3, `state.panelWidth=null`, `applyPanelGeometry`
    //    early-return via __caCinemaLock, jadi `updatePanelCompactMode` tidak
    //    pernah jalan → class nyangkut. Sync di sini = self-healing.
    try {
        var __rect = cc.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (__rect.width > 0) {
            cc.classList.toggle('ca-compact', __rect.width <= 500);
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    // 4) Force HIDDEN selama render — overwrite applyGeometry's opacity/visibility
    cc.style.setProperty('visibility', 'hidden', 'important');
    cc.style.setProperty('opacity', '0', 'important');
    cc.style.setProperty('pointer-events', 'none', 'important');

    // 5) Render grid + inject toggle/fav✖ (sinkron via ca-grid-rendered event)
    try { if (window.__ca.renderGrid) window.__ca.renderGrid(); } catch(e) {}
    try { if (window.__ca.caEnableAutoNav) window.__ca.caEnableAutoNav(); } catch(e) {}

    // 6) Reset focus state SETELAH render (renderGrid bisa reset via callback)
    if (window.__ca && window.__ca.state) {
        window.__ca.state.kbFocusTarget = 'tabs';
        window.__ca.state.kbFocusIdx    = -1;
        window.__ca.state.kbTabFocusIdx = 0;
    }

    // 7) Force reflow — browser commit semua perubahan (size, layout, DOM)
    void cc.offsetWidth;

    // 8) REVEAL — panel muncul sudah fully rendered (zero visible re-render)
    cc.style.setProperty('visibility', 'visible', 'important');
    cc.style.setProperty('opacity', '1', 'important');
    cc.style.setProperty('pointer-events', 'auto', 'important');
    cc.classList.add('ca-layout-ready');

    // 9) Cleanup transisi setelah fade-in selesai
    setTimeout(function() {
        cc.style.removeProperty('transition');
        cc.style.removeProperty('animation');
    }, 50);
}

       function hidePanel(cc) {
        if (!cc) return;
        cc.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');

        // ⭐ FIX: hapus tooltip langsung via DOM — tidak bergantung window.__ca.
        // Ini menutup celah saat window.__ca tidak terlihat dari sandbox IIFE
        // (minimize button sudah aman karena pakai closure call).
        try {
            var __stuckTt = document.getElementById('ca-country-tooltip');
            if (__stuckTt) __stuckTt.remove();
        } catch(e) {}

        // ⭐ FIX: tambahkan guard `window.__ca &&` agar tidak throw TypeError
        // yang ditelan try/catch (masalah lama: silent skip).
        try { if (window.__ca && window.__ca.caDisableAutoNav) window.__ca.caDisableAutoNav(); } catch(e) {}
        try { if (window.__ca && window.__ca.caHideTooltip) window.__ca.caHideTooltip(); } catch(e) {}
    }

    // ═══ 5. LAYOUT READY CHECKER ═══
    function isLayoutReady() {
        var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        if (!box) return false;
        var r = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
        var l = document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper');
        if (!r || !l) return false;
        var rr = r.getBoundingClientRect();
        var lr = l.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rr.width < 80 || rr.height < 80) return false;
        if (lr.width < 80 || lr.height < 80) return false;
        return true;
    }

    // ═══ 6. BOOT REVEAL ═══
    function tryBootReveal() {
        var cc = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        if (!cc) { setTimeout(tryBootReveal, 50); return; }
        if (!isLayoutReady()) { setTimeout(tryBootReveal, 80); return; }
        // Layout ready — kalau panel visible (langka), apply geometry
        if (cc.style.display !== 'none') {
            applyGeometry(cc);
        }
        cc.classList.add('ca-layout-ready');
        console.log('[CA-FIX] ✅ Boot reveal complete');
    }
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', tryBootReveal, { once: true });
    } else {
        tryBootReveal();
    }

    // ═══ 7. CLICK INTERCEPTOR ═══
    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var t = e.target;
        if (!t || !t.closest) return;

        var __W = typeof unsafeWindow !== 'undefined' ? unsafeWindow : window;
        if (__W.__caBypassIntercept) return;

        // ⭐ TAMBAHKAN BARIS INI
        if (t.closest('#my-custom-country-ui')) return;

        // Cinema toggles
        var b3 = t.closest('#ca-cinema3-toggle-btn');
        if (b3) { e.stopPropagation(); if (b3.onclick) b3.onclick(e); return; }
        var bC = t.closest('#ca-cinema-btn');
        if (bC) { e.stopPropagation(); if (bC.onclick) bC.onclick(e); return; }

        // Country button detection
        var isCountry = false;
        var btn = t.closest('.buttons__button');
        if (btn) {
            var txt = (btn.textContent || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            var cls = String(btn.className || '').toLowerCase();
            if (txt.includes('country') || txt.includes('negara') || cls.includes('country') || cls.includes('filter')) {
                isCountry = true;
            }
        }
        if (!isCountry) {
            var t2 = (t.textContent || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            if ((t2 === 'country' || t2 === 'negara') && t.offsetWidth > 30) isCountry = true;
        }

        if (!isCountry) return;

                // Cinema lock — verifikasi DOM aktual, jangan buta-buta percaya flag
        if (window.__caCinemaLock) {
            var __realCinema3 = document.querySelector('.roulette-box.ca-cinema3-active');
            if (!__realCinema3) {
                console.warn('[CA-FIX] stale __caCinemaLock → auto-clear');
                window.__caCinemaLock = false;
                // fall-through — JANGAN return
            } else {
                e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                return;
            }
        }

        // ⭐ ALWAYS block original — even on rapid clicks
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        e.stopImmediatePropagation();

        // Debounce toggle action only (not blocking)
        var now = Date.now();
        if (now - (window.__caLastCountryClickAt || 0) < 250) return;
        window.__caLastCountryClickAt = now;

        var cc = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        if (!cc) {
            if (window.__ca && window.__ca.createPanel) {
                window.__ca.createPanel();
                cc = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
            }
            if (!cc) return;
        }

        var hs = document.getElementById('ca-cinema-hide-pending');
        if (hs) hs.remove();

        var isOpen = cc.style.display !== 'none' && getComputedStyle(cc).display !== 'none';

        if (isOpen) {
            hidePanel(cc);
        } else {
            showPanel(cc);
        }
    }, true);

    // ═══ 8. DOUBLE-CLICK RESET ═══
    window.addEventListener('dblclick', function(e) {
        var header = e.target.closest('#my-custom-country-ui .ca-header-row');
        if (header && !window.__caCinemaLock) {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
            if (window.__ca && window.__ca.resetPanelGeometry) {
                window.__ca.resetPanelGeometry();
                if (window.__ca.showIndicator) window.__ca.showIndicator('↺ Panel reset', '#38bdf8');
            }
        }
    }, true);

    // ⭐ FIX RC-PANEL-FLICKER: expose showPanel/hidePanel agar popup observer
    //    (dalam main IIFE) juga pakai jalur smooth yang sama.
    if (window.__ca) {
        window.__ca.showPanel = showPanel;
        window.__ca.hidePanel = hidePanel;
    }

    console.log('[CA-FIX] ✅ v16 Active: Boot gate + clean toggle.');
})();

// ⭐ NAV DIAGNOSTIC — jalankan __caDiagNavRun() di console
//    setelah klik Country di mode normal untuk melihat state

(function() {
    if (window.__caDiagNavRun) return;
    window.__caDiagNavRun = function() {
        var cc = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        var nav = window.__caNavState || {};
        var state = window.__ca && window.__ca.state;
        var grid = cc && cc.querySelector('.ca-country-grid');
        return {
            panelExists: !!cc,
            panelInlineDisplay: cc && cc.style.display,
            panelComputedDisplay: cc && getComputedStyle(cc).display,
            panelOffsetW: cc && cc.offsetWidth,
            panelClasses: cc && cc.className,
            gridExists: !!grid,
            gridChildCount: grid ? grid.childElementCount : 0,
            kaAutoNav: nav.kbAutoNav,
            kbMode: nav.kbMode,
            focusTarget: state && state.kbFocusTarget,
            focusIdx: state && state.kbFocusIdx,
            tabFocusIdx: state && state.kbTabFocusIdx,
            cinemaLock: window.__caCinemaLock,
            cinemaActive: !!document.querySelector('.roulette-box.ca-cinema3-active'),
            activeTag: document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName,
            activeClass: document.activeElement && document.activeElement.className,
            searchVisible: (function() {
                var s = cc && cc.querySelector('.ca-search-input');
                return s ? (s.offsetWidth > 0 && s.offsetHeight > 0) : false;
            })()
        };
    };
    console.log('[CA-NAV-DIAG] ✅ run __caDiagNavRun() untuk inspect state');
})();

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ⭐ LOCK REAPER — auto-clear stale __caCinemaLock
//    Safety net: kalau ada jalur exit yang lupa clear flag,
//    reaper akan mendeteksi inkonsistensi DOM ↔ flag.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
(function() {
    'use strict';
    if (window.__caLockReaper) return;
    window.__caLockReaper = true;

    var __lockStaleSince = 0;

    setInterval(function() {
        var flag = !!window.__caCinemaLock;
        var realCinema = !!document.querySelector('.roulette-box.ca-cinema3-active');

        // Kasus 1: flag true tapi DOM tidak cinema3 → stale
        if (flag && !realCinema) {
            if (!__lockStaleSince) {
                __lockStaleSince = Date.now();
                return;   // grace 800ms (hindari race dengan VT boot)
            }
            if (Date.now() - __lockStaleSince > 800) {
                console.warn('[CA-LOCK-REAPER] stale lock cleared after 800ms grace');
                window.__caCinemaLock = false;
                window.__caNavInitCinema3 = false;
                __lockStaleSince = 0;
            }
        } else {
            __lockStaleSince = 0;
        }

        // Kasus 2: panel masih punya class docked padahal tidak cinema3
        if (!realCinema) {
            var pnl = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
            if (pnl && pnl.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-docked')) {
                pnl.classList.remove(
                    'ca-cinema3-docked',
                    'ca-mirrored-panel',
                    'ca-cinema3-mirrored'
                );
            }
        }
    }, 500);

    console.log('[CA-LOCK-REAPER] ✅ active');
})();

// ⭐ HARD-LOCK LANDSCAPE v2.3 — idempotent + fast-path + NO NS touching
//    • setIfDiff — hanya setProperty kalau nilai berubah (cegah reflow)
//    • Fast-path — skip kalau state sama (skip getBoundingClientRect juga)
//    • TIDAK sentuh NS container — module urus sendiri
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
(function () {
    'use strict';
    if (window.__caHardLockLandscapeV23) return;
    window.__caHardLockLandscapeV23 = true;

    var BOX_PROPS = ['grid-template-areas', 'grid-template-columns', 'grid-template-rows'];
    var PANEL_PROPS = ['grid-area'];
    var WRAPPER_PROPS = ['grid-area', 'width', 'height', 'max-width', 'max-height',
                         'justify-self', 'align-self', 'margin', 'z-index'];
    var CHAT_PROPS = ['position', 'grid-area', 'width', 'height', 'z-index',
                      'bottom', 'top', 'left', 'right'];
    // NS_PROPS cuma dipakai untuk cleanup — TIDAK untuk force
    var NS_PROPS = ['opacity', 'visibility', 'display'];

    function isMirror(box) {
        return box.classList.contains('ca-mirrored') ||
               box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-mirrored');
    }

    // ⭐ Idempotent setter — cegah style invalidation kalau value sama
    function setIfDiff(el, prop, val, priority) {
        if (!el) return;
        var cur = el.style.getPropertyValue(prop);
        if (cur !== val) el.style.setProperty(prop, val, priority || '');
    }

    function clearForcedInline(box) {
        var panel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
        var lv = document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper');
        var rv = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
        var chat = document.querySelector('.chat');
        var ns = document.getElementById('ca-custom-ns-container');

        BOX_PROPS.forEach(function (p) { box.style.removeProperty(p); });
        if (panel) PANEL_PROPS.forEach(function (p) { panel.style.removeProperty(p); });
        [lv, rv].forEach(function (w) {
            if (!w) return;
            WRAPPER_PROPS.forEach(function (p) { w.style.removeProperty(p); });
        });
        if (chat) CHAT_PROPS.forEach(function (p) { chat.style.removeProperty(p); });
        // Cleanup NS — hapus sisa force dari v2.2 kalau ada
        if (ns) NS_PROPS.forEach(function (p) { ns.style.removeProperty(p); });

        applyLandscapeForce._last = '';
        console.log('[CA-HARD-LOCK v2.3] 🧹 cleanup done');
    }

    function applyLandscapeForce(box) {
    // ⭐ [FIX F11] Serahkan 100% ke V25 (Pure CSS Grid)
    if (window.__caLogicV25) return;

    var panel = document.getElementById('my-custom-country-ui');
    var lv = document.getElementById('local-video-wrapper');
        var rv = document.getElementById('remote-video-wrapper');
        var chat = document.querySelector('.chat');
        if (!panel || !lv || !rv) return;

        var mir = isMirror(box);
        var swapped = box.classList.contains('ca-swapped');
        var mainW = swapped ? lv : rv;
        var pipW = swapped ? rv : lv;

        // ── Compute ──
        var W = window.innerWidth;
        var H = window.innerHeight;
        var PAD = 12, GAP = 12;
        var vh = H - (PAD * 2);
        var vw = Math.round(vh * (4 / 3));
        var pw = W - (PAD * 2) - GAP - vw;
        if (pw < 320) { pw = 320; vw = W - (PAD * 2) - GAP - pw; }
        if (vw < 100) vw = 100;
        if (pw < 100) pw = 100;

        var cols = mir ? (vw + 'px ' + pw + 'px') : (pw + 'px ' + vw + 'px');
        var areas = mir ? '"remote panel"' : '"panel remote"';
        var stateKey = cols + '|' + areas + '|' + swapped + '|' + mir + '|' + W + '|' + H;

        // ⭐ FAST-PATH: skip 100% kalau state unchanged + inline masih valid
        if (applyLandscapeForce._last === stateKey) {
            if (box.style.gridTemplateColumns === cols &&
                box.style.gridTemplateAreas === areas &&
                mainW.style.width === '100%' &&
                pipW.style.width === '220px' &&
                (!chat || chat.style.width === '340px')) {
                return;   // ← no reflow, no repaint, no SVG re-raster
            }
        }
        applyLandscapeForce._last = stateKey;

        // ── Apply (idempotent — no invalidation kalau value sama) ──
        setIfDiff(box, 'grid-template-columns', cols, 'important');
        setIfDiff(box, 'grid-template-rows', 'minmax(0, 1fr)', 'important');
        setIfDiff(box, 'grid-template-areas', areas, 'important');

        setIfDiff(panel, 'grid-area', 'panel', 'important');

        setIfDiff(mainW, 'grid-area', 'remote', 'important');
        setIfDiff(mainW, 'width', '100%', 'important');
        setIfDiff(mainW, 'height', '100%', 'important');
        setIfDiff(mainW, 'max-width', '100%', 'important');
        setIfDiff(mainW, 'max-height', '100%', 'important');
        setIfDiff(mainW, 'justify-self', 'center', 'important');
        setIfDiff(mainW, 'align-self', 'center', 'important');
        setIfDiff(mainW, 'margin', '0', 'important');
        setIfDiff(mainW, 'z-index', '1', 'important');

        setIfDiff(pipW, 'grid-area', 'remote', 'important');
        setIfDiff(pipW, 'width', '220px', 'important');
        setIfDiff(pipW, 'height', '165px', 'important');
        setIfDiff(pipW, 'justify-self', mir ? 'start' : 'end', 'important');
        setIfDiff(pipW, 'align-self', 'end', 'important');
        setIfDiff(pipW, 'margin', mir ? '0 0 16px 16px' : '0 16px 16px 0', 'important');
        setIfDiff(pipW, 'z-index', '9999', 'important');

        if (chat) {
            setIfDiff(chat, 'position', 'absolute', 'important');
            setIfDiff(chat, 'grid-area', 'unset', 'important');
            setIfDiff(chat, 'width', '340px', 'important');
            setIfDiff(chat, 'height', '320px', 'important');
            setIfDiff(chat, 'z-index', '9996', 'important');

            var br = box.getBoundingClientRect();
            var mr = mainW.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (mr.width > 10 && br.width > 10) {
                setIfDiff(chat, 'bottom', Math.round(br.bottom - mr.bottom + 16) + 'px', 'important');
                setIfDiff(chat, 'top', 'auto', 'important');
                if (mir) {
                    setIfDiff(chat, 'right', Math.round(br.right - mr.right + 16) + 'px', 'important');
                    setIfDiff(chat, 'left', 'auto', 'important');
                } else {
                    setIfDiff(chat, 'left', Math.round(mr.left - br.left + 16) + 'px', 'important');
                    setIfDiff(chat, 'right', 'auto', 'important');
                }
            }
        }

        // ⚠️ NS CONTAINER TIDAK DISENTUH — biarkan module `CUSTOM NO-SIGNAL` urus sendiri
    }
    applyLandscapeForce._last = '';

   function tick() {
    var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
    if (!box) return;
    if (window.__caLogicV25) return; // ⭐ [FIX F11] Matikan total
    if (window.__caVTActive) return;
        if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-booting')) return;

        var isCinema3 = box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-active');
        var isLandscape = box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-landscape-mode');
        var isActive = box.classList.contains('ca-hard-lock-active');

        if (isCinema3 && isLandscape) {
            applyLandscapeForce(box);
            if (!isActive) box.classList.add('ca-hard-lock-active');
            return;
        }

        if (isActive) {
            clearForcedInline(box);
            box.classList.remove('ca-hard-lock-active');
        }
    }

    setInterval(tick, 500);

    new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (!document.documentElement.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-booting')) {
            setTimeout(tick, 50);
            setTimeout(tick, 300);
            setTimeout(tick, 800);
            setTimeout(tick, 2000);
        }
    }).observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });

    var __boxMo = null;
    function watchBox() {
        var box = document.querySelector('.roulette-box');
        if (!box || (__boxMo && __boxMo._target === box)) return;
        if (__boxMo) try { __boxMo.disconnect(); } catch(e){}
        __boxMo = new MutationObserver(function () {
            requestAnimationFrame(tick);
            setTimeout(tick, 50);
            setTimeout(tick, 200);
        });
        __boxMo._target = box;
        __boxMo.observe(box, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    }
    watchBox();
    setInterval(watchBox, 3000);

    if (window.__caBodyBus) {
        window.__caBodyBus.subscribe(function (n) {
            if (n && n.nodeType === 1 && n.classList &&
                n.classList.contains('roulette-box')) {
                setTimeout(tick, 150);
                setTimeout(tick, 800);
            }
        });
    }

    console.log('[CA-HARD-LOCK-LANDSCAPE v2.3] ✅ idempotent + fast-path + no NS touching');
})();

    function __ca25_applyDisplayContents(box) {
        if (!box || !box.classList.contains('ca-cinema3-active')) return;
        var targets = ['remote-video-wrapper', 'local-video-wrapper'];
        for (var i = 0; i < targets.length; i++) {
            // ⭐ KUNCI: HANYA box.querySelector — JANGAN fallback ke getElementById
            //    (cegah walk-up sampai ke <body> saat transient detach)
            var el = box.querySelector('#' + targets[i]);
            if (!el) continue;
            var parent = el.parentElement;
            var depth = 0;
            while (parent && parent !== box && depth < 30) {
                if (parent.style.display !== 'contents') {
                    parent.style.setProperty('display', 'contents', 'important');
                }
                parent = parent.parentElement;
                depth++;
            }
        }
        var chat = box.querySelector('.chat');
        if (chat) {
            var cp = chat.parentElement;
            var d = 0;
            while (cp && cp !== box && d < 30) {
                if (cp.style.display !== 'contents') {
                    cp.style.setProperty('display', 'contents', 'important');
                }
                cp = cp.parentElement;
                d++;
            }
        }
    }

    function __ca25_cleanInlineGrid(box) {

                         function __ca25_fix() {

            }

    // ⭐ TAMBAHAN: Helper untuk membuat blur snapshot di mode Cinema Normal
    var __ca25BlurCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    __ca25BlurCanvas.width = 32; __ca25BlurCanvas.height = 18;

    window.__ca25_updateBlur = function() {
        var video = document.getElementById('remote-video');
        if (!video || video.readyState < 2 || video.videoWidth === 0) return;
        var now = Date.now();
        if (now - __ca25LastBlurUpdate < 1000) return; // Throttle 1 detik
        __ca25LastBlurUpdate = now;

        try {
            __ca25BlurCtx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, 32, 18);
            var imgData = __ca25BlurCtx.getImageData(0, 0, 32, 18).data;

        }, CFG.DOH_TIMEOUT_MS);
        try {
            GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                method: 'GET',
                url: 'https://dns.google/resolve?name=' + encodeURIComponent(name) + '&type=' + type,
                timeout: CFG.DOH_TIMEOUT_MS,
                onload: function (r) {
                    if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer);
                    try { callback(JSON.parse(r.responseText)); }
                    catch (e) { callback(null); }
                },
                onerror: function () { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); callback(null); },
                ontimeout: function () { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); callback(null); }
            });
        } catch (e) {
            if (!settled) { settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); callback(null); }
        }
    }

    function isIPv4(ip) { return /^\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}$/.test(String(ip)); }
    function isIPv6(ip) { return typeof ip === 'string' && ip.indexOf(':') !== -1 && /^[0-9a-fA-F:]+$/.test(ip); }

    function expandIPv6(ip) {
        ip = String(ip).split('%')[0].toLowerCase();
        if (ip.indexOf('::') === -1) {
            var segs = ip.split(':');
            while (segs.length < 8) segs.push('0');
            return segs.map(function (g) { return ('0000' + g).slice(-4); }).join('');
        }
        var halves = ip.split('::');
        var left = halves[0] ? halves[0].split(':') : [];
        var right = halves.length > 1 && halves[1] ? halves[1].split(':') : [];
        var missing = 8 - (left.length + right.length);
        if (missing < 0) missing = 0;
        var middle = new Array(missing).fill('0');
        return left.concat(middle, right)
            .map(function (g) { return ('0000' + g).slice(-4); })
            .join('');
    }

    function reverseIPv6(ip) {
        return expandIPv6(ip).split('').reverse().join('.');
    }

    function addSignal(info, signal) {
    if (!info) return;
    if (!info.advSignals) info.advSignals = [];
    // idempotent: skip kalau tag sudah ada
    for (var i = 0; i < info.advSignals.length; i++) {
        if (info.advSignals[i].tag === signal.tag) return;
    }
    info.advSignals.push(signal);
    // ⭐ FIX: update score + level supaya signal berpengaruh ke verdict
    // ⭐ FASE3-FIX: clamp [0,100] — cegah skor negatif dari FASE3-CLEAN (delta -15)
    var _raw = (info.advVpnScore || 0) + (signal.delta || 0);
    info.advVpnScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, _raw));
    var _sc = info.advVpnScore;
    info.advVpnLevel = _sc >= 50 ? 'high' : _sc >= 30 ? 'medium' : _sc > 0 ? 'low' : 'clean';
    info.advVpnLabel = _sc >= 50 ? '🔴 VPN HOSTING/VPN ASN TERDETEKSI'
                     : _sc >= 30 ? '🟠 SUSPICIOUS ASN/TZ'
                     : _sc > 0   ? '🟡 MINOR SIGNAL'
                     :             '🟢 CLEAN';
}

    function signalExists(info, tag) {
        if (!info || !info.advSignals) return false;
        for (var i = 0; i < info.advSignals.length; i++) {
            if (info.advSignals[i].tag === tag) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

              function refreshVerdict() {
        try { if (W.__caUnifiedVerdictRefresh) W.__caUnifiedVerdictRefresh(); } catch (e) {}
        try { if (W.__ca && W.__ca.updateFloatingBox) W.__ca.updateFloatingBox(); } catch (e) {}
        // ⭐ FIX: Blok dispatch 'ca-ip-ready' dihapus untuk mencegah infinite loop (spam console)

        // ⭐ NEW: dedicated event — cakup Tor, IPv6, Kitsune, Fase3
        //    Loop-safe: 'ca-vpn-updated' TIDAK memicu onIPReady/Fase3/analyzeRelayIP
        try {
            W.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ca-vpn-updated', {
                detail: {
                    ip: (W.__ca && W.__ca.state && W.__ca.state.currentIP) || '',
                    reason: 'refresh-verdict'
                }
            }));
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // FASE 1 — TOR EXIT LIST
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    var torCache = null;

    function loadTorCache() {
        var cached = getVal(KEYS.TOR, null);
        if (cached && cached.ips && cached.ts && (Date.now() - cached.ts) < CFG.TOR_TTL_MS) {
            torCache = new Set(cached.ips);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function refreshTorList() {
        if (!ENABLE.TOR) return;
        if (typeof GM_xmlhttpRequest !== 'function') return;
        try {
            GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                method: 'GET',
                url: CFG.TOR_URL,
                timeout: 15000,
                onload: function (r) {
                    try {
                        var lines = r.responseText.split(/\r?\n/);
                        var ips = [];
                        for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                            var s = lines[i].trim();
                            if (!s || s.charAt(0) === '#') continue;
                            if (isIPv4(s)) ips.push(s);
                        }
                        if (ips.length > 100) {
                            torCache = new Set(ips);
                            setVal(KEYS.TOR, { ips: ips, ts: Date.now() });
                            console.log('[CA-VPN] ✅ Tor list: ' + ips.length + ' exits');
                        }
                    } catch (e) {}
                }
            });
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function isTorExit(ip) {
        return !!(ENABLE.TOR && torCache && torCache.has(ip));
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // FASE 1 — IPv6 PTR LOOKUP
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function lookupIPv6Ptr(ip, callback) {
        if (!ENABLE.IPV6_PTR || !isIPv6(ip)) { callback(null); return; }

        var ptrCache = getVal(KEYS.PTR, {}) || {};
        var cached = ptrCache[ip];
        if (cached && (Date.now() - cached.ts) < CFG.PTR_TTL_MS) {
            callback(cached);
            return;
        }

        var reverse = reverseIPv6(ip) + '.ip6.arpa';
        dohQuery(reverse, 'PTR', function (res) {
            if (!res) { callback(null); return; }

            var hasA = false;
            var ptrs = [];
            var answers = res.Answer || [];
            for (var i = 0; i < answers.length; i++) {
                if (answers[i].type === 12) ptrs.push(answers[i].data);
                if (answers[i].type === 1) hasA = true; // RFC violation → anomaly
            }

            var result = { ptrs: ptrs, hasARecord: hasA, ts: Date.now() };
            ptrCache[ip] = result;
            setVal(KEYS.PTR, ptrCache);
            callback(result);
        });
    }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// FASE 2 FIX — Team Cymru dengan fallback ipinfo + debug
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function lookupASN(ip, callback) {
    if (!ip) { callback(null); return; }

    var asnCache = getVal(KEYS.ASN, {}) || {};
    var cached = asnCache[ip];
    if (cached && (Date.now() - cached.ts) < CFG.ASN_TTL_MS) {
        callback(cached);
        return;
    }

    tryCymruASN(ip, function (cymruResult) {
        if (cymruResult) {
            var classified = classifyASNType(cymruResult);

            // ⭐ FIX: Cymru DNS 5-part (no name) + ASN tidak di registry
            //         → enrich via ipinfo untuk dapat name + type
            if (classified === 'unknown' && !cymruResult.name) {
                console.log('[CA-VPN] Cymru: unknown + no name → ipinfo enrich');
                tryIpinfoASN(ip, function (ipinfoResult) {
                    if (ipinfoResult) {
                        cymruResult.name = ipinfoResult.name || '';
                        cymruResult.type = ipinfoResult.type || 'unknown';
                        cymruResult.enrichedBy = 'ipinfo';
                    }
                    asnCache[ip] = cymruResult;
                    setVal(KEYS.ASN, asnCache);
                    callback(cymruResult);
                });
                return;
            }

            asnCache[ip] = cymruResult;
            setVal(KEYS.ASN, asnCache);
            callback(cymruResult);
            return;
        }

        // Cymru gagal total → full ipinfo fallback
        tryIpinfoASN(ip, function (ipinfoResult) {
            if (ipinfoResult) {
                asnCache[ip] = ipinfoResult;
                setVal(KEYS.ASN, asnCache);
            }
            callback(ipinfoResult);
        });
    });
}

function tryCymruASN(ip, callback) {
    var reverse, zone;
    if (isIPv4(ip)) {
        reverse = ip.split('.').reverse().join('.');
        zone = 'origin.asn.cymru.com';
    } else if (isIPv6(ip)) {
        reverse = reverseIPv6(ip);
        zone = 'origin6.asn.cymru.com';
    } else {
        callback(null); return;
    }

    var queryName = reverse + '.' + zone;
    console.log('[CA-VPN-CYMRU] query:', queryName);

    dohQuery(queryName, 'TXT', function (res) {
        console.log('[CA-VPN-CYMRU] raw:', res);

        if (!res) {
            console.warn('[CA-VPN-CYMRU] ❌ no response for', ip);
            callback(null); return;
        }
        if (res.Status !== 0) {
            console.warn('[CA-VPN-CYMRU] ❌ DNS status=' + res.Status + ' for', ip);
            callback(null); return;
        }
        if (!res.Answer || !res.Answer.length) {
            console.warn('[CA-VPN-CYMRU] ❌ empty answer for', ip);
            callback(null); return;
        }

        try {
            var txtRecord = null;
            for (var i = 0; i < res.Answer.length; i++) {
                if (res.Answer[i].type === 16) { txtRecord = res.Answer[i]; break; }
            }
            if (!txtRecord) {
                console.warn('[CA-VPN-CYMRU] ❌ no TXT record for', ip);
                callback(null); return;
            }

            var raw = String(txtRecord.data || '').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim();
            console.log('[CA-VPN-CYMRU] TXT:', raw);

            var parts = raw.split('|').map(function (s) { return s.trim(); });

            // ⭐ FIX: DNS TXT often omits AS Name (5 fields instead of 6)
            // WHOIS: "ASN|Prefix|CC|Registry|Allocated|AS Name"
            // DNS:   "ASN|Prefix|CC|Registry|Allocated"
            if (parts.length < 5) {
                console.warn('[CA-VPN-CYMRU] ❌ parse fail, parts=' + parts.length);
                callback(null); return;
            }

            callback({
                asn: parts[0] || null,
                prefix: parts[1] || null,
                country: parts[2] || null,
                registry: parts[3] || null,
                allocated: parts[4] || null,
                name: parts[5] || '',    // empty when DNS omits name — OK
                source: 'cymru',
                ts: Date.now()
            });
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[CA-VPN-CYMRU] ❌ exception:', e);
            callback(null);
        }
    });
}

function tryIpinfoASN(ip, callback) {
    if (typeof GM_xmlhttpRequest !== 'function') { callback(null); return; }

    var token = '';
    try {
        if (typeof GM_getValue === 'function') token = GM_getValue('ca_ipinfo_token', '') || '';
        if (!token) token = localStorage.getItem('ca_ipinfo_token') || '';
    } catch (e) {}

    var url = token
        ? 'https://ipinfo.io/' + ip + '/json?token=' + encodeURIComponent(token)
        : 'https://ipinfo.io/' + ip + '/json';

    var settled = false;
    var timer = setTimeout(function () {
        if (!settled) { settled = true; callback(null); }
    }, 4000);

    GM_xmlhttpRequest({
        method: 'GET',
        url: url,
        timeout: 3500,
        onload: function (r) {
            if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer);
            try {
                var d = JSON.parse(r.responseText);
                if (!d || d.error || !d.org) { callback(null); return; }

                                var m = String(d.org).match(/^(AS\d+)\s+(.+)$/);
                var asnNum = m ? m[1].replace('AS', '') : null;
                var asnName = m ? m[2] : String(d.org);

                // ⭐ FIX: delegate ke classifyASNType (ASN-number-first)
                var klass = classifyASNType({ asn: asnNum, name: asnName });

                console.log('[CA-VPN-IPINFO] AS' + asnNum + ' ' + asnName + ' → ' + klass);

                callback({
                    asn: asnNum,
                    name: asnName,
                    type: klass,
                    source: 'ipinfo',
                    ts: Date.now()
                });
            } catch (e) { callback(null); }
        },
        onerror: function () { if (!settled) { settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); callback(null); } },
        ontimeout: function () { if (!settled) { settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); callback(null); } }
    });
}

// Update classifyASNType untuk konsumsi format baru (ipinfo ada field `type`)
function classifyASNType(asnData) {
    if (!asnData) return 'unknown';
    if (asnData.type) return asnData.type;   // already classified — idempotent

    var name = (asnData.name || '').toLowerCase();
    var asn = parseInt(asnData.asn, 10);

    // ══ PRIMARY: ASN-number registry (works even when name absent) ══
    var VPN_ASNS = [9009, 62240, 202425, 209854, 216071];
    if (VPN_ASNS.indexOf(asn) !== -1) return 'vpn';

    var HOSTING_ASNS = [
        // Major cloud
        16509, 14618, 15169, 396982, 8075, 13335,
        // VPS / hosting
        14061, 16276, 24940, 213230, 51167, 12876, 20473, 63949,
        32475, 36352, 46844, 40676, 49981, 60068, 61317, 53479,
        53667, 47583, 200373, 198605, 210644, 399486, 30936, 32244,
        61138, 51852, 29761, 212238,
        // Regional cloud
        132203, 37963, 45102, 55990, 136907, 138915, 135377
    ];
    if (HOSTING_ASNS.indexOf(asn) !== -1) return 'hosting';

    // ⭐ FIX #7: check learned ASN cache BEFORE name-based fallback
    // Priority: hardcoded ASN list > learned cache > name pattern
    var learnedType = getLearnedAsnType(asn);
    if (learnedType) return learnedType;

    // ══ SECONDARY: name-based fallback ══
    if (/\b(vpn|proxy|m247|nord|surfshark|express|cyberghost|ipvanish|mullvad|private internet|torguard|windscribe|protonvpn|purevpn)\b/i.test(name)) {
        return 'vpn';
    }
    if (/\b(hosting|cloud|datacenter|data center|vps|colocation|amazon|aws|google cloud|microsoft azure|digitalocean|linode|vultr|ovh|hetzner|contabo|leaseweb|aeza|racknerd|hivelocity|psychz)\b/i.test(name)) {
        return 'hosting';
    }
    if (/\b(mobile|cellular|lte|gsm|4g|5g|wireless|telkomsel|indosat|smartfren|vodafone|t-mobile|telefonica)\b/i.test(name)) {
        return 'mobile';
    }
    if (/\b(telekom|telecom|broadband|fiber|ftth|dsl|cable|comcast|verizon|at&t|charter|cox|centurylink|frontier|spectrum|indihome|biznet|first media)\b/i.test(name)) {
        return 'isp';
    }
    return 'unknown';
}

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // FASE 2 — KITSUNE-DERIVED CLASSIFICATION
    //    Adaptasi: kita hanya punya srflx origin, bukan exit IP.
    //    Rule: srflx origin di-hosting/datacenter ASN → signal.
    //    Country mismatch + DC origin → konfirmasi kuat.
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function applyKitsuneRule(info, srflxIp, domCode) {
        if (!ENABLE.KITSUNE || !srflxIp || !info) return;

        lookupASN(srflxIp, function (asnData) {
            if (!asnData || !asnData.asn) return;
            var asnType = classifyASNType(asnData);
            if (asnType !== 'hosting' && asnType !== 'vpn') return;

            // Simpan ASN info di info (diagnostic)
            info.srflxASN = asnData.asn;
            info.srflxASNName = asnData.name;
            info.srflxASNType = asnType;

            // Tambah signal
            addSignal(info, {
                tag: 'KITSUNE-DC-ORIGIN',
                delta: WEIGHTS['KITSUNE-DC-ORIGIN'],
                detail: 'WebRTC origin AS' + asnData.asn + ' (' + asnType + ')'
            });

            applyScoreRebalance(info);
            refreshVerdict();
        });
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // FASE 1 — SCORE REBALANCE (TZ/Lang diturunkan + penalty)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function applyScoreRebalance(info) {
        if (!ENABLE.SCORE_REBALANCE || !info) return;
        if (!info.advSignals || !info.advSignals.length) return;

        var score = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < info.advSignals.length; i++) {
            var s = info.advSignals[i];
            var w = WEIGHTS[s.tag];
            score += (w !== undefined ? w : (s.delta || 0));
        }

        // Penalties dari sinyal positif
        if (info.ispType === 'fixed') score -= 10;
        if (info.ispType === 'mobile') score -= 5;
        if (info.reverseDns && info.reverseDns.length) {
            var rds = info.reverseDns.join(' ').toLowerCase();
            if (/\b(broadband|fiber|ftth|dsl|cable|residential|dynamic|ppp)\b/.test(rds)) {
                score -= 15;
            }
        }

        score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score));
        info.advVpnScore = score;
        info.advVpnLevel = score >= 50 ? 'high'
                         : score >= 30 ? 'medium'
                         : score > 0   ? 'low'
                         :              'clean';
        info.advVpnLabel = score >= 50 ? '🔴 VPN HOSTING/VPN ASN TERDETEKSI'
                         : score >= 30 ? '🟠 SUSPICIOUS ASN/TZ'
                         : score > 0   ? '🟡 MINOR SIGNAL'
                         :              '🟢 CLEAN';
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // FASE 1 — RELAY LOADING BADGE
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    (function () {
        if (document.getElementById('ca-relay-loading-kf')) return;
        var s = document.createElement('style');
        s.id = 'ca-relay-loading-kf';
        s.textContent = '@keyframes caPulseLoading {0%,100%{opacity:.6}50%{opacity:1}}';
        document.head.appendChild(s);
    })();

    function renderRelayLoadingBadge() {
        if (!ENABLE.RELAY_LOADING) return;
        var content = document.getElementById('ca-float-content');
        if (!content) return;

        var caState = W.__ca && W.__ca.state;
        var info = caState && caState.currentIPInfo;
        var isRelay = caState && caState.currentIPType === 'relay';
        var isLoading = info && info.relayAnalysis && info.relayAnalysis.loading;

        var existing = content.querySelector('.ca-relay-loading-badge');

        if (!isRelay || !isLoading) {
            if (existing) existing.remove();
            return;
        }
        if (existing) return;

        var badge = document.createElement('div');
        badge.className = 'ca-relay-loading-badge';
        badge.style.cssText = 'margin:8px 0;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;' +

            'animation:caPulseLoading 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;';
        badge.innerHTML = '<div>⏳ Menganalisis relay…</div>';
        content.appendChild(badge);
    }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// FASE 3 — MULTI-PROVIDER ENRICHMENT (FREE + PAID)
//    Priority: ipapi.is > vpnapi.io > proxycheck.io > ip-api.com
//    Cache 24h di localStorage (per IP) — hemat quota provider
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var FASE3_KEYS = {
    ipapi_is:   'ca_fase3_key_ipapi_is',
    vpnapi_io:  'ca_fase3_key_vpnapi_io',
    findip_net: 'ca_findip_token'
};
var FASE3_CACHE_KEY  = 'ca_fase3_results';
var FASE3_CACHE_TTL  = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;   // ⭐ fallback default — lihat _getFase3TTL()

// ⭐ FIX #6: TTL dinamis untuk Fase3 cache
// VPN/hosting/Tor signal: 1 jam (cepat recycle)
// Clean: 24 jam (aman)
// Unknown: 12 jam (konservatif)
function _getFase3TTL(e) {
    if (!e || !e.result) return FASE3_CACHE_TTL;
    var signals = e.result.signals || [];
    var hasVpnSignal = signals.some(function(s) {
        return s.tag === 'VPN-ASN' ||
               s.tag === 'TOR-EXIT' ||
               s.tag === 'SUSPICIOUS-RELAY' ||
               s.tag === 'HOSTING-ASN';
    });
    if (hasVpnSignal) return 60 * 60 * 1000;                    // 1 jam
    if (e.result.clean) return FASE3_CACHE_TTL;                 // 24 jam
    return 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000;                                 // 12 jam
}

function getFase3Key(provider) {
    try {
        if (typeof GM_getValue === 'function') {
            var v = GM_getValue(FASE3_KEYS[provider], '');
            if (v) return v;
        }
        var ls = localStorage.getItem(FASE3_KEYS[provider]) || '';
        if (ls) return ls;
        if (provider === 'findip_net') return 'a07b56057712948e8ea7d00ba90fa7c0';
        return '';
    } catch(e) { return ''; }
}

function setFase3Key(provider, key) {
    var clean = String(key || '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/g, '').slice(0, 64);
    try {
        if (typeof GM_setValue === 'function') {
            GM_setValue(FASE3_KEYS[provider], clean);
        } else {
            if (clean) localStorage.setItem(FASE3_KEYS[provider], clean);
            else       localStorage.removeItem(FASE3_KEYS[provider]);
        }
        return true;
    } catch(e) { return false; }
}

function getFase3Cache(ip) {
    try {
        var all = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FASE3_CACHE_KEY) || '{}');
        var e = all[ip];
        if (!e) return null;
        // ⭐ FIX #6: TTL dinamis (was: flat 24h)
        var ttl = _getFase3TTL(e);
        if (Date.now() - e.ts > ttl) {
            delete all[ip];
            localStorage.setItem(FASE3_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
            return null;
        }
        return e;
    } catch(e) { return null; }
}

function setFase3Cache(ip, provider, result) {
    try {
        var all = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FASE3_CACHE_KEY) || '{}');
        all[ip] = { ts: Date.now(), provider: provider, result: result };
        var keys = Object.keys(all);
        if (keys.length > 500) {
            keys.sort(function(a, b) { return (all[b].ts || 0) - (all[a].ts || 0); });
            var pruned = {};
            keys.slice(0, 300).forEach(function(k) { pruned[k] = all[k]; });
            all = pruned;
        }
        localStorage.setItem(FASE3_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
    } catch(e) {}
}

var FASE3_PROVIDERS = [
    {
        name: 'ipapi_is', label: 'ipapi.is', needsKey: true,
        url: function(ip) {
            var k = getFase3Key('ipapi_is');
            return 'https://api.ipapi.is/?q=' + encodeURIComponent(ip) + (k ? '&key=' + encodeURIComponent(k) : '');
        },
        parse: function(d) {
            if (!d || d.error) return null;
            var s = [];
            if (d.is_vpn)        s.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN',     delta: 50, detail: 'ipapi.is is_vpn' });
            if (d.is_proxy)      s.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN',     delta: 50, detail: 'ipapi.is is_proxy' });
            if (d.is_tor)        s.push({ tag: 'TOR-EXIT',    delta: 60, detail: 'ipapi.is is_tor' });
            if (d.is_datacenter) s.push({ tag: 'HOSTING-ASN', delta: 35, detail: 'ipapi.is is_datacenter' });
            return { signals: s, clean: s.length === 0 };
        }
    },
    {
        name: 'vpnapi_io', label: 'vpnapi.io', needsKey: true,
        url: function(ip) {
            var k = getFase3Key('vpnapi_io');
            return 'https://vpnapi.io/api/' + encodeURIComponent(ip) + '?key=' + encodeURIComponent(k);
        },
        parse: function(d) {
            if (!d || !d.security) return null;
            var s = [], sec = d.security;
            if (sec.vpn)   s.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN',          delta: 50, detail: 'vpnapi.io vpn=true' });
            if (sec.proxy) s.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN',          delta: 50, detail: 'vpnapi.io proxy=true' });
            if (sec.tor)   s.push({ tag: 'TOR-EXIT',         delta: 60, detail: 'vpnapi.io tor=true' });
            if (sec.relay) s.push({ tag: 'SUSPICIOUS-RELAY', delta: 40, detail: 'vpnapi.io relay=true' });
            return { signals: s, clean: s.length === 0 };
        }
    },
    {
        name: 'proxycheck_io', label: 'proxycheck.io', needsKey: false,
        url: function(ip) {
            return 'https://proxycheck.io/v2/' + encodeURIComponent(ip) + '?vpn=1&asn=1&risk=1&tag=ChatAltUltimate';
        },
        parse: function(d) {
            if (!d || d.status !== 'ok') return null;
            var entry = null;
            for (var k in d) {
                if (k !== 'status' && d[k] && typeof d[k] === 'object') { entry = d[k]; break; }
            }
            if (!entry) return null;
            var s = [];
            var proxy = String(entry.proxy || '').toLowerCase();
            var type  = String(entry.type  || '').toLowerCase();
            if (proxy === 'yes') {
                if (type.indexOf('tor') !== -1)        s.push({ tag: 'TOR-EXIT',    delta: 60, detail: 'proxycheck tor' });
                else if (type.indexOf('vpn') !== -1)   s.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN',     delta: 50, detail: 'proxycheck vpn' });
                else if (type.indexOf('proxy') !== -1) s.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN',     delta: 50, detail: 'proxycheck proxy' });
                else                                    s.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN',     delta: 50, detail: 'proxycheck: ' + (type || 'yes') });
            }
            var risk = parseInt(entry.risk, 10);
            if (!isNaN(risk) && risk >= 66 && !s.some(function(x){return x.tag==='VPN-ASN';})) {
                s.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN', delta: 30, detail: 'proxycheck risk=' + risk });
            }
            return { signals: s, clean: s.length === 0 };
        }
    },
        {
        name: 'ip_api_com', label: 'ip-api.com', needsKey: false,
        url: function(ip) {
            return 'http://ip-api.com/json/' + encodeURIComponent(ip) + '?fields=status,message,proxy,hosting,isp,org,as,query';
        },
        parse: function(d) {
            if (!d || d.status !== 'success') return null;
            var s = [];
            if (d.proxy)   s.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN',     delta: 50, detail: 'ip-api.com proxy=1' });
            if (d.hosting) s.push({ tag: 'HOSTING-ASN', delta: 35, detail: 'ip-api.com hosting=1' });
            return { signals: s, clean: s.length === 0 };
        }
    },
        {
        name: 'findip_net',
        label: 'findip.net',
        needsKey: true,
        url: function(ip) {
            var k = getFase3Key('findip_net');
            return 'https://api.findip.net/' + encodeURIComponent(ip) + '/?token=' + encodeURIComponent(k);
        },
        parse: function(d) {
            if (!d) return null;
            var s = [];

            // Priority 1: intelligence (MaxMind Anonymous/Precision tier)
            if (d.intelligence) {
                var f = d.intelligence.flags || {};
                if (f.is_tor)       s.push({ tag: 'TOR-EXIT',         delta: 60, detail: 'findip.net is_tor' });
                if (f.is_vpn)       s.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN',          delta: 50, detail: 'findip.net is_vpn' });
                if (f.is_proxy)     s.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN',          delta: 50, detail: 'findip.net is_proxy' });
                if (f.is_relay)     s.push({ tag: 'SUSPICIOUS-RELAY', delta: 40, detail: 'findip.net is_relay' });
                if (f.is_hosting)   s.push({ tag: 'HOSTING-ASN',      delta: 35, detail: 'findip.net is_hosting' });
                if (f.is_malicious) s.push({ tag: 'MALICIOUS-IP',     delta: 70, detail: 'findip.net is_malicious' });
                return { signals: s, clean: s.length === 0 };
            }

            // Priority 2: traits (MaxMind GeoIP2 ISP tier)
            if (d.traits) {
                var t = d.traits;
                if (t.is_tor_exit_node)       s.push({ tag: 'TOR-EXIT',    delta: 60, detail: 'findip.net tor_exit' });
                if (t.is_anonymous_vpn)       s.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN',     delta: 50, detail: 'findip.net anon_vpn' });
                if (t.is_public_proxy)        s.push({ tag: 'VPN-ASN',     delta: 50, detail: 'findip.net public_proxy' });
                if (t.is_hosting_provider)    s.push({ tag: 'HOSTING-ASN', delta: 35, detail: 'findip.net hosting' });
                if (t.user_type === 'hosting')s.push({ tag: 'HOSTING-ASN', delta: 35, detail: 'findip.net user_type=hosting' });
                return { signals: s, clean: s.length === 0 };
            }

            // Neither — free tier tanpa intel data → anggap clean
            // (cegah cascade ke provider berikutnya, hemat quota)
            return { signals: [], clean: true };
        }
    }
];

function applyFase3Signals(info, result, sourceLabel) {
    if (!info || !result) return;

    // ⭐ FIX: Guard agar tidak render berulang-ulang jika cache hit
    if (info.fase3Applied) return;
    info.fase3Applied = true;

    info.fase3Source = sourceLabel;
    if (result.signals && result.signals.length > 0) {
        for (var i = 0; i < result.signals.length; i++) {
            addSignal(info, result.signals[i]);
        }
    }
    if (result.clean) {
        // ⭐ FASE3-FIX: delta -15 untuk "mencerahkan" false positive minor
        // (UNKNOWN-ASN 15, NO-RDNS 15, RDNS-NON-RESIDENTIAL 15 → bisa di-counter)
        addSignal(info, {
            tag: 'FASE3-CLEAN',
            delta: -15,
            detail: 'Verified clean by ' + sourceLabel
        });
    }
    applyScoreRebalance(info);
    refreshVerdict();
}

function enrichWithFase3(ip, info) {
    if (!ENABLE.IPAPI_IS) return;
    if (!ip || !info) return;
    // ⭐ FASE3-FIX: threshold 60 → 80 — verifikasi borderline tetap dijalankan.
    // Skor 60 sangat tinggi; zona 50-79 justru paling butuh verifikasi eksternal.
    if ((info.advVpnScore || 0) >= 80) return;

    var cached = getFase3Cache(ip);
    if (cached) {
        console.log('[CA-FASE3] ⚡ cache hit for ' + ip + ' (' + cached.provider + ')');
        applyFase3Signals(info, cached.result, cached.provider);
        return;
    }

    // Build available provider list (semua yang key-nya sudah diset)
    var available = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < FASE3_PROVIDERS.length; i++) {
        var p = FASE3_PROVIDERS[i];
        if (p.needsKey && !getFase3Key(p.name)) continue;
        available.push(p);
    }
    if (available.length === 0) {
        console.log('[CA-FASE3] No provider available (all need keys, none configured)');
        return;
    }

        // ⭐ PARALLEL MARKER — satu kali per session, untuk verifikasi console
    if (!window.__caFase3ParallelLogged) {
        window.__caFase3ParallelLogged = true;
        // ⭐ FIX #8a: propagate ke unsafeWindow (page scope) untuk verify script
        try { if (typeof W !== 'undefined' && W) W.__caFase3ParallelLogged = true; } catch(e) {}
        console.log('%c[CA-FASE3] 🚀 PARALLEL MERGE MODE ACTIVE (' + available.length + ' providers)',
                    'color:#10b981;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;background:#000;padding:2px 6px;');
    }

    var results = [];
    var pending = available.length;
    var settled = false;
    var tried = [];
    var batchStartAt = Date.now();

    console.log('[CA-FASE3] 🔍 Batch querying ' + available.length + ' providers for ' + ip +
                ' → ' + available.map(function(x){return x.label;}).join(', '));

    // ⭐ FINALIZE — merge semua sinyal setelah semua provider settle
    var finalize = function() {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;

        var merged = { signals: [], clean: false };
        var contributors = [];
        var anySignal = false;
        var anyClean = false;

        for (var r = 0; r < results.length; r++) {
            var rr = results[r];
            if (!rr || !rr.result) continue;
            contributors.push(rr.provider);
            if (rr.result.signals && rr.result.signals.length > 0) {
                anySignal = true;
                for (var s = 0; s < rr.result.signals.length; s++) {
                    merged.signals.push(rr.result.signals[s]);
                }
            }
            if (rr.result.clean) anyClean = true;
        }

        // Dedup signals by tag+detail (cegah double signal dari provider berbeda)
        var seenSig = {};
        var deduped = [];
        for (var ds = 0; ds < merged.signals.length; ds++) {
            var sig = merged.signals[ds];
            var key = sig.tag + '|' + (sig.detail || '');
            if (seenSig[key]) continue;
            seenSig[key] = true;
            deduped.push(sig);
        }
        merged.signals = deduped;

        // ⭐ Clean HANYA kalau tidak ada signal + minimal 1 provider confirm clean
        merged.clean = !anySignal && anyClean;

        var sourceLabel = contributors.length > 0 ? contributors.join('+') : 'none';
        var batchElapsed = Date.now() - batchStartAt;

        // ⭐ Cache dulu (sebelum race guard) — IP→result tetap valid meski partner ganti
        if (contributors.length > 0) {
            setFase3Cache(ip, sourceLabel, merged);
        }

        // ⭐ Learn ASN dari strong signals (sebelum race guard)
        if (info && info.asn && merged.signals.length > 0) {
            var _hasStrongVpn = merged.signals.some(function(s) {
                return s.tag === 'VPN-ASN' || s.tag === 'TOR-EXIT';
            });
            var _hasStrongHosting = merged.signals.some(function(s) {
                return s.tag === 'HOSTING-ASN';
            });
            if (_hasStrongVpn)          learnAsn(info.asn, info.asnName, 'vpn');
            else if (_hasStrongHosting) learnAsn(info.asn, info.asnName, 'hosting');
        }

        // ⭐ Race guard — info diganti partner baru saat async jalan
        if (W.__ca && W.__ca.state && W.__ca.state.currentIPInfo !== info) {
            console.log('[CA-FASE3] info changed during async — cached for next time');
            return;
        }

        if (contributors.length > 0) {
            applyFase3Signals(info, merged, sourceLabel);
            console.log('%c[CA-FASE3] ✅ ' + sourceLabel + ' → ' +
                (merged.clean ? 'CLEAN' :
                 merged.signals.map(function(x){return x.tag;}).join(',')) +
                ' (' + batchElapsed + 'ms, ' + results.length + '/' + available.length + ' ok)',
                'color:#10b981;font-weight:bold;');
        } else {
            console.warn('[CA-FASE3] ❌ All providers failed: ' + tried.join(', '));
        }
    };

    // Hard timeout untuk seluruh batch (cegah hang kalau ada provider macet)
    var hardTimer = setTimeout(function() {
        if (settled) return;
        console.warn('[CA-FASE3] ⏱️ hard batch timeout (5500ms) → finalize partial');
        finalize();
    }, 5500);

    // ⭐ PARALLEL FIRE — semua provider query bersamaan
    available.forEach(function(provider) {
        tried.push(provider.label);
        var pSettled = false;
        var pTimer = setTimeout(function() {
            if (pSettled) return;
            pSettled = true;
            console.warn('[CA-FASE3] ' + provider.label + ' outer timeout → skip');
            pending--;
            if (pending === 0) { clearTimeout(hardTimer); finalize(); }
        }, 4500);

        try {
            GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                method: 'GET',
                url: provider.url(ip),
                timeout: 4000,
                onload: function(r) {
                    if (pSettled) return;
                    pSettled = true;
                    clearTimeout(pTimer);
                    try {
                        var d = JSON.parse(r.responseText);
                        var result = provider.parse(d);
                        if (result) {
                            results.push({ provider: provider.label, result: result });
                            var tags = result.clean ? 'CLEAN' :
                                result.signals.map(function(x){return x.tag;}).join(',');
                            console.log('[CA-FASE3]   ✓ ' + provider.label + ' → ' + tags);
                        } else {
                            console.warn('[CA-FASE3]   ⚠ ' + provider.label + ' parse null');
                        }
                    } catch(e) {
                        console.warn('[CA-FASE3]   ⚠ ' + provider.label + ' exception:', e);
                    }
                    pending--;
                    if (pending === 0) { clearTimeout(hardTimer); finalize(); }
                },
                onerror: function() {
                    if (pSettled) return;
                    pSettled = true;
                    clearTimeout(pTimer);
                    console.warn('[CA-FASE3]   ✗ ' + provider.label + ' network error');
                    pending--;
                    if (pending === 0) { clearTimeout(hardTimer); finalize(); }
                },
                ontimeout: function() {
                    if (pSettled) return;
                    pSettled = true;
                    clearTimeout(pTimer);
                    console.warn('[CA-FASE3]   ✗ ' + provider.label + ' timeout');
                    pending--;
                    if (pending === 0) { clearTimeout(hardTimer); finalize(); }
                }
            });
        } catch(e) {
            if (!pSettled) {
                pSettled = true;
                clearTimeout(pTimer);
                console.warn('[CA-FASE3]   ✗ ' + provider.label + ' throw:', e);
                pending--;
                if (pending === 0) { clearTimeout(hardTimer); finalize(); }
            }
        }
    });
}

                var lv = localStorage.getItem(FASE3_KEYS[provider]);

            return false;

                continue;

            if (setFase3Key(provider, AUTO_KEYS[provider])) {
                seeded.push(provider);
            }
        }
        if (seeded.length > 0) {
            console.log('[CA-FASE3-SEED] ✅ Auto-seeded: ' + seeded.join(', '));
        }
    })();

        var ip = detail.ip;
        if (!ip) return;

        // Debounce — jangan proses ulang IP yang sama <1s
        if (ip === __lastProcessedIP && (Date.now() - __lastProcessedAt) < 1000) return;
        __lastProcessedIP = ip;
        __lastProcessedAt = Date.now();

        var caState = W.__ca && W.__ca.state;
        if (!caState) return;
        var info = caState.currentIPInfo;
        if (!info) return;
        var domCode = caState.lastDetectedCountry || null;
        var ipType = caState.currentIPType;

        // ── FASE 1: Tor (sync) ──
        if (ENABLE.TOR && isTorExit(ip)) {
            addSignal(info, { tag: 'TOR-EXIT', delta: WEIGHTS['TOR-EXIT'] });
            applyScoreRebalance(info);
            refreshVerdict();
        }

        // ── FASE 1: IPv6 PTR (async) ──
        if (ENABLE.IPV6_PTR && isIPv6(ip)) {
            lookupIPv6Ptr(ip, function (result) {

                if (!info.reverseDns) info.reverseDns = [];

                    if (info.reverseDns.indexOf(p) === -1) info.reverseDns.push(p);
                });

                if (result.hasARecord) {
                    addSignal(info, { tag: 'IPV6-A-RECORD-ANOMALY', delta: WEIGHTS['IPV6-A-RECORD-ANOMALY'] });
                } else if (result.ptrs.length === 0) {
                    addSignal(info, { tag: 'IPV6-NO-PTR', delta: WEIGHTS['IPV6-NO-PTR'] });
                }
                applyScoreRebalance(info);
                refreshVerdict();
            });
        }

        // ── FASE 2: Kitsune (srflx-only adaptation) ──
        if (ENABLE.KITSUNE && ipType === 'srflx' && info.code) {
            // state.currentIP saat ca-ip-ready = srflx origin (non-relay case)
            applyKitsuneRule(info, ip, domCode);
        }

// ── FASE 3: multi-provider enrichment ──
if (ENABLE.IPAPI_IS) {
    setTimeout(function () { enrichWithFase3(ip, info); }, 1000);
}

        // ── FASE 1: Rebalance poll (ad-vpn bisa overwrite) ──
        var rebalanceAttempts = 0;
        (function pollRebalance() {

            if (rebalanceAttempts > 10) return; // 5s max
            if (info.advSignals && info.advSignals.length) {

        })();

        // ── FASE 1: Relay loading badge ──

        }
    }

    } catch (e) {

            if (caState && caState.currentIP && caState.currentIP !== lastIP) {

    // Relay loading polling (independent — tidak gantung ca-ip-ready)

            refreshTorList();
        } else {
            var cached = getVal(KEYS.TOR, null);
            if (cached && (Date.now() - cached.ts) > CFG.TOR_TTL_MS * 0.8) {

            }
        }
        setInterval(refreshTorList, CFG.TOR_TTL_MS);
    }

    // ── Public API ──

            console.log('[CA-VPN] ✅ Learned ASN cache cleared');
        },

        clearCache: function () {
            setVal(KEYS.TOR, null);
            setVal(KEYS.ASN, {});

setFase3Key: function(provider, key) {
    if (!FASE3_KEYS[provider]) {
        console.warn('[CA-FASE3] Unknown provider. Use: ipapi_is, vpnapi_io');
        return false;
    }
    var ok = setFase3Key(provider, key);
    if (ok && key) {
        try { W.__ca.showIndicator('🔑 ' + provider + ' key saved', '#10b981'); } catch(e) {}
    } else if (ok) {
        try { W.__ca.showIndicator('🗑️ ' + provider + ' key cleared', '#64748b'); } catch(e) {}
    }
    return ok;
},

getFase3Keys: function() {
    var out = {};
    for (var p in FASE3_KEYS) {
        var k = getFase3Key(p);
        out[p] = k ? (k.substring(0, 4) + '…' + k.substring(k.length - 4)) : '(not set)';
    }
    return out;
},

testFase3: function(ip) {
    ip = ip || (W.__ca && W.__ca.state && W.__ca.state.currentIP);
    if (!ip) { console.warn('[CA-FASE3] No IP'); return; }
    console.log('%c[CA-FASE3-TEST] ' + ip, 'color:#38bdf8;font-weight:bold;font-size:12px');
    FASE3_PROVIDERS.forEach(function(p) {
        if (p.needsKey && !getFase3Key(p.name)) {
            console.log('  ⏭️  ' + p.label + ' — SKIP (no key)');
            return;
        }
        GM_xmlhttpRequest({
            method: 'GET', url: p.url(ip), timeout: 5000,
            onload: function(r) {
                try {
                    var d = JSON.parse(r.responseText);
                    console.log('  ✅ ' + p.label + ':', { raw: d, parsed: p.parse(d) });
                } catch(e) { console.log('  ❌ ' + p.label + ' parse error:', e); }
            },
            onerror: function() { console.log('  ❌ ' + p.label + ' network error'); },
            ontimeout: function() { console.log('  ❌ ' + p.label + ' timeout'); }
        });
    });
},

clearFase3Cache: function() {
    try { localStorage.removeItem(FASE3_CACHE_KEY); } catch(e) {}
    try { W.__ca.showIndicator('🗑️ Fase3 cache cleared', '#64748b'); } catch(e) {}
}
    };
        // ⭐ FIX #3 (v2): Post-hoc version bump + expose API
    //    Pendekatan ini TIDAK menyentuh object W.__caVpnEnhancedAPI secara struktural,
    //    jadi tidak peduli apakah property clearFase3Cache ada atau tidak.
    try {
        W.__caVpnEnhancedAPI.version            = '2.0.0-parallel';
        W.__caVpnEnhancedAPI.enrichWithFase3    = enrichWithFase3;
        W.__caVpnEnhancedAPI.applyFase3Signals  = applyFase3Signals;
        W.__caVpnEnhancedAPI.getFase3Cache      = getFase3Cache;
        W.__caVpnEnhancedAPI.setFase3Cache      = setFase3Cache;
        W.__caVpnEnhancedAPI.FASE3_PROVIDERS    = FASE3_PROVIDERS;
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[CA-FIX-3] post-hoc exposure failed:', e);
    }

    console.log('%c[CA-VPN-ENHANCED v2.0.0-parallel] ✅ Fase 1/2/3 loaded',
        'color:#10b981;font-weight:900;font-size:12px');
    console.log('[CA-VPN]   Fase 1: Tor=' + ENABLE.TOR +
                ' · IPv6=' + ENABLE.IPV6_PTR +
                ' · Rebalance=' + ENABLE.SCORE_REBALANCE +
                ' · RelayLoading=' + ENABLE.RELAY_LOADING);
    console.log('[CA-VPN]   Fase 2: Cymru=' + ENABLE.TEAM_CYMRU +
                ' · Kitsune=' + ENABLE.KITSUNE);
    console.log('[CA-VPN]   Fase 3: IPAPI=' + (ENABLE.IPAPI_IS ? 'ON' : 'OFF') +
                ' (key=' + (CFG.IPAPI_KEY ? 'set' : 'MISSING') + ')');
    console.log('[CA-VPN]   API: window.__caVpnEnhancedAPI');
})();
